6. In a medium-sized saucepan, heat milk and the 2 tbsp butter over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened-- it will take anywhere from 5 to 10 minutes.
7. Spread this over baked crust in baking pan and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, or until golden; remove from oven but leave oven on.
8. Sprinkle the chocolate chips evenly over top; return to oven for 2 minutes, or until the chips soften and are shiny.
9. Remove from oven (turn oven off now) and spread the chocolate evenly; then sprinkle the Skor bits over the chocolate, pressing down with a very light touch to embed the Skor bits into the chocolate.
10. You could cut them into bars right away, but they will cut easier if allowed to chill in the refrigerator for at least a few minutes.
11. Best served at room temperature, not cold.

ingredients_reels: margarine | olive oil | fennel | salt | pepper | white wine | parmesan cheese
texte:
Fennel With Wine and Parmesan

Ingredients:
- 3 margarine
- 1 olive oil
- 1/2 fennel
- 1/4 salt
- 2/3 pepper
- white wine
- 3/4 parmesan cheese

Instructions:
1. Heat the margarine or oil in a wide non-stick pan.
2. Roast fennel (max heat) slices until light brown.
3. Reduce the heat to medium (in my case it needed about 10 minutes).
4. Add salt, pepper and wine.
5. Stir once and cover (medium-low heat).
6. Continue to cook until soft for about 10 minutes. If necessary add more wine or some water.
7. Adjust salt and pepper.
8. Now you have two possibilities (A and B).
9. A) Top with parmesan and continue to cook until parmesan melts (easiest and fast version).
10. B) Transfer fennel to a baking mold, top with parmesan and broil under grill shortly until parmesan changes color (beautiful and tasty). Don't burn it.
11. Serve warm as side dish.
12. Note: Small portions on a buffet woud be very cute as well. Reserve some fennel as decoration!

ingredients_reels: broccoli florets | carrot | red cabbage | green cabbage | raisins | sweet onion | mayonnaise | milk | sugar | vinegar | lemon juice
texte:
Broccoli and Raisin Coleslaw

Ingredients:
- 2 broccoli florets
- 1 carrot
- 1 red cabbage
- 1/4 - 1/2 green cabbage
- 1/2 raisins
- 1/2 sweet onion
- 1/4 - 1/2 mayonnaise
- 3 milk
- 2 sugar
- 1 vinegar
- lemon juice

Instructions:
1. In a serving bowl, combine all salad ingredients.
2. In a separate bowl, combine dressing ingredients.
3. Mix all together and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
4. Stir before serving.
5. Yield: 3 servings.

ingredients_reels: eggs | bananas | skim milk | unsweetened applesauce | vanilla | whole wheat flour | salt | baking soda | stevia powder | cinnamon | walnuts
texte:
Low Fat Stevia Banana Bread

Ingredients:
- 2 eggs
- 2 bananas
- 1/3 skim milk
- 2/3 unsweetened applesauce
- 1 vanilla
- 2 1/4 whole wheat flour
- 1/4 salt
- 1 baking soda
- 1 stevia powder
- 1 1/2 cinnamon
- walnuts

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 and prepare a 9x5 loaf pan.
2. Beat eggs by hand.  Then add in the applesauce, vanilla, milk and bananas.
3. In a seperate bowl combine dry ingredients - flour, stevia, baking soda, cinnamon and salt.
4. Add scoops of the dry ingredients into the egg mixture, mixing after each scoop until all combined.
5. Pour into loaf pan and bake 45 minutes to an hour.

ingredients_reels: flour | butter
texte:
Gumbo Base (Aka Roux)

Ingredients:
- 3/4 flour
- 3/4 butter

Instructions:
1. Melt Butter in a heavy bottomed skillet over medium to medium high heat.
2. Slowly sprinkle in the flour a little at a time, stirring constantly.
3. Continue to stir constantly.
4. Do not walk away!
5. If you burn it even the tiniest bit, it is unusable.
6. You will notice the flour beginning to brown.
7. The darker the flour, the darker the gravy.
8. For gumbo, when the roux reaches a deep dark chocolate brown color it is done.
9. At that point you would add your seasonings, such as onion, garlic, bell pepper and celery.
10. You can make this ahead of time and keep tightly covered in the frige or freezer.

ingredients_reels: shortening | butter | sugar | brown sugar | egg | vanilla | flour | baking soda | chocolate chips
texte:
Katie's Chocolate Chip Cookies

Ingredients:
- 1/3 shortening
- 1/3 butter
- 1/2 sugar
- 1/2 brown sugar
- 1 egg
- 1 vanilla
- 1 1/2 flour
- 1/2 baking soda
- 6 chocolate chips

Instructions:
1. Mix shortening, butter, sugars, egg and vanilla.
2. Sift dry ingredients together and stir in.
3. Mix in chocolate chips.
4. Drop rounded teaspoons 2\" apart.
5. Bake 8-10 minutes at 375 degrees.

ingredients_reels: unsalted butter | flour | ale | extra-sharp cheddar cheese | English mustard | Worcestershire sauce | Tabasco sauce | English muffins | bacon | parsley
texte:
Mean Chef's Welsh Rarebit

Ingredients:
- 3 unsalted butter
- 3 flour
- 2/3 ale
- 10 extra-sharp cheddar cheese
- 1 English mustard
- 1 Worcestershire sauce
- 2 -3 Tabasco sauce
- 6 English muffins
- 6 bacon
- parsley

Instructions:
1. Melt the butter in a saucepan over low heat, add the flour and whisk to make a roux.
2. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes.
3. Whisk in the ale and boil the mixture for 3 minutes while whisking.
4. Reduce heat to low, add the Cheddar cheese, mustard, Worcestershire, and Tabasco pepper sauce, and cook, stirring, until hot but not boiling.
5. Spoon the Cheddar mixture over the toasted muffins, garnish with parsley and serve with crispy bacon.

ingredients_reels: garlic cloves | shallots | fresh parsley | oregano leaves | salt | red pepper flakes | olive oil | red wine vinegar | water
texte:
Easy Chimichurri Marinade

Ingredients:
- 6 garlic cloves
- 2 shallots
- 2 fresh parsley
- 1/4 oregano leaves
- 1 salt
- 1 red pepper flakes
- 1 olive oil
- 1/2 red wine vinegar
- 1/4 water

Instructions:
1. Mince, or finely chop, the first 4 ingredients together and then add salt and pepper flakes.
2. Add the oil, vinegar and water to the above mixture.  Blend with a whisk and marinate meat and/or veggies overnight in this sauce.
3. Grill meat/veggies over medium heat.

ingredients_reels: tofu | soy sauce | garlic powder | olive oil | onion | carrots | zucchini | diced tomatoes | water | tomato juice | basil | oregano | garlic powder | salt | pepper | spaghetti | canned kidney beans
texte:
Minestrone With Tofu

Ingredients:
- 1 tofu
- 3 soy sauce
- 1/2 garlic powder
- 2 olive oil
- 1 onion
- 2 carrots
- 1 zucchini
- 28 diced tomatoes
- 4 water
- 2 tomato juice
- 2 basil
- 1 oregano
- 1/2 garlic powder
- 1/2 salt
- 1/2 pepper
- 3 spaghetti
- 15 canned kidney beans

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F.
2. Mix together the soy sauce and 1/2 tsp garlic powder.
3. Toss with the tofu cubes and spread on oiled cookie sheet.
4. Bake 15 minutes, flip and bake another 15 minutes until cubes crisp up.
5. When done, set aside.
6. Meanwhile heat oil and add the onion, carrots and zucchini.
7. Sauté for 10 minutes.
8. Then add the tomatoes, water, juice, basil, oregano, garlic powder, salt & pepper.
9. Bring to a boil and add the broken spaghetti; simmer for about 15 minutes.
10. Add the kidney beans and the browned tofu cubes.
11. Heat through and serve.

ingredients_reels: flour | sugar | pecans | butter | margarine | egg
texte:
Raspberry Bars

Ingredients:
- 2 1/4 flour
- 1 sugar
- 1 pecans
- 1 butter
- 1 margarine
- 1 egg

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, pecans, butter& egg.
2. Beat at low speed, scraping bowl often, until mixture is crumbly (about 2-3 minutes).
3. Reserve 1 1/2 cups crumb mixture; set aside.
4. Press remaining crumb mixture on bottom of greased 8- or 9-inch square baking pan.
5. Spread preserves to within 1/2 inch of edge.
6. Crumble reserved crumb mixture over preserves.
7. Bake 40-50 minutes or until lightly browned.
8. Cool completely; cut into bars or squares.

ingredients_reels: olive oil | Worcestershire sauce | ground beef | onion | bay leaf | bell pepper | garlic | diced tomatoes | tomato paste | water | tomato sauce | oregano | thyme | basil | salt | black pepper | marjoram | rosemary | lemon juice concentrate | brown sugar
texte:
Italian Spaghetti Meat Sauce

Ingredients:
- 2 olive oil
- 1/2 Worcestershire sauce
- 1 ground beef
- 1 onion
- 1 bay leaf
- 1 bell pepper
- 2 garlic
- 1 diced tomatoes
- 1 tomato paste
- 1/2 water
- 1 tomato sauce
- 1 oregano
- 1/8 thyme
- 1 basil
- 1/2 salt
- 1/2 black pepper
- 1/4 marjoram
- 1/8 rosemary
- 1 lemon juice concentrate
- brown sugar

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a heavy sauce pan.
2. Sauté garlic and onion, until onion is transparent.
3. Then add bay leaf, ground meat, cook until meat is no longer pink.
4. Stir in diced tomatoes, water and tomato paste, tomato sauce.
5. Add all the spices and then lemon juice.
6. Bring to a boil then reduce to simmer, uncovered for 1 to 2 hours or til sauce is desired consistency, stirring occasionally.
7. Remove bay leaf and then add brown sugar to taste.
8. Note: If you use ground turkey use two beef cubes or two teaspoons of beef soup base (use no salt).

ingredients_reels: eggs | milk | vanilla yogurt | vanilla | baking powder | sugar | butter | flour | farmer cheese | cottage cheese | butter | egg | sour cream | salt
texte:
Cheese Blintz Casserole

Ingredients:
- 3 eggs
- 3/4 milk
- 1/4 vanilla yogurt
- 1/2 vanilla
- 1 baking powder
- 1 sugar
- 2 1/2 butter
- 1 flour
- 8 farmer cheese
- 12 cottage cheese
- 2 butter
- 1 egg
- 2 sour cream
- salt

Instructions:
1. Mix the first 7 ingredients in a blender until blended.
2. Add the flour and mix again.
3. Pour half of batter mixture into a 9\" square greased or Pam’d casserole.
4. Bake at 350 for about 10 min or until set.
5. Mix the remaining ingredients to make the filling.
6. Spread filling evenly over the baked bottom layer.
7. Re-stir the remaining batter and pour it over the filling, trying to cover all the cheese layer.
8. Bake at 350 for about 40 min or until slightly browned.
9. Optional - brush top with melted butter the last 5 minute.

ingredients_reels: celery | cream cheese | sour cream | walnuts | green olives
texte:
Stuffed Celery

Ingredients:
- 1 celery
- 1 cream cheese
- 2 sour cream
- 1/4 walnuts
- 20 green olives

Instructions:
1. Coarsely chop the olives. Separate and wash celery stalks. Can remove celery strings, if desired.
2. Mix cream cheese and sour cream. Stir in walnuts and olives.
3. Spread filling into celery. Cut into bite-sized pieces. Chill until serving time.

ingredients_reels: green bell peppers | red bell peppers | ground pork | onion | garlic cloves | crushed tomatoes | tomato sauce | parsley | oregano | basil | sugar | marjoram | pepper | beef broth | instant brown rice | salt | mozzarella cheese
texte:
Parsley's Stuffed Peppers

Ingredients:
- 6 -7 green bell peppers
- 1 red bell peppers
- 1 ground pork
- 1 onion
- 4 -6 garlic cloves
- 1 crushed tomatoes
- 1 tomato sauce
- 2 parsley
- 1 oregano
- 1 basil
- 1 sugar
- 1/2 marjoram
- 1/2 pepper
- 3/4 beef broth
- 1 instant brown rice
- salt
- mozzarella cheese

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F  Lightly grease a deep large baking pan.
2. Cut tops off peppers and remove seeds.  Place hollowed peppers cut side up in the prepared baking dish.
3. In a large skillet, brown and crumble beef and pork with the onion and garlic; drain off fat and return to the skillet.
4. Add (to the cooked meat mixture in the skillet) the crushed tomatoes, about HALF of the tomato sauce, chopped parsley, oregano, basil, sugar, marjoram, and pepper.  Allow to come to a soft boil.
5. Add the beef broth and uncooked instant rice.  Stir well.  Bring to a soft boil; reduce heat.
6. Cover skillet and simmer gently for 15 minutes; stirring once or twice.
7. Stir again and add desired amount of salt; if needed.
8. Generously fill each hollowed bell pepper.  If any leftover filling exists, just pour more over each.
9. Top each with the RESERVED tomato sauce.
10. Loosely cover with foil and bake 45 minutes.
11. After 45 minutes, uncover (and IF using the optional mozzarella, sprinkle it on now) and bake uncovered for an additional 15 minutes.  (sometimes I put a bit more sauce over the cheese).

nom: Bow Ties With Chicken and Asiago Cheese Sauce
ingredients_reels: butter | all-purpose flour | evaporated milk | milk | chicken broth | asiago cheese | olive oil | boneless chicken breast | fresh parsley | garlic clove | salt | black pepper | bow tie pasta
texte:
Bow Ties With Chicken and Asiago Cheese Sauce

Ingredients:
- 2 butter
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 12 evaporated milk
- 1/2 milk
- 1/4 chicken broth
- 1 asiago cheese
- 1 olive oil
- 1 boneless chicken breast
- 2 fresh parsley
- 1 garlic clove
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 black pepper
- 1 bow tie pasta

Instructions:
1. In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the flour and stir just until mixed.
2. Add the evaporated milk, regular milk and chicken broth and cook, stirring often, until the sauce thickens and begins to simmer.
3. Remove from heat and add the Asiago cheese, stirring just until the cheese melts smoothly into the sauce. Set aside.
4. Heat the olive oil in a large, preferably non-stick, skillet. Add the cubed chicken, parsley and garlic, and continue to cook, stirring frequently, until the chicken is opaque and cooked through — 8 to 10 minutes. Add the Asiago sauce and season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine.
5. Meanwhile, cook the bow tie pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until tender but not mushy.
6. Drain well in a colander, then return pasta to the pot and add the chicken and Asiago sauce. Toss to combine and serve immediately, with additional grated Asiago cheese sprinkled on top, if desired.
7. If making ahead, transfer the sauce to a covered container and refrigerate. When you are ready to serve dinner, place sauce in a large saucepan and heat very gently over low heat, stirring often. Don’t let it boil.

nom: Peppery Bravas Potatoes  (red or Yukon Wedges)
ingredients_reels: olive oil | garlic | red pepper flakes | kosher salt | yukon gold potatoes
texte:
Peppery Bravas Potatoes  (red or Yukon Wedges)

Ingredients:
- 1/4 olive oil
- 1 garlic
- 2 red pepper flakes
- 1 kosher salt
- 2 yukon gold potatoes

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees Combine oil, garlic, pepper flakes and salt in a large bowl; add potatoes and toss to coat.
2. Spread potatoes on a baking sheet in a single layer; Cover with foil and roast for 15 minutes to steam.
3. Remove foil and continue to roast potatoes an additional 30 minutes or until tender and brown, stiring once or twice.

ingredients_reels: butter | margarine | brown sugar | salt | water | vanilla | cinnamon | oatmeal | wheat germ | coconut | raisins
texte:
Gourmet Granola

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 1/2 margarine
- 1 brown sugar
- 1/2 salt
- 1 water
- 1 vanilla
- 7 -8 cinnamon
- 1 oatmeal
- 1 wheat germ
- 1/2 coconut
- 1/2 - 1 raisins

Instructions:
1. Melt butter.
2. Mix butter with brown sugar, salt, water, vanilla and cinnamon in a small bowl In a large bowl, mix oatmeal, wheat germ, coconut and nuts and dried fruit.
3. Pour butter mixture over the dry mixture and toss to coat.
4. Spread on large, rimmed cookie sheet.
5. Bake for 30-45 minutes at 325.

nom: Marra's Low Fat Sugar Lemon Loaf
ingredients_reels: butter | margarine | unsweetened applesauce | sugar | Splenda sugar substitute | egg substitute | eggs | 1% fat buttermilk | all-purpose flour | baking powder | salt | lemon, zest of | Splenda sugar substitute
texte:
Marra's Low Fat Sugar Lemon Loaf

Ingredients:
- 1/4 butter
- 1/4 margarine
- 1/4 unsweetened applesauce
- 1/2 sugar
- 1/2 Splenda sugar substitute
- 1/2 egg substitute
- 1 1/2 eggs
- 1 1% fat buttermilk
- 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1/2 baking powder
- 1 salt
- 1 lemon, zest of
- 1/4 Splenda sugar substitute

Instructions:
1. Beat butter in a big bowl with sugar, Splenda and apple sauce and 1/4 cup egg substitute.
2. Add the rest of egg substitute (or second egg) and beat. Add the milk.
3. In another bowl, mix flour, baking powder, salt and lemon peel as well as almond extract if using.  . Pour into egg mixture. Mix only to wet.
4. With a spoon, pour in a greased loaf pan of 8 x 4 inch.
5. Cook in the oven at 350°F for 45 minutes to 1 hour until the loaf is cooked. Remove from oven and put on glaze.
6. Glaze: Put lemon juice and Splenda in a small saucepan. Heat and stir to dissolve sugar. Spoon over warm loaf.
7. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes. Remove from the pan, cool and wrap.

ingredients_reels: shortening | brown sugar | baking soda | flour | boiling water | oatmeal | pecans | chocolate chips
texte:
Egg Free Oatmeal Cookies

Ingredients:
- 1 shortening
- 1 brown sugar
- 1 baking soda
- 1 flour
- 1/4 boiling water
- 3 oatmeal
- 1/2 pecans
- 1 chocolate chips

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375F.
2. Mix first six ingredients thoroughly.
3. Stir in nuts and chips.
4. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet.
5. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes.

ingredients_reels: butter | powdered sugar | vanilla extract | cranberries | all-purpose flour | clove | cinnamon
texte:
Holiday Shortbread

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 1 powdered sugar
- 1 vanilla extract
- 1 cranberries
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 1 clove
- 1/8 cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Beat butter, sugar, and vanilla until smooth.
2. Add cranberries, flour cloves, and cinnamon.
3. Mix until doughy.
4. If you wish to divide dough in half, now is the time to do it.
5. Place dough on floured wax paper and with floured hands, form into a log. Approximately 1 1/2 around.
6. Wrap log(s) snugly in paper, then refrigerate until firm.  About 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
7. Once firm, unwrap log(s) and slice dough into cookies just under 1/2 inch thick.  Let sit at room temperature for five minutes if crumbling occurs.
8. Place on cookie sheet about 1 inch apart and cook at 350 degrees until lightly golden.  (Approximately 20 minutes).
9. Cool and enjoy!

ingredients_reels: butter | elbow macaroni | salt | pepper | cheese | milk | peas | broccoli
texte:
Raw Macaroni and Cheese

Ingredients:
- 3 butter
- 2 1/2 elbow macaroni
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 pepper
- 1/4 cheese
- 1 milk
- peas
- broccoli

Instructions:
1. Melt butter in a deep baking dish. Stir uncooked noodles in melted butter until well coated. Sprinkle salt and pepper and cheese on noodles. Pour milk on all until it just reaches the top of the noodles. (Do not stir) Bake at 375F for one hour. Do not stir.
2. You can add frozen vegetables to the dry noodles and place some meat on top before you bake. Peas, pepperoni, and colby jack cheese is my family's favorite. We've also loved other variations too.

ingredients_reels: potatoes | potatoes | hard-boiled eggs | salt | green onions | mayonnaise | mustard | pepper
texte:
Southern Potato Salad

Ingredients:
- 1 potatoes
- 4 potatoes
- 1/2 hard-boiled eggs
- 3 salt
- 1/2 green onions
- 1 mayonnaise
- 1 mustard
- 1/2 pepper

Instructions:
1. Cook potatoes in covered pot with boiling water 40 minutes or until tender; drain and cool.
2. Peel potatoes and cut into small pieces.
3. Separate egg whites from the yolks. Chop egg whites.
4. In a large bowl, stir together potato, egg whites, 1/2 tsp salt and green onions.
5. Using a fork, mash the yolks in a small bowl; add in mayo, pickle relish, mustard, and pepper; stirring until well blended.
6. Gently stir yolk mixture into potato mixture; adjust seasoning to taste with salt and pepper.
7. Cover and chill 2 hours (it is even better if you can chill this overnight and serve the next day).
8. Sprinkle with Paprika before serving.

ingredients_reels: white sugar | butter | margarine | eggs | all-purpose flour | baking powder | fresh lemon rind | low-fat milk | brown sugar | cinnamon
texte:
Fresh Plum Flan

Ingredients:
- 3/4 white sugar
- 1/4 butter
- 2 margarine
- 1 eggs
- 1 all-purpose flour
- 1 baking powder
- 1/4 fresh lemon rind
- 2 low-fat milk
- 1/2 brown sugar
- 1 cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Cream together sugar, butter.
2. Beat in eggs, beat well.
3. Combine flour, baking powder and rind.
4. Beat into egg mixture alternately with milk, making 3 additions of flour and 2 of milk.
5. Put batter into greased 10 inch springform pan or a 9 inch square baking dish.
6. Arrange plums, cut side down, in circles on top, gently press into batter.
7. Combine topping- sugar and cinnamon, sprinkle over fruit.
8. Bake in 350 degree (180 C) oven 45-55 minutes.

ingredients_reels: boneless beef top sirloin steak | Worcestershire sauce | fresh lemon juice | black pepper | fresh garlic | garlic powder | bacon | green bell pepper | red bell pepper | zucchini | fresh mushrooms | onion
texte:
Fantastic Grilled Beef Kabobs!

Ingredients:
- 1 boneless beef top sirloin steak
- 1 Worcestershire sauce
- 2 fresh lemon juice
- 2 black pepper
- fresh garlic
- 2 -3 garlic powder
- 8 -10 bacon
- 1 green bell pepper
- 1 red bell pepper
- 2 zucchini
- 8 fresh mushrooms
- 1 onion

Instructions:
1. In a bowl, combine salad dressing, Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice, pepper and fresh minced garlic or garlic powder (if using) mix well to combine; reserve about 1/4 cup and refrigerate.
2. Using a shallow glass dish place in the beef cubes, and pour the remaining marinade over the beef; toss to coat.
3. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight is even better.
4. After 8 hours, remove the beef, and discard the marinade.
5. Wrap the bacon slices around the beef cubes.
6. Then thread the beef alternately with the coarsely chopped veggies (make certain to thread the skewers through the wrapped bacon side, or the bacon will come open when grilled).
7. Grill over hot heat for about 10-15 minutes, basting frequently with reserved marinade, or until beef reaches desired tenderness.

ingredients_reels: bananas | mozzarella cheese | butter | sugar | cinnamon | nutmeg
texte:
Cartola

Ingredients:
- 2 bananas
- 2 mozzarella cheese
- 1 butter
- 1 sugar
- 1 cinnamon
- 1/8 nutmeg

Instructions:
1. Cut the bananas in half (long side).
2. Melt the butter on a frying pan then fry the halves of the bananas one side at a time.
3. When both sides looks dark brown, arrange the two halves of the bananas on plate.
4. Cover them with mozzarella cheese slices, put the remaining halves on top.
5. Sprinkle sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg.
6. Serve while it's hot!

ingredients_reels: sugar | water | cognac | unsalted butter | fresh strawberries | apples | pear | banana | tangerine | star fruit
texte:
Caramel-Cognac Fondue

Ingredients:
- 1/2 sugar
- 2 water
- 1 1/3 cognac
- 2 unsalted butter
- 1 fresh strawberries
- apples
- pear
- banana
- tangerine
- star fruit

Instructions:
1. Combine sugar and 2 tablespoons water in heavy medium saucepan.
2. Stir over low heat until sugar dissolves.
3. Increase heat; boil without stirring until mixture is deep amber color, occasionally brushing down sides of pan with wet pastry brush and swirling pan, about 3 minutes.
4. Add warm cream to caramel.
5. Stir over medium-high heat until sauce is smooth and reduced to 1 1/4 cups, about 5 minutes.
6. Add Cognac and cook 1 minute longer.
7. Remove from heat.
8. Add butter and stir until melted.
9. (Can be prepared 8 hours ahead. Cover and chill. Rewarm over medium-low heat before serving.) Transfer sauce to small fondue pot or flameproof ceramic bowl.
10. Set pot over candle or canned heat burner.
11. Serve with strawberries, apples or pears, bananas, tangerine segments and star fruit.

ingredients_reels: olive oil | potatoes | salt | butter | onions | anaheim chili | red bell pepper | garlic | monterey jack cheese | fresh lemon juice | peanuts | cilantro | lemon wedge
texte:
Peruvian Home Fries

Ingredients:
- 3 olive oil
- 2 potatoes
- 3/4 salt
- 1 -2 butter
- 1 1/2 - 2 onions
- 1 anaheim chili
- 1 red bell pepper
- 1 -2 garlic
- 3/4 monterey jack cheese
- 3 fresh lemon juice
- 1 peanuts
- cilantro
- lemon wedge

Instructions:
1. Place a 10\" skillet or saute pan over medium heat. When hot, add 1 tbls. oil, wait about 10 seconds, then swirl to coat pan. Turn heat up to medium high and add half the cooked potatoes, spreading them into a single layer in the hot oil. Let them cook without stirring 5 minutes.
2. Sprinkle in 1/8 teaspoons salt and turn potatoes over, using a metal spatula. Spread them into a single layer again. Let them cook 5-8 more minutes, or until golden. Scrape from the bottom to loosen potatoes and toss them around in the pan. Cook for another few minutes, then move to a plate, scraping out and saving all the tasty brown tidbits from the bottom of the pan. Repeat this procedure with the remaining potatoes, using another tbls. of the oil and anohter 1/8 teaspoons salt.
3. After cooking the potatoes, scrape out the pan, saving the scrapings, and wipe it out with a damp paper towel. Return the pan to the heat and when it is hot, add remaining tbsl. of oil You may also melt in a little butter. Wait 10 seconds, then swirl the pan. add the onion and saute over medium heat 5-8 minutes, or until it becomes very soft. Add the chiles and bell peppers, along with the remaining 1/2 teaspoons salt. Continue to cook, stirring often, for another 5-8 minutes.
4. Return the potatoes to the pan and stir them into the onion mixutre, along with the garlic. Saute over medium heat for another 10-20 minutes, or until everything is done to your liking. Sprinkle in the  cheese and lemon juice during the last few minutes of cooking, and if needed, adjust the salt.
5. Serve hot or warm, with peanuts and minced cilantro or parsley, and with lemon wedges on the side. Enjoy!
6. Note:
7. If prepping the potatoes in advance, store them in fresh water in a tightly covered container in the fridge. Drain and dry completely before using.

ingredients_reels: ground beef | paprika | ground cumin | chili powder | salt | cayenne pepper | black pepper | water | garlic
texte:
Hot Dog Sauce

Ingredients:
- 2 ground beef
- 1 paprika
- 2 ground cumin
- 2 chili powder
- 1 salt
- 1 cayenne pepper
- 1 black pepper
- water
- 2 garlic

Instructions:
1. Add enough water to cover ground beef.
2. Heat until it begins to boil, mash it with a potato masher until fine.
3. Add rest of ingredients.
4. Simmer 1/2 hour to 45 minutes.

nom: Beef Pot Roast (Pot, Oven or Slow Cooker)
ingredients_reels: boneless beef roast | Worcestershire sauce | instant beef bouillon | dried basil | new potatoes | sweet potatoes | carrots | parsnips | onions | celery ribs | flour
texte:
Beef Pot Roast (Pot, Oven or Slow Cooker)

Ingredients:
- 1 boneless beef roast
- 2 Worcestershire sauce
- instant beef bouillon
- 1 dried basil
- 1 new potatoes
- 1 sweet potatoes
- 3/4 carrots
- 1 parsnips
- 2 onions
- 2 celery ribs
- 1/4 flour

Instructions:
1. Trim fat from meat. Brown meat on all sides in hot oil in a 4- to 6-quart Dutch oven. Drain fat.
2. Mix 3/4 cup water, Worcestershire sauce, bouillon, basil and salt and pepper to taste.
3. Pour over roast. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, 1 hour.
4. Peel a strip of skin from center of each new potato or peel and quarter sweet potatoes.
5. Add potatoes, carrots, onions and celery to pot. Return to boil. Reduce heat.
6. Simmer covered, until tender, 45 to 60 minutes. Add water as needed.
7. Transfer meat and vegetables to platter. Reserve juices.
8. To prepare gravy, measure juices, skim off fat, and add enough water to make 1 1/2 cups. Return to Dutch oven.
9. In a small bowl, stir 1/2 cup water into flour. Stir into pan juices. Cook, stirring, on medium heat until thickened, then 1 minute more. Season to taste. Serve with pot roast.
10. For oven cooking: After browning meat and adding liquid mixture to pan, bake, covered, for 1 hour at 325 degrees. Prepare potatoes as directed. Add vegetables to meat. Bake, covered, until tender, 45 to 60 minutes. Make gravy as directed.
11. For slow cooker: Trim fat from meat. Slice vegetables into a 4- to 5-quart crockery cooker. Put meat on top of vegetables. Mix the liquid mixture to cooker. Cover and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours or on high for 5 to 6 hours. Prepare gravy as directed.

ingredients_reels: asparagus spears | salt | wine vinegar | Dijon mustard | shallots | green onions | fresh parsley
texte:
Asparagus With Vinaigrette

Ingredients:
- 24 asparagus spears
- salt
- 1 1/2 wine vinegar
- 1 1/2 Dijon mustard
- 1/4 shallots
- 1 1/2 green onions
- 1 1/2 fresh parsley

Instructions:
1. Trim asparagus.  Put in a skillet and cover with salted water.  Cook until crisp-tender.
2. Meanwhile, combine vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper in a mixing bowl and stir with a wire whisk.  Add the oil, stirring.  Stir in the shallots.
3. Arrange asparagus on serving plates.  Pout sauce over top.  Garnish with parsley.

ingredients_reels: russet potatoes | water | onions | bay leaf | half-and-half | salt | pepper | butter | smoked sausage
texte:
Irish Potato Soup

Ingredients:
- 4 russet potatoes
- 1 water
- 2 onions
- 1 bay leaf
- 1/2 half-and-half
- 2 salt
- 1/2 pepper
- 3 butter
- 1/2 smoked sausage

Instructions:
1. Peel and slice the potatoes.
2. Put potatoes into a soup pot with water, onions, and bay leaf.
3. Simmer covered for 45 minutes.
4. Puree soup in batches.
5. Add half and half, salt, and pepper. Also add smoked sausage if using.
6. Cook for 15 minutes on low just until heated thoroughly without scalding the half and half.
7. Add butter and serve.

nom: One-Bowl Ooey Gooey Peanut Butter Chip Blondies
ingredients_reels: margarine | butter | brown sugar | eggs | vanilla extract | flour | baking powder | salt
texte:
One-Bowl Ooey Gooey Peanut Butter Chip Blondies

Ingredients:
- 1/2 margarine
- 1 3/4 butter
- 2 brown sugar
- 2 eggs
- 1 1/2 vanilla extract
- 1/2 flour
- 1/4 baking powder
- 6 salt

Instructions:
1. In a large microwave-safe bowl, heat margarine or butter in the microwave on half-power until mostly melted.
2. With a wire whisk, mix in brown sugar.  Beat in eggs and vanilla extract.
3. Dump in flour, baking soda and salt (if you're a purist, you can mix them in a separate bowl ahead of time, but I've always had just as good of results with the single-bowl method).  Stir with a large wooden or plastic spoon until flour is completely incorporated.
4. Add peanut butter chips and stir.
5. Pour batter into a greased 13x9-inch pan and bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes or until it's nicely browned and looks set.
6. Meanwhile, eat any remaining batter sticking to the bowl. :).
7. If you like your blondies more done, you can bake them a bit longer until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.  I have no idea how long that takes because I've never gone that far.  I find they're just right at about 22 minutes, and definitely best when warm.

ingredients_reels: bulk sausage | butter | onions | celery | mushrooms | cornbread stuffing mix | rubbed sage | dried thyme | poultry seasoning | salt | fresh ground pepper | pecans | turkey broth | chicken broth | eggs
texte:
Mom's Best Stuffing

Ingredients:
- 12 bulk sausage
- 1/2 butter
- 3 onions
- 1 celery
- 3 mushrooms
- 6 cornbread stuffing mix
- 6 rubbed sage
- 1 dried thyme
- 1 poultry seasoning
- 1 salt
- 1 fresh ground pepper
- 1 pecans
- 1 turkey broth
- 1 1/2 chicken broth
- 2 eggs

Instructions:
1. Saute sausage until brown; remove from pan and cut into small bites.
2. In a large skillet, melt butter and cook onion, celery, and mushrooms over medium heat for 3 minutes or until softened.
3. Transfer sausage and veggies, including any butter that is left in the pan to a bowl.
4. Add stuffing mix, bread cubes, sage, thyme, poultry seasoning, salt, pepper, pecans, turkey stock, and eggs.
5. Toss well and adjust seasoning.
6. Stuffing should be moist but not soggy. Add more stock if needed.
7. Transfer to a baking dish.
8. Bake in a 325 degree Fahrenheit oven for 20 minutes covered and 10 minutes uncovered until heated through and crust forms on top.
9. Or better yet stuff it into a big fat turkey.

ingredients_reels: solid white tuna packed in water | fresh lemon juice | celery | red onions | dill pickles | garlic | salt | ground black pepper | fresh parsley leaves | mayonnaise | Dijon mustard
texte:
Classic Tuna Salad

Ingredients:
- 2 solid white tuna packed in water
- 2 fresh lemon juice
- 1 celery
- 2 red onions
- 2 dill pickles
- 1/2 garlic
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 ground black pepper
- 2 fresh parsley leaves
- 1/2 mayonnaise
- 1/4 Dijon mustard

Instructions:
1. Place the tuna in a colander and drain well.
2. Shred the tuna with your fingers, breaking up any clumps until it has a fine and even texture.
3. Put the tuna in a medium bowl and mix in the lemon juice, celery, onion, pickles, garlic, salt, pepper, and parsley until well blended.
4. Fold in the mayonnaise and Dijon until mixture is evenly moistened.
5. Salad can be kept covered in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

ingredients_reels: sugar | white vinegar | dry mustard | turmeric | cabbage | green pepper | onion
texte:
Mother's Cabbage Relish

Ingredients:
- 1 sugar
- 1 white vinegar
- 1 dry mustard
- 1 turmeric
- 1 cabbage
- 1 green pepper
- 1 onion

Instructions:
1. Combine first four ingredients in saucepan, boil 1 minute.
2. Pour hot mixture over slaw.
3. Chill.
4. In a covered dish relish will keep for up to one week.

ingredients_reels: russet potato | unsalted butter | unsalted butter | sour cream | parsley
texte:
Mashed Potatoes With Sour Cream

Ingredients:
- 1 russet potato
- 2 unsalted butter
- 2 unsalted butter
- 1/3 sour cream
- 2 parsley

Instructions:
1. Place potatoes in a heavy saucepan.
2. Cover with salted water.
3. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low.
4. Cover saucepan and simmer 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Drain, reserving 1/3 cup liquid.
5. Add butter, sour cream, and salt and pepper to taste.
6. Mash until smooth with an electric mixer or hand masher, adding reserved cooking liquid as necessary to moisten potatoes.
7. Stir in parsley. Serve potatoes with mushroom gravy.

ingredients_reels: potatoes | cream cheese | bacon bits | cheddar cheese | red pepper flakes
texte:
5 Ingredient Baked Potato Skins

Ingredients:
- 4 potatoes
- 4 cream cheese
- 1/4 bacon bits
- 3/4 cheddar cheese
- 1 red pepper flakes

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400.
2. Cut potatoes into quarters lengthwise, scoop out center leaving 1/2 inch of flesh, reserve centers for another use.
3. Combine cream cheese, cheddar, bacon bits and pepper flakes until blended, mixture should be thick.
4. Press onto each skin.
5. Bake for 15 minutes, switch to broil and toast tops for another 3 or until lightly browned.
6. Cooking time may vary depending on if potatoes have been refrigerated.
7. For OAMC, tightly wrap in plastic wrap or vacuum seal and freeze, these reheat in 5-7 minutes in a toaster oven, great for hungry teens and superbowl parties!

nom: Red Curry Sauce for Fish, Rice, or Veggies
ingredients_reels: red curry paste | coconut milk | brown sugar
texte:
Red Curry Sauce for Fish, Rice, or Veggies

Ingredients:
- 3 -4 red curry paste
- 1 1/2 coconut milk
- 2 brown sugar

Instructions:
1. Whisk all ingredients in a small saucepan until blended. Add more curry to taste; be careful, a lot goes a long way.
2. Heat over medium-low until bubbling. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.
3. Pour over fish, rice, and vegetables.

ingredients_reels: olive oil | shrimp | garlic | basil | butter | linguine | asiago cheese
texte:
Shrimp Linguine With Basil-Garlic Butter

Ingredients:
- 3 olive oil
- 1 shrimp
- 2 garlic
- 3 basil
- 3 butter
- 1 linguine
- asiago cheese

Instructions:
1. Boil water for the linguine, adding 1 tbsp of the olive oil and a pinch of salt to the water. Cook the linguine for 7-8 minutes (al dente), stirring every minute. While the pasta is cooking, heat a large skillet with remaining olive oil.
2. When th e oil is hot, add the shrimp to the skillet, sauteeing until the shrimp turns pink, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Add the garlic and the basil and cook an additional 2-3 minutes.
4. Add the butter, and toss in the pasta, making sure to coat the pasta with the sauce. Remove from heat.
5. Serve immediately and garnish with the Asiago cheese as desired!

ingredients_reels: orzo pasta | zucchini | carrots | tomatoes | water | white wine | salt | white pepper | shrimp | minced garlic cloves | curry powder | olive oil | fresh lemon juice | salt | pepper
texte:
Orzo With Baked Shrimps

- 2 tomatoes

- 200 white wine

- salt

Instructions:
1. Put in a pot, the water ,the vegetables (zucchini, carrots, tomatoes), the wine and season with salt and pepper.

3. Put it again in the same pot and when it boils cook the orzo for 7 minutes. Drain.

7. Serve the orzo, add the shrimps on top and the add the vinaigrette sauce.

ingredients_reels: boneless skinless chicken breast halves | monterey jack pepper cheese | barbecue sauce
texte:
Barbecue Jack Chicken

Ingredients:
- 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves
- 4 monterey jack pepper cheese
- 1 barbecue sauce

Instructions:
1. Carefully cut a pocket in each chicken breast half. Fill with cheese; secure with metal or soaked wooden skewers. Grill chicken, covered, over medium heat or broil 4 inches from the heat for 6-8 minutes on each side or until juices run clear, basting frequently with barbecue sauce.

texte:
Creamy Miso Dressing

1. Combine all ingredients and whisk to blend well.

ingredients_reels: Spanish onions | olive oil | garlic cloves | thyme | mushroom | garlic cloves | olive oil | white wine | butter | onion | celery | Dark Vegetable Stock | soy sauce | fresh ground pepper
texte:
Roasted Onion & Mushroom Soup

- 1 olive oil
- 4 garlic cloves

- 1 mushroom
- 4 garlic cloves
- 1 olive oil
- 1/2 white wine
- 2 butter

- 6 Dark Vegetable Stock
- 2 soy sauce
- fresh ground pepper

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375.
2. Combine first four ingredients in a non-reactive baking dish (glass, corningware - not metal), and roast, stirring several times, for 45 minutes.

4. Deglaze onions with wine.
5. Melt butter in soup pot, add chopped onions and celery, and sweat  until onions are translucent.  Add roasted onions, mushrooms, stock, and soy sauce, and simmer 30 minutes, adding additional soy sauce if necessary.
6. Add fresh ground pepper to taste.

texte:
Memo's Molasses Cookies

Ingredients:
- 3/4 shortening
- 1 sugar
- 1/4 unsulphured molasses
- 1 egg

- 2 baking soda

- 1/2 ginger

1. Melt shortening, cool.  Add sugar, molasses and egg; beat well.
2. Sift dry ingredients, add to first mixture and mix well.

5. Bake at 375 degrees for 7-8 minutes.  Cookies should be light, pillowy and soft, not dark and crispy.

ingredients_reels: potatoes | baby dill pickles | onion | granny smith apple | mayonnaise | pickle juice | sugar | salt | pepper
texte:
Berliner Kartoffelsalat / Berliner Potato Salad

Ingredients:
- 2 potatoes
- 5 -6 baby dill pickles
- 1 onion
- 1 granny smith apple
- 16 mayonnaise
- 6 pickle juice
- 1 sugar

- 1/2 pepper

Instructions:
1. Make sure onion, pickles and apple are chopped the same size.
2. Boil the whole potatoes with their skins on until tender about 20-30 minutes.
3. Remove from pot and let rest until cool enough to handle but still warm, then peel and dice into preferred size.
4. In a bowl combine all the ingredients except potatoes.

ingredients_reels: cake flour | salt | baking powder | unsalted butter | sugar | eggs | vanilla extract | pecans | walnuts
texte:
Classic Brownies

Ingredients:

- 6 unsalted butter
- 12 sugar

- 4 vanilla extract
- 1 pecans

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 325°.
2. Cut 18\" length foil and fold lenghtwise to 8\" width.
3. Fit foil into 13x9\" baking dish.
4. Make sure it is in the corners and sides of the baking dish.
5. Make sure that the foil hangs over the side.
6. Cut a 14 inch length foil, and fit into width of pan, perpendicular to first sheet.
7. Make sure the foil hangs over the side.
8. Spray foil with cooking spray.
9. In a medium bowl, combine flour, salt, and baking powder; set aside.
10. Melt chocolate and butter in double broiler, stirring until smooth.
11. When chocolate is smooth, remove from heat and gradually whisk in sugar.
12. Add eggs one at a time, whisking after each egg.
13. Add in vanilla.
14. Add 1/3 flour mixture, fold in with rubber spatula.
15. Repeat until all flour is used and mix is smooth.
16. Pour batter into prepared pan- make sure to spread brownie mix into corners of pan.
17. Smooth the surface for even baking.
18. If using nuts, sprinkle them on top.
19. Cook brownies for 30 to 35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the brownies comes out clean.
20. Cool in pan on wire rack for 2 hours.
21. Remove brownies from pan by lifting foil over-hang.
22. Cut brownies into 2\" squares.
23. Brownies can can be stored in an airtight container up to 3 days.

nom: Pineapple Nectar Cake With Cream Cheese Icing

nom: Breakfast Strata With Spinach and Mushroom
ingredients_reels: unsalted butter | shallots | mushrooms | frozen chopped spinach | dry white wine | havarti cheese | gruyere cheese | eggs | half-and-half | salt | ground black pepper
texte:
Breakfast Strata With Spinach and Mushroom

Ingredients:
- 14 unsalted butter
- 9 shallots
- 8 mushrooms
- 8 frozen chopped spinach
- 20 dry white wine
- 1 havarti cheese
- 12 gruyere cheese
- 12 eggs
- 2 1/2 half-and-half
- salt
- ground black pepper

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 225 degrees. Arrange bread slices in a single layer on 2 large baking sheets and bake until dry and crisp, about 40 minutes, turning slices over halfway through drying time. (Alternatively, leave slices out overnight to dry.) When cooled, butter slices on one side using 4 tablespoons of butter; set aside. (Note: I used Smart Balance® with just a thin coating on each slice).
2. Heat 3 1/2 tablespoons butter in large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Sauté shallots and mushrooms until shallots become fragrant and translucent, about 3 minutes.
3. Add spinach to skillet. Season with salt and pepper to taste and cook, stirring occasionally, until spinach and shallots are combined, about 3 minutes. Transfer to medium bowl; set aside.
4. Add wine to skillet, increase heat to medium-high, and simmer until reduced to 1/2 cup, 3 to 4 minutes; set aside.
5. Butter a 9x13-inch baking dish with remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons butter.
6. Arrange half the buttered bread slices, buttered-side up, in single layer in dish. Spread half of spinach mixture, then lay half of the cheese evenly over bread slices. Arrange remaining bread slices in single layer over cheese; spread remaining spinach mixture and the remaining cheese evenly over bread.
7. Whisk eggs in medium bowl until combined; whisk in reduced wine, half-and-half, 2 teaspoon salt, and pepper to taste. Pour egg mixture evenly over bread layers; cover surface flush with plastic wrap, weigh down (see note, below), and refrigerate at least 1 hour or up to overnight.
8. Remove dish from refrigerator and let stand at room temperature 20 minutes. Meanwhile, adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 325 degrees. Uncover strata and bake until both edges and center are puffed and edges have pulled away slightly from sides of dish,  60 to 65 minutes (or about 50 to 55 minutes for halved recipe). Cool on wire rack 5 minutes; serve.
9. NOTE: By weighing down the strata, all of the bread is able to soak in the custard. To weigh down the assembled strata, two 1-pound boxes of brown or powdered sugar, laid side by side over the plastic-covered surface, make ideal weights. A gallon-sized zipper-lock bag filled with about 2 pounds of sugar or rice also works. This recipe halves easily; use one 8x8-inch baking dish greased with only 1 tablespoon butter and reduce the baking time as directed in step 8.
10. A word about substituting fat-free half-and-half:  The second time I made this recipe, I used fat-free half-and-half. The strata was soggy, not like the original recipe, even though I baked it longer. I think the custard needed more fat from the half-and-half in order to set properly.
11. If you try this with fresh spinach, cook it first, squeeze it dry, then use it in place of frozen.

texte:
Nutty Peanut Butter Cookies

ingredients_reels: brown sugar | butter | baking soda | ground cinnamon | pure vanilla extract | salt | eggs | oats | flour | raisins
