nom: The Simplest Tomato Sauce Ever  (Marcella Hazan)
ingredients_reels: canned plum tomatoes | unsalted butter | yellow onion | salt
texte:
The Simplest Tomato Sauce Ever  (Marcella Hazan)

Ingredients:
- 2 canned plum tomatoes
- 5 unsalted butter
- 1 yellow onion
- salt

Instructions:
1. Combine the tomatoes, their juices, the butter, and the onion halves in a medium saucepan.
2. Add a pinch or two of salt. Place over medium heat and bring to a simmer. Cook, uncovered, at a very slow but steady simmer, adjusting the heat as necessary, for about 45 minutes, or until droplets of fat float free from the tomato.
3. Stir occasionally, mashing any large pieces of tomato with the back of a wooden spoon. Taste and salt as needed.
4. Discard the onion.

ingredients_reels: flour tortillas | olive oil | kosher salt | sour cream | lime | ground cumin | fresh ground black pepper | fresh cilantro | fresh parsley leaves
texte:
Crispy Open-Faced Quesadillas

Ingredients:
- 2 flour tortillas
- 2 olive oil
- kosher salt
- 1/4 sour cream
- 1 lime
- 1/2 ground cumin
- fresh ground black pepper
- 1 1/2 fresh cilantro
- 1 fresh parsley leaves

Instructions:
1. Preheat the broiler.
2. Brush the tortillas on both sides with  oil and lightly salt.
3. Heat a large saute pan over medium heat and cook the tortillas, 1 at a time, until slightly golden on both sides.
4. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix together the sour cream, lime zest and juice, cumin, and salt and pepper, to taste, until smooth. Pour into a plastic squeeze bottle or sturdy resealable plastic bag and cut small tip in corner.
5. Arrange the browned tortillas on a baking sheet and sprinkle evenly with cheese. (You may need to do this in batches if both tortillas don't fit on 1 tray.).
6. Broil until the cheese bubbles and begins to brown, about for 1 to 2 minutes, being careful not to burn.
7. Slice each quesadilla into 8 wedges and drizzle sour cream decoratively over the top.
8. Sprinkle with cilantro and serve.

ingredients_reels: olive oil | chicken breasts | salt | pepper | chicken broth | capers | rosemary | thyme | Dijon mustard | butter | honey
texte:
Honey Dijon Chicken with Capers

Ingredients:
- 1 olive oil
- 2 chicken breasts
- salt
- pepper
- 1/3 chicken broth
- 2 capers
- 1/2 rosemary
- 1/4 thyme
- 1 Dijon mustard
- 1 butter
- 1 honey

Instructions:
1. Salt and Pepper chicken on both sides to season.
2. Heat oil over med.
3. high in frying pan, cook chicken 5-6 minutes per side.
4. Pour in broth, capers, rosemary and thyme.
5. Return to simmer for 5 minutes.
6. Stir in mustard, butter and honey and immediately remove from heat.
7. Serve with spooning remaining sauce over each breast.

ingredients_reels: granny smith apples | water | ground cinnamon | brown sugar | light corn syrup | butter | margarine | pecan pieces | eggs | milk | vanilla | ground nutmeg
texte:
Caramel Apple Breakfast Pudding

Ingredients:
- 2 granny smith apples
- 1/4 water
- 3/4 ground cinnamon
- 1/2 brown sugar
- 2 light corn syrup
- 2 butter
- 1/4 margarine
- 3 pecan pieces
- 1 1/4 eggs
- 1 milk
- 1/4 vanilla
- 8 -10 ground nutmeg

Instructions:
1. In a saucepan, add apples and water; bring mixture to boiling; lower heat.
2. Cover and cook over medium-low for 5-7 minutes or until apples are tender; stirring frequently.
3. Drain apples and transfer to a small bowl.
4. Stir in cinnamon and set apples aside.
5. In the same saucepan, add brown sugar, corn syrup, and butter.
6. Cook and stir over medium heat until just reaches boiling.
7. Remove from heat.
8. Pour mixture into an ungreased 2-quart square baking dish.
9. Sprinkle evenly with pecans.
10. In another bowl, add eggs, milk, vanilla, and nutmeg; mix well.
11. Place half of the bread slices on top of the caramel, trimming bread to fit.
12. Spoon apples evenly over the bread slices.
13. Place remaining bread slices over apples.
14. Pour egg mixture evenly over bread slices; press bread down gently to moisten completely.
15. Cover and chill if refrigerator for 3 to 24 hours.
16. In a 325°F oven, bake, uncovered, for 40-45 minutes or until knife comes out clean.
17. Run a knife around the edges to loosen.
18. Cool in pan on a wire rack for 15 minutes.
19. Carefully invert pudding onto a platter (Spoon any remaining caramel mixture in dish over pudding).
20. Cut and serve warm.

ingredients_reels: butter | olive oil | onion | celery | potatoes | sausage | chicken broth | spinach | heavy cream | milk | fresh basil
texte:
Spinach Sausage and Potato Soup

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 1 olive oil
- 1 onion
- 2 celery
- 2 potatoes
- 2 sausage
- 4 chicken broth
- 3 -4 spinach
- heavy cream
- milk
- fresh basil

Instructions:
1. Sauté first four ingredients.  When translucent, add potato and sausage; continue sautéeing for about 10 minutes.
2. Add broth and simmer for 20 minutes.
3. Add spinach and simmer till spinach is just cooked; add cream if you like.
4. You can blend this with a hand blender or in a blender or serve it as is. Season to taste.

ingredients_reels: distilled white vinegar | cider vinegar | sugar | vanilla | cocoa powder
texte:
Weight Watchers Chocolate Meringue Cookies

Ingredients:
- 4 distilled white vinegar
- 1/2 cider vinegar
- 1 sugar
- 2 vanilla
- 4 cocoa powder

Instructions:
1. Beat egg whites till frothy.
2. Add vinegar and beat till soft peaks form.
3. Increase the mixer to high and gradually add in the sugar until glossy peaks form.
4. Beat in vanilla.
5. Add cocoa and mix by hand.
6. Line two cookie sheets with foil and (lightly) spray with Pam.
7. Drop mixture by tablespoon fulls about 1 in apart on pans.
8. Should make 44 cookies.
9. Bake at 200 degrees F for 3 hours.
10. Let cool completely on cookie sheet for about 1 hours.
11. Remove and store leftovers in an air proof container.

ingredients_reels: graham cracker crumbs | flour | baking powder | sweetened condensed milk | margarine | coconut | chocolate chips | pecans
texte:
Chocolate Chip Graham Cookies

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 graham cracker crumbs
- 1/2 flour
- 2 baking powder
- 1 sweetened condensed milk
- 1/2 margarine
- 1 1/3 coconut
- 2 chocolate chips
- pecans

Instructions:
1. Mix first 6 ingredients till well blended.
2. Add chips and nuts; mix again.
3. Bake 8-10 minutes on greased cookie sheet, being careful not to overcook.
4. Watch the temp on your oven, should bake between 350-375°F .
5. NOTE: If you are finding they are baking to quickly and/or burning just turn down your oven temperature (the sweetened condensed milk can cause burning around edges if temp is to high, I cook mine at 350°F).
6. These are better the second day!

ingredients_reels: bulbs shallots | olive oil | kosher salt | green beans
texte:
Green Beans and Shallots

Ingredients:
- 6 bulbs shallots
- 1/4 olive oil
- kosher salt
- 6 green beans

Instructions:
1. Peel and slice the shallots thinly.
2. Heat a sauce pan over medium heat and put the olive oil and shallots in the pan.
3. Saute the shallots until caramelized, maybe 20 minutes.
4. You can prepare this far ahead of time.
5. Take the stems off the beans but otherwise leave whole.
6. Steam them briefly until just tender but still crisp.
7. Toss the beans with the shallots and oil and season with salt and serve.

ingredients_reels: salt | sugar | powdered sugar | paprika | curry powder | onion powder | garlic powder | cornstarch | cinnamon | black pepper
texte:
Half the Sodium  Seasoned Salt

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 salt
- 1 sugar
- 1 powdered sugar
- 2 paprika
- 1 curry powder
- 1/2 onion powder
- 1/2 garlic powder
- 1/2 cornstarch
- 1/8 cinnamon
- 1/8 black pepper

Instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and mix well.
2. Pour the blend into an empty spice bottle to store.

ingredients_reels: elbow macaroni | butter | salt | pepper | flour | milk | medium cheddar
texte:
Lyssie's Best Macaroni and Cheese

Ingredients:
- 2 elbow macaroni
- 1/4 butter
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 pepper
- 1/4 flour
- 1 3/4 milk
- 1 medium cheddar

Instructions:
1. Cook elbow macaroni as directed, in fairly salty water.
2. Melt butter in frying pan over medium heat. Stir in salt and pepper. Add flour, and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until smooth (about a minute or two.you really want to cook the flour, without making it brown).
3. Remove the frying pan from the stove and add milk.
4. Return the frying pan to the burner and gradually increase heat as you stir constantly. When mixture boils, continue to stir for one minute, then remove from heat. Stir in shredded cheddar cheese.
5. Add cheese sauce to the macaroni and stir thoroughly.
6. Bake uncovered at 375 degrees for 30 minutes. Remove from oven, sprinkle top with paprika, then bake for another five minutes.

ingredients_reels: grapefruit | sugar
texte:
Toasted Grapefruit

Ingredients:
- 1 grapefruit
- 2 sugar

Instructions:
1. Cut the grapefruit in half.
2. Place cut- side - up on a baking tray and sprinkle a tablespoon of sugar over each half.
3. Grill until sugar starts to bubble.

ingredients_reels: brown sugar | walnuts | ground cinnamon | butter | sugar | eggs | sour cream | vanilla | flour | baking powder | baking soda | salt
texte:
Sour Cream Coffee Cake Muffins

Ingredients:
- 1/2 brown sugar
- 1/2 walnuts
- 1 ground cinnamon
- 1/2 butter
- 1/2 sugar
- 2 eggs
- 1 sour cream
- 1 vanilla
- 2 flour
- 1 baking powder
- 1 baking soda
- 1/4 salt

Instructions:
1. Mix brown sugar walnuts and cinnamon together and set aside.
2. Muffin: Mix butter, sugar and eggs.
3. Add sour cream and vanilla.
4. Add dry ingredients.
5. Marble the brown sugar mixture through the batter using a table knife.
6. Reserve a few tablespoons for sprinkling on top.
7. Fill 12 greased muffin cups.
8. Sprinkle remaining brown sugar mix on top of each.
9. Bake at 375 degrees for 22 minutes.
10. Remove from pan and cool.

nom: Best Ever Banana Cake With Cream Cheese Frosting
ingredients_reels: bananas | lemon juice | flour | baking soda | salt | butter | sugar | eggs | vanilla | buttermilk | butter | cream cheese | vanilla | icing sugar | walnuts
texte:
Best Ever Banana Cake With Cream Cheese Frosting

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 bananas
- 2 lemon juice
- 3 flour
- 1 1/2 baking soda
- 1/4 salt
- 3/4 butter
- 2 1/8 sugar
- 3 eggs
- 2 vanilla
- 1 1/2 buttermilk
- 1/2 butter
- 1 cream cheese
- 1 vanilla
- 3 1/2 icing sugar
- walnuts

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 275°F (135C).
2. Grease and flour a 9 x 13 pan.
3. In a small bowl, mix mashed banana with the lemon juice; set aside.
4. In a medium bowl, mix flour, baking soda and salt; set aside.
5. In a large bowl, cream 3/4 cup butter and  2 1/8 cups sugar until light and fluffy.
6. Beat in eggs, one at a time, then stir in 2 tsp vanilla.
7. Beat in the flour mixture alternately with the buttermilk.
8. Stir in banana mixture.
9. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake in preheated oven for one hour or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
10. Remove from oven and place directly into the freezer for 45 minutes.  This will make the cake very moist.
11. For the frosting, cream the butter and cream cheese until smooth.
12. Beat in 1 teaspoon vanilla.
13. Add icing sugar and beat on low speed until combined, then on high speed until frosting is smooth.
14. Spread on cooled cake.
15. Sprinkle chopped walnuts over top of the frosting, if desired.

ingredients_reels: sugar | butter | cocoa powder | cocoa powder | milk | creamy peanut butter | oats | wheat germ | powdered milk
texte:
No-Bake Cookies (Oamc)

Ingredients:
- 2 sugar
- 1/2 butter
- 1/4 cocoa powder
- 2 cocoa powder
- 1/2 milk
- 1 creamy peanut butter
- 4 oats
- 1 wheat germ
- 1 powdered milk

Instructions:
1. ASSEMBLY DIRECTIONS:.
2. In a saucepan, bring the sugar, butter, cocoa powder and milk together to a boil.
3. As soon as it boils, remove it immediately from the heat and stir in the remaining ingredients.
4. While still hot, drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper.
5. Allow to cool and harden.
6. FREEZING:.
7. Label and freeze in a rigid containers.

nom: Luby's Cafeteria Baked Corned Beef Brisket W/ Sour Cream New Pot
ingredients_reels: corned beef brisket | brown sugar | prepared mustard | potatoes | sour cream | butter | margarine | salt | pepper
texte:
Luby's Cafeteria Baked Corned Beef Brisket W/ Sour Cream New Pot

Ingredients:
- 4 corned beef brisket
- 1 brown sugar
- 1/4 prepared mustard
- 3 potatoes
- 2 sour cream
- 1/2 butter
- 2 margarine
- salt
- pepper

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 225 degrees F.
2. In a roasting pan with a cover, place the meat. Cover and bake in the preheated oven for 3-1/2 hours or until tender.
3. Remove from the oven. Increase the oven temperature to 350 degrees F.
4. In a small bowl, mix the brown sugar and mustard. Spread the mixture over the meat. Bake uncovered for 15 minutes.
5. In a large saucepan, boil the potatoes in enough water to cover for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender. Drain.
6. In a bowl, whisk together the sour cream, butter/margarine, horseradish, salt, and white pepper.
7. Pour the mixture over the potatoes. Using a rubber scraper, mix gently to coat evenly. Serve with the meat.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | sweetened flaked coconut | brown sugar | baking soda | butter | sugar | eggs | crushed pineapple | flaked coconut
texte:
Pineapple Coconut Bars

Ingredients:
- 3 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1 sweetened flaked coconut
- 1 brown sugar
- 1 baking soda
- 1 butter
- 1 sugar
- 3 eggs
- 1 crushed pineapple
- flaked coconut

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees; lightly grease a 13x9-inch baking pan.
2. In large bowl, combine 2 1/2 cups flour, coconut, brown sugar, and baking soda.
3. Using a pastry blender, cut in 1/2 cup butter until mixture is crumbly.
4. Reserve 1 cup crumb mixture for topping.
5. Press remaining crumb mixture evenly into bottom of prepared pan.
6. Bake for 10 minutes.
7. In medium bowl, beat remaining 1/2 cup butter and sugar at medium speed with an electric mixer until creamy.
8. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
9. Gradually beat in remaining 1 cup flour.
10. Stir in pineapple.
11. Spread mixture evenly over baked layer.
12. Sprinkle evenly with reserved crumb mixture.
13. Bake for 25 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.
14. Let cool completely before cutting into squares.
15. Garnish with toasted flaked coconut, if desired.

ingredients_reels: carrots | salt | butter | honey | lemon juice
texte:
Honeyed Carrots

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 carrots
- 1/2 salt
- 3 butter
- 1/3 honey
- 1 lemon juice

Instructions:
1. Steam or boil carrots in salted water for 10-15 minutes until they are tender-crisp and drain.
2. Heat butter, honey and lemon juice in a heavy skillet for about 2 minutes or until hot and bubbly, stirring often.
3. Add carrots; cook uncovered 4-7 minutes or until they are glazed, stirring frequently.

ingredients_reels: chicken broth | carrots | scallion | milk | all-purpose flour | ground mustard | pepper | cream cheese | sharp cheddar cheese
texte:
Creamy Cheese Soup

Ingredients:
- 3 chicken broth
- 1 1/2 carrots
- 1/2 scallion
- 2 1/2 milk
- 4 all-purpose flour
- 1 ground mustard
- 1/4 pepper
- 1 cream cheese
- 2 sharp cheddar cheese

Instructions:
1. Combine chicken broth, carrots, and green onion in a Dutch oven pan and heat on medium heat.
2. In a medium bowl, combine milk, flour, dry mustard, and pepper and mix well.
3. Stir into chicken broth.
4. Cook, stirring occasionally, till thickened and bubbly.
5. Remove 1 cup of the broth from the pan and place in a medium mixing bowl.
6. Add softened cream cheese and stir until blended well and cream cheese is almost melted.
7. Pour this back into the heated broth mixture and stir well.
8. Heat through.
9. Just before serving, add sharp Cheddar cheese and stir until all is melted.

nom: Chicken Fingers With Honey Mustard Sauce
ingredients_reels: boneless skinless chicken breasts | egg | garlic | parmesan cheese | panko breadcrumbs | dried oregano | salt | pepper | paprika | butter | light mayonnaise | Dijon mustard | liquid honey
texte:
Chicken Fingers With Honey Mustard Sauce

Ingredients:
- 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts
- 1 egg
- 1/2 garlic
- 1 parmesan cheese
- 1 panko breadcrumbs
- 1 dried oregano
- 1/2 salt
- pepper
- 1/2 paprika
- 1/4 butter
- 1/3 light mayonnaise
- 2 Dijon mustard
- 1 liquid honey

Instructions:
1. In small bowl, stir together mayonnaise, Dijon and honey.Cover and refrigerate up to 3 days.
2. Between sheets of plastic wrap, pound chicken with flat side of meat pounder or with rolling pin until 1/2-inch thick.
3. Cut lengthwise on diagonal into 4 x 1-1/2-inch strips.
4. In bowl, whisk eggs and garlic.
5. I used Egg Creations to replace the eggs.
6. In shallow bowl, combine cheese, bread crumbs, oregano, salt, pepper and paprika.
7. One at a time, dip chicken strips into eggs, letting excess drip back into bowl. Dredge in cheese mixture, coating generously and pressing to adhere.
8. Arrange on greased baking sheets; drizzle with butter.
9. Bake in 425°F oven until golden, crispy and no longer pink inside, about 15 minutes. Serve with dipping sauce.

ingredients_reels: warm water | active dry yeast | sugar | salt | caraway seed | butter | all-purpose flour | butter | margarine | caraway seed
texte:
Rye Breadsticks With Caraway Seed

Ingredients:
- 1 1/4 warm water
- 1 active dry yeast
- 3 sugar
- 1 salt
- 1 caraway seed
- 1/4 butter
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 - 2 butter
- margarine
- caraway seed

Instructions:
1. Place  1/4 cup water in a bowl. Sprinkle in yeast; stir until dissolved. Add remaining 1 cup water, sugar, salt, caraway seed, butter, rye flour, and 1/2 cup all-purpose flour. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer, scraping bowl occasionally. Stir in enough remaining flour to make a soft dough. Knead on lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic, about 8 to 10 minutes. Place in greased bowl, turning to grease top. Cover; let rise in warm, draft-free place until doubled in size, about 1 hour.
2. Punch the dough down; divide in half. Cut each half into 12 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a rope about 6 inches long. Place on greased baking sheets, about 2 inches apart. Cover; let rise in warm, draft-free place until doubled in size, about 30 minutes.
3. Brush lightly with melted butter; sprinkle with caraway seed.
4. Bake at 400*F for 15 to 20 minutes or until done.
5. Remove from baking sheets; cool on wire racks. Enjoy!

ingredients_reels: mushrooms | black pepper | cottage cheese
texte:
BBQ Cottage Cheese Stuffed Mushrooms

Ingredients:
- 2 mushrooms
- 1/4 black pepper
- 4 cottage cheese

Instructions:
1. Remove stalks from mushrooms and stuff with cottage cheese until level with the top and sprinkle a little ground pepper over the top.
2. Cook on an oiled BBQ plate with hood down but away from direct heat - so well to the side of of a burner that is turned on. Pick the coolest spot in your BBQ.
3. In around 20-30 minutes you should see the top of the mushrooms turning soft and dark in color, they are ready to serve at that point.

ingredients_reels: flour | baking powder | baking soda | salt | light margarine | nonfat plain yogurt | honey
texte:
Anyday Louisiana Biscuits

Ingredients:
- 1 flour
- 1 1/2 baking powder
- 1/8 baking soda
- 1/8 salt
- 2 light margarine
- 1/2 nonfat plain yogurt
- 1 honey

Instructions:
1. Mix first four ingredients in large bowl.
2. Using a pastry blender or fork, cut in the margarine until the mix resembles coarse meal.
3. Preheat oven to 425 degrees.
4. Add yogurt and honey until dry ingredients are just moistened.
5. Knead the dough 4 times on a floured surface.  Roll the dough into 1/2\" thickness and cut off biscuit rounds about 2 1/2\" wide.
6. Place each biscuit on an ungreased baking sheet (I like air bake sheets).
7. Bake at 425 degrees F for 10 minutes or until golden.  Serve hot and fresh!

ingredients_reels: butter | shallots | green onions | white wine | heavy cream | half-and-half | gruyere cheese | cayenne | cornstarch | water
texte:
Mushroom and Gruyere Cheese Omelet

Ingredients:
- 2 butter
- 4 shallots
- 1  - 1 1/2 green onions
- 1/2 white wine
- 1/4 heavy cream
- 1/4 half-and-half
- 1/2 gruyere cheese
- cayenne
- 1 cornstarch
- 1 water

Instructions:
1. Melt butter over medium heat.
2. Sauté chopped the shallots or green onions.
3. Stir in the mushrooms and lemon juice.
4. Add the wine and cream.
5. Stir in the cheese and let it melt.
6. Season with cayenne.
7. Add the cornstarch in water and stir to thicken, heating through.

ingredients_reels: ketchup | chili powder | lemon juice | sugar | salt | black pepper
texte:
Cocktail Sauce Without Horseradish

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 ketchup
- 1 chili powder
- 1 lemon juice
- 2 sugar
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 black pepper

Instructions:
1. Mix everything together and chill for at least one hour before serving if desired.
2. If you like lots of lemon juice you can add another teaspoon for more zip.

ingredients_reels: fresh green beans | carrots | butter | onion | fresh mushrooms | seasoning salt | garlic | white pepper
texte:
Green Bean Medley

Ingredients:
- 1/2 fresh green beans
- 2 carrots
- 1/4 butter
- 1 onion
- 1/2 fresh mushrooms
- 1/2 seasoning salt
- 1/4 garlic
- 1/4 white pepper

Instructions:
1. Steam or cook carrots and green beans in boiling water.
2. Cook until tender, but still firm.
3. Melt butter over medium heat.
4. Saute onions and mushrooms until almost tender.
5. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 3 minutes.
6. Stir in green beans, carrots, seasoned salt, garlic, and white pepper.
7. Cover and cook five minutes on low heat.

ingredients_reels: cucumbers | pickling salt | water | curry powder | vinegar | prepared mustard | celery seed
texte:
Curry Pickles

Ingredients:
- 24 cucumbers
- 1/2 pickling salt
- 2 water
- 1 curry powder
- 2 1/2 vinegar
- 1/4 prepared mustard
- 1 celery seed

Instructions:
1. Put the cucumbers in a bowl, add the salt and water, and let stand for 5 hours.
2. Drain and rinse the cucumbers well.
3. Combine the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil.
4. Add the cucumbers and heat just to the boiling point.
5. Pack into hot jars and seal.

ingredients_reels: russet potatoes | olive oil | parsley | parmesan cheese | garlic powder | paprika | cayenne pepper | kosher salt
texte:
Parmesan Oven Fries

Ingredients:
- 3 russet potatoes
- 3 olive oil
- 2 parsley
- 1/4 parmesan cheese
- 1/2 garlic powder
- 1/4 paprika
- 1/8 cayenne pepper
- kosher salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 475 degrees with a baking sheet inside.
2. Combine Parmesan, garlic powder, paprika, cayenne and salt in small bowl.
3. Coat potatoe wedges with 1 Tbsp oil in a large bowl, then add Parmesan mixture, tossing to coat.  Remove baking sheet from oven and coat with remaining oil.
4. Place wedges on the pan and roast until golden, 15 minutes per side.  Return fries to bowl and toss with parsley.

ingredients_reels: butter | sugar | vanilla | egg | sour cream | salt | lemon, rind of | flour | baking powder | plums | butter | flour | sugar | cinnamon
texte:
German Plum Cake

Ingredients:
- 1/4 butter
- 1/3 sugar
- 1/2 vanilla
- 1 egg
- 1 sour cream
- 1 salt
- 1 lemon, rind of
- 1 3/4 flour
- 1 baking powder
- 2 plums
- 6 butter
- 3/4 flour
- 1/3 sugar
- 1/2 cinnamon

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, cream the butter, add the sugar, vanilla, egg, lemon peel, sour cream and salt (if desired).
2. Mix the flour and baking powder and add that into the mixture.
3. Grease the base of a round baking pan and spread the dough over the pan.
4. Liberally spread plums over the dough.
5. To make the optional topping, cream the butter, add flour, sugar and cinnamon.
6. Sprinkle over the plums and bake for 30-45 minutes in the middle rack at 375 F.
7. Be careful not to let the bottom burn!
8. Serve with lots of freshly-made whipped cream.
9. If you like, you may also sprinkle rum or cinnamon over the fruit before baking.

ingredients_reels: water | sugar | seedless oranges
texte:
Sliced Oranges in Syrup

Ingredients:
- 1/2 water
- 1/3 sugar
- 3 seedless oranges

Instructions:
1. Cut thin slivers of peel from 1 orange. Don't cut into white membrane.
2. Cover peel with boiling water; let stand 5 minutes. Drain.
3. Heat orange peel, water and sugar to boiling; simmer uncovered until slightly thickened, 10 to 15 minutes. Cool.
4. Cut oranges into slices.
5. Pour syrup over slices; cover and refrigerate.
6. Garnish with sprig of mint if desired.

nom: Ham and Potato Soup (For the Slow Cooker)
ingredients_reels: country ham | green onion | heavy cream | water | milk | smoked gouda cheese | ground black pepper | Velveeta cheese | butter | margarine | green onion
texte:
Ham and Potato Soup (For the Slow Cooker)

Ingredients:
- 2 country ham
- 1 green onion
- 3/4 heavy cream
- 2 water
- 2 milk
- 1 1/2 smoked gouda cheese
- 1 ground black pepper
- 2 Velveeta cheese
- 8 butter
- 1/4 margarine
- green onion

Instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large slow cooker. Cover and cook on low-heat setting for 4 to 6 hours or until potatoes are tender. To serve garnish with diced green onions.
2. NOTE: Country ham is salt cured and not honey cured.

ingredients_reels: unsweetened soymilk | vinegar | cornmeal | whole wheat pastry flour | raw sugar | raw sugar | sea salt | baking powder | baking soda | olive oil
texte:
Vegan Cornbread

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 unsweetened soymilk
- 1 1/2 vinegar
- 1 cornmeal
- 1 whole wheat pastry flour
- 2 raw sugar
- 1 raw sugar
- 3/4 sea salt
- 1 baking powder
- 1/2 baking soda
- 2 olive oil

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 425.
2. Lightly oil a 9-inch square baking dish.
3. Combine soymilk and vinegar and let stand.
4. In a large bowl, mix dry ingredients.
5. Add soymilk mixture and oil.
6. Stir just until blended.
7. Spread the batter into pan.
8. Bake for 20-30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

ingredients_reels: eggs | water | dried oregano | pepper | butter | feta cheese | tomatoes | parsley | kalamata olives
texte:
Greek Scrambled Eggs

Ingredients:
- 12 eggs
- 1/4 water
- 3/4 dried oregano
- 1/8 pepper
- 2 butter
- 6 feta cheese
- 1 tomatoes
- 1/4 parsley
- 10 kalamata olives

Instructions:
1. Cut feta cheese into 1/2 inch chunks.
2. Beat eggs with water, oregano and pepper to blend.
3. Melt butter in a wide skillet with an ovenproof handle, over low heat.
4. Pour in egg mixture. Cook, lifting cooked portion with a wide spatula to let the uncooked eggs flow underneath, until eggs are just softly set.
5. Sprinkle feta cheese evenly over eggs.
6. Put under broiler for about 2 minutes, just until cheese is hot.
7. Sprinkle with tomatoes, parsley & olives.
8. Cut into wedges to serve.

nom: Mika's Korean Sesame Seed Cookies (Ggae Gwa Ja)
ingredients_reels: butter | brown sugar | white sugar | eggs | baking soda | hot water | vanilla extract | flour | toasted sesame seeds
texte:
Mika's Korean Sesame Seed Cookies (Ggae Gwa Ja)

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 3/4 brown sugar
- 3/4 white sugar
- 2 eggs
- 1 baking soda
- 1 hot water
- 1 vanilla extract
- 3 flour
- 3/4 toasted sesame seeds

Instructions:
1. Cream butter with brown and white sugars.  Add eggs and beat well.  Add baking soda, hot water and vanilla extract.  Mix well.
2. Stir in flour and sesame seeds to make a stiff dough.  Cover and chill until dough is firm.
3. Roll heaping teaspoonfuls into balls; place on greased baking sheet, about 2\" apart.  Flatten slightly.  Bake at 325 degrees for 10-12 minutes.

ingredients_reels: rhubarb | sugar | raspberry gelatin powder | strawberry gelatin | butter | water | vanilla ice cream
texte:
Rhubarb Dump Cake

Ingredients:
- 4 -5 rhubarb
- 3/4 sugar
- 1 raspberry gelatin powder
- 1 strawberry gelatin
- 1/2 butter
- 1 water
- vanilla ice cream

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Line the bottom of an ungreased 13x9x2-inch baking pan with the rhubarb.
3. Sprinkle sugar over the rhubarb.
4. Sprinkle dry raspberry gelatin, ( or strawberry gelatin ) which ever you prefer; over the sugar.
5. Next, sprinkle the cake mix over the gelatin.
6. Melt butter; pour over the cake mix.
7. Pour the 1 cup of water over cake mix.
8. Bake for 45 minutes.
9. Cool completely; then chill in refrigerator.
10. When ready to serve, invert onto plate.
11. Top with either vanilla ice cream or Cool Whip.
12. Serves 12 to 16.
13. Note: If using frozen rhubarb, reduce the amount of water to 1/2 cup.
14. This cake was baked in a gas oven.
15. If baking in an electric oven, you may need to increase baking time; depending upon oven and altitude.
16. Chef sheerkerry baked hers in an electric oven for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

ingredients_reels: warm water | active dry yeast | milk | sugar | salt | eggs | shortening | flour
texte:
Sweet Roll Dough

Ingredients:
- 1/2 warm water
- 2 active dry yeast
- 1 1/2 milk
- 1/2 sugar
- 2 salt
- 2 eggs
- 1/2 shortening
- 7  - 7 1/2 flour

Instructions:
1. Mix water and yeast in large mixing bowl.
2. Stir until dissolved.
3. Add milk, sugar salt, eggs, shortening and 1/2 of the flour.
4. Mix until smooth and pour out onto floured surface. Knead while adding the additional flour. Knead until smooth and elastic( about 5 minutes).
5. Round up in greased bowl with greased side up. Cover with damp cloth.
6. Let rise in warm place until double (about 1&1/2 hours).
7. Punch down; let rise again until almost double.
8. Dough is ready to to make into cinnamon rolls or dinner rolls now.

ingredients_reels: bacon | eggs
texte:
Grandpa Farrell's  Scrambled Eggs

Ingredients:
- 3 bacon
- 2 eggs

Instructions:
1. Fry the bacon in the cast iron pan.
2. Beat up the eggs while cooking the bacon.
3. Take the bacon out and pour off most of the grease.
4. Dump the eggs into hot pan and stir off heat  till done.

ingredients_reels: canned salmon | scallion | capers | lemon, juice and zest of | dried dill | fresh dill | fresh cracked pepper | mayonnaise
texte:
Salmon Salad

Ingredients:
- 12 canned salmon
- 1/2 scallion
- 2 capers
- 1/2 lemon, juice and zest of
- 1/2 dried dill
- 1/4 fresh dill
- fresh cracked pepper
- 1/2 mayonnaise

Instructions:
1. Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl.
2. Serve on a bed of greens for low carb.
3. Or serve with bagel chips or on your favorite bread.

ingredients_reels: unsalted butter | pecan halves | light brown sugar | paprika | chili powder | ground cumin | cider vinegar
texte:
Cajun Spiced Pecans

Ingredients:
- 2 unsalted butter
- 3 pecan halves
- 1/2 light brown sugar
- 1 paprika
- 2 chili powder
- 1 ground cumin
- 1/4 cider vinegar

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375¼F.
2. In a large skillet over medium heat melt butter. Add the pecans - saute until lightly browned, about 3 minutes.
3. Add the brown sugar and cook until caramelized.
4. Stir in the paprika, chile powder and cumin. Add the vinegar and cook until all the liquid has evaporated.
5. Season with salt.
6. Spread the pecans on a cookie sheet and bake in an oven until crisp, about 3 to 5 minutes.

ingredients_reels: tart apples | sugar | lemon | ground cinnamon | unsalted butter | eggs | milk | flour | salt | confectioners' sugar
texte:
German Apple Pancake

Ingredients:
- 2 tart apples
- 3 sugar
- 1 lemon
- 1/4 ground cinnamon
- 6 unsalted butter
- 3 eggs
- 3/4 milk
- 3/4 flour
- 1/2 salt
- confectioners' sugar

Instructions:
1. Combine apples, sugar, 2 T of the lemon juice and cinnamon in a medium bowl; toss to coat apples.
2. Melt 2 T of the butter in a skillet over medium-high heat; add apples, cook just until soft, 3 minutes; remove from heat and set aside.
3. Heat oven to 450 degrees.
4. Whisk together eggs and milk in a bowl until well blended, whisk in flour and salt to form a slightly lumpy batter.
5. Melt remaining 4 T of the butter in an oven-proof 10-inch skillet (a well-seasoned cast iron skillet is good) until just beginning to brown, about 2 minutes; spread apples in bottom of pan, pour batter over apples.
6. Bake until the pancake is golden brown and puffed, about 20 minutes; invert onto a large platter.
7. Sprinkle with remaining lemon juice; dust with confectioners' sugar.

ingredients_reels: zucchini | onion | red bell pepper | salt | sugar | white vinegar | mustard seeds | celery seed | ground mustard
texte:
Sweet Zucchini Pickles

Ingredients:
- 3 zucchini
- 1/2 onion
- 1 red bell pepper
- 1 salt
- 1 sugar
- 3/4 white vinegar
- 3/4 mustard seeds
- 3/4 celery seed
- 1/4 ground mustard

Instructions:
1. Mix squash, onion, and sweet pepper in a big bowl.
2. Mix with salt. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Drain.
3. Combine sugar, vinegar, mustard seed, celery seed, and ground mustard. Boil.
4. Add squash mixture. Return to boiling; remove from heat.
5. Spoon mixture into 2 clean pint jars. I just use tupperware.
6. Cool 30 minutes.
7. Cover and refrigerate at least 24 hours before serving.
8. Store in refrigerator up to 1 month or freeze forever :).

ingredients_reels: corn | unsalted butter | kosher salt | black pepper
texte:
Sauteed Fresh Corn

Ingredients:
- 6 corn
- 2 1/2 unsalted butter
- 1 kosher salt
- 1/4 black pepper

Instructions:
1. Remove the husks and silk from the corn.
2. Holding the cob straight up on the cutting board cut off the kernels and close as possible to the cob.
3. You should have about 5 cups of kernels.
4. Melt the butter in a large sauté pan over medium low.
5. Add the corn, salt and pepper and sauté uncovered for 8 to 10 minutes stirring occasionally until the starchiness is gone.

ingredients_reels: chicken breasts | flour tortillas | onion | garlic clove | green chilies | sour cream | tomato sauce | cumin | butter | margarine | cheddar cheese
texte:
Chicken Chimi Chimies ( Chimichangas )

Ingredients:
- 2 chicken breasts
- 10 flour tortillas
- 1/2 onion
- 1 garlic clove
- 1 green chilies
- 1 sour cream
- 1/4 - 1/2 tomato sauce
- 1/2 cumin
- 1 -2 butter
- 4 margarine
- 1 1/2 - 2 cheddar cheese

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 450°F.
2. Boil chicken in water until done, about 15 minutes. For extra flavor add some onion & garlic (fresh or dry), and salt and pepper to the water. Shred chicken.
3. Sauté garlic and onion in the oil about 5 minutes, don't brown.
4. Stir together chicken and all the ingredients except for butter, tortillas and cheese.
5. Brush tortillas one at a time with melted butter, to the dry side and a spoon a generous scoop of chicken mixture in a line about 1 inch from one  edge of the tortilla, tuck in sides as you go and roll up tortilla, and place seam side down on a cookie sheet, repeat until all you mixture is used.
6. NOTE: You can wait an brush with butter after it's rolled, this is done best if tortillas are room temperature.
7. Bake 15 minutes or until golden brown.
8. OPTION:
9. If you prefer your cheese melted, a few minutes before removing from the oven, sprinkle each chimi with shredded cheese.
10. Serve chimis with shredded cheese, also good with sour cream, chopped tomatoes and   black olives.

ingredients_reels: brown sugar | Bisquick baking mix | milk | egg | whole berry cranberry sauce | Bisquick baking mix | granulated sugar
texte:
Cranberry Streusel Muffins

Ingredients:
- 2 brown sugar
- 1 Bisquick baking mix
- 1/3 milk
- 1 egg
- 1/2 whole berry cranberry sauce
- 2 Bisquick baking mix
- 2 granulated sugar

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Grease only the bottom of a 12 muffin baking pan or use paper liners. Mix the brown sugar and 1 tablespoon of Bisquick mix, set aside.
2. In medium bowl, slightly beat milk, egg, and cranberry sauce. Add the 2 cups of Bisquick mix and the granulated sugar and mix until moistened.
3. Fill muffin cups half full and sprinkle with brown sugar mixture that was put aside.
4. Bake 18 minutes or until golden brown. Cool and remove from pan, serve.

ingredients_reels: unsalted butter | pineapple | mango | papaya | bananas | maple syrup | ground cinnamon | dark rum | yogurt
texte:
Caribbean Fruit Dessert

Ingredients:
- 2 unsalted butter
- 1 pineapple
- 1 mango
- 1 papaya
- 2 bananas
- 2 maple syrup
- 1 ground cinnamon
- 4 dark rum
- yogurt

Instructions:
1. First be sure to have all of your fruit prepared.
2. Melt your butter in a large heavy-based frying pan.
3. Once it is melted, add the pineapple and cook for 3 minutes until it starts to brown; turn occasionally.
4. Add your mango, papaya, and bananas to the frying pan and cook for just one minute, making sure you turn occasionally.
5. Next stir in your maple syrup, cinnamon, and rum and cook for 2 more minutes until the sauce thickens and fruit is nice and tender.
6. Serve immediately with yogurt.

ingredients_reels: flour | whole wheat flour | baking powder | cinnamon | brown sugar | milk | eggs | butter | apples | cranberries | flour | brown sugar | oats | butter
texte:
Apple-Cranberry-Crumble-Muffins

Ingredients:
- 150 flour
- 150 whole wheat flour
- 2 baking powder
- 1/2 cinnamon
- 100 brown sugar
- 150 milk
- 2 eggs
- 120 butter
- 2 apples
- 4 cranberries
- 5 flour
- 55 brown sugar
- 35 oats
- 30 butter

Instructions:
1. Mix both types of flour, baking powder, brown sugar and cinnamon in a bowl. In another bowl mix together milk, butter and eggs.
2. Make a mould in the middle of the flour mixture and add the milk mixture into it.
3. Blend in diced apples and cranberries.
4. Fill the dough into a lined muffin pan and pre-heat the oven to 190°C.
5. For the crumble-topping combine flour, butter, sugar and oats using your fingers. Knead until a crumbly mixture has formed.
6. Spread each muffin with 2 ts of the crumble-topping.
7. Bake for 25 minutes.

ingredients_reels: carrot | yoghurt | garlic | salt | olive oil | lemon juice | ground walnuts

Yoghurt & Carrot Dip

Ingredients:
- 1/2 carrot
- 300 yoghurt
- 2 garlic
- 1 salt
- 3 -4 olive oil
- 1 lemon juice
- 1/2 ground walnuts

Instructions:
1. Scrape the carrots and grate them. Whip yoghurt with remaining ingredients, throw in the carrot and mix well.

ingredients_reels: lettuce leaf | dried cherries | red seedless grapes | red apple | peanut butter
texte:
Ladybug C/O --Tasty Dish--

Ingredients:
- 1 lettuce leaf
- 1 dried cherries
- 7 red seedless grapes
- 1/2 red apple
- peanut butter

Instructions:
1. On lettuce leaf, place the half cored apple red peel side facing up.
2. Place dried fruit on apple with small dabs of peanut butter.
3. Use one whole grape for the ladybug's head. Slice a small slit off the end of the grape so it stands up straight.
4. Cut up the remaining grapes into thin pieces to make the ladybug's feet and antennae. (You might need an adult to help you with this step).

ingredients_reels: passion fruit juice | pink grapefruit juice | cranberry juice | pink grapefruit

August Sunset Mocktail

Ingredients:

- 3 cranberry juice

Instructions:
1. In a cocktail shaker filled with ice, combine juices.  Shake to mix. Strain into a Martini glass and garnish with a pink grapefruit slice.

ingredients_reels: salt | cornstarch | sugar | sugar | crushed pineapple | butter

Pineapple Cake Filling

Ingredients:
- 1/2 salt
- 3 cornstarch
- 1/2 sugar
- 1 sugar
- 1 crushed pineapple
- 3 butter

Instructions:
1. In heavy saucepan combine cornstarch, all of the sugar and salt.
2. Add pineapple with juice and mix well.
3. Cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a bubbling boil, stirring constantly.
4. Once mixture comes to a boil continue stirring constantly for approximately 5 minutes, or until thickened and its looses it's \"milky\" look.
5. Remove from heat and add butter, stirring to melt.
6. Let cool then store in refrigerator.

ingredients_reels: unsalted butter | all-purpose flour | sugar | baking powder | salt | milk | fresh lemon juice | ground cinnamon | ground nutmeg

Easy Fresh Peach Cobbler

Ingredients:
- 1/2 unsalted butter
- 1 all-purpose flour
- 2 sugar
- 3 baking powder
- 1 salt
- 1 milk
- 4 fresh lemon juice
- 1 ground cinnamon
- 3 ground nutmeg

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 375°F degrees.
2. Pour the melted butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
3. In medium bowl, combine the flour, 1 cup of sugar, baking powder, and salt; mix well.
4. Stir in the milk and stir until just combined.
5. Pour the batter over the butter.  DO NOT mix together.
6. In a small saucepan, combine the peaches, lemon juice, and the remaining cup of sugar; bring to a boil over high heat, stirring constantly.
7. Pour the peaches over the batter, but do not stir in; sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg.
8. Bake in preheated oven for 40 to 45 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
9. Serve warm or cold.

ingredients_reels: kiwi fruits | seedless grapes | cantaloupes | honeydew melon | watermelon | cottage cheese

Instructions:
1. Combine all fruit in large bowl.
2. Top with cottage cheese & serve.

ingredients_reels: elbow macaroni | butter | flour | salt | black pepper | milk | American cheese

Mom's Macaroni & Cheese

Ingredients:

- 4 butter
- 4 flour
- 1 salt
- 1/4 black pepper
- 2 milk
- 1 American cheese

Instructions:
1. Melt butter, add flour, salt, and pepper, wisk until smooth.
2. Add milk slowly, whisking to blend.
3. Cook until thick and smooth, add cheese and stir until melted.
4. Cook elbow noodles as directed on package.
5. Drain and pour into a baking dish.
6. Pour cheese sauce over cooked elbows.
7. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes or until lightly browned.
8. *It's best to use a double boiler or nonstick pan to make your cheese sauce.

ingredients_reels: butter | margarine | brown sugar | pecans | sugar | ground cinnamon | granny smith apple
texte:
Apple-Praline Bubble Bread

Ingredients:
- 1/3 butter
- 1/2 margarine
- 1/2 brown sugar
- 1/4 pecans
- 1/2 sugar
- 2 ground cinnamon
- 1 granny smith apple

Instructions:
1. Heat oven to 375°F Spray with cooking spray or grease with shortening a 12-cup fluted tube cake pan.
2. In small microwavable bowl, microwave butter on High about 30 seconds or until melted.
3. Stir in brown sugar.
4. Spread mixture evenly in pan.
5. Sprinkle with half of the pecans.
6. In small bowl, mix sugar and cinnamon;
7. Roll biscuit quarters in sugar mixture until evenly coated.
8. Place half of the coated biscuit quarters in pan. Sprinkle remaining pecans and apple on top of biscuit quarters;
9. Arrange remaining coated biscuit quarters on top.
10. Bake 35 to 38 minutes or until golden brown. Carefully turn pan upside down onto serving platter. Let stand 1 minute before removing pan. Cool slightly.
11. To serve, pull apart or slice.

ingredients_reels: garlic | butter | soy sauce | honey | fresh lemon juice | chicken pieces
texte:
Honey Baked Chicken

Ingredients:
- 1 garlic
- 4 butter
- 1 1/2 soy sauce
- 1/4 honey
- 1/4 fresh lemon juice
- 3 chicken pieces

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400F.
2. Place all ingredients, except chicken, in a small saucepan, and cook, over low heat, for 3 minutes, to melt honey.
3. Whisk a couple of times.
4. Place chicken, skin side down, in a shallow baking pan.
5. Season with salt and pepper.
6. Bake about 30 minutes.
7. Turn, pour on sauce, season with more salt and pepper.
8. Bake about 20 minutes more longer, until juices run clear when chicken is pierced, basting once or twice.

ingredients_reels: frozen spinach | onion | yogurt | parmesan cheese
texte:
"Creamed" Spinach

Ingredients:
- 1 frozen spinach
- 1 onion
- 1/2 yogurt
- 2 parmesan cheese

Instructions:
1. I keep drained yogurt available in my fridge all the time.
2. I use a coffee filter and a wire strainer.
3. I usually drain it over night, but even a half hour makes a big difference.
4. Once you drain the yogurt, it becomes very thick and much less tart.
5. Cook spinach according to package directions.
6. While it cooks, saute chopped onions until slightly browned.
7. Drain spinach well and combine with all other ingredients while still hot.

ingredients_reels: rolled oats | salt | baking powder | ground cinnamon | egg | nonfat milk | vanilla extract
texte:
Oat Pancakes (Wheat Free)

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 rolled oats
- 1/4 salt
- 1/2 baking powder
- 1/2 ground cinnamon
- 1 egg
- 1 nonfat milk
- 1/2 vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. Put oats in a blender or food processor and blend about one minute, or until ground to a flour consistency.
2. Combine oat flour, salt, baking powder and cinnamon in a large mixing bowl; mix well.
3. Combine egg, milk and vanilla in a small bowl and mix well.
4. Stir liquid mixture into dry mixture; mix until just moist.  Allow to rest 5 minutes.
5. Heat a nonstick large skillet or gridle over medium heat.
6. When hot, pour 1/4 cup batter for each pancake.
7. Cook until bubbles form on surface of pancake.  Turn over and cook until lightly browned.

ingredients_reels: potatoes | olive oil | sea salt | pepper | fresh rosemary | garlic cloves | cayenne pepper | paprika

Grilled Potato Planks

Ingredients:
- 4 potatoes
- 1/2 olive oil
- 2 sea salt
- 1 pepper
- 2 fresh rosemary
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1/4 cayenne pepper
- 1/2 paprika

Instructions:
1. Wash the potatoes and standing them on their side, cut 1/4 inch "planks".  In a large bowl, toss potatoes with other ingredients until all are coated evenly.  Grill should be nice and hot (approx. 550 degrees farenheit).  Spray grill with PAM or coat with oil (unless it is non-stick).  Lay potato planks onto the grill for 15 to 20 minutes, turning every five minutes, until done.  "Done" means a nice dark golden brown with grill marks evident.  (A good panini maker may cook the potatoes a bit sooner.)  DIG IN!

3. Cool and add to pizza dough.

ingredients_reels: swiss chard | garlic clove | olive oil | onion | zucchini | mushroom | eggs | cheese | salt | pepper
texte:
Swiss Chard Omelette Dinner

Ingredients:
- 5 swiss chard
- 1 garlic clove
- 3 olive oil
- 1/4 onion
- 1 zucchini
- 1 mushroom
- 2 eggs
- 1/4 cheese
- salt
- pepper

Instructions:
1. In skillet, heat oil and garlic on medium heat.
2. Add chopped chard. I use both the stalks and the leaves. Stalks when cooked taste something like celery. Leaves taste a lot like spinach.
3. Chop and add remaining ingredients in order: onion, zucchini, mushrooms.

5. Return skillet to burner. Scramble egg and cheese together. I also add a little pepper.
6. Place egg on top of veggies and serve immediately.

ingredients_reels: maraschino cherries | all-purpose flour | sugar | baking powder | salt | eggs | walnuts | flaked coconut
texte:
Pink Cherry Bread

- 1 maraschino cherries
- 3 all-purpose flour
- 2 sugar
- 3 baking powder
- 1/2 salt
- 4 eggs
- 1 1/2 walnuts
- 1 flaked coconut

Instructions:
1. Drain cherries, reserving juice.
2. Coarsely chop cherries, set aside cherries and juice.
3. In a bowl, combine the dry ingredients.
4. In another bowl, beat eggs and cherry juice.
5. Stir into dry ingredients just unil combined.
6. Fold in walnuts, coconut and cherries.
7. Transfer to two greased 8x4x2 inch loaf pans.
8. Bake at 350° for 60-65 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
9. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pans.
10. Makes 2 loaves.

ingredients_reels: sugar | salt | five-spice powder | garlic clove | fresh ginger | ketchup | soy sauce | white wine | hoisin sauce | honey | boneless lean pork

Chinese BBQ Pork

Instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients (except the pork) in a bowl large enough for the pork and set aside.
2. Trim pork to remove visible fat.
3. Slice into thin (1/8\") slices.

5. Marinate at least 1 hour, but can sit in fridge overnight.

7. Bake at 375 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

ingredients_reels: granulated sugar | almond paste | unsalted butter | eggs | vanilla extract | all-purpose flour | baking powder | salt
texte:
Chez Panisse Almond Cake

Ingredients:
- 1 1/3 granulated sugar
- 3/4 almond paste
- 10 unsalted butter
- 6 eggs
- 1 vanilla extract
- 1 all-purpose flour
- 1 baking powder
- 1/4 salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees and position the rack to the center of the oven.
2. Line the bottom of a 9-inch cake pan with a round of parchment paper, or butter the pan and dust it lightly with flour, tapping out any excess.
3. With an electric mixer, beat together the sugar and almond paste until the paste is finely broken up (the sugar crystals helps break the paste into pieces-so don't add the butter yet!) 3.
4. Now add the butter and beat for a few minutes until light and fluffy.
5. In a separate bowl, or a measuring cup with a spout, stir together the eggs with a fork then dribble it into the batter as you beat.
6. Add the vanilla.
7. Mix together the flour, baking soda and salt with a whisk.
8. Stir the dry ingredients into the batter until just incorporated.
9. Transfer the batter into the prepared cake pan and bake for about 1 hour, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
10. The baking time may take a but longer due to the variation in different brands of almond paste.
11. Cool the cake on a rack before serving.
12. This cake is extremely moist and will keep well for up to a week if well-wrapped.

nom: Quick and Easy Puff Pastry or Bladerdeeg

Quick and Easy Puff Pastry or Bladerdeeg

- 1 1/2 flour
- 1 butter

Instructions:
1. Cut butter into flour until it resembles crumbs. Stir in sour cream.
2. Turn onto a floured board and knead until it just holds together.
3. Form into a ball, flatten slightly and wrap airtight. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.
4. Work with half of the dough at a time and keep other half in the refrigerator until ready to use.
5. Pound the dough with a heavy rolling pin to make it pliable. Use in any recipe calling for puff pastry.

ingredients_reels: chicken breasts | tandoori paste | yogurt | lime, juice of | garlic

Alan's Tandoori Chicken
