- 3 tandoori paste
- 3 yogurt
- 1 lime, juice of
- 2 garlic

Instructions:
1. Slice chicken breasts lengthwise and separate.
2. Mix Tandoori paste, garlic, lime juice and yogurt in dish.
3. Place chicken in marinade covering all the chicken.
4. Cover and place in refridgerator for 1 hour.
5. Fry on stove in pan or on a BBQ hotplate.
6. Serve with green salad or mixture of finely cut Cucumber and yogurt mix.

ingredients_reels: whole chickens | chicken piece | limes, juice of | olive oil | onion | saffron
texte:
Joojeh Kabob (Persian Style Grilled Chicken)

Ingredients:
- 1 whole chickens
- 2 chicken piece
- 1/2 limes, juice of
- 1 olive oil
- 1/2 onion
- saffron

Instructions:
1. Mix all ingredients in a bowl and let chicken sit in marinade for up to one day before grilling, preferably on a charcoal grill.
2. Grill until juices from chicken run clear when chicken is pierced with knife.

ingredients_reels: olive oil | garlic powder | dried oregano | dried basil | pepper | salt | onion powder | dijon-style mustard | red wine vinegar
texte:
Grecian Salad Dressing

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 olive oil
- 1/3 garlic powder
- 1/3 dried oregano
- 1/3 dried basil
- 1/4 pepper
- 1/4 salt
- 1/4 onion powder
- 1/4 dijon-style mustard
- 2 red wine vinegar

Instructions:
1. In a very large container, mix together the olive oil, garlic powder, oregano, basil, pepper, salt, onion powder, and Dijon-style mustard.
2. Pour in the vinegar, and mix vigorously until well blended.
3. Store tightly covered at room temperature.

ingredients_reels: vanilla vodka | Amaretto | Amarula cream liqueur
texte:
Vanilla Cream Shooter

Ingredients:
- 1 vanilla vodka
- 1/2 Amaretto
- 1/2 Amarula cream liqueur

Instructions:
1. Layer all ingredients in a glass,.
2. Amaretto first, then the Amarula, then the vodka.

ingredients_reels: flour | active dry yeast | sugar | salt | baking soda | milk | water | cornmeal
texte:
English Muffin Loaves

Ingredients:
- 5 1/2 - 6 flour
- 2 active dry yeast
- 1 sugar
- 2 salt
- 1/4 baking soda
- 2 milk
- 1/2 water
- cornmeal

Instructions:
1. Combine 3 cups flour, yeast, sugar, salt and soda.
2. Heat liquid until very warm (120-130 degrees F).
3. Add to dry mixture, beat well.  Stir in enough more flour to make a stiff batter.  Spoon into two 8 1/2 x 4 1/2\" pans that have been greased and sprinkled with cornmeal.  Sprinkle tops with cornmeal.
4. Cover with clean dishcloth; let rise in a warm place for 45 minutes.  Bake at 400 degrees F for 25 minutes.  Remove from pans immediately and cool.
5. Slice and toast.

ingredients_reels: plain nonfat yogurt | lemon juice | paprika | garlic powder | salt | ground ginger | cumin | cayenne pepper | boneless skinless chicken breasts
texte:
George Foreman Grilled Tandoori Chicken

Ingredients:
- 8 plain nonfat yogurt
- 1 lemon juice
- 2 paprika
- 1 garlic powder
- 1/4 salt
- 1/2 ground ginger
- 1/2 cumin
- 1/2 cayenne pepper
- 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts

Instructions:
1. 1. Mix together all of the marinade ingredients in a bowl.
2. 2. Cover chicken with the marinade, and store in the refrigerator for 1-8 hours.
3. 3. Grill chicken and serve. (I use the George Foreman grill).

ingredients_reels: pumpkin | evaporated milk | sugar | pumpkin pie spice | ground cinnamon | eggs | pecans | butter | margarine
texte:
Simple Pumpkin Dump Cake

Ingredients:
- 1 pumpkin
- 1 evaporated milk
- 1 sugar
- 1/4 pumpkin pie spice
- 1/2 ground cinnamon
- 3 eggs
- 1 pecans
- 1 butter
- 1 margarine

Instructions:
1. Beat the pumpkin, evaporated milk, sugar, spices, and eggs together.
2. Pour into a 9x13 inch baking dish.
3. Sprinkle the cake mix evenly over your mixture.
4. Sprinkle the chopped pecans on top.
5. Finally, drizzle the butter on top of this mixture.
6. Bake at 350°F for one hour.

ingredients_reels: broiler-fryer chickens | all-purpose flour | salt | paprika | pepper | butter | shortening
texte:
Easy Oven Fried Chicken

Ingredients:
- 2 1/2 broiler-fryer chickens
- 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1 salt
- 1 paprika
- 1/4 pepper
- 1/4 butter
- 1/4 shortening

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees F.
2. Mix flour, salt, paprika, and pepper in a shallow bowl.
3. Rinse off chicken pieces and coat in four mixture.
4. Heat butter and shortening in a 13X9X2-inch baking dish at 425 degrees F until melted.
5. Place coated chicken pieces (skin side down) in dish.
6. Cook uncovered for 30 minutes.
7. Turn chicken; cook uncovered about 30 minutes longer.

nom: Caramelized Bananas With Rum Sauce and Vanilla Ice Cream
ingredients_reels: sweet unsalted butter | bananas | light brown sugar | light brown sugar | light rum | vanilla ice cream
texte:
Caramelized Bananas With Rum Sauce and Vanilla Ice Cream

Ingredients:
- 3 sweet unsalted butter
- 2 bananas
- 1/4 light brown sugar
- 2 light brown sugar
- 1/2 light rum
- 1 vanilla ice cream

Instructions:
1. Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.  Add bananas and saute until they turn brown, about 3 minutes.  Sprinkle brown sugar over the bananas and cook until the sugar melts, about another 3 minutes.  Remove from heat and pour rum into skillet; ignite with a match and let the flames die out.
2. Divide ice cream among 4 serving dishes and spoon bananas over. Serve immediately.

ingredients_reels: butter | icing sugar | vanilla extract | all-purpose flour | fine sea salt
texte:
Basic Shortbread With Variations

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 1/2 icing sugar
- 1 vanilla extract
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 1/4 fine sea salt

Instructions:
1. Line two cookie sheets with parchment paper. In a bowl, combine flour and salt.
2. In a separate bowl, cream butter with an electric mixer until light and fluffy.
3. Add sugar and continue beating until smooth. Stir in vanilla.
4. Add flour and salt to mixture and stir until smooth.
5. Divide dough into two flat disks roughly an inch thick and wrap in plastic.
6. Chill for an hour.
7. Preheat oven to 300°F.
8. On a slightly floured surface, roll out dough to desired thickness.
9. Shape with lightly floured cookie cutters. Place on cookie sheets and refrigerate 20 more minutes.
10. Bake for 20 minutes, or until cookies are firm without browning.
11. Cool on a rack.
12. Now for the Variations on the Theme:
13. White-Chocolate Dipped:
14. Roll out dough roughly 1/3 of an inch thick. Cut into rounds and place cookies onto prepared baking sheets. Refrigerate and bake as per above instructions. After cooling, melt 6 ounces of white chocolate in a double boiler. Dip cookies into white chocolate and return to rack. Let chocolate set before handling.
15. Cranberry Clementine:
16. Prepare one batch of basic shortbead dough, omitting vanilla extract. Work 1/2 cup finely chopped dried cranberries and 2 tbs grated clementine zest into dough. Roll out dough 1/2 inch thick. Cut into desired shapes. Refrigerate and bake as per above instructions.
17. Pecan Macadamia Bites:
18. Add 1/4 cup finely chopped pecans and 1/4 cup finely chopped macadamia nuts to dough. Scoop out tablespoons of dough and roll into balls. Flatten each ball between your palms into bite-sized disks about an inch across. Place on prepared cookie sheets, refrigerate and bake as per instructions above. After cooking, dust cookies with icing sugar through a fine wire strainer.
19. Sugar Stars:
20. Roll out dough roughly 1/3 of an inch thick. Cut into stars and place cookies onto prepared baking sheets. Using a pastry brush, lightly brush tops of cookies with egg white and sprinkle each cookie with coarse white sugar. Refrigerate and bake as per above instructions.
21. Enjoy!

nom: Greek Rice - Rice With Spinach and Feta
ingredients_reels: long grain rice | low sodium chicken broth | vegetable broth | water | olive oil | butter | onion | garlic cloves | fresh lemon juice | dried oregano | fresh oregano | fresh ground black pepper | dry sherry | feta cheese
texte:
Greek Rice - Rice With Spinach and Feta

Ingredients:
- 1 long grain rice
- 1 1/2 low sodium chicken broth
- 1/2 vegetable broth
- 2 water
- 1 olive oil
- 3/4 butter
- 8 onion
- 3 garlic cloves
- 2 fresh lemon juice
- 1/2 dried oregano
- 6 fresh oregano
- fresh ground black pepper
- 1 dry sherry
- 4 feta cheese

Instructions:
1. Over medium heat in a saucepan, combine the rice, broth, and water, and bring to a boil.
2. Cover, reduce the heat to medium low, and let simmer for 15 to 18 minutes or until the rice has absorbed the liquid; transfer to a serving bowl and keep warm.
3. In a skillet over medium heat, melt the olive oil and butter together, then add the onion, mushrooms, and garlic for 5 to 7 minutes, then stir in the lemon juice and oregano.
4. Add the spinach and pepper, then sprinkle with the sherry and toss until the spinach is slightly wilted; remove from heat.
5. Add the crumbled feta and toss until the cheese begins to melt.
6. Add to the cooked rice, toss well, and serve immediately.

ingredients_reels: chicken wings | soy sauce | dry vermouth | sugar | cayenne pepper | ground ginger
texte:
Grama Steve's Chicken Wings

Ingredients:
- 2 chicken wings
- 1/2 soy sauce
- 1/2 dry vermouth
- 1/4 sugar
- 1/4 cayenne pepper
- 1 1/4 ground ginger

Instructions:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
2. Turn in the morning.
3. Cook uncovered@ 375 for 1 1/2 hrs.
4. Turn once half way through.
5. Serve warm and ENJOY!

ingredients_reels: mushroom | butter | flour | water | half-and-half | salt | parsley
texte:
Deutsche Pilzsuppe (German Mushroom Soup)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 mushroom
- 2 butter
- 3 flour
- 2 water
- 2 half-and-half
- salt
- parsley

Instructions:
1. Clean and chop mushrooms.
2. Melt butter and saute mushrooms for 5 minutes.
3. Sprinkle with flour and saute briefly.
4. Add water and seasonings and boil gently for 5 minutes.
5. Reduce heat, add half-and-half and simmer just until heated.
6. Just before serving, add parsley.

ingredients_reels: lettuce | celery | purple onion | sour cream | sugar | mayonnaise | vinegar | bacon | parmesan cheese
texte:
Fourth of July Salad

Ingredients:
- 1 lettuce
- 2 celery
- 1/4 purple onion
- 1 sour cream
- 1/2 sugar
- 1/2 mayonnaise
- 2 vinegar
- 1/2 bacon
- 1 parmesan cheese

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, glass one if you have it, begin to layer ingredients as follows:
2. Layer 1 - Lettuce.
3. Layer 2 - Celery.
4. Layer 3 - Purple Onion.
5. Layer 4 - Combine sour cream and sugar and pour over salad.
6. Layer 5 - Combine mayonnaise and vinegar and pour on top.
7. Layer 6 - Sprinkle parmesan cheese.
8. Layer 7 - Sprinkle bacon.

ingredients_reels: cucumbers | garlic cloves | white vinegar | Splenda granular | dried dill
texte:
Light and Tasty Cucumber Slices

Ingredients:
- 13 cucumbers
- 2 garlic cloves
- 3/4 white vinegar
- 1 1/2 Splenda granular
- 1/4 dried dill

Instructions:
1. Slice the cucumber into really thin slices.  I use my food processor to do this and it just takes a few seconds.
2. In a bowl combine the white vinegar, Splenda, garlic and dill and just stir until the Splenda is dissolved.
3. Pour wet mixture over the cucumber slices and stir so that the mixture has coated all of the slices.
4. You can eat right away but they are much better if you put them in an air tight container and chill them in the fridge for a few hours (I do them overnight).

ingredients_reels: cornstarch | all-purpose flour | baking powder | salt | black pepper | garlic powder | water | egg
texte:
Fried Zucchini Batter

Ingredients:
- 3/4 cornstarch
- 1/4 all-purpose flour
- 1 baking powder
- 1 1/2 salt
- 1/2 black pepper
- 1/2 garlic powder
- 1/2 water
- 1 egg

Instructions:
1. In medium mixing bowl mix all the above until smooth.  Dip sliced zucchini in batter and fry in 1/3 inch hot oil till golden brown.
2. This recipe usually will cover 12-15\" long zucchini cut in 1/3\" slices.

ingredients_reels: granny smith apples | pecans | raisins | dark rum | cinnamon | brown sugar | butter
texte:
Baked Apples

Ingredients:
- 6 granny smith apples
- 1/2 pecans
- 1/4 raisins
- dark rum
- 1/2 cinnamon
- 1/4 - 1/2 brown sugar
- 3 butter

Instructions:
1. Mix nuts, strained raisins reserving the rum, cinnamon, and sugar ingredients,stuff into apples.
2. Place into a shallow baking dish that's greased with butter.
3. Pour remaining rum on apples.
4. Dot each apple with 1/2 tablespoon butter.
5. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 45 minutes.
6. Till fork tender.
7. Serve hot with a side of vanilla ice cream. (A yummy Must).

ingredients_reels: butter | margarine | confectioners' sugar | salt | vanilla | all-purpose flour | confectioners' sugar
texte:
Italian Wedding Cookies

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 butter
- 3/4 margarine
- 3/4 confectioners' sugar
- 1 1/2 salt
- 1 vanilla
- 3 all-purpose flour
- confectioners' sugar

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C).
2. Cream butter or margarine in a bowl, gradually add confectioners' sugar and salt. Beat until light and fluffy.
3. Add almonds and vanilla.
4. Blend in flour gradually and mix well.
5. Shape into balls (or crescents) using about 1 teaspoon for each cookie.
6. Place on ungreased cookie sheets, and bake for 15-20 minutes.  Do not brown.
7. Cool slightly, then roll in the extra confectioners' sugar.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | salt | baking powder | shortening | water
texte:
My Flour Tortillas

Ingredients:
- 4 all-purpose flour
- 2 salt
- 2 baking powder
- 1/2 shortening
- 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 water

Instructions:
1. In a mixing bowl, stir in flour, salt, and baking powder.
2. Add the shortening, the mixture should have a small mealy texture to it.
3. Make a well in the middle and pour a small amount of water at a time until the dough comes together.
4. Remove the dough from the bowl and continue to knead until it looks smooth and feels elasticy. Place in covered bowl and let rest for 10 minutes.
5. At this time, preheat ungreased griddle over medium-high heat.
6. Tear off golfball sized pieces and lightly flatten, so they don't roll.
7. Using a rolling pin, roll out each ball into a circle, thickness of a cracker.
8. Cook for each side for about 1 minute.
9. Both sides should be slightly freckled.
10. Cooking time could vary.

ingredients_reels: sugar | butter | eggs | light corn syrup | vanilla | lime juice | all-purpose flour | baking powder | baking soda | salt | powdered sugar
texte:
Lovely Lime Cookies

Ingredients:
- 1 1/4 sugar
- 1 butter
- 2 eggs
- 1/4 light corn syrup
- 1 vanilla
- 3 lime juice
- 3 all-purpose flour
- 3/4 baking powder
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1/2 salt
- 1/2 powdered sugar

Instructions:
1. combine sugar and butter in a large bowl. stir until smooth and creamy.
2. add eggs, corn syrup, vanilla and lime juice to mixture in bowl. mix well.
3. combine flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a medium bowl. mix well.
4. add flour mixture to creamy mixture. mix well.
5. roll dough into 1 inch balls. place several inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet.
6. bake in a preheated 375 degree oven for 5 - 7 minutes. (do not overbake!).
7. when cool, remove cookies from baking sheet. dust generously with powdered sugar.

nom: Senn High School Chicago Butter Cookies
ingredients_reels: unsalted butter | sugar | salt | all-purpose flour | vanilla extract
texte:
Senn High School Chicago Butter Cookies

Ingredients:
- 2 unsalted butter
- 1 1/2 sugar
- 1/4 salt
- 3 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 2 vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. Cream butter with mixer untill light and fuffy.
2. Add sugar and salt and beat until no longer grainy.
3. Gradually add flour a little at a time, beating at low speed untill dough forms.
4. Mix in vanilla.
5. Form dough into balls, one heaping tablespoon = 1 ball.
6. Place balls on ungreased cookie sheet spaced widely- about 9 per sheet.
7. Put 1/4 cup of sugar on saucer. Press first 3 fingers into sugar, then press down on ball to flatten to a 3 inch circle wide and 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick.
8. Bake in preheated 350 degree oven 12-15 minutes, until faintly browned around the egdes.
9. Gently remove cookies from sheet with a spatula, cool completely on wire racks.

ingredients_reels: eggs | butter | margarine | quick-cooking oats | chocolate chips | raisins
texte:
German Chocolate Cookies

Ingredients:
- 1 eggs
- 2 butter
- 1/2 margarine
- 1/2 quick-cooking oats
- 1 chocolate chips
- 1/2 raisins

Instructions:
1. In a mixing bowl, combine the dry cake mix, eggs, butter and oats.
2. Mix well.
3. Stir in the chocolate chips and raisins.
4. Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls 2\" apart onto an ungreased baking sheets.
5. Bake at 350° for 9-11 minutes or until set.
6. Cool for 5 minutes; remove to wire racks.

ingredients_reels: mayonnaise | eggs | garlic clove | sour cream | salt | pimiento | green onions | hot mustard
texte:
Egg Salad

Ingredients:
- 1/2 mayonnaise
- 6 eggs
- 1 garlic clove
- 1/3 sour cream
- 1/4 salt
- 1 pimiento
- 2 green onions
- 1/4 hot mustard

Instructions:
1. Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise, salt, & garlic together.
2. Add the egg then the other ingredients and mix well. Garnish with the pimiento.

ingredients_reels: flour | baking powder | ground cinnamon | ground cloves | salt | olive oil | sugar | sugar | oranges, juice and zest of | brandy | water | golden raisin | walnuts
texte:
Fanouropita (Greek Spiced Raisin Cake)

Ingredients:
- 4 flour
- 4 baking powder
- 1 1/2 ground cinnamon
- 1/2 ground cloves
- 1/2 salt
- 1 olive oil
- 1 sugar
- 2 sugar
- 2 oranges, juice and zest of
- 2 brandy
- 1/2 water
- 1 golden raisin
- 1 walnuts

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Butter and flour a 12-inch, round cake pan or a 9x13x2-inch baking dish.
3. Mix the flour with the spices.
4. In a bowl mix the oil, sugar, orange juice, brandy and the orange zest.
5. Mix well.
6. Add the flour, the raisins and the walnuts.
7. Mix well.
8. Pour batter into prepared pan.
9. Bake the cake (it is called a'pie'- pita' in Greek) for 45 min to an hour (tester inserted comes out clean).

ingredients_reels: half-and-half | rum | vanilla vodka | vodka | cream of coconut
texte:
Coconut Snowball Martini

Ingredients:
- 3/4 half-and-half
- 1/2 rum
- 1/4 vanilla vodka
- 1/4 vodka
- cream of coconut

Instructions:
1. In a pitcher stir together the half-and-half, coconut rum, vanilla vodka, and cream of coconut.
2. Place ice cubes in a martini shaker.
3. Add coconut mixture.
4. Cover and shake.
5. Divide mixture among prepared martini glasses.
6. Makes: 4 to 6 drinks.

nom: Mom's Chocolate Mayonnaise Cake with Chocolate Deluxe Frosting
ingredients_reels: flour | sugar | baking soda | salt | cocoa powder | black coffee | Miracle Whip light | vanilla | powdered sugar | salt | egg | margarine | cocoa powder | vanilla
texte:
Mom's Chocolate Mayonnaise Cake with Chocolate Deluxe Frosting

Ingredients:
- 2 flour
- 1 sugar
- 2 baking soda
- 1/4 salt
- 4 cocoa powder
- 1 black coffee
- 1 Miracle Whip light
- 2 vanilla
- 2 powdered sugar
- 1/4 salt
- 1 egg
- 1/3 margarine
- 2 cocoa powder
- 1 vanilla

Instructions:
1. Mix cake ingredients together and bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes in a 9x13 greased and floured pan.
2. Mix together Frosting ingredients until creamy.
3. Smooth over cooled cake.
4. Keep covered and kept in fridge so frosting won't melt.

ingredients_reels: tart apples | cinnamon | brown sugar | flour | margarine | chunky peanut butter | ice cream
texte:
Apple and Peanut Butter Crisp

Ingredients:
- 2 tart apples
- 1 cinnamon
- 3/4 brown sugar
- 2/3 flour
- 1/4 margarine
- 1/4 chunky peanut butter
- ice cream

Instructions:
1. Put apples in greased 8 inch square baking dish; mix in cinnamon. In a bowl, combine sugar and flour. With pastry blender or 2 knives, cut in margarine and peanut butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add 1/2 cup to apple mixture, mix well. Sprinkle remainder over apples. Bake uncovered in 375* oven about 40 minutes or until apple is tender and top is lightly browned. Serve warm as is or with ice cream or whipped topping.

ingredients_reels: onion | green pepper | butter | olive oil | zucchini | garlic | salt | tomatoes | eggs
texte:
Vegetable Frittata

Ingredients:
- 1/3 onion
- 2/3 green pepper
- 1 butter
- 4 olive oil
- 1 1/2 zucchini
- 2 garlic
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 tomatoes
- 6 eggs

Instructions:
1. In skillet, cook onions and green pepper in butter and 2 tablespoons olive oil, stirring, 5 minutes.
2. Add zucchini, cook covered 4 minutes.
3. Add garlic, salt and tomato, cook stirring, 5 minutes.
4. Transfer to bowl.
5. Cool.
6. Add eggs.
7. Over medium heat, heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in 10\" ovenproof skillet.
8. Add egg mixture, cook 3-5 minutes till underside is set.
9. Bake preheated 400 degrees F oven for 1 to 2 minutes till puffed and golden.
10. Cut into wedges.

ingredients_reels: margarine | sugar | egg | skim milk | vanilla | carrot | all-purpose flour | baking powder | ground cinnamon | salt | nutmeg
texte:
Carrot Snack Cake

Ingredients:
- 1/4 margarine
- 1/2 sugar
- 1 egg
- 1/4 skim milk
- 1/2 vanilla
- 1/2 carrot
- 1 all-purpose flour
- 1 1/4 baking powder
- 1/4 ground cinnamon
- 1/8 salt
- 1 nutmeg

Instructions:
1. In a small mixer bowl beat margarine and sugar til blended.
2. Beat in egg, milk, and vanilla.
3. Stir in carrot.
4. In another bowl combine flour, powder, cinnamon, salt and nutmeg.
5. Add carrot mixture and stir until blended.
6. Spray an 8x8x2\" baking pan with nonstick cooking spray.
7. Pour batter evenly into pan.
8. Bake in a 350°F oven for 20-25 minutes  or until a toothpick inserted in the centre of the cake comes out clean.
9. Cool on wire rack.

ingredients_reels: sugar | light corn syrup | water | walnuts
texte:
Wet Walnut Topping

Ingredients:
- 1 sugar
- 1 light corn syrup
- 1 water
- 2 walnuts

Instructions:
1. Combine the sugar, corn syrup and water in a large, heavy saucepan and place over medium heat.
2. Stir until the sugar dissolves and the syrup is clear.
3. Boil for 2 minutes without stirring.
4. Add the walnuts, bring back to a boil, and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
5. Remove from heat and allow to cool.
6. Serve and store at room temperature.
7. Stir well before using.
8. Variations: Fall Walnut Topping: Add 1/4 cup raisins and 1/4 cup chopped dried figs along with the nuts.
9. Process with the recipe as indicated.
10. Walnut Whiskey Topping: Add 1/4 cup whiskey to the finished topping.

ingredients_reels: cucumber | lemon | salt | chili powder
texte:
Cucumbers With a Kick

Ingredients:
- 1 cucumber
- 1 lemon
- 1 salt
- 1 chili powder

Instructions:
1. peel cucumber.
2. add into a storage container ( i use ziplock)
3. seed lemon squeezing all juices into storage container and as much pulp as desired ( microwave lemon 10 seconds and roll to extract all the juice)
4. add salt ( and if desired your chili powder)
5. place lid on container and shake
6. eat immediatly
7. OR leave in fridge a day or so  and by all means drink the juice!

nom: Apple Crumble With Tea Masala Spices
ingredients_reels: apples | brown sugar | flour | rolled oats | butter | margarine
texte:
Apple Crumble With Tea Masala Spices

Ingredients:
- 3 apples
- 3/4 brown sugar
- 3/4 flour
- 3/4 rolled oats
- 1/3 butter
- 1/2 - 1 margarine

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375ºF/190°C.
2. Grease bottom and sides 10 inch square pan with butter or margarine.
3. Distribute apples in the mold.
4. In bowl combine remaining ingredients and mix well.
5. With your hands form crumbles. Sprinkle the crumbles over apples.
6. Bake about 30 minutes or until topping is golden brown and apples are tender.
7. Serve warm with ice cream or custard.
8. Note: You can reduce the amount of butter to ¼ of cup and add 2 tablespoons of light cream cheese.

ingredients_reels: baking mix | sugar | sugar | eggs | sour cream | blueberries
texte:
Sour Cream Blueberry Muffins

Ingredients:
- 2 baking mix
- 3/4 sugar
- 2 sugar
- 2 eggs
- 1 sour cream
- 1 blueberries

Instructions:
1. In a bowl, combine the baking mix and 3/4 cup sugar. In another bowl, combine the eggs and sour cream; stir into the dry ingredients just until combined.
2. Fold in blueberries.  Fill greased muffin cups three-fourths full. Sprinkle with the remaining sugar.
3. Bake at 375°F for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
4. Cool for 5 minutes before removing from pan to a wire rack.

ingredients_reels: white rum | Cointreau liqueur | dry vermouth | sweet vermouth | lemon juice | maraschino cherry
texte:
An Elbow in the Boobs

Ingredients:
- 1 white rum
- 1/2 Cointreau liqueur
- 1/2 dry vermouth
- 1/2 sweet vermouth
- 1/2 lemon juice
- 1 maraschino cherry

Instructions:
1. Add rum,cointreau,vermouths and lemon juice to a cocktail shaker. Shake thoroughly and pour in to a 3 oz cocktail glass garnish with a marachino cherry and serve.

ingredients_reels: tea | ginger | fresh mint leaves | sugar | boiling water | fresh lemon juice | of fresh mint
texte:
Iced Lemon & Ginger Mint Tea

Ingredients:
- 4 tea
- 8 ginger
- 1/2 fresh mint leaves
- 1/2 sugar
- 6 boiling water
- 1/2 fresh lemon juice
- 6 of fresh mint

Instructions:
1. Place tea bags, ginger, mint& sugar in saucepan.
2. Pour in boiling water, cover, and let stand 10 minutes.
3. Strain tea into large pitcher and stir in lemon.
4. Refrigerate until cold.
5. Pour into ice filled glasses and garnish with mint.

ingredients_reels: bacon | green beans | onions | salt | sugar | cayenne pepper | new potato
texte:
Old-fashioned Country Beans

Ingredients:
- 1/2 bacon
- 2 green beans
- 2 onions
- 2 salt
- 1 sugar
- 1/4 cayenne pepper
- 1 new potato

Instructions:
1. Place bacon in large saucepan and cover with water; boil 20 minutes.
2. Add green beans, onions, salt, sugar and cayenne; boil 15 minutes.
3. Add potatoes; boil until potatoes are tender.

ingredients_reels: cooked rice | lean round steak | paprika | butter | garlic cloves | beef broth | green onion | green peppers | cornstarch | water | soy sauce | tomatoes
texte:
Pepper Steak With Rice

Ingredients:
- 3 cooked rice
- 1 lean round steak
- 1 paprika
- 2 butter
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1 1/2 beef broth
- 1 green onion
- 2 green peppers
- 2 cornstarch
- 1/4 water
- 1/4 soy sauce
- 2 tomatoes

Instructions:
1. Method: While rice is cooking, pound meat to 1/4\" thickness.
2. (I use sandwich steaks, inside or outside round as it eliminates the need for pounding.) Sprinkle meat with paprika and allow to stand while preparing other ingredients.
3. Using a large skillet, brown meat in butter.
4. Add garlic and broth and simmer covered for 30 minutes.
5. Stir in onions and green peppers.
6. Cover and cook 5 minutes more.
7. Blend cornstarch, water and soy sauce.
8. Stir into meat mixture.
9. Cook, stirring until clear and thickened- about 2 minutes.
10. Add tomatoes and stir gently.
11. Serve over fluffy rice.

ingredients_reels: penne pasta | hot Italian sausage | onion | green bell pepper | garlic cloves | chopped tomatoes | kalamata olive | tomato paste | capers | anchovy paste | parmesan cheese
texte:
Italian Sausage Puttanesca

Ingredients:
- 8 penne pasta
- 8 hot Italian sausage
- 1 onion
- 1 green bell pepper
- 3 garlic cloves
- 2 chopped tomatoes
- 1/2 kalamata olive
- 2 tomato paste
- 1 capers
- 1 anchovy paste
- 1/2 parmesan cheese

Instructions:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions.
2. Drain well.
3. Meanwhile, remove casings from sasage and saute with onion, pepper and garlic over medium-high heat, stirring and crumbling sausage until sausage is done and vegetables softened (about 7 or 8 minutes).
4. Remove from heat and drain off fat.
5. Add tomatoes, olives, tomato paste, capers and anchovy paste to pan and bring to a boil.  (I like to give the tomatoes a couple of pulses in the food processor to break them up a little).
6. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
7. Remove from heat.
8. Add pasta and stir to combine.
9. Spray 8-inch square casserole dish with non-stick spray.
10. Spoon mixture into casserole and sprinkle evenly with Parmesan cheese.
11. Bake at 400°F for about 15 minutes until cheese melts and begins to brown.

ingredients_reels: chicken breast halves | salt | pepper | paprika | rosemary | white wine | water | fresh mushrooms | sour cream | flour
texte:
Crock Pot Chicken Parisienne

Ingredients:
- 6 chicken breast halves
- salt
- pepper
- paprika
- 1/4 - 1/2 rosemary
- 1/2 white wine
- 1 water
- 1 fresh mushrooms
- 1 sour cream
- 1/4 flour

Instructions:
1. Sprinkle chicken breasts lightly with salt, pepper, paprika and rosemary.
2. Place in crock pot.
3. Mix wine (or water), soup, and mushrooms until well combined.
4. Pour over chicken.
5. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours (or on high for 2 1/2 to 3 hours).
6. Mix sour cream and flour and add during the last 30 minutes.
7. Bon Appétit!

ingredients_reels: water | chicken broth | boneless skinless chicken breasts | mayonnaise | plain yogurt | curry powder | fresh lime juice | honey | ground ginger | salt | black pepper | red onion | mango | red seedless grapes | roasted cashews
texte:
Curried Chicken Salad

Ingredients:
- 4 water
- 1 3/4 chicken broth
- 1 1/2 boneless skinless chicken breasts
- 1/2 mayonnaise
- 1/3 plain yogurt
- 5 curry powder
- 1 fresh lime juice
- 1 honey
- 1/2 ground ginger
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 black pepper
- 1 red onion
- 1 mango
- 1 red seedless grapes
- 1/2 roasted cashews

Instructions:
1. Bring water and chicken broth to a simmer in a 2- to 3-quart saucepan.
2. Add chicken and simmer, uncovered, 6 minutes.
3. Remove from heat, cover pan, then let stand until chicken is cooked through (about 15 minutes).
4. Move chicken to a plate, let cool 10 minutes, then chop into 1/2-inch pieces.
5. While chicken is cooling, whisk together mayonnaise, yogurt, curry, lime juice, honey, ginger, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
6. Add chicken, onion, mango, grapes, and cashews; gently stir to combine.

ingredients_reels: unsalted butter | shortening | milk | salt | vanilla | confectioners' sugar
texte:
Classic Buttercream Frosting

Ingredients:
- 3/4 unsalted butter
- 1/4 shortening
- 1/2 milk
- 1/4 salt
- 1 1/2 vanilla
- 2 confectioners' sugar

Instructions:
1. Place butter, shortening, milk, vanilla, salt and one pound of sugar in large bowl.
2. Beat at low speed until combined.
3. Gradually add the other pound of sugar.
4. Stop and scrape sides.
5. Beat on high until mixture is light and fluffy.
6. Keep covered with plastic wrap to prevent crusting.
7. Chocolate Buttercream: For each pound of sugar used in the butter cream, allow 2/3 cup unsweetened cocoa, 3 tablespoons butter and 0.125 teaspoon salt.

ingredients_reels: eggs | milk | flour | confectioners' sugar | butter
texte:
Perfect Crepes

Ingredients:
- 5 eggs
- 1 milk
- 1/2 flour
- 1/2 confectioners' sugar
- 1/4 butter

Instructions:
1. Place all ingredients in blender and blend thouroughly.
2. Melt 1/2-1 tbls of butter in hot skillet (I use medium high heat).
3. Pour 1/4 cup batter or slightly more, depending on the size of crepe desired, into skillet.
4. Cook 2-3 minutes on each side.
5. Repeat steps 2 through 4 until batter is used up.

ingredients_reels: honey | water | prepared mustard | margarine | butter | curry powder | lemon juice | garlic clove | boneless skinless chicken breasts | cooked rice
texte:
Curry-Cajun Spiced Chicken

Ingredients:
- 1/3 honey
- 3 water
- 3 prepared mustard
- 2 margarine
- 2 -3 butter
- 2 -3 curry powder
- 1 lemon juice
- 1 garlic clove
- 6 boneless skinless chicken breasts
- cooked rice

Instructions:
1. In a 3-quart rectangular baking dish combine honey, water, mustard, melted butter, cajun seasoning, curry powder, lemon juice, and garlic; mix well.
2. Add chicken, turning to coat. Arrange in single layer.
3. Bake, uncovered, in a 350 degree oven for about 30 minutes or till chicken is tender and no longer pink.
4. Serve chicken and pan drippings with hot cooked rice.

ingredients_reels: rubbed sage | salt | ground black pepper | yukon gold potatoes | onion | cheddar cheese | heavy cream | chicken broth
texte:
Sage and Cheddar Potato Gratin

Ingredients:
- 2 rubbed sage
- 1 1/2 salt
- 1/2 ground black pepper
- 3 yukon gold potatoes
- 1 onion
- 1 cheddar cheese
- 1 heavy cream
- 1 chicken broth

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F  Mix sage, salt and pepper in small bowl.
2. Layer 1/3 of the potatoes and 1/2 of the onion in lightly greased 13x9-inch baking dish.
3. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of the sage mixture and 1/3 of the cheese.  Repeat layers.  Top with remaining potatoes, sage mixture and cheese.
4. Stir broth and cream in medium bowl with wire whisk until well blended.  Pour evenly over potatoes.
5. Bake 1 hour or until potatoes are tender and top is golden.  Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

ingredients_reels: green beans | bacon | garlic powder | salt | pepper
texte:
Awesome Green Beans!

Ingredients:
- 2 green beans
- 8 bacon
- 1 garlic powder
- 1 salt
- 3 pepper

Instructions:
1. Cook bacon in the pan, add drained beans, and the spices. If you like steak seasonning spices, you can add that too. Cook for 10 more minute.

ingredients_reels: head of cabbage | carrot | green pepper | salt | onion | vinegar | water | mustard seeds | celery seed | sugar
texte:
Freezer Coleslaw

Ingredients:
- 1 head of cabbage
- 1 carrot
- 1 green pepper
- 1 salt
- 1 onion
- 1 vinegar
- 1/4 water
- 1 mustard seeds
- 1 celery seed
- 2 sugar

Instructions:
1. Cut cabbage and onion.
2. Mix with salt and let stand one hour.
3. Mix the vinegar, water, mustard seed, celery seed, and sugar.
4. Bring all this to a boil and boil one minute.
5. Let cool until lukewarm.
6. Cut up carrot and green pepper and mix with the cabbage.
7. Pour the vinegar mixture over the cabbage, place in containers and freeze.

ingredients_reels: roma tomatoes | extra virgin olive oil | flat leaf parsley | fresh rosemary | coarse salt | sea salt | fresh ground pepper | olive oil | rosemary | garlic | whole black peppercorn
texte:
Oven-Dried Herbed Tomatoes

Ingredients:
- 20 roma tomatoes
- 1/4 extra virgin olive oil
- 2 flat leaf parsley
- 2 fresh rosemary
- 1 coarse salt
- sea salt
- fresh ground pepper
- olive oil
- 1 rosemary
- 1 garlic
- 1 whole black peppercorn

Instructions:
1. Trim the stem ends off of the tomatoes, quarter lengthwise and remove and discard seeds.
2. Place in a large bowl and add the olive oil, vinegar, parsley, rosemary, mixing well.
3. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
4. Cover bowl and allow to marinate in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours.
5. Preheat oven to 200 degrees.
6. Pack tomatoes in a single layer on parchment paper on a baking sheet.
7. Bake for 6 to 12 hours.
8. Place them in the oven  around 7:00 in the evening and bake the tomatoes throughout the night.
9. You'll have plump, juicy tomatoes.
10. Cool completely before storing.
11. To store: Place tomatoes, garlic, rosemary, pepper, in sterilized glass jars and pour olive oil over to cover, seal tightly with lids.
12. Store in the refrigerator for 2 to 3 weeks.

ingredients_reels: mushrooms | 2% fat cottage cheese | garlic cloves | cayenne pepper | chili powder
texte:
'lite' Stuffed Mushrooms

Ingredients:
- 12 mushrooms
- 1/4 2% fat cottage cheese
- 1 garlic cloves
- 2 cayenne pepper
- chili powder

Instructions:
1. Place the mushrooms in a baking dish.
2. Mix cottage cheese, jalapeno and garlic.
3. Spoon into the mushroom caps.
4. Sprinkle with cayenne or chile.
5. Have oven rack in second position down in the oven turn on broiler and broil the mushrooms until the cottage cheese is bubbly and slightly brown.
6. Serve warm.

ingredients_reels: cream cheese | marshmallow cream | vanilla
texte:
Marshmallow Fruit Dip

Ingredients:
- 8 cream cheese
- 8 marshmallow cream
- 1/2 vanilla

Instructions:
1. Soften cream cheese to about room temperature.
2. Mix cream cheese with marshmallow fluff in a medium mixing bowl with a spoon (don't try this in a blender, doesn't work well).
3. Stir in vanilla.
4. Put dip in small serving bowl on large plate with cut up fruit arranged around it and serve!

ingredients_reels: butter | margarine | garlic cloves | fresh dill | onion | zucchini | salt | pepper
texte:
Dilled Summer Squash

Ingredients:
- 2 butter
- 2 margarine
- 1 garlic cloves
- 1 fresh dill
- 1 onion
- 1 zucchini
- 1/4 salt
- 1/4 pepper

Instructions:
1. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Thoroughly wash zucchini and squash, and remove ends.
3. Slice squash and zucchini lengthwise, then cut halves into thin slices.
4. Add garlic, dill and onions to skillet, and cook for about a minute, stirring constantly.
5. Add remaining ingredients and cook 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
6. Cover, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer 3 minutes or until crisp and tender.
7. If there is too much water left in the pan, increase heat to medium-high and simmer uncovered until gone, stirring frequently.

nom: The Brigantine's Not Your Usual Blue Cheese Dressing!
ingredients_reels: blue cheese | olive oil | red wine vinegar | lime juice | salt | garlic clove | beef bouillon cube | Worcestershire sauce | pepper | sugar
texte:
The Brigantine's Not Your Usual Blue Cheese Dressing!

Ingredients:
- 8 blue cheese
- 6 olive oil
- 1 red wine vinegar
- 1 lime juice
- 1/4 salt
- 1/3 garlic clove
- 1 beef bouillon cube
- 1 Worcestershire sauce
- 1 pepper
- 1 sugar

Instructions:
1. Stir, but don't beat- all ingredients with spoon until blended.
2. Add sugar while blending.
3. Serve well chilled; the dressing will thicken when chilled.
4. (Note: cook time is chill time).

ingredients_reels: flour | sugar | butter | canola oil | water | eggs | vanilla | cinnamon | baking soda | buttermilk | butter | vanilla | cream cheese | powdered sugar
texte:
White Texas Buttermilk Sheet Cake

Ingredients:
- 2 2/3 flour
- 2 sugar
- 1/2 butter
- 1/2 canola oil
- 1 water
- 2 eggs
- 2 vanilla
- 1 cinnamon
- 1 1/2 baking soda
- 2/3 buttermilk
- 1/2 butter
- 1 vanilla
- 1 cream cheese
- 2 powdered sugar

Instructions:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees F.
2. Grease a 17\" x 11\" baking sheet.
3. In a bowl mix together the flour and sugar.
4. In a saucepan, combine 1/2 cup butter, oil and water; bring to a boil, then pour over flour mixture; beat thoroughly.
5. Beat in eggs, vanilla, cinnamon, baking soda and buttermilk.
6. Pour into prepared baking pan.
7. Bake for about 20 minutes or until cake tests done.
8. For frosting;: Cream together 1/2 cup butter, 1 tsp vanilla and the cream cheese; beat in icing sugar, adding more, if necessary to reach the desired consistency.
9. Beat until light and fluffy.
10. Spread over warm cake.

nom: Mushrooms and Watercress in Mustard Dressing
ingredients_reels: olive oil | red wine vinegar | Dijon mustard | dried tarragon | fresh chives | green onion top | mushroom | watercress | butter lettuce
texte:
Mushrooms and Watercress in Mustard Dressing

Ingredients:
- 2 olive oil
- 1 red wine vinegar
- 1 Dijon mustard
- 1 dried tarragon
- 1 fresh chives
- green onion top
- 1 mushroom
- 1/2 watercress
- 1 butter lettuce

Instructions:
1. For the dressing, mix together the oil, vinegars, mustard, tarragon, salt and pepper, and chives.
2. Add the mushrooms to the dressing, mixing lightly.
3. Add several sprigs of watercress.
4. Chill briefly.
5. Arrange the remaining watercress or butter lettuce on a platter and and mound the mushroom salad on top.

ingredients_reels: fresh spinach | olive oil | minced garlic cloves | hot red pepper flakes
texte:
Sauteed Spinach

Ingredients:
- 6 fresh spinach
- 2 olive oil
- 2 minced garlic cloves
- 1/8 hot red pepper flakes

Instructions:
1. Measure the oil into a large skillet.
2. Add the garlic to the oil and briefly sautee over medium heat.
3. Wash and dry the spinach and add to the skillet.
4. Sautee the spinach, stirring constantly, until wilted.
5. Sprinkle with red hot pepper flakes (add more or less per your tastes).
6. Enjoy!

nom: Elaine's Holiday Cut out Sugar Cookies - Christmas
ingredients_reels: butter | sugar | eggs | vanilla | flour | baking powder | salt
texte:
Elaine's Holiday Cut out Sugar Cookies - Christmas

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 1 1/2 sugar
- 2 eggs
- 2 vanilla
- 3 1/2 flour
- 1 baking powder
- 1/2 salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375.
2. Cream butter and sugar.
3. Add eggs and vanilla.  Mix well.
4. Add flour, baking powder and salt.  Mix well.
5. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour, to chill dough before rolling.
6. Roll dough thickly. (about 1/4\"). If you roll them too thin, they are hard to work with.
7. Cut shapes, and put on an ungreased baking sheet.
8. Bake 10-12 minutes.
9. Cool on rack.
10. Frost with your favorite frosting, icing, or glaze.

ingredients_reels: eggs | milk | all-purpose flour | baking powder | salt | butter
texte:
Waffles

Ingredients:
- 3 eggs
- 1 1/2 milk
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 4 baking powder
- 1/2 salt
- 5 butter

Instructions:
1. Beat yolks.
2. Stir in milk.
3. Combine dry ingredients and stir into the yolk mixture.
4. Stir in the melted butter.
5. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into batter.
6. Cook in a waffle iron according to manufacturers directions.

ingredients_reels: beef broth | chunky peanut butter | soy sauce | lemon pepper | onion powder | garlic powder | beef sirloin steaks | beef steak | green bell pepper | green onions
texte:
Weeknight Thai Beef (1 Pan & 3 Carbs!)

Ingredients:
- 1 beef broth
- 4 chunky peanut butter
- 1 soy sauce
- 1 1/2 lemon pepper
- 1/4 onion powder
- 1/4 garlic powder
- 1 beef sirloin steaks
- 1 beef steak
- 3 green bell pepper
- green onions

Instructions:
1. Start 6 servings of white rice cooking according to package directions.
2. Whisk together broth, peanut butter, soy sauce and lemon pepper in small bowl- set aside.
3. Heat large nonstick skillet on medium high-heat until hot, then add beef, onion powder, garlic powder and pepper to taste- cook and stir 5 to 7 minutes or until no longer pink.
4. Add green pepper and cook, stirring, 2 to 3 minutes or until tender- reduce heat to medium.
5. Stir in peanut sauce until well blended, and sprinkle with green onions (optional).
6. Serve over hot rice- Enjoy!

ingredients_reels: lean ground beef | onion | barbecue sauce
texte:
Best Burgers

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 - 2 lean ground beef
- 1/2 onion
- 4 barbecue sauce

Instructions:
1. Mix ingredients well. You may also choose to add some steak seasoning to taste to give it a little extra zip.
2. Shape into 5-6 patties.
3. Place into a preheated skillet, cook on medium heat 6 minutes on each side, or until juices run clear.
4. Sometimes you will need to add oil to the pan before preheating to keep the meat from sticking and burning.
5. Top with your choice of cheese and place on bun with toppings like tomatoes, lettuce, pickles, etc.

ingredients_reels: chocolate chips | sugar | self-rising flour | butter | eggs | salt | vanilla | walnuts | walnuts
texte:
Aim's Best Batch of Brownies

Ingredients:
- 1 chocolate chips
- 3/4 sugar
- 1 self-rising flour
- 1/4 butter
- 2 eggs
- 1/4 salt
- 1 vanilla
- 1/2 walnuts
- 2 walnuts

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F Line an 8x8-inch pan with foil.  Spray the foil.
2. Combine 1 cup chips and the butter.  Melt in the microwave for 1 minute, stirring until smooth.  Whisk in the sugar and eggs.  Stir in the flour and salt.  Fold in the 1/2 cup nuts and vanilla.
3. Bake for 23-25 minutes or until done.
4. Finely chop the remaining nuts.  Top the baked brownies with the remaining nuts and chips.  Return to the oven for 2 minutes to melt the chips to form a glaze.  Cool completely and cut into squares.

ingredients_reels: flour | baking soda | sugar | sugar substitute | yogurt | vanilla
texte:
Cookie Muffins

Ingredients:
- 1 flour
- 3/4 baking soda
- 1/4 sugar
- 1/4 sugar substitute
- 1/2 yogurt
- 1 -2 vanilla

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven, 375.
2. In SMALL bowl combine flour and baking soda, mix.
3. Set aside.
4. In the medium bowl beat sugar, yogurt, and vanilla till mixed.
5. Add egg and mix again.
6. Stir in the flour mixture until well blended and sticky.
7. Place sticky little rolls on cookie sheet (mine was ungreased, but greased would probably work better) and sift sugar and cinnamon over top.
8. Leave in for about 5 minutes and then CHECK.
9. Check often until the little peaky tops (which most of them will have) are slightly browned.
10. They are wonderful straight out of the oven, I don't know how they are after a while, cause we ate them-- hehehe.

ingredients_reels: dark brown sugar | butter | dark rum | dark molasses | spicy mustard | cider vinegar | ground cinnamon | fresh ground pepper
texte:
Holiday Ham Glaze

Ingredients:
- 1/2 dark brown sugar
- 8 butter
- 1/2 dark rum
- 1/4 dark molasses
- 3 spicy mustard
- 1 cider vinegar
- 1/2 ground cinnamon
- 1/2 fresh ground pepper

Instructions:
1. Mix all ingredients (just prior to use) in a non-reactive saucepan and bring to a boil.
2. Stir constantly while heating.
3. Reduce heat, stirring and allow to simmer for 5 to 10 minutes.
4. Apply to ham while warm.

ingredients_reels: butter | chicken breasts | garlic powder | seasoning salt | onion powder
texte:
Garlic Chicken

Ingredients:
- 3 butter
- 4 chicken breasts
- 2 garlic powder
- 1 seasoning salt
- 1 onion powder

Instructions:
1. Mix seasonings with melted butter and coat chicken. Sauté 10-15 minutes on each side.

ingredients_reels: old fashioned oats | milk | brown sugar | dried dates | raisins | salt
texte:
Oatmeal Master Recipe With Variations

Ingredients:
- 3 old fashioned oats
- 3 milk
- 1/2 brown sugar
- 1/2 dried dates
- 1/2 raisins
- 1/2 salt

Instructions:
1. Mix the oatmeal, milk, and 4 cups water in a large, deep saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat. When it boils, quickly turn the heat down to very low.
2. Stir in brown sugar, dried fruits, and salt and cook at a low simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until very thick and creamy. Stir often to prevent bottom of pan from burning.
3. Serve with additional milk, or cool and chill to reheat later in the week.
4. Variations:.
5. Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal:.
6. Swap 2 Granny Smith apples, peeled, cored, and chopped for the dried fruit Add 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon, plus more for serving.
7. Banana Nut Oatmeal:.
8. Swap 1/2 cup pure maple syrup for the brown sugar and 2 bananas, chopped, for the dried fruit.

ingredients_reels: butter | margarine | turkey | lettuce
texte:
Turkey, Butter and Lettuce Sandwich

Ingredients:
- 2 butter
- margarine
- turkey
- lettuce

Instructions:
1. Butter bread.
2. Place turkey and lettuce on buttered bread.
3. Eat.
4. Enjoy!

ingredients_reels: Brussels sprouts | olive oil | kosher salt | fresh ground black pepper
texte:
Low-Fat Roasted Brussels Sprouts

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 Brussels sprouts
- 3 olive oil
- 3/4 kosher salt
- 1/2 fresh ground black pepper

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F.
2. Cut off the ends of the Brussels sprouts and pull off any yellow outer leaves.
3. Mix them in a bowl with the olive oil, salt, and pepper.
4. Transfer them to a sheet pan and roast for 35 to 40 minutes, until crisp outside and tender inside.
5. Shake the pan from time to time to brown the Brussels sprouts evenly.
6. Sprinkle with more kosher salt (I like these salty like French fries) and serve hot.

ingredients_reels: butter | sugar | egg | salt | baking powder | flour | vanilla
texte:
Granny's Sugar Cookies

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 1 sugar
- 1 egg
- 1/2 salt
- 2 baking powder
- 2 flour
- 1/2 vanilla

Instructions:
1. Cream together butter and sugar.
2. Blend in egg.
3. Sift together salt, baking powder, and flour.
4. Add to mixture.
5. Blend vanilla into mixture.
6. Chill dough.
7. Roll dough to thickness desired, and cut out shapes with a cookie cutter.
8. Bake on lightly greased cookie sheet in 400°F  preheated oven for 8-10 minutes.

ingredients_reels: skim milk | vanilla | sugar-free instant vanilla pudding mix | Splenda sugar substitute | nutmeg
texte:
Eggnog for Diabetics

Ingredients:
- 5 1/2 skim milk
- 1 vanilla
- 1 sugar-free instant vanilla pudding mix
- 3 1/4 Splenda sugar substitute
- 1/4 nutmeg

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, combine vanilla and milk.
2. In another bowl, combine the dry pudding mix, sweetener, and nutmeg.
3. Whisk the dry mix into the milk mixture until smooth.  Refrigerate until serving.
4. **NOTE:  Diabetic exchange is for one cup: 1 skim milk and 1/2 starch; 17 g. carbs.

ingredients_reels: olive oil | red wine vinegar | yellow onion | tomatoes | green bell pepper | serrano chili | salt
texte:
Salsa Criolla (Chopped Tomato Salad)

Ingredients:
- 1/4 olive oil
- 1 red wine vinegar
- 1 yellow onion
- 4 tomatoes
- 1 green bell pepper
- 1 serrano chili
- salt

Instructions:
1. Pour olive oil and red wine vinegar into a large mixing bowl and whisk together.
2. Add onion, tomatoes, and green bell pepper to the bowl.
3. Toss vegetables with the dressing until evenly coated.
4. Add chile to the bowl and stir. Season to taste with salt.
5. Set aside for 30 minutes before serving.

ingredients_reels: water | white bread flour | caraway seeds | salt | butter | brown sugar | cocoa powder | sour cream | molasses | fast rise yeast | active dry yeast
texte:
Creamy Rye (Bread Machine)

Instructions:
1. Combine according to your manufacturer's directions.
2. Success Hints: For a different kind of snack, top with Simple Chutney Cheese Spread (see recipe I posted) This recipe can be made using regular or rapid rise cycles.

nom: Korean Spicy Chicken and Potato (Tak Toritang)
ingredients_reels: chicken pieces | potatoes | carrots | onion | green bell peppers | red bell pepper | garlic cloves | water | soy sauce | white sugar | fresh ginger
texte:
Korean Spicy Chicken and Potato (Tak Toritang)

Ingredients:
- 2 1/2 chicken pieces
- 2 potatoes
- 2 carrots
- 1 onion
- 1 green bell peppers
- 4 red bell pepper
- 1/2 garlic cloves
- 1/3 - 1/2 water
- 2 soy sauce
- 1 white sugar
- 3 fresh ginger

Instructions:
1. In a large pot over medium heat, mix the chicken, potatoes, carrots, onion, sugar, ginger and garlic.
2. Pour in water and soy sauce, and stir in sugar and hot pepper paste.
3. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer 45 minutes, until chicken juices run clear, vegetables are tender, and liquid has thickened.
4. You may also cook this in the crock pot for several hours.
5. The liquid will thicken as it cools.
6. Enjoy!

nom: Southwestern Chicken Chili- the Greatest Crock Pot Recipe Ever!
ingredients_reels: chicken breasts | kidney beans | whole canned tomatoes | canned corn niblets | yellow onion | chili powder
texte:
Southwestern Chicken Chili- the Greatest Crock Pot Recipe Ever!

Ingredients:
- 5 chicken breasts
- 2 kidney beans
- 2 whole canned tomatoes
- 2 canned corn niblets
- 1 yellow onion
- 5 chili powder

Instructions:
1. Put rinsed kidney beans on the bottom of the slow cooker.
2. Next add corn niblets.
3. Place 1/2 the chili Powder on top of the corn and beans.
4. Pile on the chicken slices.
5. Pour in tomatoes.
6. Cover with remaining chili powder.
7. Add the onion last as it is the softest thing in there.
8. I cook mine for about 6 hours on High.
9. It depends on how you like yours, six hours gets all the juices to almost a sauce like consistency.
10. If you want a more runny chili cook it for 5 hours.
11. 10 minutes before you serve it, put it in bowls and add tortilla chips and monterey jack cheese on top of it.
12. Serve with cornbread.

ingredients_reels: flour | margarine | butter | pistachios | cream cheese | powdered sugar | instant pistachio pudding mix | milk
texte:
Refrigerator Pistachio Dessert

Ingredients:
- 1 1/4 flour
- 1/2 margarine
- 1/2 butter
- 1 pistachios
- 1 cream cheese
- 1 powdered sugar
- 2 instant pistachio pudding mix
- 3 milk

Instructions:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Grease 9\" x 13\" pan.
3. In small bowl, combine flour and margarine until crumbly.
4. Stir in pistachios; pat into prepared pan.
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 18 to 22 minutes or until light golden brown; cool.
6. In small bowl, combine cream cheese and powdered sugar until smooth and creamy.
7. Fold in 1/2 carton of whipped topping; spread over cooled crust.
8. In large bowl, beat pudding mix and milk at medium speed until thickened, about 5 minutes.
9. Pour mixture carefully over cheese layer.
10. Spread with remaining whipped topping.
11. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | active dry yeast | water | egg | butter | sugar | salt | ham | mozzarella cheese | pimento pepper | black olives
texte:
Ham'n Cheese Picnic Bread

Ingredients:
- 3 all-purpose flour
- 1 active dry yeast
- 1 water
- 1 egg
- 1 butter
- 1 sugar
- 1 salt
- 1 ham
- 1 mozzarella cheese
- 1 pimento pepper
- 1/2 black olives

Instructions:
1. In a small bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water and let stand until fully dissolved and creamy (this will take close to 10 minutes).
2. In a large mixing bowl, combine the dissolved yeast mixture, with the flour, butter, egg, sugar and salt and mix this well.
3. When the dough has come (pulled) together, turn it out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until nice and smooth.
4. This will take around 7-8 minutes.
5. Lightly oil a large mixing bowl, place the dough in this bowl and turn to coat the dough with oil.
6. Cover with a damp cloth and set aside to rise in a warm place until it has doubled in volume.
7. This will take approximately 1 hour.
8. Preheat your oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
9. Combine ham, cheese, pimento, and olives in a medium bowl, and set aside.
10. Deflate the dough and turn it out onto a lightly floured surface.
11. ROll or pat the dough into a 10x14 inch rectangle.
12. Make parallel cuts 3/4 inch wide and 2 inches long on the two long edges of the rectangle.
13. Evenly spread the filling mixture over the center of the rectangle.
14. Fold the short ends of the rectangle over the filling.
15. Starting from one of these ends-- alternately stretch strips so that they overlap diagnally.
16. Transfer the loaf to a lightly greased baking sheet, cover with damp cloth and set aside to rise until doubled in volume.
17. This will take around 40 minutes or so.
18. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

ingredients_reels: active dry yeast | water | water | bread flour | active dry yeast | milk | water | olive oil | bread flour | salt
texte:
Ciabatta (Italian Slipper Bread)

Ingredients:
- 1/8 active dry yeast
- 2 water
- 1/3 water
- 1 bread flour
- 1/2 active dry yeast
- 2 milk
- 2/3 water
- 1 olive oil
- 2 bread flour
- 1 1/2 salt

Instructions:
1. Make sponge: Stir together, warm water and yeast.
2. Let stand 5 minutes, until creamy.
3. Transfer yeast mixture to another bowl and add room-temp water and flour.
4. Stir for 4 minutes.
5. Cover bowl with plastic wrap.
6. Let stand at cool room temp at least 12 hours and up to 1 day.
7. Make bread: Stir together yeast and milk in small bowl and let stand 5 minutes, until creamy.
8. In bowl of standing electric mixer, with dough hook, blend together milk mixture, sponge, water, oil and flour at low speed until flour is moistened.
9. Beat on medium for 3 minutes.
10. Add salt and beat for 4 more minutes.
11. Scrape dough into oiled bowl and cover with plastic wrap, until doubled- about 1 1/2 hours.
12. Note: Dough will be VERY sticky and full of bubbles.
13. Cut two pieces of parchment paper, approx 12 inches by 6 inches.
14. Place on baking sheet and flour well.
15. Turn dough out onto a well-floured surface and cut in half.
16. Transfer each half to paper and form irregular ovals approx 9 inches long.
17. Dip fingers in flour and dimple loaves.
18. Dust tops with flour.
19. Cover with dampened kitchen towel and let rise 1 1/2 to 2 hours, until almost doubled.
20. At least 45 minutes before baking bread, pre-heat pizza stone on lowest oven rack position at 425°F.
21. Transfer 1 loaf, along with parchment paper, onto stone and bake for 20 minutes or until pale golden.
22. Remove to cooling racks and repeat with second loaf.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | baking powder | baking soda | salt | unsalted butter | buttermilk | cayenne | sharp cheddar cheese
texte:
Cheddar Drop Biscuits

Ingredients:
- 1 all-purpose flour
- 1 baking powder
- 1/4 baking soda
- 1/8 salt
- 3 unsalted butter
- 2/3 buttermilk
- 1 cayenne
- 1/2 sharp cheddar cheese

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees.
2. In a midium bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, baking soda, cayenne, and salt.
3. Whisk gently to blend.
4. With a pastry blender or two knives, cut in the butter and Cheddar cheese until the mixture resembles coarse meal.
5. (Or pulse in a food processor.) Add the buttermilk and stir until just blended; do not overmix.
6. Drop by heaping tablespoons about 2 inches apart onto a lightly greased cookie sheet.
7. Bake about 12 minutes, until the biscuits are golden brown.

ingredients_reels: granulated sugar | water
texte:
Doily Sugar Starch

Ingredients:
- 1 granulated sugar
- 1/2 water

Instructions:
1. Put sugar and water in a small pan.  Over low heat cook and stir mixture constantly until it becomes clear. DO NOT LET IT BOIL!  When mixture is completely clear remove from heat and cool.
2. Next dampen the crocheted item in fresh water and pat out excess moisture with a towel.  Then dip it in the cooled sugar mixture and gently squeeze out any excess liquid.
3. If it's a doily simple lay it flat and reshape and let it dry.  For a basket, take a bowl that is the desired size, turn it upside down and place the crocheted basket over the bowl to dry.

ingredients_reels: butter | brown sugar | coconut | white sugar | vanilla extract | eggs | flour | baking powder | baking soda | salt | quick-cooking oatmeal | pecans
texte:
Socks-Off Oatmeal Cookies (No Raisins)

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 1 brown sugar
- 1 coconut
- 1 white sugar
- 2 vanilla extract
- 2 eggs
- 2 flour
- 1 baking powder
- 1 baking soda
- 1/2 salt
- 3 1/2 quick-cooking oatmeal
- 1 pecans

Instructions:
1. Mix butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla extract.
2. Add coconut.
3. Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda.
4. salt and oatmeal.
5. Blend all ingredients together.
6. Add chopped nuts.
7. Drop 1 tablespoons of batter onto greased baking sheet.
8. Bake in 350° for 15 minutes.

ingredients_reels: tomatoes | red onion | jalapeno chiles | cilantro | lime juice | salt | black pepper
texte:
Salsa Fresca

Ingredients:
- 4 tomatoes
- 1/4 red onion
- 2 jalapeno chiles
- 1 cilantro
- 2 lime juice
- 3/4 salt
- 1 black pepper

Instructions:
1. In a mixing bowl combine all the ingredients.
2. Stir and toss well.
3. Serve. Store in a covered container in the refrigerator no more than 1 day.

ingredients_reels: boneless skinless chicken breast halves | olive oil | garlic powder | lemon juice | parmesan cheese | salt | black pepper
texte:
Caesar Grilled Chicken

Ingredients:
- 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves
- 2/3 olive oil
- 1/2 garlic powder
- 1/4 lemon juice
- 1/4 parmesan cheese
- 1 salt
- 1/4 black pepper

Instructions:
1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. Place the chicken in a medium bowl.
3. In a blender, combine the remaining ingredients, Blend on high speed until mixture is smooth. Pour blended mixture over chicken, cover, and refrigerate 2 to 3 hours, or overnight.
4. Grill chicken 3 to 4 minutes per side, until no pink remains and the juices run clear.

nom: Iced Sugar Cookies (Cake-Like Cookies, Soft Icing)
ingredients_reels: butter | sugar | eggs | vanilla extract | milk | baking powder | flour | salt | powdered sugar | butter | milk
texte:
Iced Sugar Cookies (Cake-Like Cookies, Soft Icing)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 1 sugar
- 2 eggs
- 1 vanilla extract
- 1/2 milk
- 2 baking powder
- 3 flour
- 1/2 salt
- 2 powdered sugar
- 1/2 butter
- 1 -2 milk

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. For the cookies beat the butter and sugar until creamed.  Add in eggs and vanilla and beat until smooth.
3. Combine dry ingredients.
4. Add dry ingredients and milk into the creamed mixture in two batches.
5. Refrigerate dough for up to an hour.
6. Use 2 'tablespoons' (cereal spoons) to make 2-3 inch balls of dough.  (After baking you want cookies that are about the size of the palm of your hand.).
7. Bake for 10-12 minutes.  The tops of the cookies shouldn't be browned.
8. For the frosting beat all ingredients together until smooth adding more milk if necessary.  When cookies are cool, frost and add sprinkles if you like.

ingredients_reels: focaccia bread | turkey breast | dried cranberries | sharp cheddar cheese | red onion | olive oil | salt | fresh ground black pepper
texte:
Roasted Turkey Panini

Ingredients:
- 1 focaccia bread
- 1 turkey breast
- 6 dried cranberries
- 4 sharp cheddar cheese
- 1 red onion
- 1/2 olive oil
- salt
- fresh ground black pepper

Instructions:
1. Saute the dried cranberries and red onion in olive oil for two minutes. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add one tablespoon of water to keep ingredients moist. Set cranberry compote aside.
2. Slice the rosemary & onion focaccias in half, then slice horizontally to create the top and bottom sandwich portions.
3. Cover the bottom half of the focaccia with cranberry compote and top with 4 ounces of roasted turkey breast and one slice of sharp cheddar cheese.
4. Place top of focaccia over sandwich. Grill over medium-high heat on both sides.

ingredients_reels: butter | cream cheese | flour | egg | butter | vanilla | brown sugar | salt | pecans
texte:
Kathie Lee Gifford's Pecan Tarts

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 3 cream cheese
- 1 flour
- 1 egg
- 1 butter
- 1 vanilla
- 3/4 brown sugar
- 1/4 salt
- 1/2 pecans

Instructions:
1. FOR THE CRUST:
2. Cream together the softened butter and cream cheese.
3. Add the flour and beat well.
4. Mold into mini muffin tins, muffin cups, or any little container [these are BEST when they are bite-sized].
5. Refrigerate in pans overnight.
6. FOR THE FILLING:
7. Beat egg well and add oil, vanilla, brown sugar, salt and pecans.
8. To assemble:  Put a small ball of crust mixture into each hole of a mini muffin tin and, with a wet spoon, press into the bottom and sides. Repeat.
9. Then fill each shell to 2/3 full with pecan mixture.
10. Bake at 350º for 25 minutes.
11. Let cool.
12. Note: when I feel too lazy to make little tarts, I have made this as a pie - pressing the crust into a 9 X 5 loaf pan or a 9 inch square pan --  and poured the filling in -- and it satisfies the craving.

ingredients_reels: zucchini | eggplants | tomatoes | garlic cloves | brown sugar | tamari | fresh ground black pepper | cayenne | tahini
texte:
Zucchini and Garlic Spread

Ingredients:
- 5 zucchini
- 2 eggplants
- 8 tomatoes
- 4 garlic cloves
- 1 brown sugar
- 1 tamari
- fresh ground black pepper
- 1 cayenne
- 1 tahini

Instructions:
1. Steam the zucchini and eggplant until tender.
2. Sauté the tomatoes and garlic until very soft, remove from the heat and add the sugar.
3. Blend all the ingredients in a food processor or blender.
4. Serve hot or cold.
5. NOTES: Tahini is made from ground sesame seeds and is used as both for its binding qualities and for flavouring; it is rich in minerals, calcium, magnesium, phosphorus and iron. Tahini is an ingredient in most hummus recipes. Tamari is pure, top quality soy sauce, and is free from chemicals and preservatives. It can be used for flavouring in place of added salt or stock cubes in soups, vegetable dishes, pies, casseroles and dressings. Tahini and tamari are available at health food stores and large supermarkets.

ingredients_reels: baby red potatoes | low sodium chicken broth | fresh lemon juice | fresh lemon juice | extra virgin olive oil | kosher salt | fresh ground black pepper | lemon zest | fresh basil leaf
texte:
Lemon-Basil Potatoes

Ingredients:
- 16 baby red potatoes
- 2 low sodium chicken broth
- 1/2 fresh lemon juice
- 2 fresh lemon juice
- 2 extra virgin olive oil
- 1 kosher salt
- 1/4 fresh ground black pepper
- 1 lemon zest
- 1/4 fresh basil leaf

Instructions:
1. Place the potatoes, chicken stock, lemon juice, 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt, and pepper in a medium saucepan.
2. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
3. Reduce the heat and simmer until the potatoes are tender, about 20 to 25 minutes.
4. Drain the potatoes and place in a serving bowl.
5. Drizzle with the remaining olive oil.
6. Add the lemon zest, salt and pepper to taste, and 3 tablespoons of the basil.
7. Toss well and garnish with the remaining chopped basil.

nom: Roasted Potatoes With Sage and Lemon
ingredients_reels: potato | sage leaf | lemon zest | extra virgin olive oil | water | garlic cloves | ground black pepper | sage leaf
texte:
Roasted Potatoes With Sage and Lemon

Ingredients:
- 1 potato
- 1/3 sage leaf
- 1 lemon zest
- 1 1/2 extra virgin olive oil
- 1 water
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1/2 ground black pepper
- sage leaf

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 200 degree celsius.
2. Place potatoes in a large saucepan (with a lid) and cover with plenty of cold water.
3. Cover and bring to the boil, reduce heat to medium and cook, partially covered for 10 minutes, or until tender but still firm.
4. Drain well and while still warm, cut them into quarters.
5. While potatoes are cooking, in a small bowl combine the finely chopped sage, zest, oil, water, garlic and pepper.
6. Spray a 3 litre (12 cup) capacity baking dish with cooking spray.
7. Place the potatoes in the dish, pout over the sage mixture and gently toss until potatoes are evenly coated.
8. Bake, turning once halfway during cooking, about 35 to 45 minutes or until golden and crisp.
9. Garnish with the extra sages leaves if using.

ingredients_reels: parmesan cheese | heavy cream | Dijon mustard | salt | black pepper | eggs
texte:
Mustard-Baked Eggs

Ingredients:
- 1/2 parmesan cheese
- 2 heavy cream
- 2 Dijon mustard
- salt
- black pepper
- 4 eggs

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350. Lightly butter or oil two 4\" ovenproof ramekins or bowls.
2. Mix together the cheese, cream, mustard, salt, and pepper.
3. Crack two eggs into each ramekin. Pierce yolks with a toothpick. Bake eggs for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and spoon the cheese-mustard mixture over each egg. Return to oven and bake another 5-6 minutes until the eggs are done and the cheese has melted.
4. Variation: Microwaved.
5. Cover ramekins with waxed paper. Cook eggs for 2 minutes in microwave on high. Add cheese-mustard mixture. Cook for about 1 minute longer on high. (These times are approximate, since microwave ovens vary.).

ingredients_reels: sugar | boiling water | cold water | papayas | fresh lemon juice
texte:
Papaya Lemonade

Ingredients:
- 1 sugar
- 1 boiling water
- 3 1/2 cold water
- 3 papayas
- 1 fresh lemon juice

Instructions:
1. Combine sugar and boiling water, stirring until sugar dissolves.
2. Let cool slightly.
3. Place sugar syrup, 2 cups cold water, papaya, and lemon juice in blender; process until mixture is smooth.
4. Stir in remaining 1 1/2 cups cold water.
5. Serve over ice.
6. Enjoy!

ingredients_reels: salt | black pepper | onions | shallots | dry red wine | cornstarch | fresh lemon juice | red currant jelly | black currant jelly | brown sugar | Dijon mustard
texte:
Pork Tenderloin with Cumberland Sauce

Ingredients:
- 1 salt
- 1 black pepper
- onions
- shallots
- 2 dry red wine
- 1 cornstarch
- 1 fresh lemon juice
- 1 red currant jelly
- 2 black currant jelly
- 1 brown sugar
- 1 Dijon mustard

Instructions:
1. Heat 2 tsp oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Season pork lightly with salt and pepper and cook for 4 to 5 minutes per side, or until brown on the outside and no longer pink but still juicy inside.
3. Transfer to plates or a platter and keep warm.
4. Add remaining 1 tsp oil to the skillet.
5. Add onions or shallots and cook, stirring, until softened, about 30 seconds.
6. Add wine and bring to a boil, stirring.
7. Boil for 5 to 6 minutes, or until reduced to about 1/3 cup.
8. Dissolve cornstarch in lemon juice and whisk into the sauce.
9. Cook, stirring, until thickened and glossy.
10. Remove from heat and stir in jelly, sugar and mustard.
11. Taste and adjust seasonings with more salt and pepper, if needed.
12. Spoon the sauce over the pork.
13. Serves 2 with side dishes, and doubles easily.
14. Note from Julie: I used black-currant jelly and the sauce was wonderful.  I wouldn't describe it as sweet-and-sour - you'd have to taste it for yourself to know what I mean.  But I used this recipe the first time I ever cooked pork tenderloin and it's become a recipe I use again and again as a favorite!
15. Posted to Gail's Recipe Swap by Liz LA, who got it from Eating Well Magazine.

ingredients_reels: butter | powdered sugar | vanilla | all-purpose flour | baking powder | pecans
texte:
Christmas Snowball Cookies

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 2 powdered sugar
- 2 vanilla
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 1/4 baking powder
- 1 pecans

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, with a mixer on medium speed, beat 1 cup butter, 1/2 cup powdered sugar, and vanilla until smooth.
2. In a medium bowl, mix flour and baking powder.
3. Add to butter mixture, stir to mix, then beat until well blended.
4. Stir in pecans.
5. Shape dough into 1-inch balls and place about 1 inch apart on buttered 12- by 15-inch baking sheets.
6. Bake in a 300° regular or convection oven until cookies are pale golden brown, about 25 minutes.
7. If baking two sheets at once in one oven, switch their positions halfway through baking.
8. Let cookies stand on sheets until cool enough to handle.
9. Place remaining 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar in a shallow bowl.
10. Roll warm cookies in powdered sugar to coat all over; discard remaining sugar.
11. Set cookies on racks to cool completely.

ingredients_reels: olive oil | onion | garlic cloves | diced tomatoes | dried oregano | dried basil | red pepper flakes | fresh ground pepper | salt | tomato paste | cream cheese | parmesan cheese | penne pasta | fresh spinach
texte:
Creamy Tomato and Spinach Pasta

Ingredients:
- 1 olive oil
- 1 onion
- 2 garlic cloves
- 15 diced tomatoes
- 1/2 dried oregano
- 1/2 dried basil
- 1 red pepper flakes
- fresh ground pepper
- 1/2 salt
- 2 tomato paste
- 2 cream cheese
- 1/4 parmesan cheese
- 1/2 penne pasta
- 9 fresh spinach

Instructions:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat.
2. Add the pasta and cook until tender (7 to 10 minutes).  Drain the pasta in a colander.
3. While waiting for the pasta to cook, dice the onion and mince the garlic.
4. Cook both in a large skillet with the olive oil over medium-low heat until softened and transparent, about 5 minutes.
5. Add the diced tomatoes with juices, oregano, basil, red pepper flakes, salt, and some freshly cracked pepper to the skillet with the onions and garlic.
6. Stir to combine.  Add the tomato paste and a 1/2 cup of water to the skillet and stir until the tomato paste is dissolved into the sauce.
7. Turn the heat down to low.  Cut the cream cheese into a few pieces and then add them to the skillet with the tomato sauce.
8. Use a whisk to stir the sauce until the cream cheese has fully melted in and the sauce is creamy.
9. Add half of the parmesan to the skillet and whisk until it is melted inches  Add the remainder of the parmesan and whisk until melted in again.
10. Add the fresh spinach and gently stir it into the sauce until it has wilted (3 to 5 minutes).  Add the pasta and stir until it is well coated with the creamy tomato sauce.
11. Taste and adjust the salt and pepper as needed.  Serve warm.

ingredients_reels: olive oil | onion | garlic clove | artichoke hearts | vegetable broth | sour cream | fresh thyme leaves | sun-dried tomatoes
texte:
Chilled Artichoke Soup

Ingredients:
- 1 olive oil
- 1 onion
- 1 garlic clove
- 2 artichoke hearts
- 600 vegetable broth
- 150 sour cream
- 2 fresh thyme leaves
- 2 sun-dried tomatoes

Instructions:
1. Warm the olive oil in a large saucepan and saute the onion and garlic just until they are softened, but not browned.
2. Add the artichoke hearts and vegetable broth to the mixture.
3. Bring to the boil, then reduce the temperature to a simmer; partially cover the pan and allow to simmer for 3 minutes.
4. Remove from heat, and puree the mixture with a hand blender (or do the same in a food processor) until smooth.
5. Return to the saucepan and allow to cool completely.
6. After it is cooled, add the sour cream and the thyme.
7. Place in the refrigerator, covered, for 3-4 hours before serving.
8. When serving, garnish each bowl with sun-dried tomato strips, if desired.

ingredients_reels: butter | eggs | all-purpose flour | baking soda | baking powder | lemon juice | lemon zest | white sugar | salt | plain yogurt
texte:
Lemon-Yogurt Cake With Lemon Glaze

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 4 eggs
- 2 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1 baking soda
- 1 baking powder
- 1/2 lemon juice
- 2 lemon zest
- 1 1/2 white sugar
- 1/2 salt
- 1 plain yogurt

Instructions:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350°F Grease and flour bunt pan.
2. In a large bowl, beat butter until fluffy. Slowly beat in sugar.
3. Add eggs, one at a time.
4. Add lemon juice and zest; mix well.
5. In a separate bowl, combine dry ingredients.
6. Fold in dry ingredients into egg and butter mixture. Mix just until blended.
7. Fold in yogurt last.
8. Bake for 40 minutes or until done.
9. Remove cake from pan and while warm top with a lemon glaze made from 1 cup powdered sugar and the juice of one lemon. If glaze is too thin add a little more powdered sugar.

ingredients_reels: grapefruit juice | cranberry juice cocktail | sparkling water | lime
texte:
Sea Breeze Sparklers

Ingredients:
- 2 1/2 grapefruit juice
- 3 1/2 cranberry juice cocktail
- 2 1/2 sparkling water
- 1 lime

Instructions:
1. Stir juices together in a large pitcher.
2. Just before serving, stir in sparkling water.
3. Serve over ice with lime wedges.

ingredients_reels: active dry yeast | white sugar | water | buttermilk | margarine | honey | salt | sesame seeds | flax seeds | poppy seeds | toasted wheat germ | sunflower seeds | whole wheat flour | bread flour
texte:
Sesame-Sunflower-Poppy-Flax Seed Buttermilk Bread!

Ingredients:
- 1 active dry yeast
- 1 white sugar
- 3/4 water
- 1 1/2 buttermilk
- 2 margarine
- 3 honey
- 2 salt
- 2 sesame seeds
- 2 flax seeds
- 2 poppy seeds
- 2 toasted wheat germ
- 2 sunflower seeds
- 2 whole wheat flour
- 4 bread flour

Instructions:
1. In a small bowl, dissolve the yeast and sugar in the warm water.
2. Let stand until creamy, about 10 minutes.
3. Combine buttermilk, butter or margarine, honey and the yeast mixture in a large bowl.
4. Add the salt, all of the seeds and the whole wheat flour and wheat germ.
5. Stir to combine.
6. Add the bread flour, 1/2 cup at a time, mixing well with a wooden spoon after each addition.
7. When the dough has pulled together, turn it out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 6 minutes.
8. Lightly oil a large mixing bowl, place the dough in the bowl and turn to coat with the oil.
9. Cover with a damp cloth and put in a warm place to rise until doubled in volume, about 1 hour.
10. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F.
11. Grease two 9x5 inch loaf pans.
12. Deflate the dough and turn it out onto a lightly floured surface.
13. Divide the dough into two equal pieces and form into loaves.
14. Place the loaves into the prepared pans.
15. Cover with a damp cloth and let rise until doubled in volume, about 40 minutes.
16. Bake at 375 degrees F for about 30 minutes or until the tops are brown and the bottom of a loaf sounds hollow when tapped.
17. Makes 2 loaves.

ingredients_reels: cream cheese | ground cinnamon | powdered sugar | butter | vanilla
texte:
Cinnamon  Cream Cheese Frosting

Ingredients:
- 8 cream cheese
- 1 ground cinnamon
- 5 3/4 - 6 1/4 powdered sugar
- 1/2 butter
- 1 vanilla

Instructions:
1. Beat together cream cheese, butter, cinnamon and vanilla on medium speed until light and fluffy.
2. Add about half the powdered sugar and beat until mixed well. Then gradually add the remaining powdered sugar until you reach a spreading consistency.

ingredients_reels: red kidney beans | onion | garlic cloves | bacon | chili powder | red wine | chicken broth | chicken broth | chopped tomatoes
texte:
Chili Beans

Ingredients:
- 1 red kidney beans
- 1 onion
- 2 -4 garlic cloves
- 1/4 bacon
- 1 chili powder
- red wine
- 1 chicken broth
- 3 chicken broth
- 1 chopped tomatoes

Instructions:
1. Soak the beans in water overnight.
2. Drain and combine with the remaining ingredients in a large pot.
3. Bring to a boil and reduce the heat to low.
4. Simmer covered for 4 hours, or until the beans are tender and the sauce has thickened, adding more chicken broth if necessary.

ingredients_reels: milk | eggs | honey | olive oil | wheat germ | whole wheat flour | salt | baking powder
texte:
Wheat Germ Muffins (Whole Foods)

Ingredients:
- 2 milk
- 2 eggs
- 6 honey
- 6 olive oil
- 2 wheat germ
- 2 whole wheat flour
- 1 salt
- 2 1/2 baking powder

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Mix all the wet ingredients plus wheat germ together in a large bowl.
3. In another bowl mix the flour, salt, and baking powder.
4. Add the flour mix to the wheat germ mix and stir very well.
5. Fill your greased muffin tins 3/4 way full with batter.
6. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.

ingredients_reels: russet potatoes | half-and-half | fresh rosemary | unsalted butter
texte:
Rosemary Mashed Potatoes

Ingredients:
- 4 1/2 russet potatoes
- 1 1/2 half-and-half
- 2 fresh rosemary
- 1/2 unsalted butter

Instructions:
1. Cook potatoes in large pot of boiling salted water until tender, about 40 minutes. Drain. Return potatoes to pot; mash.
2. Combine half and half and rosemary in small saucepan; bring to simmer. Remove from heat; stir into mashed potatoes. Add butter; stir to melt. Season to taste with salt and pepper. (Can be made 2 hours ahead. Cover; let stand at room temperature. Before serving, stir over low heat until warm.).

nom: Hungarian Cream Cheese Cookies With Prune Lekvar
ingredients_reels: cream cheese | flour | butter | prune jam
texte:
Hungarian Cream Cheese Cookies With Prune Lekvar

Ingredients:
- 2 cream cheese
- 2 flour
- 1 butter
- 1 prune jam

Instructions:
1. Cream together the cream cheese and butter.
2. To this, add the flour - in small portions by hand.
3. When it comes together, turn over on a lightly floured surface and add the rest of the flour to form a dough (IT WILL BE SOFT - but it should be smooth)
4. Refrigerate for about 1 hour.
5. Roll out to about 1/4 inch thick on a floured surface.
6. Cut into squares about 2 x 2 and fill center with about 1/4 tsp of the lekvar.
7. Bring together opposite corners and pinch and fold over.
8. Bake on a lightly greased baking sheet for about 15 - 20 minutes until lite gold at 350F (Be careful not to let them burn).
9. While still warm, role in powdered sugar and let cool.
10. Once cooled, repeat the powdered sugar coating once more.
11. You can use any flavor lekvar or even an almond paste.
12. It just has to be really thick so it doesn't run while baking.

ingredients_reels: flour tortillas | barbecue sauce | iceberg lettuce | monterey jack pepper cheese | monterey jack cheese | avocado | pitted black olives | red bell pepper | turkey | cherry tomatoes
texte:
Southwestern Club Wrap

Ingredients:
- 4 -6 flour tortillas
- 3/4 barbecue sauce
- 1/3 iceberg lettuce
- 1/4 monterey jack pepper cheese
- 1/2 monterey jack cheese
- 1 avocado
- 1 pitted black olives
- 1 red bell pepper
- 1/2 turkey
- cherry tomatoes

Instructions:
1. Heat the oven to 250°F Wrap the tortillas in aluminum foil and warm them in the oven for about 10 minutes to soften. This will make them easier to roll. Alternately, heat each tortilla in the microwave for 10 seconds.
