3. Working with one wrapper at a time, layer each ingredient on half of the tortilla. Start with a bit of sauce (there'll be plenty left to serve on the side as well), then add the lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, avocado, olives, and peppers, using as much of each as you like. End with a piece of the turkey. Fold in each side of the tortilla and begin rolling the wrap from the end with the filling. Tuck in the filling as you roll.
4. Slice each sandwich in the center, on the bias, with a sharp serrated knife and serve (with the extra sauce in a bowl). Makes 4 to 6 wraps.

ingredients_reels: whole wheat flour | gluten | baking powder | baking soda | kosher salt | butter | milk | sour cream
texte:
100% Whole Wheat Sour Cream Biscuits

Ingredients:
- 2 whole wheat flour
- 2 gluten
- 2 1/4 baking powder
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1/2 kosher salt
- 1/4 butter
- 1/2 milk
- 1/2 sour cream

Instructions:
1. Put oven rack just below the middle so the biscuits will bake in the middle of the oven.  This will prevent the bottoms being overdone, and will produce a nice crust on the top and a tender middle.
2. Preheat oven to 400°F  Bake 18 minutes, or until the biscuit is firm with just a little \"give\" when lightly pressed on top, and are golden brown.  The time will vary slightly depending on the size of your biscuits.
3. In a medium bowl, stir together flour, gluten, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
4. Using a pastry blender, cut cold butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.  Make a well in the center of the flour mixture; set aside.  (If you don't have a pastry blender, use two table knives and keep cutting across the mixture. It takes a little longer, but works as well.).
5. In a small bowl, stir together milk and sour cream until mixture is fairly smooth.  Add the milk mixture all at once to the flour mixture in the medium bowl.  Using a wooden spoon or spatula, stir just until the dough sticks together.
6. Turn dough onto a lightly-floured surface.  Gently knead 10-12 times, or just until the dough holds together.
7. Pat dough to 1/2 thickness, forming a square or rectangle.  Cut dough into squares or rectangles.  If too large, cut squares across corner-to-corner into diamonds.  OR: roll dough with a floured rolling pin to 1/2-inch thickness and cut biscuits with a floured 3-inch biscuits cutter.  Push the cutter straight down and twist to cut the dough without tearing it.  Push the cut biscuits out of the cutter.
8. Put the cut biscuits on an ungreased baking sheet, leaving about a 1-inch space on all sides between biscuits so the sides will get \"crusty\" like the tops.
9. Bake for 18 minutes, or until golden brown.  Serve warm.

2. Cut the vanilla bean in 1/2 lengthwise, then, using the back of the knife, scrape the vanilla seeds from the pod and add to the saucepan, along with the pod.
3. Bring the mixture to a boil and cook for 4 or 5 minutes, until the sugar is dissolved and the mixture thickens. Remove from the heat and allow to cool.
4. Put the lemon juice into a 2 gallon jug or pitcher. Pour the sugar syrup through a strainer into the pitcher.
5. Add water to equal 2 gallons and stir well.
6. Serve over ice with lemon wheels or wedges.
7. Note: Dry off the vanilla pod and add to sugar for a lovely vanilla sugar.

ingredients_reels: butter | mustard | honey | seasoning salt | chili powder | onion powder | curry powder | pepper | chicken pieces
texte:
Chicken Bombay (Oamc)

Ingredients:
- 1/4 butter
- 1/4 mustard
- 1/2 honey
- 1 seasoning salt
- 1/2 chili powder
- 1/4 onion powder
- 1/4 curry powder
- 1/4 pepper
- 3 chicken pieces

Instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients, except chicken, in a small sauce pan. Heat over medium heat until smooth and slightly warmed.
2. Roll each piece of chicken into the sauce and place in a greased, 9x13 inch baking pan.
3. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes at 375°F
4. Spread remaining sauce over chicken and bake for an additional half hour or until chicken is done.
5. To freeze: after casserole has cooled, label and freeze for up to 4 months.
6. To serve: thaw overnight and bake until heated through add an additional 30-45 minutes if baking from frozen.

ingredients_reels: skinless chicken breasts | honey | soy sauce | salt | black pepper | gingerroot | garlic clove | dry white wine
texte:
BBQ Chicken Teriyaki

Ingredients:
- 6 skinless chicken breasts
- 1 1/2 honey
- 1/2 soy sauce
- 1/2 salt
- 1/2 black pepper
- 2 1/2 gingerroot
- 1 garlic clove
- 1/2 dry white wine

Instructions:
1. Melt the honey and the soy sauce together- I use the microwave for this.
2. Stir in all of the remaining marinade ingredients.
3. Arrange the chicken in a single layer in a baking dish or tin.
4. Pour the marinade over the chicken and then turn the chicken over to coat thoroughly in the marinade.
5. Leave the chicken to marinate for two hours in the refrigerator. Turn the chicken occasionally.
6. If you are picnicing you can marinate the chicken in a large tupperware container and keep it stored in your esky.
7. Cook the chicken on the BBQ plate or grill -5 to 7 minutes on each side shoud be about right. You can baste the chicken with some of the marinade in the first few minutes of cooking.
8. NOTE: Cooking time includes marinating time.

ingredients_reels: strawberries | cream cheese | vanilla extract | powdered sugar | pecans
texte:
Ww Stuffed Strawberries (1 Ww Point)

Ingredients:
- 25 strawberries
- 8 cream cheese
- 1 vanilla extract
- 3 powdered sugar
- 1/4 pecans

Instructions:
1. cut an \"X\" in  the tip of each strawberry, cutting deep but leaving strawberry whole.
2. Place cream cheese and next 3 ingredients in a medium bowl, and beat with a mixer at medium speed until smooth. place mixture in a small zip top plastic bag. seal bag; snip  a small hole in one corner of bag.
3. pipe about 2 teaspoons cream cheese mixture into each strawberry.
4. serving size=1 strawberry.

ingredients_reels: oranges | avocado | dill | napa cabbage | tomatoes | romaine leaves
texte:
Orange Slaw Wraps (Raw Vegan)

Ingredients:
- 3 oranges
- 1/2 avocado
- 2 dill
- 1/2 napa cabbage
- 2 tomatoes
- 12 romaine leaves

Instructions:
1. Slice the peel off of the 3 oranges and then section them out and get rid of any seeds. Chope one orange into chunks and place the other two into the blender.
2. Add the avocado & dill to the oranges in the blender and process until smooth.
3. Pour the dressing over the cabbage, toss, add in the additional orange, and toss again.
4. Spoon this mixture into romaine leaves, top with tomato slices, wrap up and enjoy!

ingredients_reels: paprika | onion powder | garlic powder | salt | pepper | cayenne pepper | oregano | olive oil | portabella mushrooms
texte:
Cajun Spiced Portobella Mushrooms

Ingredients:
- 3 paprika
- 2 onion powder
- 2 garlic powder
- 1 salt
- 1/2 pepper
- 1 cayenne pepper
- 2 oregano
- 1/4 olive oil
- 4 portabella mushrooms

Instructions:
1. In a wide shallow dish, mix together all ingredients except olive oil and mushrooms.
2. Lightly coat or brush both sides of the mushrooms, then dip in the spice mixture until thoroughly coated.
3. Place mushrooms on the barbecue and grill on each side until done.

ingredients_reels: butter | cream cheese | sugar | egg | vanilla | all-purpose flour
texte:
Buttery Cut-Out Christmas Cookies

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 3 cream cheese
- 3/4 sugar
- 1 egg
- 1 vanilla
- 3 all-purpose flour

Instructions:
1. Combine the first five ingredients in a large mixing bowl.
2. Beat at about medium speed until well combined and creamy, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Gradually add flour, and beat until well mixed, about 2-3 minutes more.
4. Divide dough in half, and wrap each on in plastic wrap.
5. Refrigerate until firm, at least two hours.
6. Preheat oven to 375°.
7. Roll out dough half on a lightly floured surface to about 1/4\" thick.
8. Keep the other half in the fridge until ready to use.
9. Cut out the shapes your prefer, using a 2 1/2 inch cookie cutter.
10. Place 1\" apart onto ungreased cookie sheets.
11. (I lined my sheets with nonstick \"release\" foil).
12. If I'm making Christmas cookie shapes, I sprinkle the cookies with red, green, or multi-colored sugars before baking.
13. Bake for 7-9 minutes or until edges are just slightly browned.
14. Note: I find 8 minutes is the magic number for my oven. These cookies may also be baked plain, and decorated with icings after they are cooled.

ingredients_reels: tomatoes | onions | salt | dry mustard | curry powder | sugar | tomato sauce | flour | water
texte:
Ezy-Sauce Tomato Relish

Ingredients:
- 8 tomatoes
- 3 onions
- 2 salt
- 4 dry mustard
- 4 curry powder
- 3 sugar
- 330 tomato sauce
- 1 flour
- 1 water

Instructions:
1. Peel tomatoes and onions, slice and place in a large bowl. Mix in salt, cover, and stand for 12 hours. Before cooking drain off the liquid.
2. Empty tomatoes, onions and salt into a large saucepan and bring to a boil.
3. Mix mustard and curry powder together with about 1/2 cup water to make a thin paste. Stir into pan with sugar and Ezy Sauce.
4. Boil for about 2 1/4 hours.
5. Mix about 1/2 water into flour until smooth. Stir into pan contents and cook further 15 minutes.
6. Fill, using a small jug or ladle into hot sterilized bottles or jars. Cover loosely, cool, then seal.

nom: Pressure Cooker Beef Barley Vegetable Soup
ingredients_reels: lean ground beef | crushed tomatoes | water | barley | carrots | celery | idaho potato | onion | garlic | dried basil | dried thyme leaves | dried rosemary | dried marjoram | salt | fresh ground black pepper
texte:
Pressure Cooker Beef Barley Vegetable Soup

Ingredients:
- 1 1/4 lean ground beef
- 1 crushed tomatoes
- 2 1/2 water
- 1/2 barley
- 3 carrots
- 2 celery
- 1 idaho potato
- 1 onion
- 1 garlic
- 1/2 dried basil
- 1/2 dried thyme leaves
- 1/2 dried rosemary
- 1/2 dried marjoram
- 1/4 salt
- fresh ground black pepper

Instructions:
1. Brown the beef in the pressure cooker.
2. Drain off any fat.
3. Add the tomatoes, water and barley.
4. Close pressure cooker and bring up to full pressure.
5. Reduce heat to stabilize and cook for 10 minutes While the soup is cooking, split the carrots in half lengthwise, then cut into 1/2\" thick slices.
6. Peel and dice the potato.
7. Dice the onion and mince the garlic.
8. When the soup has cooked for 10 minutes, realease pressure and add the vegetables, basil, thyme, rosemary, marjoram, salt and pepper to taste.
9. Close pressure cooker and bring up to full pressure.
10. Reduce the heat until pressure is stabilized and cook and cook 10 minutes longer.
11. Release the pressure.
12. The soup can be refrigerated for up to 4 days or frozen.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | whole wheat flour | baking powder | salt | brown sugar | beer
texte:
Wheat Beer Bread

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 whole wheat flour
- 4 1/2 baking powder
- 1 1/2 salt
- 1/3 brown sugar
- 12 beer

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan.
2. In a large mixing bowl, combine all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, baking powder, salt and brown sugar. Pour in beer, stir until a stiff batter is formed. It may be necessary to mix dough with your hands. Scrape dough into prepared loaf pan.
3. Bake in preheated oven for 50 to 60 minutes, until a toothpick inserted into center of the loaf comes out clean.

ingredients_reels: baking potatoes | bacon | 2% low-fat milk | all-purpose flour | green onions | low-fat cheddar cheese | salt | black pepper | low-fat sour cream
texte:
Baked Potato Soup

Ingredients:
- 4 baking potatoes
- 4 bacon
- 6 2% low-fat milk
- 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 4 green onions
- 5 low-fat cheddar cheese
- 1 salt
- 1/2 black pepper
- 8 low-fat sour cream

Instructions:
1. Pierce potatoes with fork and bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 45 minutes or until done.
2. Cut bacon into 1/2 inch pieces and cook in a heavy bottom soup pot over medium heat until crisp.  Remove bacon from pot and set aside, leaving drippings in the pot.
3. To the drippings in the pot add flour and stir and heat for 1 minute, whisk in milk.
4. Cook over medium heat for 15 minutes or until bubbly and thickened, stirring frequently.
5. Scoop out potato pulp from the skins; add to the milk mixture; mash with the back of a wooden spoon leaving it a little bit chuncky.
6. Add bacon (leaving a little out for topping the soup),  2 tablespoons of the onion, 1 cup cheese, and salt and pepper.
7. Stir until cheese has melted.
8. Remove from heat and stir in  sour cream; mix until combined.
9. Spoon soup into bowls, sprinkle with bacon, cheese and onions.

nom: Carolina Mustard BBQ and Basting Sauce
ingredients_reels: prepared mustard | brown sugar | cider vinegar | beer | chili powder | black pepper | cayenne pepper | Worcestershire sauce | butter | liquid smoke | Tabasco sauce
texte:
Carolina Mustard BBQ and Basting Sauce

Instructions:
1. Combine first 7 ingredients in a heavy saucepan.

texte:
Dani's Awesome Twiced Baked Potatoes

Ingredients:
- 4 baking potatoes

- 1 cream cheese
- 1/2 sour cream
- 1/4 butter

- chives

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
2. Lightly coat potatoes with oil and bake for 1 hour or until tender.

5. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise and carefully scoop flesh into a mixing bowl, leaving a 1/4 inch shell.
6. Place potato shells on baking sheet.
7. Add cream cheese, sour cream, butter,salt, pepper and garlic powder to potato mixture and whip as if preparing mashed potatoes.
8. If potatoes are a little too stiff or lumpy warm in the microwave and add 1-2 tbs milk.
9. Spoon potato mixture into shells and top with crumbled bacon, chives, and sprinkle with paprika& cheddar cheese.
10. Bake for 20 minutes or until warmed and cheese is lightly browned.

ingredients_reels: chicken breasts | monterey jack cheese | Pepperidge Farm Herb Stuffing | butter | margarine
texte:
Alice's Baked Chicken Breast

Ingredients:
- 3 chicken breasts

Instructions:
1. Grease a 9\" X 13\" baking pan.

ingredients_reels: boneless pork shoulder | onion | garlic cloves | water | tomatoes | carrots | parsnips | celery | lentils | dried rosemary | beef bouillon granules | salt | pepper | rosemary sprig

texte:

ingredients_reels: sugar | salt | butter | margarine | warm water | flour | coarse salt | baking soda | water
texte:
Soft Pretzels

Ingredients:
- 1 sugar
- 1 salt
- 1 butter
- 2 margarine
- 1 warm water
- 2 3/4 flour
- coarse salt
- 5 baking soda
- 4 water

Instructions:
1. Put yeast, sugar and water in bowl and stir.  Let sit for 5 minutes and add salt, butter and 1 cup flour.  Stir till smooth.
2. Add rest of flour and stir till mixed well.  When mixture is too stiff to stir with a spoon (or you can use an electric mixer with dough hook like I do), begin kneading.  Knead dough till smooth and the dough no longer sticks to your hands.
3. Place dough back in bowl and cover to rise to double it's size.
4. While dough is rising, grease cookie sheet and preheat oven to 475°F  Prepare baking soda boil by combining the 4 cups of water and 5 teaspoons baking soda in a non-aluminum pot and bring to a boil on stove.
5. When dough has risen, punch down and knead a minute or so.  Divide and roll into 6 inch sticks to about 1/2 inch diameter with your hands, or 12 inch long rolls to make into the pretzel shape.
6. Allow pretzels to sit for 2-3 minutes.  Place 1-2 at a time into the boiling baking soda water.
7. Let pretzels boil for 1 minute and 10 seconds on one side, then flip them over and boil 1 minute and 10 seconds on the other side.
8. This boiling step is the secret to firm skin and adds that definite pretzel flavor.  Not boiling them long enough leaves them too soft and allows them to rise too much.  Boiling too long makes them tough.  Err on the side of not too long if unsure.
9. Using a large slotted spoon, lift them  out the of water, let them drip off and place on the greased cookie sheet.  When all are done, sprinkle with course salt (Parmesan is good too!).
10. Bake 12-15 minutes until the are a medium to dark golden brown.
11. Makes 3 dozen 6 inch sticks or 1 dozen pretzels.

ingredients_reels: egg | lemon juice | Dijon mustard | canola oil
texte:
Basic Food Processor Mayonnaise

Ingredients:
- 1 egg
- 1 lemon juice
- 1 Dijon mustard
- 1 1/4 canola oil

Instructions:
1. The oil you use is up to you, and you can use one oil or a combination of oils; try using just canola oil the first time you make this, but using 1 cup canola oil and 1/4 cup olive oil is nice, too.
2. Also note that if you want a very thick mayonnaise, don't use one egg: use two egg yolks instead.
3. Okay, note number three: according to the folks at Cuisinart, you can substitute 2 tbsp of Egg Beaters for the raw egg; you OMIT the lemon juice/vinegar when you do this; I have never done this myself, mind you, so I can't vouch for the taste of the results.
4. Okay, let's make mayo.
5. Into your food processor (fitted with the metal blade, with the food pusher left in), place the egg, lemon juice, mustard, and ONE TBSP of the oil.
6. Process for one minute only.
7. The food pusher in your food processor should have a small hole in its bottom; that is for recipes like this one.
8. The next step is to place 1/4 cup of the oil in the food pusher; with the machine running, let this small amount of oil dribble through.
9. Turn machine off and remove food pusher; then turn back on and SLOWLY pour remaining oil in.
10. When done, taste; add salt and/or pepper if you wish.
11. If you want a herby mayo, add 1/4 cup lightly packed fresh herbs (try parsley) in at the beginning, along with the egg.
12. Keep mayo refrigerated.
13. Note that this is REAL mayo, not the commercial stuff loaded with preservatives, and foods prepared with it shouldn't be left at room temperature too long.

5. To make syrup, combine ingredients in a saucepan.  Boil for 1 minute.  Drizzle the syrup over the warm muffins.

nom: Cream Cheese and Bacon Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients_reels: bacon | cream cheese | onion | Worcestershire sauce | fresh white mushroom
texte:
Cream Cheese and Bacon Stuffed Mushrooms

Ingredients:
- 1 bacon
- 1 cream cheese
- 1 onion
- 1 Worcestershire sauce
- 1 fresh white mushroom

Instructions:
1. Dice bacon and fry until very crisp.  Drain on paper towel.
2. Mix onion and Worcestershire sauce with softened cream cheese.
3. Add bacon; mix well.
4. Clean and remove stems from mushrooms.
5. Fill mushroom caps with cream cheese mixture.
6. Mushrooms can be refrigerated at this point, if made in advance.
7. Bake in preheated oven, 375°F for 13 to 15 minutes, or until tops are lightly golden.
8. Watch carefully the last few minutes.

ingredients_reels: butter | margarine | eggs | instant coffee | vanilla | flour | cream cheese | flour | cinnamon | sugar
texte:
Cappuccino Cream Cheese Brownies

Ingredients:
- 4 butter
- 3/4 margarine
- 5 eggs
- 3 instant coffee
- 1 vanilla
- 1 1/4 flour
- 1 cream cheese
- 2 flour
- 1/2 cinnamon
- 2 1/3 sugar

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Microwave chocolate and butter in large microwave-safe bowl on high for 2 minutes, or until butter is melted.
3. Stir until chocolate is completely melted.
4. Stir in 2 cups of the sugar.
5. Add 4 of the 5 eggs, coffee granules and vanilla; mix well.
6. Stir in 1 1/4 cups of the flour.
7. Spread into greased and foil-lined 13x9 baking pan.
8. Beat cream cheese, remaining 1/3 cup sugar, remaining egg, 2 T. flour and cinnamon in same bowl until well blended.
9. Spoon over brownie batter, swirl with knife to marbleize.
10. Bake 40 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out with fudgy crumbs.
11. DO NOT OVER BAKE.
12. Cool in pan, cut into squares.
13. Store leftovers in refrigerator.

ingredients_reels: crushed tomatoes | tomato paste | celery ribs | onions | mushrooms | garlic cloves | salt | black pepper | dried oregano | low sodium chicken broth | canola oil | flour
texte:
Pictou County Pizza Sauce

Ingredients:
- 4 crushed tomatoes
- 1 tomato paste
- 8 celery ribs
- 5 -6 onions
- 2 mushrooms
- 4 garlic cloves
- 1/4 salt
- 1/2 black pepper
- 1 dried oregano
- 2 low sodium chicken broth
- 2 canola oil
- 2 flour

Instructions:
1. Saute onions, celery, and salt until transparent.
2. Combine in a large pot with tomatoes, tomato paste, mushrooms, and garlic.
3. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 4 hours.
4. Add pepper, oregano, and broth: simmer about 15 minutes.
5. Add flour and oil.  It's like making gravy -- start with 2 cups of each, blend well (I use a big whisk).  Depending on how thick you like your sauce, you MAY NEED TO ADD MORE of either. Additional chicken broth may also be used if you would like to thin the sauce.
6. Ready to use, jar, or freeze.

ingredients_reels: pearl barley | oatmeal | milk | heavy whipping cream | butter | brown sugar | real maple syrup | golden raisin | pecans | salt | cinnamon
texte:
Goldilock's Porridge

Ingredients:
- 1/4 pearl barley
- 3/4 oatmeal
- 2 milk
- 1/2 heavy whipping cream
- 2 butter
- 1 1/2 brown sugar
- 1 real maple syrup
- 1/4 golden raisin
- 1/8 pecans
- 3/8 salt
- 1 cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Spray small crockpot with cooking spray.
2. Place all ingredients in the crockpot and stir together.
3. Cook overnight or for 8-9 hours.  If crockpot has a temperature setting, use low.

nom: Blue Cheese & Pear Filling for Mini-Tartlets (German)
ingredients_reels: blue cheese | celery | cream cheese | fresh ground black pepper | chives | pears | lemon juice | poppy seed
texte:
Blue Cheese & Pear Filling for Mini-Tartlets (German)

Ingredients:
- 100 blue cheese
- 1 celery
- 200 cream cheese
- fresh ground black pepper
- 1 chives
- 2 pears
- 1 lemon juice
- poppy seed

Instructions:
1. Mash cheese w/a fork in a bowl. Mix in the celery + black pepper, gradually beat in the cream cheese & fold in the chives. Chill in the fridge till required.
2. Peel, quarter & core pears 20-30 min b4 serving. Cut crossways into slices & mix w/the lemon juice to stop them turning brown (I usually use my pastry brush for this).
3. Fill 18 pre-baked mini-tartlet shells w/the cheese mixture, stand a pear piece on top & sprinkle lightly w/poppy seeds (if using).

ingredients_reels: egg | sugar | all-purpose flour | milk | baking powder | ricotta cheese | shortening
texte:
Ricotta Balls (Italian Doughnuts)

Ingredients:
- 1 egg
- 1 sugar
- 1 all-purpose flour
- 3 milk
- 2 baking powder
- 1 ricotta cheese
- shortening

Instructions:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl.
2. Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot oil and deep fry.
3. Balls will turn themselves over when one side is done.
4. Fry until golden brown and cooked through adjust heat as needed if they brown too quickly without cooking through.
5. Drain on paper towels to cool and absorb oil.
6. When cool, sprinkle with powdered sugar.

ingredients_reels: garlic clove | zucchini | green onions | tomatoes | fresh parsley | parmesan cheese | romano cheese
texte:
Zucchini and Tomato Parmesan

Ingredients:
- 1 garlic clove
- 1 zucchini
- 2 green onions
- 4 tomatoes
- 2 fresh parsley
- 1/4 parmesan cheese
- 1/2 romano cheese

Instructions:
1. Preheat wok over high heat; add cooking oil.
2. Stir-fry garlic in hot oil for 15 seconds.
3. Add zucchini; stir-fry for 1½ minutes.
4. Add green onions; stir-fry about 1½ minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender.
5. Stir in tomatoes and parsley.
6. Cover and cook about 1 minute or until heated through.
7. Sprinkle with Parmesan or Romano cheese; toss gently.
8. Serve immediately.

ingredients_reels: butter | margarine | light corn syrup | vanilla | powdered sugar | milk
texte:
Creamy Brownie Frosting

Ingredients:
- 3 butter
- 3 margarine
- 1 light corn syrup
- 1/2 vanilla
- 1 powdered sugar
- 1 -2 milk

Instructions:
1. In a small mixer bowl, beat butter, cocoa, corn syrup and vanilla until blended.
2. Add powdered sugar and milk; beat until spreading consistency.
3. Note:  This makes enough for an 8x8\" pan; double it for a 9x13\" pan.

nom: Penne Noodles With Tomatoes, Cheese and Bacon
ingredients_reels: penne pasta | water | bacon | bacon drippings | garlic | dry red wine | diced tomatoes in tomato puree | tomato paste | oregano | crushed red pepper flakes | fresh Italian parsley | parmesan-romano cheese mix
texte:
Penne Noodles With Tomatoes, Cheese and Bacon

Ingredients:
- 1 penne pasta
- 1/2 water
- 6 bacon
- 4 bacon drippings
- 6 garlic
- 1/2 dry red wine
- 28 diced tomatoes in tomato puree
- 1 tomato paste
- 1 1/2 oregano
- 1/4 crushed red pepper flakes
- 4 fresh Italian parsley
- 3/4 parmesan-romano cheese mix

Instructions:
1. Fry bacon in deep fry pan.
2. Drain off all but 4 tablespoons drippings.
3. Keep bacon in pan and add garlic and stir 30 seconds.
4. Stir in wine and scrape up any browned bits on pan.
5. Add diced tomatoes, tomato paste, oregano, red pepper.
6. Simmer 10 minutes to thicken.
7. Meanwhile, cook pasta as box directs.
8. Drain off all but 1/2 cup pasta water for reserve.
9. Put pasta in serving bowl and pour sauce.
10. Can add some reserve water if seems dry a teaspoon at a time.
11. Mix in shredded cheese.
12. Sprinkle with parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste.
13. Serve immediately.
14. I have served with italian links, a chef salad, fresh bread and wine of course!

nom: Super Easy Triple Layer Lemon Pie
ingredients_reels: milk | instant lemon pudding | graham cracker pie crusts | non-dairy whipped topping
texte:
Super Easy Triple Layer Lemon Pie

Ingredients:
- 2 milk
- 2 instant lemon pudding
- 6 graham cracker pie crusts
- 1 non-dairy whipped topping

Instructions:
1. Pour milk into large bowl.  Add dry pudding mixes.  Beat with wire wisk 2 minutes or until well blended (mixture will be thick).
2. Spread 1.5 cups of the pudding onto the bottom of the crust.
3. Gently stir half of the whipped topping into remaining pudding in bowl and spread over pudding layer in crust.
4. Top with remaining whipped topping.
5. Refrigerate 3 hours or until set.  Garnish with lemon peel, if desired.  Store leftover pie in refrigerator.

ingredients_reels: rolled oats | all-purpose flour | walnuts | brown sugar | ground cinnamon | ground ginger | salt | butter | rhubarb | granulated sugar | cornstarch | raspberries
texte:
Raspberry-Rhubarb Crisp

Ingredients:
- 1 rolled oats
- 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1/2 walnuts
- 1/2 brown sugar
- 1/2 ground cinnamon
- 1/2 ground ginger
- 1/8 salt
- 1/2 butter
- 12 rhubarb
- 3/4 granulated sugar
- 2 cornstarch
- 4 raspberries

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, mix oats, flour, walnuts, brown sugar, cinnamon, ginger and salt.  With your fingers or a pastry blender, rub or cut butter into oat mixture until coarse crumbs form.  Cover and chill.
2. Rinse rhubarb; trim off and discard green parts of stalks.  Cut red parts into 1/2-inch thick slices; you need about 2 cups of sliced rhubarb.  In a large bowl, combine granulated sugar, cornstarch, raspberries and rhubarb and mix gently to coat.  Pour into a shallow 2 to 3-qt. baking dish and sprinkle evenly with the topping.
3. Bake in a 350° oven until topping is golden brown and fruit is bubbling, about 45 minutes.  Serve warm or at room temperature with ice cream or whipped cream.

nom: Pork Chops With Mustard & Sour Cream Sauce
ingredients_reels: chicken broth | sour cream | Dijon mustard | coarse grain mustard | cornstarch | fresh parsley | boneless pork chops | salt | pepper
texte:
Pork Chops With Mustard & Sour Cream Sauce

Ingredients:
- 1/4 chicken broth
- 1/4 sour cream
- 2 Dijon mustard
- 2 coarse grain mustard
- 1/2 cornstarch
- fresh parsley
- 4 boneless pork chops
- salt
- pepper

Instructions:
1. In a blender process chicken broth, sour cream, both mustards and the cornstarch until mixture is smooth and not lumpy. Transfer the mixture to a saucepan and simmer over medium heat until it becomes thickened. Stir in the parsley and keep sauce warm.
2. Heat a large skillet. Season both sides of pork chops with salt and pepper and cook on high heat until browned; about 5 minutes. Turn the pork chops over and cook another 3 minutes or until cooked through. Transfer the pork chops to dinner plates and spoon the mustard sauce over the top.

ingredients_reels: warm water | olive oil | brown sugar | bread flour | salt | active dry yeast
texte:
Plain Ole Italian Bread Abm

Ingredients:
- 1 1/3 warm water
- 1 1/2 olive oil
- 1 brown sugar
- 4 bread flour
- 1 1/2 salt
- 2 1/4 active dry yeast

Instructions:
1. Place Water, Olive Oil, Brown Sugar, 2 Cups of the Flour, and then Salt in the pan of the bread machine.  Then add the remainder 2 Cups of the Flour (make a little well) and add Yeast.
2. Use the French Bread Setting, Medium Crust, 2 lb loaf.
3. As the dough is forming you may want to check and scrape the sides a time or two.
4. Let the machine do its thing and enjoy the aroma!

ingredients_reels: granulated sugar | cold water | salt | vanilla extract | ground cinnamon | walnuts
texte:
Ila's Candied Walnuts

Ingredients:
- 1 granulated sugar
- 1/2 cold water
- 3/4 salt
- 1 vanilla extract
- 1 ground cinnamon
- 1 walnuts

Instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a skillet except walnuts. Simmer for 4 minutes or until mixture spins small thread from spoon.
2. Remove from heat and stir in walnuts. Continue stirring until syrup forms a sugar coating over the walnuts. Gently separate nuts while cooling.

ingredients_reels: unsalted margarine | sugar | egg | vanilla extract | orange zest | lemon, zest of | cake flour
texte:
Old Fashioned Vanilla Wafers

Ingredients:
- 1/4 unsalted margarine
- 1/2 sugar
- 1 egg
- 1 vanilla extract
- 1 orange zest
- 1/4 lemon, zest of
- 3/4 cake flour

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F.
2. Line 2 large baking sheets with parchment paper.
3. Cream the margarine together with the sugar on low speed until fluffy.
4. Beat in the egg and vanilla until incorporated.
5. Stir in the zests.
6. Still on low speed, beat in the flour until fully blended.
7. By teaspoonfuls, drop the batter onto the baking sheets, leaving a good two inches between each cookie.
8. Bake for about 7 minutes, or until the wafers are lightly browned along the edges.
9. Transfer to a cooling rack where they will crisp as they cool.
10. Store carefully in layers in an airtight container.

ingredients_reels: water | stone ground mustard | margarine | butter | bread flour | gluten flour | brown sugar | caraway seed | salt | dry yeast
texte:
Mustard Rye Bread

Ingredients:
- 1 1/4 water
- 1/4 stone ground mustard
- 1 margarine
- 2 butter
- 1 1/2 bread flour
- 2 gluten flour
- 1 brown sugar
- 1 caraway seed
- 3/4 salt
- 1 dry yeast

Instructions:
1. Place all ingredients in bread pan in the order that manufacturer recommends.
2. If available, select whole wheat cycle, or select Basic/White cycle.
3. When bread is baked, remove from pan and cool on wire rack.

ingredients_reels: tomatoes | water | onion | celery | fresh parsley | bay leaf | salt | paprika | salt | sugar
texte:
Homemade Tomato Juice

Ingredients:
- 12 tomatoes
- 1/2 water
- 1/3 onion
- 2 celery
- 1 fresh parsley
- 1 bay leaf
- 1 salt
- 1/4 paprika
- 1/4 salt
- 1/4 sugar

Instructions:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients into Dutch oven, bring to a boil.
2. Reduce heat.
3. Cover and simmer 30 minutes.
4. Remove from heat.
5. Put vegetable mixture through a food mill or sieve.
6. Stir in salt, paprika and sugar.
7. Chill thoroughly.
8. Serve over ice if desired.

ingredients_reels: sugar | flour | salt | baking powder | baking soda | ground cinnamon | low-fat plain yogurt | skim milk | canola oil | egg | vanilla extract | bananas | kiwi
texte:
Banana and Kiwi Muffins

Ingredients:
- 1/2 sugar
- 2 flour
- 1/2 salt
- 1 baking powder
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1/2 ground cinnamon
- 3/4 low-fat plain yogurt
- 6 skim milk
- 3 canola oil
- 1 egg
- 1 vanilla extract
- 2 bananas
- 3 kiwi

Instructions:
1. Combine the first 6 ingredients (DRY) in a large mixing bowl; set aside.
2. Mix yogurt, milk, oil, egg, vanilla and mashed bananas together in a smaller bowl until well-combined (WET).
3. Add WET mixture to the DRY mixture, mix until just combined (DO NOT OVERMIX) - lumps are ok.
4. Now stir in chopped kiwi gently; you may also add chopped nuts if you like.
5. Bake in a pre-heated oven at 375°F or 180°C for 25-30mins (mini muffins take about 20mins).
6. Cool in pan for 10mins, then remove and cool thoroughly on wire rack.

ingredients_reels: boneless skinless chicken breast halves | salt | pepper | paprika | gruyere cheese | cream cheese | parmesan cheese | sour cream | green onions | garlic | shallots | butter | fresh mushrooms | prosciutto | flour | dry sherry
texte:
Rolled Chicken Breasts

Ingredients:
- 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 pepper
- 1/4 paprika
- 1 gruyere cheese
- 1 cream cheese
- 1/3 parmesan cheese
- 1/4 sour cream
- 4 green onions
- 2 garlic
- 2 shallots
- 1/2 butter
- 1/2 fresh mushrooms
- 4 prosciutto
- 3 flour
- 3/4 dry sherry

Instructions:
1. Pound chicken breasts to flatten.
2. Mix salt, pepper and paprika; sprinkle on chicken.
3. Mix Gruyere cheese with the next 5 ingredients.
4. Saute shallots in 2 TBS butter 1 minute; add mushrooms, saute for 3 minutes.
5. Using a slotted spoon, remove mushroom mixture from pan.
6. Place 1 slice prosciutto on each chicken breast half.
7. Spread Gruyere cheese mixture over the prosciutto.
8. Fold the sides in and roll up; secure with toothpicks.
9. Brown chicken in 3 TBS butter; place chicken in greased 8 inch square baking dish.
10. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes; remove and keep warm.
11. Add remaining 3 TBS butter to skillet; stir in flour until smooth.
12. Cook and stir for 1 minute; slowly add sherry.
13. Cook and stir until thickened.
14. Add mushroom mixture; stir well.
15. Pour over chicken, return to oven; bake another 10 minutes.

nom: A Jolly Christmas Special Cosmo or Red Hot Lovers Cosmo
ingredients_reels: vodka | cranberry juice | triple sec | Cranberry Liqueur | lime, juice of
texte:
A Jolly Christmas Special Cosmo or Red Hot Lovers Cosmo

Ingredients:
- 1/2 vodka
- 1/2 cranberry juice
- 1/2 triple sec
- 1/2 Cranberry Liqueur
- 1 lime, juice of

Instructions:
1. In a shaker fill with ingredients add ice and shake.
2. Pour into a martini glass.
3. Garnish with lime slice and fresh cranberries.

nom: Blueberry Muffins With Streusel Topping Recipe
ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | ground cinnamon | brown sugar | unsalted butter | all-purpose flour | baking powder | baking soda | kosher salt | unsalted butter | sugar | eggs | vanilla extract | sour cream | milk | fresh blueberries
texte:
Blueberry Muffins With Streusel Topping Recipe

Ingredients:
- 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1 ground cinnamon
- 1/2 brown sugar
- 4 unsalted butter
- 2 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 2 baking powder
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1/2 kosher salt
- 12 unsalted butter
- 1 1/2 sugar
- 3 eggs
- 1 1/2 vanilla extract
- 8 sour cream
- 1/4 milk
- 3 fresh blueberries

Instructions:
1. For the topping: In a medium bowl, stir together the 1/2 cup flour, 1 teaspoon cinnamon and 1/2 cup brown sugar. Add the 4 tablespoons butter and combine with a fork until the topping resembles coarse crumbs. Set aside.
2. Preheat over to 350 degrees.
3. Place paper baking liners in muffin pans. In a separate medium bowl, sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
4. With electric mixer fitted with paddle attachment, cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffly, about 5 minutes.
5. At low speed, beat one egg at a time, then add vanilla, sour cream and milk until combined. Add 1/3 of the dry ingredients at a time and beat until just combined. Carefully fold in blueberries into batter.
6. Scoop batter into muffin pans filling each cup to the top. Sprinkle topping evenly over batter. Be generous.
7. Bake 30-35 minutes until cake tester comes out clean.

ingredients_reels: chili peppers | fresh cilantro leaves | flat leaf parsley | fresh lime juice | sugar | salt
texte:
Tomatillo Salsa Verde

Ingredients:
- 1 chili peppers
- 3 fresh cilantro leaves
- 3/4 flat leaf parsley
- 2 fresh lime juice
- 1 sugar
- 1 salt

Instructions:
1. Place all ingredients in a food processor or blender, and puree.

ingredients_reels: green bell peppers | minced garlic cloves | sweet onion | tomatoes | ground beef | cilantro | ground cumin | cayenne pepper | steamed rice | monterey jack pepper cheese
texte:
Southwest Stuffed Bell Peppers

Ingredients:
- 2 green bell peppers
- 3 minced garlic cloves
- 1 sweet onion
- 1 tomatoes
- 1 ground beef
- 2 cilantro
- 1/2 ground cumin
- 1/4 cayenne pepper
- 1 1/2 steamed rice
- 1 monterey jack pepper cheese

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F.
2. Slice tops off peppers and save.
3. Cut peppers in half lengthwise so they will lay flat.
4. Remove seeds and veins.
5. Steam tomato over boiling water 5-10 minutes or until the skin can be removed easily.
6. Remove skin while still warm, then when cool enough to handle remove seeds and dice.
7. (Or sub one 10 oz can steamed diced tomato) In a medium frying pan, cook garlic in 2 tbsp olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes or until it starts to turn light brown.
8. Add onions and continue to cook about 5 more minutes or until well wilted.
9. Place everything except the cheese and the peppers themselves in a large mixing bowl and mix well.
10. In a greased baking dish, place 4 pepper halves open side up.
11. Place beef mixture in each and shape until even with open end and top of pepper.
12. Bake uncovered 35 minutes.
13. Remove from oven and sprinkle cheese evenly over each pepper.
14. Bake an additional 5 minutes or until cheese is all melted.

ingredients_reels: apples | flour | quick oats | cinnamon | brown sugar | butter | nutmeg
texte:
Apple Crisp

Ingredients:
- 4 apples
- 1/2 flour
- 1/2 quick oats
- 3/4 cinnamon
- 3/4 brown sugar
- 1/3 butter
- 3/4 nutmeg

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375*.
2. Lightly spray bottom of 8- or 9-inch square pan with cooking spray.
3. Place apples in bottom of pan.
4. Mix remaining ingredients until crumbly; sprinkle over apples.
5. Bake for 30-45 minutes.

ingredients_reels: margarine | white sugar | molasses | all-purpose flour | water | baking soda | ground ginger | ground cinnamon | ground cloves | nutmeg | fresh ginger | salt | raisins | white sugar
texte:
Soft, Spicy, Heavenly Ginger Cookies

Ingredients:
- 3/4 margarine
- 1 white sugar
- 1/4 molasses
- 2 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1/3 water
- 1 1/2 baking soda
- 2 ground ginger
- 1 ground cinnamon
- 1/2 ground cloves
- 1/2 nutmeg
- 1 fresh ginger
- 1/4 salt
- 3/4 raisins
- 2 white sugar

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, cream together the margarine and 1 cup sugar until light and fluffy.
2. Stir in the molasses.
3. Mix the water and baking soda and stir.
4. Sift together the flour, salt, and dry spices; add gradually to the sugar-margarine mixture.
5. Gradually stir the sifted ingredients, along with the ginger and raisins, into the molasses mixture.
6. Shape dough into walnut sized balls, and roll them in the remaining 2 tablespoons of sugar.
7. (The dough may be too soft to handle at this point- I suggest either adding a bit of flour, or refrigerating for 20 minutes[or even overnight]).
8. Place the cookies 2 inches apart onto an ungreased cookie sheet, and flatten slightly.
9. Bake at 350°F for 10-12 minutes.

ingredients_reels: oatmeal | flour | coconut | sugar | margarine | golden syrup | baking soda | baking powder
texte:
Crunchies

Ingredients:
- 500 oatmeal
- 250 flour
- 250 coconut
- 200 sugar
- 250 margarine
- 15 golden syrup
- 5 baking soda
- 5 baking powder

Instructions:
1. Melt margarine and syrup together in a large pot.
2. Add baking soda and stir.
3. The mixture will froth up, just keep stirring until all of it has frothed up.
4. Add all remaining ingredients and mix well.
5. Press into a greased baking sheet.
6. Dough must be 1 1/2 cm thick.
7. Bake at 350F for 25 minutes.
8. While still hot, cut into squares and leave to set before removing to cooling rack.

ingredients_reels: watermelon | water | sugar | fresh lime juice
texte:
Watermelon Agua Fresca

Ingredients:
- 4 watermelon
- 4 water
- 2 sugar
- 2 fresh lime juice

Instructions:
1. Finely chop two cups of the watermelon, and set aside.
2. Place remaining two cups watermelon in a blender; process until smooth.
3. Pour pureed watermelon through a sieve into a pitcher, and discard the solids.
4. Add water, sugar and lime juice; stir until sugar dissolves.
5. Stir in chopped watermelon.
6. Cover and chill at least one hour.

ingredients_reels: carrot | garlic cloves | olive oil | cumin | cinnamon | lemon | parsley | cilantro | black olives | kalamata olive
texte:
Roasted Carrots -Memories of Morocco (Ww Core)

Ingredients:
- 1 carrot
- 1 garlic cloves
- 6 -8 olive oil
- 4 -6 cumin
- 2 cinnamon
- 1/2 lemon
- 1/2 parsley
- 1 cilantro
- 1 black olives
- 1/4 kalamata olive

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Preapare a baking sheet with a light coating of cooking spray.
2. Clean and scrub the carrots well.  Cut into sticks 2-3 inches long and quartered.  If the top sections are especially thick, cut into sixths rather than quarters. Place in large bowl.
3. Add the onion rings and halved garlic cloves to the bowl of carrots.  Drizzle oil on top and sprinkle the cinnamon and cumin. Toss the vegetables to coat.
4. Place the vegetables in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet and cook for 10 minutes. Check the vegetables, turning lightly and return to the oven to cook an additional 5 to 10 minutes.  (Actual cooking time will vary by the size of your sticks.) You want the carrots to be tender but still crisp and the onions and garlic to be nice and soft.
5. Place the roasted vegetables into a serving bowl and toss with the parsley, cilantro, olives and juice from the 1/2 lemon.
6. Serve hot or at room temperature.

ingredients_reels: flour tortillas | butter | margarine | water | sugar | ground cinnamon
texte:
Fruit Filled Tortilla Roll Ups

Ingredients:
- 8 flour tortillas
- 1/4 butter
- 2 margarine
- 1 water
- 1 1/2 sugar
- 1 ground cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Fill tortillas with pie filling and place folded side down in a greased 9x13 pan.
2. Bring 1 cup sugar, water and margarine or butter to a boil and pour over tortillas.
3. Sprinkle top with 1/2 cup sugar mixed with the cinnamon.
4. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes.
5. Let stand before serving to allow the filling to thicken.

ingredients_reels: granulated sugar | egg substitute | soft silken tofu | vanilla | all-purpose flour | wheat flour | baking soda | salt | cinnamon | allspice | walnuts | apples
texte:
Vegan Apple Walnut Cake

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 granulated sugar
- 2 egg substitute
- 2 soft silken tofu
- 3 vanilla
- 1 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 wheat flour
- 1 1/2 baking soda
- 1 salt
- 1 cinnamon
- 1/4 allspice
- 1 walnuts
- 3 apples

Instructions:
1. Chop walnuts and dice apples.
2. Preheat the oven to 350°F In a large bowl, combine the oil, sugar, egg substitute, and vanilla.
3. In a separate bowl, sift the flour, baking soda, and salt.
4. Add this to the oil-and-sugar mixture and stir by hand, approximately 200 strokes, until it is thoroughly mixed.
5. Fold in the walnuts and diced apples. The batter will be a little stiff.
6. Pour it into a greased and floured 10-inch tube or Bundt pan or use two bread pans.
7. Bake the cake at 350°F for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

ingredients_reels: eggs | sugar | vanilla extract | all-purpose flour | salt | baking soda | apples | pecans | butter | margarine | milk | brown sugar | salt
texte:
Caramel Apple Coffee Cake

Ingredients:
- 3 eggs
- 2 sugar
- 1 1/2 vanilla extract
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 3 salt
- 1 baking soda
- 1 apples
- 3 pecans
- 1 butter
- 1/2 margarine
- 1/4 milk
- 1 brown sugar
- 1 salt

Instructions:
1. In a mixing bowl, beat eggs until foamy; gradually add sugar. Blend in oil and vanilla.
2. Combine flour, salt and baking soda; add to egg mixture. Stir in apples and pecans.
3. Pour into a greased 10-in. tube pan; bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until the cake tests done.
4. Cool in pan on a wire rack for 10 minutes.
5. Remove cake to a serving platter.
6. For topping, combine all ingredients in a saucepan; boil 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
7. Slowly pour over warm cake (some topping will run down onto the serving plate.).

ingredients_reels: strawberries | rhubarb | sugar | crystallized ginger | fresh lime juice | lime zest
texte:
Strawberry-Rhubarb Compote

Ingredients:
- 2 strawberries
- 1 rhubarb
- 3/4 sugar
- 3 crystallized ginger
- 1 fresh lime juice
- 3/4 lime zest

Instructions:
1. Place 1 1/2 pounds strawberries and rhubarb in medium pot.
2. Mix in sugar, ginger, lime juice, and peel.
3. Cook over high heat until sugar dissolves, stirring often.
4. Boil 4 minutes, stirring often.
5. Reduce heat to medium; simmer just until rhubarb is beginning to fall apart, about 3 minutes.
6. Remove from heat.
7. Stir in remaining strawberries.
8. Cool.
9. Chill until cold at least 1 hour and up to 1 day.

ingredients_reels: butter | water | carrots | celery ribs | garlic clove | tarragon | black pepper | salt
texte:
Carrots and Celery Tarragon

Ingredients:
- 6 butter
- 2 water
- 6 carrots
- 3 celery ribs
- 1 garlic clove
- 2 tarragon
- 1/4 black pepper
- 1/8 salt

Instructions:
1. In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.
2. Add all remaining ingredients.
3. Reduce heat to medium-low; cover and cook (stirring occassionally) for about 20 minutes or until veggies are to your desired tenderness.

ingredients_reels: butter | onion | garlic cloves | thyme leaves | ground sage | ground black pepper | potatoes | sauerkraut | beef kielbasa
texte:
Grandpa's Sauerkraut and Kielbasa

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 1 onion
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1/2 thyme leaves
- 1/4 ground sage
- ground black pepper
- 3 potatoes
- 1 sauerkraut
- 1 beef kielbasa

Instructions:
1. Put the cold butter in a cold pan with the diced onion, and slowly bring to a simmer on medium heat.
2. This brings out the sweetness of the onions.
3. Simmer for about 10 minutes.
4. Add minced garlic and simmer 2 more minutes.
5. Add next 3 ingredients.
6. Combine with the sauerkraut (undrained and not rinsed), kielbasa and potatoes.
7. Bring to a simmer on the stove top.
8. Cover loosely with foil and place in a preheated 225°F oven for 3 hours.

nom: Braised Short Ribs With Dijon Mustard
ingredients_reels: dry red wine | short rib of beef | shallots | Dijon mustard | plum tomatoes
texte:
Braised Short Ribs With Dijon Mustard

Ingredients:
- 4 dry red wine
- 4 short rib of beef
- 10 shallots
- 3 Dijon mustard
- 6 plum tomatoes

Instructions:
1. Boil wine in a 2-quart heavy saucepan until reduced to about 1 cup.
2. While wine is reducing, pat ribs dry and cut crosswise into 1-rib pieces (each about 2 1/2 inches long).
3. Season well with salt and pepper.
4. Heat a dry 5-quart heavy pot over moderately high heat until hot, then brown ribs well in 3 batches on all sides, about 8 minutes for each batch.
5. Transfer browned ribs with tongs to a bowl.
6. Reduce heat to moderate and brown shallots well in fat remaining in pot, stirring.
7. Transfer with a slotted spoon to another bowl.
8. Stir wine and mustard into juices in pot.
9. Add ribs and simmer, covered, 1 3/4 hours.
10. Gently stir in shallots and tomatoes and continue to simmer, covered, without stirring, until meat is very tender, about 40 minutes.
11. Carefully transfer ribs, shallots, and tomatoes to a platter and skim off any fat from cooking liquid.
12. Season sauce with salt, pepper, and mustard to taste and pour over ribs.

ingredients_reels: butter | sugar | brown sugar | egg | vanilla | pumpkin puree | dried cranberries | flour | baking powder | baking soda | salt | cinnamon | ginger | nutmeg | allspice | clove
texte:
Pumpkin Cranberry Cookies

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 1/4 sugar
- 1/4 brown sugar
- 1 egg
- 1 vanilla
- 2/3 pumpkin puree
- 3/4 dried cranberries
- 1 3/4 flour
- 1/2 baking powder
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1/8 salt
- 1 cinnamon
- 1/2 ginger
- 1/2 nutmeg
- 1/4 allspice
- 1/4 clove

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F.
2. Cream together the butter and the sugars.
3. Beat in the egg, pumpkin and vanilla.
4. Mix dry ingredients together and then add to the wet ingredients and blend well.
5. Stir in dried cranberries.
6. Drop batter by rounded tablespoons onto a greased cookie sheet.
7. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.

ingredients_reels: milk | egg | butter | honey | salt | bread flour | whole wheat flour | bread machine yeast | butter
texte:
Honey Wheat Rolls

Ingredients:
- 1 1/4 milk
- 1 egg
- 2 butter
- 1/4 honey
- 3/4 salt
- 2 3/4 bread flour
- 1 whole wheat flour
- 1 1/4 bread machine yeast
- 2 butter

Instructions:
1. Place ingredients except for the melted butter in the pan of the bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer.
2. Select dough cycle; press start.
3. When dough cycle has finished, turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and shape into rolls by pinching and pulling the dough into balls, with smooth side facing up.
4. Place on lightly greased cookie sheets; cover and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour.
5. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
6. Brush rolls with melted butter. Bake in preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes.
7. Alternative: These can be stored after shaping in the refrigerator until ready for rise.
8. Simply remove from fridge and allow to come to room temperature, which is usually all the additional rising time they need.
9. They should be approximately double the size after shaping.
10. Bake as usual.

ingredients_reels: dried thyme leaves | dry mustard | celery seeds | garlic powder | boneless pork loin roast
texte:
Thyme/Mustard Pork Roast

Ingredients:
- 4 dried thyme leaves
- 2 dry mustard
- 2 celery seeds
- 1 garlic powder
- 5 boneless pork loin roast

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
2. In a small container thoroughly mix thyme, mustard, celery seed & garlic powder. [NOTE: I usually just rub the thyme between my thumb & index finger to crush some of the leaves.].
3. Rinse the roast & pat it dry with paper towels.
4. Rub herb mixture over the roast [OR roll the roast in it].
5. Place fat side up on a rack in a shallow roasting pan.
6. Roast, uncovered about 3 1/4 hours.
7. About 30 minutes before end of roasting time, insert meat thermometer with tip in center of largest muscle of roast.
8. Roast should be ready to remove from oven when internal temperature reaches 165 degrees F.
9. Cover with tent of foil, then let stand 10-15 minutes before carving, during which time internal temperature SHOULD reach 170 degrees F.

ingredients_reels: olive oil | onions | garlic cloves | garbanzo beans | whole tomatoes | salt | fresh ground black pepper
texte:
Stewed Tomatoes and Garbanzo Beans

Ingredients:
- 1 olive oil
- 1 1/2 onions
- 2 garlic cloves
- 2 garbanzo beans
- 1 whole tomatoes
- 1/4 salt
- 1/8 fresh ground black pepper

Instructions:
1. Heat oil in a medium sauce pan. Sauté the onion and garlic for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring frequently, until the onions start to brown.
2. Add all remaining ingredients.
3. Cover and simmer 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove cover. Serve.

ingredients_reels: mayonnaise | sour cream | heavy cream | lemon juice | garlic powder | dried dill weed
texte:
Rich Homemade Ranch Dressing

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 mayonnaise
- 1/2 sour cream
- 1/4 heavy cream
- 2 lemon juice
- 1/2 garlic powder
- 1/2 dried dill weed

Instructions:
1. Place all ingredients in blender or food processor, blitz on high speed for 2 minutes.
2. The mixture will look runny, but will thicken as it chills.
3. Store in an airtight container in refrigerator for up to two weeks.

ingredients_reels: potatoes | olive oil | pepper | salt | garlic cloves | paprika
texte:
Spanish-Style Oven Fries

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 potatoes
- 1 olive oil
- 1/4 pepper
- 1 salt
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1 paprika

Instructions:
1. Cut each potato lenghtwise in 8 wedges.
2. Mix all the ingredients in a bowl.
3. Place potatoes on a baking sheet coated with a little olive oil or cooking spray.
4. Bake at 400 degrees for 60 minutes, tossing once or twice.

nom: Crock Pot Dilly Beef for Sandwiches
ingredients_reels: beef roast | dill pickles | chili sauce | garlic cloves
texte:
Crock Pot Dilly Beef for Sandwiches

Ingredients:
- 5 beef roast
- 1 dill pickles
- 1 chili sauce
- 2 garlic cloves

Instructions:
1. Place beef in slow cooker, cutting in half if necessary.
2. Add all other ingredients.
3. Cover.
4. Cook on low about 8 hours, or until beef is tender.
5. Discard pickles.
6. Remove roast from broth.
7. When cool enough to handle, shred the meat.
8. Return meat to the sauce and heat through.
9. Serve on hamburger buns.

ingredients_reels: tuna | mayonnaise | onion | green pepper | dried basil | dried oregano | butter | margarine | cheese
texte:
Garden Tuna Melts

Ingredients:
- 1 tuna
- 1/2 mayonnaise
- 1/4 onion
- 1/4 green pepper
- 1/2 dried basil
- 1/2 dried oregano
- butter
- 8 margarine
- 4 cheese

Instructions:
1. Mix tuna, mayo, onion, green pepper, and seasonings.
2. Cover each of 4 bread slices with tuna mixture, one slice of cheese and second bread slice; spread outsides of sandwiches with butter.
3. Cook in skillet on medium heat until lightly browned on both sides and cheese is melted.

ingredients_reels: butter | sugar | baking soda | cream of tartar | egg | vanilla | all-purpose flour | sugar | ground cinnamon
texte:
Old-Fashioned Snickerdoodles

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 1 sugar
- 1/4 baking soda
- 1/4 cream of tartar
- 1 egg
- 1/2 vanilla
- 1 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 2 sugar
- 1 ground cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Beat softened butter until creamy.  Add your 1 cup sugar, baking soda and cream of tartar; mixing together.  Beat egg and vanilla into the mixture.  Slowly add the flour until entirely combined.  At this point if you can manage to wait long enough,  let the dough sit in the fridge for at least a half an hour.  This step isn't absolutely necessary but it allows the dough to firm up so that it's easier to work with.
2. Stir together the 1 teaspoons cinnamon and 2 tablespoons sugar.  Shape the dough into small balls and coat with your cinnamon/sugar mixture.  Place a few inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake in a preheated 375°F oven for 9 - 11 minutes (depending on how hot your oven runs).  The recipe recommends taking them out of the oven when the edges are golden, but they are especially delicious slightly underbaked.   They will be cool enough to eat in no time at all.

ingredients_reels: asparagus spears | grainy mustard | white wine vinegar | caster sugar | light olive oil | salt | black pepper
texte:
Asparagus with Grainy Mustard Dressing

Ingredients:
- 20 asparagus spears
- 2 grainy mustard
- 1 white wine vinegar
- 1 caster sugar
- 1/4 light olive oil
- salt
- black pepper

Instructions:
1. Trim tough ends off asparagus.
2. Cook until just tender in a saucepan of boiling salted water.
3. Drain and place on serving dish.
4. Shake or whisk the dressing ingredients together and pour over asparagus.
5. Serve hot or cold.

ingredients_reels: eggs | onion | salt | black pepper | butter
texte:
Russian Chopped Eggs With Onion

Ingredients:
- 8 eggs
- 2/3 onion
- 1 salt
- black pepper
- 3 butter

Instructions:
1. Chop eggs very finely.
2. Fry onion until light brown and stir in salt and pepper.
3. Mix in the butter.
4. Spread on bread slices.

ingredients_reels: butter | salt | granulated sugar | cinnamon | unbleached flour
texte:
Medieval Fine Cakes

Ingredients:
- 6 butter
- 1 1/2 salt
- 3 granulated sugar
- 1/2 cinnamon
- 12 unbleached flour

Instructions:
1. Cream together the sugar, salt, and butter.
2. Mix together the cinnamon and flour.  Add this to the creamed mixture.  Mix in water, as needed, to make the dough manageable.
3. Press dough into 2-3 baking sheets lined with baking parchment; prick all over with a fork at regular intervals.
4. Bake at 325 degrees F for 30 minutes; cut into 100 squares.

ingredients_reels: black plums | nectarines | brown sugar | flour | margarine | oats | cinnamon
texte:
Peaches and Plums

Ingredients:
- 4 black plums
- 3 nectarines
- 1/2 brown sugar
- 1/3 flour
- 1/4 margarine
- 3/4 oats
- 1/4 cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Lightly grease a shallow 2 quart baking dish.
2. Mix plums and nectarines, spread in dish.
3. Mix sugar and flour, cut in margarine with pastry blender.
4. Stir in oats.
5. Sprinkle mixture evenly over fruit.
6. Dust with cinnamon.
7. Bake at 350 30-35 minutes.
8. Serve warm.

ingredients_reels: steel cut oats | milk | pure vanilla extract | ground cinnamon | fine sea salt | pure maple syrup | dates
texte:
Creamy Breakfast Oatmeal (Rice Cooker)

Ingredients:
- 2/3 steel cut oats
- 1 2/3 milk
- 1 pure vanilla extract
- 1 1/4 ground cinnamon
- 1 fine sea salt
- 2 pure maple syrup
- 1/2 dates

Instructions:
1. Place all ingredients, except dates, in cooker; stir gently to combine; sprinkle dates on top.
2. Close the cover, set on Porridge cycle.
3. NOTE1: This recipe is designed for a rice cooker with fuzzy logic - use the porridge setting. If you have a regular rice cooker, you will need to watch it to determine when the oatmeal is done, probably 25 to 30 minutes, depending on your cooker.
4. NOTE2: Steel cut oats vary slightly. With some brands I find I need to reduce the milk to 1 1/2 cup to get the right consistency.
5. NOTE3: You can substitute vanilla flavored soy milk for the milk plus vanilla extract.

ingredients_reels: sugar | baking soda | salt | whole wheat flour | olive oil | 1% low-fat milk | bananas | vanilla | raisins
texte:
Banana Raisin Muffins

Ingredients:
- 1/4 sugar
- 1 baking soda
- 1/4 salt
- 1 1/2 whole wheat flour
- 1/4 olive oil
- 1/4 1% low-fat milk
- 2 bananas
- 1 vanilla
- 1/3 raisins

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375º degrees.
2. In a large bowl add sugar, baking soda, salt, and flour. Stir well to combine dry ingredients.
3. Add oil, milk, mashed bananas and vanilla, mix just until flour is moistened. Fold in raisins.
4. Using a non-stick muffin pan or muffin papers, fill muffin cups approximately 2/3 full with batter.
5. Bake for approximately 15-20 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from pan and let cool.

ingredients_reels: potatoes | water | garlic clove | salt | milk | unsalted butter | white pepper | smoked sausage | green onions | dried marjoram | eggs | swiss cheese | parsley
texte:
Ofenguck (Peek-In-The-Oven Casserole)

Ingredients:
- 2 potatoes
- water
- 1 garlic clove
- 1/4 salt
- 1/2 milk
- 4 unsalted butter
- 1/4 white pepper
- 1 smoked sausage
- 2 green onions
- 1 dried marjoram
- 4 eggs
- 4 swiss cheese
- 2 parsley

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
2. Combine potatoes, water, garlic and salt in a pan over high heat.
3. Bring to a boil.
4. Reduce heat to medium and cook until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.
5. Drain potatoes and place in a bowl.
6. Discard garlic.
7. Add milk, butter and white pepper.
8. Mash well.
9. Add sausage, green onions and butter and mix well.
10. Spread mixture into a large well-greased oval casserole.
11. With the back of a large, moistened spoon, make 4 deep depressions in mixture.
12. Break an egg carefully into each depression.
13. Bake on middle rack of oven for 20 minutes.
14. Sprinkle with grated Swiss cheese.
15. Bake until egg whites are firm, about 3 to 5 minutes more.
16. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve.

ingredients_reels: low-fat mayonnaise | lime juice | curry powder | apples | granny smith apples | dried sweetened cranberries | celery | pecans | scallion
texte:
Curried Cranberry Chicken Salad

Ingredients:
- 1 low-fat mayonnaise
- 2 lime juice
- 1 1/2 curry powder
- 4 1/2 apples
- 2 granny smith apples
- 1 dried sweetened cranberries
- 1 celery
- 1/2 pecans
- 1/4 scallion

Instructions:
1. Combine mayonnaise, lime juice and curry powder in large mixing bowl.
2. Stir in remaining ingredients.

ingredients_reels: sugar | onion | bacon | salt | vinegar | pepper | endive | lettuce
texte:
Suss-Saures Kartoffelgemuse (Sweet-And-Sour Potatoes)

Ingredients:
- 8 sugar
- 3/4 onion
- 1 bacon
- 4 salt
- 1/4 vinegar
- 3/4 pepper
- 1/4 endive
- lettuce

Instructions:
1. Peel and cube potatoes.
2. Add diced onion, salt, pepper, and sugar.
3. Reserve in a covered bowl.
4. In a small frypan, fry the bacon until crisp.
5. Add the vinegar to the hot bacon and bring to a boil.
6. Pour immediately over potato mixture, mix well.
7. If too tart, add a little more sugar before serving.
8. Cut endive or leaf lettuce, add to this it's very good.

ingredients_reels: potatoes | salt | pepper
texte:
Quick Hash Browns

Ingredients:
- 3 -5 potatoes
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 pepper

Instructions:
1. The number of potatoes simply depends upon the number of people you are feeding.
2. Wash and do not peel the potatoes. Microwave on high until mostly done. If using 2-3 small red potatoes for two servings this will be about 2 1/2 minutes.
3. While microwaving the potatoes fill a bowl with iced water. When potatoes are done drop them into the ice water and cut them lengthwise in half to expedite cooling.
4. When just cool enough to handle shred each half without peeling. Keep the peel against your palm while shredding and most of the peel will remain in your hand. Discard the peel and continue with recipe.
5. Place shredded potatoes in skillet sprayed with vegetable spray and cook over medium heat until well browned. Flip and repeat.
6. (I don't use salt and pepper, I had to include something else here or the system would not let me publish this. Add it if you would like.).
7. NOTE: If you want to add other items to these then shred them onto a plate first, add the other items and them place in fry pan. You might want to add some diced onion, bacon or bacon bits, shredded cheese, chives or whatever you might imagine.

ingredients_reels: water | sugar | frozen unsweetened raspberries | tea bags | lemon juice
texte:
Raspberry Iced Tea

Ingredients:
- 4 water
- 1 1/2 sugar
- 1 frozen unsweetened raspberries
- 10 tea bags
- 1/4 lemon juice

Instructions:
1. In a large kettle or Dutch oven, bring water and sugar to a boil. Remove from the heat; stir until sugar is dissolved. Add the raspberries, tea bags and lemon juice. Cover and steep for 3 minutes. Strain; discard berries and tea bags.
2. Transfer tea to a large container or pitcher. Refrigerate until chilled. Serve over ice.

ingredients_reels: baguette | garlic | olive oil | tomatoes | cucumber | red onion | kalamata olives | black olives | cheese | hard-boiled eggs | red capsicum | capers | artichoke heart | pesto sauce | herbs
texte:
Pan Bagnat

Ingredients:
- 1 baguette
- 1 garlic
- 1/4 olive oil
- 1 tomatoes
- 1 cucumber
- 1/2 red onion
- 1/2 kalamata olives
- black olives
- 4 cheese
- 2 hard-boiled eggs
- 1 red capsicum
- 1/4 capers
- 1 artichoke heart
- 1/2 pesto sauce
- herbs

Instructions:
1. slice the bread in half lengthwise, nearly all the way through.
2. Carefully open the loaf and spread the garlic on one of the cut sides.
3. Drizzle the olive oil on both sides.
4. Layer the tomato, cucumber, onion and olives and any of the optional ingredients on one half of the bread.
5. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.
6. Close the loaf and wrap in tightly in plastic wrap or aluminium foil.
7. Weight the full length of the Pan Bagnat with a heavy book[or several] for 1-3 hours.
8. Slice and serve.

ingredients_reels: ground coffee | boiling water | 2% low-fat milk | sugar | ground cinnamon
texte:
Café Con Leche

Ingredients:
- 2/3 ground coffee
- 2 boiling water
- 2 2% low-fat milk
- sugar
- ground cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Place coffee in bottom of prewarmed French press. Add boiling water, replace lid (without lowering filter), and allow to brew for 5 minutes.
2. Meanwhile, place milk in a small saucepan. Bring just to boiling point (the first larger bubble breaking on surface), then reduce heat to barely simmering. Simmer gently for a few minutes, stirring occasionally, until coffee is done.
3. After the 5 minutes are up, depress plunger on press to strain grounds. Divide coffee evenly between 4 mugs. Add hot milk to each cup in equal amounts to coffee.
4. Sweeten to taste. Garnish with a dash of cinnamon, if desired.

ingredients_reels: olive oil | butter | dried basil | dried rosemary | dried thyme
texte:
Herb Toasts

Ingredients:
- 2 olive oil
- 2 -3 butter
- 1/2 dried basil
- 1/2 dried rosemary
- 1/2 dried thyme

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
2. Split the bread horizontally.
3. Brush all four circles with the oil or butter; sprinkle the combined herbs over the bread.
4. Put them on oven trays and bake for 7 to 10 minutes, depending on your oven.
5. You can cut the bread in pieces before baking or carefully break them up after they are baked and cooled, this gives a more\"rustic\" look For variations add: garlic, cayenne, paprika or some fresh grated Parmesan.

nom: Charmaqine's Oatmeal Cookies With Raisins, Dates, and Walnuts
ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | baking powder | ground cinnamon | baking soda | salt | unsalted butter | vegetable shortening | sugar | dark brown sugar | honey | eggs | vanilla extract | old fashioned oats | raisins | pitted dates | walnuts
texte:
Charmaqine's Oatmeal Cookies With Raisins, Dates, and Walnuts

Ingredients:
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 1 baking powder
- 1 ground cinnamon
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1/2 salt
- 3/4 unsalted butter
- 1/4 vegetable shortening
- 1 sugar
- 1 dark brown sugar
- 1/4 honey
- 2 eggs
- 1 vanilla extract
- 3 old fashioned oats
- 1 raisins
- 1 pitted dates
- 1 walnuts

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper and spray with nonstick spray.
3. Mix first 5 ingredients in medium bowl.
4. Using electric mixer, cream butter, shortening, and both sugars in large bowl until fluffy.
5. Add honey, eggs, and vanilla, then gradually beat in flour mixture. Stir in oats, raisins, dates, and walnuts.
6. Drop batter by tablespoonfuls onto prepared sheets, spacing mounds 2 inches apart. Flatten cookies slightly with the bottom of a buttered glass.
7. Bake cookies 10-12 minutes at 350F or until until golden brown.
8. Cool completely on sheets.
9. When cool, store in airtight containers.

ingredients_reels: rolled oats | whole wheat flour | baking powder | salt | honey | olive oil | 1% low-fat milk
texte:
Oatmeal Whole Wheat Quick Bread

Ingredients:
- 1 rolled oats
- 1 whole wheat flour
- 2 baking powder
- 1/2 salt
- 1 1/2 honey
- 1 olive oil
- 1 1% low-fat milk

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 425.
2. Grind oatmeal in a food processor or blender.
3. In a large bowl, combine oatmeal, flour, baking powder, and salt.
4. In a separate bowl, dissolve honey in oil then stir in milk.
5. Combine both mixtures and stir.
6. Turn out onto a lightly loiled baking sheet and bake for about 20 minutes.

ingredients_reels: Baileys Irish Cream | Kahlua | white creme de menthe
texte:
Girl Scout Cookie Shot

Ingredients:
- 1/2 Baileys Irish Cream
- 1/2 Kahlua
- 1/2 white creme de menthe

Instructions:
1. Add ingredients to a shaker and shake (either on ice or not).
2. Pour into shot glass. Enjoy!

ingredients_reels: margarine | confectioners' sugar | marshmallow cream
texte:
Marshmallow Filling

Ingredients:
- 3/4 margarine
- 2 confectioners' sugar
- 2 marshmallow cream

Instructions:
1. Mix together margarine and powdered sugar.
2. Stir in marshmallow cream until blended.

ingredients_reels: yellow cornmeal | sugar | flour | baking powder | baking soda | salt | buttermilk | eggs | vanilla | butter | honey
texte:
Honey Hush Cornbread

Ingredients:
- 1 1/4 yellow cornmeal
- 1/4 sugar
- 3/4 flour
- 1 1/2 baking powder
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1/2 salt
- 1 buttermilk
- 2 eggs
- 1/2 vanilla
- 1/2 butter
- 2 honey

Instructions:
1. Set oven at 350 degrees.  Grease an 8x8 inch baking pan with shortening.  Pop the pan in the oven to heat while you're mixing up the cornbread.
2. Mix the cornmeal, sugar, flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a bowl.  In another bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, eggs, vanilla and melted butter.
3. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and give them a good stir, just until everything is moistened.
4. Pull the hot greased pan from the oven and pour in the batter.
5. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean.
6. Take the cornbread out of the oven and brush the top with honey.
7. Cool for 10 minutes in the pan before cutting into squares.

ingredients_reels: sugar | flour | water | cinnamon | butter
texte:
Streusel Topping

Ingredients:
- 3/4 sugar
- 3/4 flour
- 1 water
- 1 1/2 cinnamon
- 1/4 butter

Instructions:
1. mix all ingredients until crumbly -- .

ingredients_reels: quick oats | margarine | butter | egg | cherry pie filling | brown sugar | pecans
texte:
Cherry Crumb Bars

Ingredients:
- 1 quick oats
- 1 1/4 margarine
- 1/2 butter
- 1 egg
- 1 cherry pie filling
- 1/4 brown sugar
- 1/2 pecans

Instructions:
1. Heat oven to 350°. Grease and flour a 13x9-inch pan.
2. Combine cake mix, 6 tablespoons butter and 1 cup rolled oats. Reserve 1 cup of this for crumb topping.
3. To remaining mixture, add egg; mix well.
4. Press into pan. Pour cherry filling over crust; spread to cover.
5. In large bowl add remaining 1 cup crumb mixture, 1/4 cup oats, 2 tablespoons butter, nuts, and brown sugar. Mix well. Sprinkle over cherries. Bake 30-40 minutes.

ingredients_reels: canola oil | black mustard seeds | cumin seed | red pepper flakes | yellow onion | garlic cloves | green chili pepper | potatoes | salt | ground turmeric | ground coriander | ground cumin | fresh spinach
texte:
Indian Spiced Spinach With Potatoes

Ingredients:
- 2 -4 canola oil
- 3/4 black mustard seeds
- 1/2 cumin seed
- 1 -2 red pepper flakes
- 1/2 - 1 yellow onion
- 3 garlic cloves
- 1 green chili pepper
- 4 1/2 potatoes
- 1/2 - 1 salt
- 1 ground turmeric
- 1 ground coriander
- 1 ground cumin
- 4 fresh spinach

Instructions:
1. Heat the oil over medium heat. When it's hot, add in the mustard seeds. When they start popping, add in the cumin seeds, then the chile/red pepper flakes. Stir for a few seconds. ( I sometimes have trouble with getting my mustard seeds to pop. I always suspect that it has to do with their age, but I'm only guessing there. If they don't pop in  a reasonable amount of time, I just proceed. It's never affected the flavor of the finished dish).
2. Add the onion, garlic and green chile if you're using one. Stir fry these for 5 minutes, adjusting the heat down partway through the fry time.
3. Add the potatoes and increase the heat a little. Stir fry for 5 minutes, then cover, turn the heat back down a bit, and cook  for 4 minutes. I lift the lid and give them a quick stir halfway through this time. The potatoes and onion will be starting to brown at this point.
4. Stir in the salt and spices. Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan and continue to cook for 10 minutes. Give a quick stir after the first 5 minutes.
5. Add the spinach and increase the heat. Stir in the spinach as it wilts, then cover pan again, reduce heat again and let cook for another 7 minutes.
6. Remove the lid and test one of the potatoes, they should be cooked through at this point. (if not, recover and cook a bit longer) Reduce the heat a little and continue cooking to evaporate any remaining juices from the spinach. Stir frequently during this time to avoid sticking.

nom: Baked Pork Chops W/ Garlic Parmesan Sauce
ingredients_reels: boneless pork chops | salt | pepper | milk | Dijon mustard | butter | margarine | garlic | white wine | chicken broth | parmesan cheese
texte:
Baked Pork Chops W/ Garlic Parmesan Sauce

Ingredients:
- 6 boneless pork chops
- 1/2 salt
- 1/2 pepper
- 1/4 milk
- 2 Dijon mustard
- 1 butter
- 1/4 margarine
- 1 1/2 garlic
- 3/4 white wine
- 1/3 chicken broth
- 1/2 parmesan cheese

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
2. Season chops with salt and pepper.
3. Mix milk and mustard; dip chops into mixture and coat with breadcrumbs.
4. Place chops on rack in a broiler pan; bake for 30 minutes or until done.
5. FOR THE SAUCE: Melt 1 Tbsp butter in small saucepan over med-high heat; add garlic and saute for 2-3 minutes.
6. Stir in cream, wine/broth and cheese; reduce heat and simmer (no boil) for 3-4 minutes.
7. Whisk in 3 Tbsp of butter until melted.
8. Pour over chops and serve.

ingredients_reels: butter | margarine | powdered sugar | vanilla | all-purpose flour | salt | powdered sugar
texte:
Russian Tea Cakes

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 1/2 margarine
- 1 powdered sugar
- 2 1/4 vanilla
- 1/4 all-purpose flour
- 3/4 salt
- powdered sugar

Instructions:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees F.
2. Beat butter, 1/2 cup powdered sugar and the vanilla in large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed, or mix with spoon.
3. Stir in flour and salt.
4. Stir in nuts.
5. Shape dough into 1-inch balls.
6. Place about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
7. Bake 8 to 9 minutes or until set but not brown.
8. Immediately remove from cookie sheet; roll in powdered sugar.
9. Cool completely on wire rack.
10. Roll in powdered sugar again.

ingredients_reels: tomatoes | garlic clove | mayonnaise | fresh dill | salt | pepper
texte:
Russian Tomato Salad

Ingredients:
- tomatoes
- 1 -2 garlic clove
- mayonnaise
- fresh dill
- salt
- pepper

Instructions:
1. Slice the tomatoes into thick (approx. 3/8”) slices, and place on a platter.  They mostly should not overlap.  Save the ends for nibbling.
2. If using garlic, discard the center green shoot, and finely chop the garlic.  Rub it over the tops of the tomato slices.  I personally like the garlic, but I go easy – even a little can be strong/spicy.
3. Put some mayo in the corner of a quart Freezer bag (not a snack, sandwich or storage bag – you need a strong bag.)  Snip a small corner off the bag.  (Fun Idea - could use a frosting tip for fun effects.).
4. This is the fun part :-)  Squeeze the mayo attractively onto the tomatoes.   I use ribbons, stripes, swirls, etc.  Nina used Lots of mayo, but you can use as much or little as you like.
5. Sprinkle liberally with chopped dill.  I might also sprinkle with some salt and pepper.

ingredients_reels: milk | canned pumpkin | sugar | vanilla extract | pumpkin pie spice | brewed coffee
texte:
Pumpkin Spice Latte

Ingredients:
- 2 milk
- 2 canned pumpkin
- 2 sugar
- 2 vanilla extract
- 1/2 pumpkin pie spice
- 1/4 brewed coffee

Instructions:
1. In a small saucepan, heat milk, pumpkin and sugar until sugar is dissolved and everything is steaming hot. Transfer to a blender with vanilla and pumpkin pie spice. Process until foamy, about 15 seconds. Pour into one large or two small mugs and top with espresso.

ingredients_reels: water | chicken bouillon | fresh coarse ground black pepper | cayenne pepper | garlic cloves | fresh ginger | chicken | mushroom | basmati rice | carrots | celery ribs | onion | green onions
texte:
Kristi's Chicken Noodle Casserole

Ingredients:
- 9 water
- 3 chicken bouillon
- fresh coarse ground black pepper
- cayenne pepper
- 7 garlic cloves
- 1 fresh ginger
- 1 chicken
- 1 mushroom
- 2 basmati rice
- 4 carrots
- 4 celery ribs
- 1 onion
- 3 green onions

Instructions:
1. Put first 6 ingredients in to a pot with a large opening.  Boil until liquid is reduced by roughly 1/4 (leaving 3/4 of original volume in pot, you're going to need a lot of liquid).
2. Add chicken and mushrooms, simmer for 45 minutes, or until chicken is done.
3. Preheat oven to 350°F.
4. Assemble casserole in a shallow dish.  Dry rice to line the bottom, then uncooked veggies (carrots, celery, etc), then cooled broth with chicken and mushrooms.
5. Cook, uncovered, in oven for approx 1 hr, or until rice is fluffy and most liquid has boiled off.

ingredients_reels: tomatoes | onion | brown sugar | salt | pepper | cinnamon | allspice | clove
texte:
15 Minute Chili Sauce

Ingredients:
- 1 tomatoes
- 1 onion
- 1/2 brown sugar
- 1 salt
- 1 pepper
- 1/2 cinnamon
- 1/2 allspice
- 1/2 clove

Instructions:
1. Mix all ingredients together and boil slowly for 15 minutes.
2. DONE!

ingredients_reels: butter | almond paste | sugar | eggs | flour | cornstarch | baking powder | milk
texte:
Almond Pound Cake

Ingredients:
- 2/3 butter
- 3 1/2 almond paste
- 1 1/4 sugar
- 4 eggs
- 2 1/4 flour
- 5 cornstarch
- 1 baking powder
- 1/2 milk

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
2. Cream butter and almond paste until fluffy.
3. Add sugar, gradually add eggs, one at a time.  Mix together flour, cornstarch and baking powder, then add flour mixture and milk alternately.
4. Bake in greased 9x5 loaf pan for 1 hour.
5. Double recipe for a bundt pan and bake 75 minute.
6. Cool 10 min in pan, then turn out and cool completely.
7. Serve with powdered sugar, orange glaze or chocolate glaze.

ingredients_reels: scallion | fresh parsley leaves | fresh basil | tarragon leaf | eggs | heavy cream | cream cheese | butter | fresh chives
texte:
Luxury Scrambled Eggs

Ingredients:
- 1 scallion
- 1/2 fresh parsley leaves
- 1/2 fresh basil
- 6 tarragon leaf
- 2 eggs
- 4 heavy cream
- cream cheese
- 2 butter
- fresh chives

Instructions:
1. Combine the chopped herbs. In a medium bowl use a fork to loosely combine the eggs and cream. Stir in cream cheese, the herbs, and a little salt and pepper. Eggs do not have to be completely uniform.
2. In a 10-inch heavy non-stick skillet melt the butter over medium heat. Add the eggs and stir with a spatula for a few seconds.
3. Lower heat to medium low and keep stirring, scraping up any egg sticking to the pan, for 3 minutes, or until large curds form. Eggs can be served almost wet, moist yet approaching firm (my preference), or quite firm.
4. Serving suggestion:  Serve hot, maybe with a salad of tart greens and orange sections for contrast.

ingredients_reels: unsalted butter | brown sugar | ground cinnamon | walnuts | unsalted butter | sugar | maple syrup | eggs | bananas | flour | baking soda | salt | walnuts
texte:
Banana Maple Nut Coffee Cake

Ingredients:
- 2 unsalted butter
- 1/3 brown sugar
- 1/2 ground cinnamon
- 1/3 walnuts
- 4 unsalted butter
- 1/2 sugar
- 1/2 maple syrup
- 2 eggs
- 3 bananas
- 1 2/3 flour
- 3/4 baking soda
- 1/2 salt
- 1/2 walnuts

Instructions:
1. To make the topping mix all ingredients together using your fingers or a wooden spoon, mix in the nuts.
2. Preheat oven to 350*F.  Brush an 8X8 inch square pan or a 9X2 inch round pan with melted butter and dust lightly with flour, or spray generously with cooking spray.
3. Beat the butter, sugar and maple syrup with an electric mixer.  Add the eggs all at once.  Scrape the sides and bottom of bowl.  Mix in the bananas.
4. Sift together the flour, baking soda and salt; add to the banana mixture, blending well.  Stir in the walnuts.  Spread into prepared pan.  Drop the topping in small dollops onto the banana batter.  Bake for 45 to 50 minutes or until the coffee cake is a deep golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.  Cool in the pan for 30 minutes.  Invert onto a plate,then invert again so coffee cake is right side up on a serving plate.

ingredients_reels: water | cinnamon | cinnamon sticks | ginger powder | sugar | walnuts | pine nuts
texte:
Arabic Cinnamon Drink (Iner)

Ingredients:
- 3 water
- 1 cinnamon
- 5 cinnamon sticks
- 1/4 ginger powder
- 3 sugar
- 1 walnuts
- 1 pine nuts

Instructions:
1. Boil all the ingredients in a saucepan except nuts on high heat, then simmer for 15 minutes.
2. Strain into cups.
3. Garnish with nuts.
4. Serve hot.

ingredients_reels: flour | baking powder | sugar | salt | egg | milk | butter
texte:
Fannie Farmer Griddlecakes

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 flour
- 2 1/2 baking powder
- 3 sugar
- 3/4 salt
- 1 egg
- 3/4 milk
- 3 butter

Instructions:
