1. Mix together the dry ingredients.  Add the beaten egg and melted butter and stir vigorously, adding more milk, if necesary, to make the batter just thin enough to pour.  Drop by spoonfuls or pour from pitcher onto heated and greased griddle or frying pan using medium heat.  When full of bubbles and the underside is browned, turn and brown the other side.  Serve with maple syrup and additional butter.

ingredients_reels: basmati rice | cumin seed | turmeric | bay leaf | cloves | black cardamom pods | cinnamon | ginger | garlic | green chilies | yellow onion | tomatoes | green peas | salt | fresh lemon juice | salt
texte:
Nepalese Vegetable Pulao

Ingredients:
- 1 1/4 basmati rice
- 1/3 cumin seed
- 1/2 turmeric
- 1 bay leaf
- 6 cloves
- 2 black cardamom pods
- 1/4 cinnamon
- 1/2 ginger
- 1 garlic
- 3 green chilies
- 1 yellow onion
- 1/2 tomatoes
- 1/2 green peas
- salt
- 1 fresh lemon juice
- salt

Instructions:
1. Rinse rice thoroughly, and then soak it in water for about 45 minutes.
2. Heat 2 Tablespoons of oil in a pan, and add cumin seeds, allowing them to heat until they begin to change color.
3. Then add turmeric, bay leaf, cloves cardamom pods and cinnamon.
4. Then add ginger, garlic and chilies.
5. Cook on medium heat for just a minute.
6. Next, add the onion, tomato and green peas, and cook for 3 minutes.
7. Now, drain the water from rice and add rice, stirring gently for a minute to combine thoroughly.
8. Add 2 and 1/2 cup of water, and add salt to taste.
9. Cook on high heat, stirring gently but continuously.
10. When water is almost absorbed, add lemon juice.
11. Lower your heat, cover the pan, and allow it to continue cooking for approximately 7 minutes or so, until the rice is completely cooked.
12. Serve immediately.

ingredients_reels: parmesan cheese | pepper
texte:
South Beach Parmesan Crackers

Ingredients:
- 8 parmesan cheese
- pepper

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degress.
2. If using seasonings, mix cheese and seasoings
3. Place a 2Tbs mound of cheese on a nonstick baking sheet, and using the back of a spoon (or your thumb) press the mound into a circle that is about 2-2 1/2inches in diameter.
4. Repeat the previous step, with about 1 inch between circles.
5. Bake for about 8-12 minuets, or until the crackersare golden brown.
6. Allow the crackers to cool on the baking sheet until they set, and then transfer to a paper towel lined plate or hard surface.  This will help drain excess oils.
7. Store in a airtight container between layers of wax paper.
8. Enjoy!

ingredients_reels: pecans | butter | curry powder | salt
texte:
Curried Pecans

Ingredients:
- 2 pecans
- 1 1/2 butter
- 1 curry powder
- 1/2 salt

Instructions:
1. Put pecans and butter into a 9\" x 9' pan.
2. Heat in 350F degrees oven until butter melts.
3. Stir well to coat nuts.
4. Continue to roast, stirring every 2-3 minutes  for about 15 minutes, they can burn if you arent careful!
5. Remove from oven.
6. Transfer to paper towels so grease will be absorbed a bit then put nuts into bowl.
7. Sprinkle with curry powder and salt if desired.
8. Stir to mix thoroughly.

ingredients_reels: potatoes | onion | butter | salt | pepper | dill weed | sharp cheddar cheese | paprika
texte:
Microwave Potatoes a La Helga

Ingredients:
- 3 potatoes
- 1 onion
- 1 -2 butter
- salt
- pepper
- 1/2 dill weed
- 1/2 sharp cheddar cheese
- 1 paprika

Instructions:
1. Cube potatoes into 1/2\" chunks.
2. Melt butter on high for 30 seconds in a microwave safe dish (2L).
3. Add in onions and potatoes and toss to coat.
4. Sprinkle with salt, pepper dill and paprika.
5. Cover and microwave at full power 10-12 minutes   or until tender.
6. Sprinkle with cheese.  Cover and let stand 5 minutes or until cheese melts.

nom: Crock Pot Cranberry Port Pork Roast
ingredients_reels: boneless pork loin roast | whole berry cranberry sauce | port wine | cranberry juice | sugar | lemon | garlic clove | candied ginger | dry mustard | salt | black pepper | cornstarch | cold water | rice
texte:
Crock Pot Cranberry Port Pork Roast

Ingredients:
- 2 1/2 - 3 boneless pork loin roast
- 1 whole berry cranberry sauce
- 1/3 port wine
- 1/4 cranberry juice
- 1/2 sugar
- 1/3 lemon
- 1 garlic clove
- 2 candied ginger
- 1/2 dry mustard
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 black pepper
- 3 cornstarch
- 2 cold water
- rice

Instructions:
1. Put the roast in slow cooker.
2. Mix in a bowl, cranberry sauce, port, and sugar.
3. Stir in lemon, raisins, garlic, ginger, mustard, salt, and pepper.
4. Pour over roast Cover and cook on low 6-7 hours or until meat is 170°F.
5. Remove roast and keep warm Measure 3 cups of cooking juices and pour into saucepan.
6. Bring to a boil.
7. In a cup dissolve cornstarch in cold water.
8. Stir into saucepan.
9. Cook, stirring until thickened.
10. Slice roast and serve over rice with sauce on top.

ingredients_reels: milk | ground beef | egg | onions | salt | white pepper | ground allspice | butter | margarine | all-purpose flour | beef bouillon cube | boiling water | half-and-half
texte:
Tailgate Swedish Meatballs

Ingredients:
- 1/2 milk
- 3/4 ground beef
- 1 egg
- 1 onions
- 3 salt
- 1 1/2 white pepper
- 1/4 ground allspice
- 1/4 butter
- 2 margarine
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 1 beef bouillon cube
- 3/4 boiling water
- 1/2 half-and-half

Instructions:
1. Put bread crumbs and 1/4 cup milk in a small bowl and set aside until milk is absorbed.
2. In a large bowl, mix ground beef, egg, onion, salt, pepper, allspice and the bread crumbs. Mix well.
3. Form the meat mixture into meatballs about 1 inch in diameter.
4. Melt butter in a large frying pan.
5. Brown meatballs about 10 to 15 at a time, removing them to a large bowl as they are done.
6. When all meatballs are browned, remove pan from heat.
7. Add flour all at once to the drippings stirring with a wooden spoon until smooth.
8. Add 3/4 cup of boiling water and a bouillon cube stirring constantly.
9. Return frying pan to medium heat. Stir until bouillon cube is dissolved.
10. Add cream and 1/2 cup of milk.
11. Bring to a simmer, stirring constantly and cook three minutes longer until sauce is thick and smooth.
12. Return meatballs to the skillet and warm through, tossing to coat.

nom: Lemon Bar/Square Renovation - Ww 2-3 Pts Each
ingredients_reels: flour | light brown sugar | unsalted butter | eggs | vanilla extract | powdered sugar | lemon juice
texte:
Lemon Bar/Square Renovation - Ww 2-3 Pts Each

Ingredients:
- 1 1/3 flour
- 5 light brown sugar
- 8 unsalted butter
- 4 eggs
- 1/2 vanilla extract
- 1 1/2 powdered sugar
- 3/4 lemon juice

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350*.
2. Make crust: mix flour and brown sugar using a food processor until fully incorporated. Toss butter into flour mixture and pulse to combine until butter is cut into tiny pea-sized pieces and dough appears lumpy. Pack gently into ungreased 13 x 9 x 2\" pan (I lined mine w/foil to simplify cutting). Bake 20 minutes until golden.
3. Meanwhile: Make lemon topping. Beat eggs in medium bowl w/electric mixer (I just did everything in the food processor for easy cleanup). Add vanilla extract and 3/4 c powdered sugar. Mix well. Add lemon juice and remaining powdered sugar until sugar is completely dissolved.
4. As soon as crust is finished, remove from oven and reduce temperature to 300*. Immediately pour lemon mixture over hot crust. Bake completely, about 30 minutes Cool and  cut into 24 bars.
5. NOTE: Instructions emphasize that the crust MUST be hot when you pour the lemon mixture over. Not sure why, but they made a special note, so I'm passing that along.

ingredients_reels: heavy cream | Brussels sprouts | salt | thick slab bacon | pepper | nutmeg | gruyere cheese
texte:
Gratin of Brussels Sprouts

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 heavy cream
- 1 1/2 - 2 Brussels sprouts
- salt
- 3 thick slab bacon
- pepper
- 1 nutmeg
- 3 gruyere cheese

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 450.
2. Lightly butter a medium sized gratin dish.
3. In a small saucepan, simmer the cream over medium heat until it is reduced to 3/4 cup, about 10 minutes.
4. Trim the base of the sprouts, discard the tough outer leaves, and rinse well.
5. Place the sprouts ina medium-sized saucepan with salt and cold water to cover.
6. Bring to a boil and continue boiling for 1 minute.
7. Drain and refresh under cold running water.
8. Saute the bacon in a small skillet until lightly brouwned, 2-3 minutes.
9. Drain on paper towels then coarsely chop.
10. Combine the sprouts and bacon in the buttered gratin dish and season with the salt, pepper and nutmeg.
11. Pour the cream over the top and sprinkle with the cheese.
12. Bake until nicely browned and crispy on top, about 15 minutes.

ingredients_reels: quick oats | sugar | salt | flour | baking powder | vanilla extract | egg | butter
texte:
Lace Cookies

Ingredients:
- 1 quick oats
- 1 sugar
- 1/2 salt
- 7 flour
- 1/4 baking powder
- 2 vanilla extract
- 1 egg
- 1/2 butter

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
2. In a large bowl mix dry ingredients together.
3. Pour melted butter over dry ingredients.
4. Add egg and vanilla extract.
5. Drop by 1/2 teaspoons onto cookie sheets lined with aluminum foil, shiny side up.
6. Bake for 12 minutes.
7. Cool on foil then peel foil from cookies.

ingredients_reels: eggs | flour | flour | milk | milk | canola oil | salt | confectioners' sugar | butter | lemon juice | confectioners' sugar
texte:
Dutch Baby Poofed Pancake

Ingredients:
- 3 eggs
- 1/4 flour
- 1 flour
- 1/4 milk
- 1 milk
- 1 canola oil
- 1/4 salt
- 1 confectioners' sugar
- 2 butter
- 2 lemon juice
- 1/8 confectioners' sugar

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400 and put a cast iron skillet inside to get hot.
2. Whisk or beat eggs.
3. Add milk and oil and whisk again.
4. Add flour and salt and whisk very well.
5. Remove skillet from oven, melt butter and swirl to coat entire surface [wiping sides with a paper towel dipped in the butter].
6. Pour in batter all at once.
7. Return to oven and bake for 18-20 minutes - it's better not to be too golden brown on the underside - and may take a few (delicious) tries to figure what degree of doneness YOU like best with your oven and pan.
8. Remove and serve at once garnished with slim lemon wedges and sprinkled with confectioner's sugar.
9. I would think you could use a souffle or casserole dish but haven't tried it myself.

ingredients_reels: bananas | butter | sugar | cinnamon | milk | ice cream
texte:
Baked Bananas

Ingredients:
- 6 bananas
- 1/3 butter
- 1 sugar
- 2 cinnamon
- milk
- ice cream

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375.
2. Cut the bananas in halves. Butter a baking dish thoroughly,  and place the bananas flat in them. Sprinkle the sugar mixed with the cinnamon over the bananas, and don’t move them.
3. Pour the milk over the banans until they are  all covered , cut butter into little cubes and scattered all over the bananas, cover with foil.
4. Place baking dish on a edged baking sheet in case millk cooks over, bake with foil on for the first five minutes, then uncover and let the cook until brown on top.
5. This dessert can be served hot or cool with vanilla cream on the side, or on it's own.

ingredients_reels: cream cheese | salsa | tortilla chips
texte:
Salsa and Cream Cheese Dip

Ingredients:
- 4 -6 cream cheese
- 1 salsa
- tortilla chips

Instructions:
1. Place softened cream cheese (not super soft!) in a serving dish.
2. Cover cream cheese with salsa of choice.
3. Enjoy with favorite brand or homemade tortilla chips.
4. You may need to pour more salsa over cream cheese as you munch along.

ingredients_reels: granulated sugar | salt | unsalted butter | active dry yeast | warm water | eggs | all-purpose white flour | unsalted butter | brown sugar | cinnamon | pecans | walnuts | unsalted butter | powdered sugar | fresh lemon juice
texte:
Cinnamon Pecan Rolls

Ingredients:
- 1/2 granulated sugar
- 1/2 salt
- 1 unsalted butter
- 1/2 active dry yeast
- 2 warm water
- 1/2 eggs
- 2 all-purpose white flour
- 4 -5 unsalted butter
- 1/2 brown sugar
- 1 cinnamon
- 1 pecans
- 2 walnuts
- 4 unsalted butter
- 1 powdered sugar
- 1 1/2 fresh lemon juice

Instructions:
1. In a small saucepan, scald the milk.
2. Pour hot milk over the granulated sugar, salt and 1/2 cup of butter.
3. Cool to lukewarm.
4. In the bowl of an electric mixer, dissolve yeast in warm water.
5. Let sit for 5 minutes until yeast is bubbly.
6. Add milk mixture to yeast and stir to mix.
7. With a whisk, beat in eggs.
8. Fit your mixer with a dough hook, add flour 1 cup at a time, mixing until smooth.
9. Add enough flour to make a soft dough.
10. Knead, adding small amounts of flour as necessary until the dough is smooth and elastic but not sticky.
11. Place dough in a greased bowl, cover and let rise until doubled, about 45 minutes.
12. Punch down.
13. Preheat your oven to 350 degrees and line 2 baking sheets with parchment.
14. Roll dough into a rectangle about 15x22 inches.
15. In a small bowl mix together the melted butter and brown sugar, Using a spatula, spread this over the dough up to 1/2 inch from the edges.
16. Sprinkle cinnamon evenly over the sugar and butter.
17. Top with a layer of nuts.
18. Roll dough up lenghthwise to make a log and pinch edge to seal.
19. Slice dough evenly into 12 pieces.
20. Place each piece cut side down on baking sheets 1 inch apart and let rise, covered with parchment or plastic for 15 minutes.
21. Bake rolls until lightly browned on top- about 30 minutes.
22. Remove from oven To prepare icing, beat 4 tablespoons of butter with the powdered sugar and lemon juice until fluffy.
23. Using a spatula, smear the icing on top of the warm rolls.

ingredients_reels: green seedless grapes | red seedless grapes | sour cream | cream cheese | granulated sugar | vanilla extract | brown sugar | pecans
texte:
Best Grape Salad

Ingredients:
- 2 green seedless grapes
- 2 red seedless grapes
- 8 sour cream
- 8 cream cheese
- 1/2 granulated sugar
- 1 vanilla extract
- 1 brown sugar
- 1 pecans

Instructions:
1. Wash and stem grapes.
2. Set aside.
3. Mix sour cream, cream cheese, white sugar and vanilla by hand until blended.
4. Stir grapes into mixture, and pour in large serving bowl.
5. For topping: Combine brown sugar, and crushed pecans.
6. Sprinkle over top of grapes to cover completely.
7. Chill overnight.

ingredients_reels: butter | whole mushroom
texte:
Cooked Mushrooms

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 1 whole mushroom

Instructions:
1. Cook the mushrooms in the butter, in a covered saucepan on low heat until done.
2. You can use the butter for omelets or other cooking like vegetables.

ingredients_reels: cucumber | low-fat sour cream | water | sugar | salt | all-purpose flour | active dry yeast | fresh chives | fresh dill
texte:
Cucumber Pan Rolls

Ingredients:
- 1 cucumber
- 1/2 low-fat sour cream
- 1/4 water
- 1 sugar
- 1 salt
- 3 3/4 all-purpose flour
- 1 active dry yeast
- 2 fresh chives
- 2 fresh dill

Instructions:
1. Place cucumber in a blender  or food processor; cover and process until smooth.
2. Place 3/4 cup of puree in a saucepan (discard remaining puree or save for  another use.)  Add sour cream, water, sugar, and salt to pan; heat to 120 to 130 degrees (mixture will appear separated).  In a mixing bowl, combine 1 1/4 cups  flour, yeast, chives and dill; add cucumber mixture.  Beat on low speed just  until moistened; beat on high for 3 minutes.
3. Add enough remaining flour to form a stiff dough.
4. Turn onto a floured surface; knead until smooth and elastic,  about 6 to 8 minutes.
5. Place in a greased bowl, turning once to grease top.
6. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled about 1 hour.
7. Punch dough  down; let rest 10 minutes.
8. Shape into 12 balls; place in a 13 x 9 x 2\" baking  pan that has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.
9. Cover and let rise until doubled, about 45 minutes.
10. Bake at 375 for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden  brown.
11. Remove from pan and cool on a wire rack f!  or 10 minutes.
12. Serve warm.

nom: Hawaiian Fruit Salad With Banana Dressing
ingredients_reels: pineapple | cantaloupe | honeydew melon | papaya | green grape | strawberry | bananas | sour cream | brown sugar | lemon juice
texte:
Hawaiian Fruit Salad With Banana Dressing

Ingredients:
- 1 pineapple
- 1 cantaloupe
- 1 honeydew melon
- 1 papaya
- 1 green grape
- 1 strawberry
- 2 bananas
- 1 sour cream
- 1/4 brown sugar
- 1 1/2 lemon juice

Instructions:
1. Prepare Banana Dressing:.
2. Combine dressing ingredients in blender, and blend until smooth 15-20 seconds. Refrigerate 2 hours.
3. Combine all cut fruits in a large bowl and toss together gently.
4. Mound fruit on individual, lettuce lined plates. Serve Banana Dressing in a gravy boat, or pour dressing over individual fruit salads.

nom: White Chocolate Chip Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients_reels: crunchy peanut butter | sugar | vanilla extract | egg | white chocolate chips
texte:
White Chocolate Chip Peanut Butter Cookies

Ingredients:
- 1 crunchy peanut butter
- 1 sugar
- 1 vanilla extract
- 1 egg
- 1/2 white chocolate chips

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven at 350°F.
2. Mix all ingredients together well. Roll into balls made from 1 tbs of dough and place on baking paper covered cookie sheet. Place 1 inch apart. Bake in the oven for 16-18 minutes. Leave on the cookie sheet for 5 minutes before placing them on a wrack to finish cooling.
3. ENJOY! :).

nom: Baked Tomatoes Stuffed With Salmon, Garlic & Capers
ingredients_reels: capers | salmon | extra virgin olive oil | flat-leaf Italian parsley | garlic | garlic | salt | black pepper | firm ripe tomatoes
texte:
Baked Tomatoes Stuffed With Salmon, Garlic & Capers

Ingredients:
- 1 capers
- 1 salmon
- 3 1/2 extra virgin olive oil
- 1 flat-leaf Italian parsley
- 1 garlic
- 2 garlic
- salt
- black pepper
- 2 firm ripe tomatoes

Instructions:
1. Drain the capers if packed in vinegar; soak, rinse, and drain if packed in salt.
2. Chop them fine.
3. Turn the oven on to 400.
4. Remove the salmon's skin, any loose membranes, and carefully pick out all bones.
5. Cut the fish into very small diced pieces and put in a bowl together with 2 1/2 tablespoons of olive oil, the chopped parsley, garlic, capers, 1 tablespoon of bread crumbs, salt and several grindings of black pepper.
6. Toss thoroughly.
7. Wash the tomatoes, cut them horizontally in half, and scoop out all the seeds and the centers to make a cup-like hollow.
8. Pat the inside of the tomatoes with a paper towel to soak up excess juice, then stuff them with the salmon mixture, pressing it down lightly as you do so.
9. There should be enough to form a mound.
10. Sprinkle the tops with the remaining bread crumbs and drizzle with remaining olive oil, holding back a few drops of the olive oil to grease the bottom of a baking pan.
11. Place the tomatoes on the baking pan and bake in the upper level of the preheated oven for 30-35 minutes or until the salmon stuffing has formed a light golden crust.
12. Serve not piping hot, but lukewarm.
13. They are also good later, at room temperature.

ingredients_reels: 6-inch flour tortillas | beef | pork | salsa | cheese
texte:
Crispy Burritos / Sandwich Maker

Ingredients:
- 2 6-inch flour tortillas
- beef
- pork
- salsa
- cheese

Instructions:
1. Preheat sandwich maker.
2. Lightly mist wells with non-stick cooking spray.
3. Place a tortilla in the sandwich maker, top with 1 Tbsp.
4. each: meat, beans, salsa, and cheese.
5. Top with remaining tortilla.
6. Close and cook for about 3 minutes.
7. Serve with a dollop of sour cream and some shredded lettuce.

nom: Easy and Delicious Potato Brunch Casserole
ingredients_reels: breakfast sausage | flour | full-fat milk | half-and-half | parmesan cheese | frozen shredded hash browns | green onions | cheddar cheese
texte:
Easy and Delicious Potato Brunch Casserole

Ingredients:
- 2 breakfast sausage
- 1/4 flour
- 3 full-fat milk
- 2 half-and-half
- 2 parmesan cheese
- 10 -12 frozen shredded hash browns
- 3 green onions
- cheddar cheese

Instructions:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees.
2. Butter a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
3. In a large skillet cook the sausages, breaking into pieces with back of the spoon (about 5 minutes).
4. Mix in flour, and cook for 1 minute.
5. Add in milk or half and half and Parmesan cheese; and cook until the mixture starts to boil and thicken (about 4-5 minutes).
6. Season with pepper to taste.
7. Pour the shredded hash brown potatoes in the prepared baking dish and toss with salt and pepper (I use seasoning salt for this) then spread out potatoes in the bottom of the dish.
8. Top with 1/3 of green onion, then 1-1/2 cups cheddar cheese, then 1/3 green onions, then sausage mixture, then top with remaining cheddar cheese.
9. Bake for about 45 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.
10. Sprinkle with remaining 1/3 green onions and serve.

ingredients_reels: fresh pumpkin | butter | brown sugar | ground nutmeg | ground cinnamon | kosher salt
texte:
Pumpkin Pie Filling

Ingredients:
- 2 fresh pumpkin
- 1/2 butter
- 1 brown sugar
- ground nutmeg
- ground cinnamon
- kosher salt

Instructions:
1. Cut the tops off of the pumpkins in a circle, just like you would for making a jack-o-lantern.
2. Quarter the pumpkins from the top down and scoop out the seeds and tendrils.  (Keep seeds for pepitas if you like.).
3. Place the pumpkin shells meat-side up on a large cookie sheet or other sided baking dish.
4. Smear the inner surfaces of the pumpkins with the butter.
5. Sprinkle the brown sugar and spices, including a small bit of salt, over the shells.
6. Bake in a pre-heated oven at 375 degrees for 30 minutes or until you can easily stab through the flesh with a fork.
7. Let stand to cool.
8. Gently cut away the outer skin.  (This is great for compost!).
9. Puree, mash, or process the meat to the desired consistency for the recipe you're preparing - very smooth for a mousse, less so for a standard pie.

ingredients_reels: flour | sugar | cocoa powder | baking powder | baking soda | salt | cinnamon | applesauce | egg substitute | powdered sugar | soymilk
texte:
Vegan Cocoa-Applesauce Bread

Ingredients:
- 1 2/3 flour
- 1 sugar
- 1/3 cocoa powder
- 1 baking powder
- 1 baking soda
- 1 salt
- 1 cinnamon
- 1 1/2 applesauce
- 2 egg substitute
- 1/2 powdered sugar
- 3 -4 soymilk

Instructions:
1. Combine dry ingredients, then add the wet ingredients to the mixture.
2. Don't overmix.
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes in a loaf pan.
4. Let cool and remove from pan.
5. Mix together powdered sugar and soy milk for the glaze and drizzle over the top.
6. Let sit at least 10 minutes and serve.

ingredients_reels: butter | brown sugar | flour
texte:
Short'nin' Bread

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 1/4 brown sugar
- 1 flour

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
2. Cream the butter with the brown sugar.  Add the flour a bit at a time until mixed well.
3. Roll out to 1/2-thickness and cut into \"ladyfinger\"-like slices.  Place on a greased pan and bake for 20 minutes or until just beginning to brown.  Cool completely.

ingredients_reels: milk | sugar | cocoa powder | all-purpose flour | salt | butter | margarine | vanilla
texte:
Chocolate Gravy

Ingredients:
- 2 milk
- 3/4 sugar
- 2 cocoa powder
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 1/2 salt
- 2 butter
- 1 margarine
- 6 -8 vanilla

Instructions:
1. Heat milk in saucepan.  Combine sugar, cocoa, flour and salt in a bowl.  Stir in enough warm milk to make a smooth paste.
2. Pour paste into remainder of warm milk in saucepan.
3. Cook over medium heat, stirring continuously, until sauce thickens.  Add butter and vanilla.  Mix well.  Serve chocolate gravy over hot buttered biscuits.

ingredients_reels: boneless skinless chicken breast half | cream cheese | water | pesto sauce | grape tomatoes | cherry tomatoes
texte:
Tuscan Chicken Simmer

Ingredients:
- 4 boneless skinless chicken breast half
- 4 cream cheese
- 1/4 water
- 1/4 pesto sauce
- 2 grape tomatoes
- 1 cherry tomatoes

Instructions:
1. HEAT large nonstick skillet sprayed with cooking spray on medium-high heat. Add chicken; cover skillet with lid. Cook 5 to 7 minutes on each side or until chicken is cooked through (165ºF). Remove chicken from skillet; keep warm.
2. REDUCE heat to medium. Add cream cheese, water, pesto and tomatoes to skillet. Cook, uncovered, 2 minutes or until heated through, stirring occasionally.
3. RETURN chicken to skillet. Cook and stir 1 minute or until chicken is coated and heated through. Sprinkle with shredded cheese.

ingredients_reels: graham cracker crumbs | butter | powdered sugar | cocoa powder
texte:
Cocoa Graham Cracker Crust

Ingredients:

- 3/4 butter

Instructions:
1. Mix together and press into 9-inch pie plate.
2. Freeze until ready to use.

ingredients_reels: butter | margarine | sugar | egg | vanilla extract | self raising flour | chocolate chips
texte:
Chocolate Crispy Biscuits

Ingredients:
- 125 butter
- 1 margarine
- 1 sugar
- 1 egg
- 2 vanilla extract
- 1 self raising flour
- 1 chocolate chips

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius.
2. Line a baking tray with baking paper.
3. Cream butter and sugar together till pale and creamy.
4. Add egg and vanilla and beat till smooth.
5. Add remaining ingredients.
6. Stir till well combined.
7. Place heaped tablespoons of mixture on trays.
8. Allow room for spreading.
9. Bake 15 - 17 minutes, then cool for 5 minutes.
10. Transfer to wire rack.

ingredients_reels: cider vinegar | black pepper | salt | sugar | chili powder | dry mustard | paprika | ground cumin
texte:
Wicker's Sloshing Sauce

Ingredients:
- 1 1/4 cider vinegar
- 1 black pepper
- 2 1/2 salt
- 1 1/2 sugar
- 4 chili powder
- 1 dry mustard
- 1 paprika
- 1/2 ground cumin

Instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients and cook for about ten minutes to dissolve spices.
2. Can be used as a marinade for beef briskets or shoulder clods or it can be used on the table as a\"sloshing sauce\" for chopped or pulled pork.

ingredients_reels: tea | prune | sugar | walnuts | creme fraiche
texte:
Aracia Mahshia-Bil-Goz (Walnut-Stuffed Prunes)

Ingredients:
- 3 tea
- 1 prune
- 1/2 sugar
- 1/2 walnuts
- 1/2 creme fraiche

Instructions:
1. Brew 3 cups very strong black tea, such as Irish Breakfast.
2. Transfer to a large bowl while still hot. Add 1 lb. pitted prunes (California prunes are plumper and therefore best) and soak overnight.
3. Remove prunes with a slotted spoon to a clean work surface and set aside.
4. Transfer tea to a medium saucepan and add 1/2 cup sugar.
5. Bring to a boil over high heat and reduce tea until it is the consistency of a thin syrup, about 10 minutes.
6. Meanwhile, stuff each prune (into the slit made when pitting prune) with a large walnut piece.
7. Place stuffed prunes in a large shallow bowl or platter, in concentric circles.
8. Pour tea syrup over prunes and cool to room temperature.
9. Serve with crème fraîche on the side.
10. Store covered in refrigerator for up to 1 week.

ingredients_reels: butter | sugar | flour | salt | quick-cooking oats | milk
texte:
Oatmeal-Lace Cookies (Havrekniplekaker)

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 1 sugar
- 2/3 flour
- 1/2 salt
- 2 quick-cooking oats
- 1/4 milk

Instructions:
1. Heat oven to 375°.
2. Melt butter in saucepan; stir in remaining ingredients, mixing well.
3. Drop by 1/2 teaspoonful about 3 inches apart on a greased and floured cookie sheet.
4. Spread thinly.
5. Bake for 5-7 minutes and WATCH CAREFULLY!
6. Let stand a few minutes before removing from pan.

ingredients_reels: old fashioned oats | flax seed | pecans | dark brown sugar | 2% low-fat milk
texte:
Deluxe Oatmeal

Ingredients:
- 1/2 old fashioned oats
- 1 flax seed
- 1 pecans
- 1 dark brown sugar
- 1 2% low-fat milk

Instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large microwave-safe bowl. Stir.  Microwave on high for 3 minutes. Allow to sit 2 minutes to thicken. Stir and enjoy.

ingredients_reels: boneless skinless chicken breasts | Best Foods Mayonnaise | parmesan cheese | artichoke hearts | garlic powder
texte:
Carole's Friend Marilyn's Artichoke Chicken

Ingredients:
- 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts
- 1 Best Foods Mayonnaise
- 1 parmesan cheese
- 14 artichoke hearts
- 1 garlic powder

Instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients.
2. Butter a baking dish and place the chicken breasts in the dish in a single layer.
3. Spread above mixture over the chicken breasts and bake at 350 for 50 to 60 minutes, uncovered.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | yellow cornmeal | baking powder | salt | sugar | sweet potatoes | sweet potatoes | eggs | milk
texte:
Sweet Potato (Queen) Cornbread

Ingredients:
- 1 all-purpose flour
- 1 yellow cornmeal
- 4 baking powder
- 1 salt
- 1/2 sugar
- 1 sweet potatoes
- 2 sweet potatoes
- 6 eggs
- 3 milk

Instructions:
1. Mom's is the ultimate example of a life well-lived.  I am in total awe of her.  She's smart, accomplished, beautiful-inside and out-loving, courageous, and bubbling over with the sheer joy of living.
2. It's been an easy fifty years for Dad, clearly.  To further endear her to me personally, she and her friends turn out some excellent eats!  Mom herself makes this sweet potato cornbread that is worth driving all the way to Mountain Pine, Arkansas, for, but you won't have to-here's how you do it.
3. Mix together this dry stuff: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1 cup yellow cornmeal, 4 teaspoons baking powder, 1 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 cup sugar.
4. Separetely, mix together this wet stuff: 3 sweet potatoes, cooked and mashed (or you may use 1 16 ounce can of sweet potatoes, and in this recipe, it really is okay not to use home-cooked ones, I would tell you if it mattered), 2 eggs, 6 tablespoons milk, and 3 tablespoons oil.
5. Then mix the dry stuff and the wet stuff, just until it's all moist (don't beat it to death), then put it in greased muffin tins and bake at 425 until done-usually about 15 to 20 minutes.

nom: Healthy Broccoli Rabe With Pine Nuts
ingredients_reels: broccoli rabe | pine nuts | garlic cloves | olive oil | black pepper | table salt
texte:
Healthy Broccoli Rabe With Pine Nuts

Ingredients:
- 6 broccoli rabe
- 1/2 pine nuts
- 2 garlic cloves
- 2 olive oil
- 1/8 black pepper
- 1/8 table salt

Instructions:
1. In large stockpot, boil water.
2. Add broccoli rabe and blanch 2 minutes.
3. Drain.
4. In large skillet, heat oil.
5. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
6. Add broccoli rabe and cook 4 minutes.
7. Season with salt and pepper.
8. Add pine nuts.
9. Toss and serve.
10. Yields about 1/2 cup per serving.

ingredients_reels: ground beef | onion | garlic clove | diced tomatoes | water | tomato paste | dried parsley flakes | dried oregano | salt | bow tie pasta | small curd cottage cheese | parmesan cheese
texte:
Skillet Bow Tie Lasagna

Ingredients:
- 1 ground beef
- 1 onion
- 1 garlic clove
- 1 diced tomatoes
- 1 1/2 water
- 1 tomato paste
- 1 dried parsley flakes
- 2 dried oregano
- 1 salt
- 2 1/2 bow tie pasta
- 3/4 small curd cottage cheese
- 1/4 parmesan cheese

Instructions:
1. In a large skillet, cook beef, onion and garlic until meat is no longer pink; drain.
2. Add the tomatoes, water, tomato paste, parsley, oregano and salt; mix well.
3. Stir in pasta; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until pasta is tender, stirring once.
4. Combine cheeses; drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto pasta mixture.
5. Cover and cook for 5 minutes.
6. Yield: 4 servings.

ingredients_reels: fresh green beans | red bell pepper | olive oil | dry mustard | garlic clove | kosher salt | black pepper | bacon
texte:
Green Bean Bundles

Ingredients:
- 1 fresh green beans
- 1 red bell pepper
- 1/2 olive oil
- 1/2 dry mustard
- 1 garlic clove
- 1/4 kosher salt
- 1/4 black pepper
- 1/2 bacon

Instructions:
1. Blanch the green beans in boiling water for about 3 to 4 minutes.
2. Run under cold water to stop the cooking or plunge into a bowl of ice water.  Drain completely and pat dry with a paper towel and put in a casserole dish.  Add red bell pepper strips.
3. Mix together the oil, mustard, garlic, salt and black pepper and pour over green beans and red bell peppers.
4. Marinate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
5. Preheat oven to 375.
6. Make a bundle of 8 or 9 beans and 2 or 3 strips of red bell pepper and wrap with half a bacon slice around each bundle.  Secure with a tothpick and arrange in a single layer in the same casserole dish used for marinating.
7. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes or until the bacon is cooked.

ingredients_reels: butter | bacon grease | onion | bacon | cabbage | sugar | white wine vinegar | caraway seed | water | fresh parsley
texte:
Cabbage and Bacon

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 1 bacon grease
- 2 onion
- 1/2 bacon
- 1 cabbage
- 1 sugar
- 1 white wine vinegar
- 1 caraway seed
- 2 water
- 2 fresh parsley

Instructions:
1. Heat the oil in a large saucepan, and add the onion and bacon and cook until the onion is softened-about 5 minutes.
2. Add the cabbage, sugar, vinegar, carraway seeds, stock powder and stir over a medium high heat for a couple of minutes or until the cabbage is coated with oil and starting to wilt.
3. Add a couple of tablespoons of water, cover and cook over a low heat (watch it doesn't burn) for a further 15 minutes, stirring once or twice.
4. Stir through the chopped parsley and serve.

ingredients_reels: mayonnaise | Dijon mustard | lemon juice | shallot | garlic clove | tarragon | parsley | chives | salt | cayenne pepper | lime wedge
texte:
Aioli With Herbs

- 1 shallot

- 1 parsley
- 1 chives
