- 1 lime wedge

Instructions:
1. Mix together all the ingredients, seasoning to taste with salt and cayenne pepper.
2. Spoon into a serving bowl and garnish with a lime wedge.

ingredients_reels: raspberries | blueberries | blackberry | sugar | butter | butter | eggs | milk | all-purpose flour | vanilla extract | orange zest | salt | powdered sugar
texte:
Oven Berry Pancakes

Ingredients:
- 1 raspberries
- 1 blueberries
- 1 blackberry
- 1 sugar
- 2 butter
- 4 butter
- 3 eggs
- 1/2 milk
- 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1 vanilla extract
- 1 orange zest
- 1/4 salt
- powdered sugar

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees.
2. Combine berries and sugar in a small bowl and set aside. Place 4 (6 to 7 inch) individual gratin dishes on a baking sheet. Place 1 teaspoons of butter in each gratin dish and set aside.
3. Place the eggs in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the whisk attachment and beat on medium speed until combined. Add the milk and mix. Slowly add the flour, vanilla, lemon zest, 2 T of melted butter, and the salt and mix just until smooth. Whisk by hand if the batter is still lumpy.
4. Place the gratin dishes in the oven for three minutes, until the butter is hot and bubbly. Make sure the butter covers the bottom of each dish. Divide the batter equally among the four dishes and bake 12-14 minutes, until puffed and lightly browned. Divide the berries among the dishes and sprinkle with powdered sugar. Add syrup if you wish. Serve hot!

ingredients_reels: firm tofu | tahini | tomato paste | button mushrooms | wheat germ | cornmeal | quick-cooking oatmeal | carrot | zucchini | scallions | garlic powder | cilantro | dried parsley | Tabasco sauce
texte:
Tofu Burgers

Ingredients:
- 14 firm tofu
- 2 tahini
- 1 -3 tomato paste
- 3 button mushrooms
- 2 wheat germ
- 1 cornmeal
- 2 -3 quick-cooking oatmeal
- 1/4 carrot
- 1/4 zucchini
- 2 scallions
- 1/2 garlic powder
- 1 cilantro
- 1/2 dried parsley
- 1/8 Tabasco sauce

Instructions:
1. starting out with smallest amounts of oatmeal and tomato paste,mix all ingredients in large bowl.
2. If allergic to both wheat AND corn then use 3 Tblsp. rice flour instead.
3. I usually don't add any salt, if you'd like salt now is the time to add it.
4. mash together with potato masher.
5. using hands, form'patties' out of mixture to desired size (mixture does not shrink very much).
6. If mixture seems too dry to you (oatmeal absorbs liquid differently on different days for some reason) add more tomato paste.
7. If mixture seems too wet to you add a little bit more instant oatmeal (or corn meal if you prefer and it's only a little too wet).
8. I prefer to bake in oven on lined cookie sheet for 20 min. or so at about 425 degrees fahrenheit.
9. Can be grilled or fried instead if desired.
10. Cooking times and temps required vary seemingly depending on humidity also.

ingredients_reels: mayonnaise | honey | Grey Poupon Dijon Mustard
texte:
Honey Mustard Dressing

Ingredients:
- 1/2 mayonnaise
- 1/4 honey
- 2 Grey Poupon Dijon Mustard

Instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients. Chill.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | light brown sugar | cinnamon | unsalted butter | all-purpose flour | sugar | baking powder | salt | light brown sugar | unsalted butter | eggs | milk | vanilla extract | blueberries
texte:
Blueberry Crumb Muffins

Ingredients:
- 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1/2 light brown sugar
- 1/2 cinnamon
- 5 unsalted butter
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 1/2 sugar
- 1 baking powder
- 1/4 salt
- 1/4 light brown sugar
- 1/2 unsalted butter
- 2 eggs
- 3/4 milk
- 1/4 vanilla extract
- 3/4 - 1 blueberries

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Line or butter muffin tin.
2. To make topping: put flour, brown sugar, and cinnamon in a small bowl and toss together. Add in the cold butter bits, and toss to coat, then use your fingers to rub the butter into the dry ingredients until you have irregularly shaped crumbs. Set aside the mix in the refrigerator while you prepare the batter.
3. In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Stir in the brown sugar.
4. In another bowl, whisk the melted butter, eggs, milk, and vanilla together until well combined.
5. Pour the liquid ingredients into the dry, and fold together quickly to blend. Fold in the blueberries. The batter will be lumpy.
6. Divide the batter evenly between the muffin cups, sprinkle some topping over each muffin, and use your fingertips to gently press the crumbs into the batter.
7. Bake for about 20 minutes, or until the tops are golden and a thin knife inserted into the center of the muffins comes out clean.
8. Cool for 5 minutes before removing from the tin.

ingredients_reels: cucumber | celery ribs | apples | kale leaves | lemon | fresh ginger
texte:
Mean Green Juice (For Juicer)

Ingredients:
- 1 cucumber
- 4 celery ribs
- 2 apples
- 6 -8 kale leaves
- 1/2 lemon
- 1 fresh ginger

Instructions:
1. Wash all ingredients thoroughly.
2. Run through juicer and enjoy!  Great over ice.

ingredients_reels: olive oil | fresh tarragon | sherry wine vinegar | orange | lemon | kosher salt | garlic | fresh ginger | hot paprika | black pepper | boneless chicken breast halves
texte:
Spanish Grilled Chicken Breasts

Ingredients:
- 1/4 olive oil
- 1/4 fresh tarragon
- 2 sherry wine vinegar
- 1 orange
- 1 lemon
- 2 kosher salt
- 1 garlic
- 1 fresh ginger
- 1/2 hot paprika
- 1/2 black pepper
- 4 boneless chicken breast halves

Instructions:
1. To make the marinade:  In a medium bowl, whisk all ingredients except the chicken.
2. Place the chicken breasts in a large, resealable bag, and pour in the marinade.  Press the air out of the bag and seal tightly.  Turn it several times to distribute the marinade and place it in a bowl and refrigerate for 3 - 4 hours.
3. Remove the chicken from the bag and reserve the marinade.  Pour the marinade in a small saucepan, bring to a boil, and boil for 1 full minute.
4. Grill the chicken, skin side down first, and turning (once) and basting with the marinade, over direct medium heat until the meat is firm to the touch and no longer pink in the center, or until it has reached an internal temperature of 165 degrees F.  This should take a total of approximately 8 - 12 minutes.

nom: Butterscotch Brownies (Gift Mix in a Jar)
ingredients_reels: flour | salt | baking powder | sugar | brown sugar | butter | eggs | vanilla extract
texte:
Butterscotch Brownies (Gift Mix in a Jar)

Ingredients:
- 2 flour
- 1/4 salt
- 1 1/2 baking powder
- 1/2 sugar
- 1 3/4 brown sugar
- 3/4 butter
- 2 eggs
- 2 vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. Creating the Gift in a Jar:.
2. Wash and thoroughly dry a 1-quart wide-mouth canning jar.
3. Layer the ingredients in the jar as listed above starting with the flour, salt, baking powder, sugar and then brown sugar - make sure to press firmly with a flat bottomed object after each addition; make the layers as level as possible.
4. Secure the lid and decorate as desired; attach the instructions for making these cookies found below.
5. BUTTERSCOTCH BROWNIES GIFT TAG:
6. Additional ingredients to be added by the recipient: 3/4 cup butter, softened, 2 eggs and 2 tsp vanilla extract.
7. BROWNIE INSTRUCTIONS:
8. Preheat oven to 375.
9. In a large bowl, blend the butter, eggs and vanilla extract.
10. Add the contents of the jar, and stir until well mixed.
11. Spread the batter evenly in a greased 13x9 inch baking pan.
12. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
13. Cool completely in pan before cutting into 24 squares.
14. Serve immediately or store in an airtight container for up to 1 week.

ingredients_reels: brown sugar | self-raising flour | butter | egg | milk | golden syrup | cornflour | boiling water
texte:
Butterscotch Self-Saucing Pudding

Ingredients:
- 3/4 brown sugar
- 1 1/4 self-raising flour
- 100 butter
- 1 egg
- 1/2 milk
- 4 golden syrup
- 1 cornflour
- 1 1/2 boiling water

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 180°C.
2. Grease a 1.5 litre (6 cup) ovenproof dish with butter.
3. Combine 1/4 cup of the brown sugar and all of the flour in a bowl.
4. Add the melted butter, slightly beaten egg, milk and 2 tablespoons of the golden syrup and stir until combined.
5. Spoon into the greased dish.
6. Combine the remaining 1/2 cup of brown sugar and cornflour. Sprinkle over the pudding mixture.
7. Combine boiling water with the remaining 2 tablespoons of golden syrup.
8. Pour over the top of the pudding mixture and bake for 40-45 minutes or until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean.
9. Serve with double cream or ice cream.

ingredients_reels: frozen green beans | green beans | bacon | onion | red pepper flakes
texte:
The Best Southern Green Beans

Ingredients:
- 2 frozen green beans
- 4 -6 green beans
- 1 bacon
- 1 onion
- red pepper flakes

Instructions:
1. Put green beans in pot- if canned add juices, if frozen add water enough to see but not cover beans- cook on medium heat.
2. Fry bacon until cooked but not too crisp- drain on paper towel.
3. Cut onion in large (thick) slices and break rings apart in to beans.
4. Crumble or rip bacon apart add to beans.
5. Add spices to taste.
6. Let cook for a few hours on low heat.
7. If want to serve sooner- turn heat up and cook until water boils down.
8. OR can put in crockpot on low all day long and let simmer.

ingredients_reels: unsalted butter | margarine | granulated sugar | eggs | vanilla extract | all-purpose flour | pecans | graham cracker crumbs | granulated sugar | unsalted butter
texte:
Decadent Fudgy Nut Bars

Ingredients:
- 4 unsalted butter
- 1/4 margarine
- 3/4 granulated sugar
- 2 eggs
- 1 vanilla extract
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 1/2 pecans
- 1/2 graham cracker crumbs
- 1 granulated sugar
- 2 unsalted butter

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F, & lightly grease 8\" square baking dish.
2. Microwave chocolate & 1/4 cup butter in large microwaveable bowl on HIGH 1 minute or until butter is melted.
3. Stir until chocolate is completely melted.
4. Add 3/4 cup sugar, & mix well.
5. Blend in eggs & vanilla.
6. Stir in flour until well blended.
7. Stir in pecans, then set aside.
8. In a bowl, mix graham cracker crumbs, 1 tablespoon sugar & 2 tablespoons butter.
9. Press firmly onto bottom & 1/2\" up sides of prepared baking dish.
10. Spread chocolate mixture over crust.
11. Bake 15-20 minutes, or until center is set.
12. Cool completely before cutting into bars.

ingredients_reels: potatoes | onion | flour | butter | salt | pepper | cheddar cheese | milk
texte:
Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes

Ingredients:
- 4 potatoes
- 1/4 onion
- 1 flour
- 4 butter
- 1 salt
- 1/8 pepper
- 2 cheddar cheese
- 1 1/2 milk

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Grease 9 x 13 inch baking dish and spread half of your potatoes on the bottom of the dish, overlapping as necessary and then layer half of your onions.
3. In a small separate bowl, mix your flour, butter, salt and pepper then sprinkle half of this mixture to make the next layer and then on top of this layer half of your cheese and the repeat to create your second layer and now add milk and cook for 45 minutes or until the potatoes are good and tender (Just to warn you this is supposed to look pretty soupy.  To be safe, you might want to put a piece of aluminum foil underneath your pan in case of run over,).

ingredients_reels: eggs | vinegar | dry mustard | salt | pepper | sugar | butter | Worcestershire sauce | paprika
texte:
Grand Ma-Ma's Deviled Eggs (No Mayo!!)

Ingredients:
- 4 eggs
- 1 1/2 vinegar
- 1/2 dry mustard
- 1/4 salt
- 1/8 pepper
- 1/2 sugar
- 1 1/2 butter
- 1/4 Worcestershire sauce
- paprika

Instructions:
1. Halve eggs and arrange egg whites on a serving platter.
2. In a bowl, mash yolks well with a fork.
3. Add remaining ingredients except paprika; mix well.
4. Spoon mixture into a plastic zipping bag and squeeze down into the corner of the bag. Snip off the corner and pipe mixture into whites; sprinkle with paprika.

ingredients_reels: butter | margarine | sugar | water | vanilla | eggs | flour | baking soda | salt
texte:
Kittencal's Extreme Chocolate Brownies

Ingredients:
- 2/3 butter
- 1 1/2 margarine
- 1/4 sugar
- 4 water
- 2 vanilla
- 4 eggs
- 1 1/2 flour
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1/2 salt

Instructions:
1. Set oven to 325 degrees F.
2. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
3. In a heavy saucepan, bring butter, sugar and water to a boil, stirring constantly until the butter is melted and sugar is dissolved (about 3 minutes).
4. Remove from the heat, with a wooden spoon, stir in 2 cups chocolate chips until melted; cool slightly, beat in vanilla.
5. In a mixing bowl,whisk eggs, gradually add in the chocolate mixture, beating with a wooden spoon until completely mixed.
6. Mix together flour, baking soda and salt; add to the egg/chocolate mixture; mix well to combine.
7. Stir in the remaining chocolate chips.
8. Spread into prepared baking pan.
9. Bake for 35-40 minutes (don't over bake).
10. Cut into squares.
11. Note: If desired, chopped walnuts may be added.

ingredients_reels: olive oil | white vinegar | salt | black pepper | garlic powder | tomatoes | green onion | black olives | green chilies
texte:
Garbage Dip

Ingredients:
- 2 olive oil
- 2 white vinegar
- 1 salt
- 1 black pepper
- 1 garlic powder
- 4 tomatoes
- 1 green onion
- 1 black olives
- 1 green chilies

Instructions:
1. Mix olive oil, vinegar, salt, pepper and garlic powder.
2. Add tomatoes, onion, olives and chilies.
3. Refrigerate overnight.
4. Serve with corn chips.

nom: Roasted Potato Halves With Herb Sprigs
ingredients_reels: baking potatoes | extra virgin olive oil | fresh herbs | coarse salt
texte:
Roasted Potato Halves With Herb Sprigs

Ingredients:
- 4 -5 baking potatoes
- 3 extra virgin olive oil
- 8 -10 fresh herbs
- 2 coarse salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375F (190C).
2. Place the halved potatoes in a bowl and pour the oil over them.  Toss in the oil and/or rub them with your hands to insure that each is coated with oil.
3. Arrange the potatoes cut side up on a baking sheet.
4. Astuce (Hint): If your potato half keeps rolling over, slice a tiny sliver off the uncut side, giving it a flat surface on which to rest.
5. Press an herb sprig on to each potato half; sprinkle them with salt.
6. Bake until a golden crust has formed on the cut surface and the potato half is tender through, about 45 minutes.
7. Serve, cut side up and nice and hot.

nom: Flour Shake and Bake for Chicken
ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | salt | paprika | pepper | dry mustard
texte:
Flour Shake and Bake for Chicken

Ingredients:
- 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1 salt
- 1 paprika
- 1/8 pepper
- 1/2 dry mustard

Instructions:
1. Mix the flour, salt, paprika, pepper and dry mustard in a plastic or paper bag.
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
3. Wash chicken pieces; pat dry on paper towels.
4. Beat an egg or two and some milk (depending on quantity of chicken) together.
5. Dip chicken pieces in the egg mixture.
6. Place about 1 Tablespoon of flour mixture per piece of chicken in a plastic bag.
7. Shake chicken pieces, one at a time, until coated. Discard any leftover used mixture.
8. Place coated chicken pieces, skin side up, on a cookie sheet with sides.
9. Bake chicken pieces at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for about 30 minutes, up to one hour, or until chicken is completely done.

ingredients_reels: cauliflower | pickling cucumbers | onions | green bell pepper | red bell pepper | pickling salt | white vinegar | granulated sugar | all-purpose flour | mustard powder | turmeric powder
texte:
Delicious Golden Mustard Pickles

Ingredients:
- 1 cauliflower
- 14 pickling cucumbers
- 6 onions
- 1 green bell pepper
- 1 red bell pepper
- 1/2 pickling salt
- 5 white vinegar
- 4 granulated sugar
- 1 all-purpose flour
- 1/2 mustard powder
- 2 turmeric powder

Instructions:
1. Trim the core off of cauliflower; cut into bite-size florets to make 8 cups.
2. Place in a large stockpot, along with cucumbers, onions, red and green peppers.
3. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup pickling salt; cover with cold water.
4. Set aside in cool spot (do not refrigerate) for 12 hours.
5. Return the pot to element; bring veggie mixture just to a boil, over med-high heat; drain in large colander, discarding brine.
6. Set the veggies aside.
7. Rinse the pot.
8. Add 4 cups of vinegar; bring to boil over medium heat.
9. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, whisk together, sugar, flour, mustard and tumeric powder; whisk in 1 cup water, and remaining vinegar to make a smooth paste.
10. Whisk into hot vinegar, and bring to a boil; reduce heat, and simmer, stirring constantly until smooth and thickened (amout 3 minutes).
11. Add the veggies, stir to coat.
12. Bring to a boil, stirring gently.
13. Ladle into 2-cup hot canning jars, leaving 1/2-inch head space.
14. Cover with warm discs; screw on bands fingertip tight.
15. Process in boiling water canner for 10 minutes.
16. Remove, and let cool on rack.

ingredients_reels: vanilla ice cream | butter | brown sugar | ground cinnamon | nutmeg | apple cider
texte:
Harry Potter's Butterbeer

Ingredients:
- 1 vanilla ice cream
- 1/4 butter
- 1/3 brown sugar
- 2 ground cinnamon
- 1 nutmeg
- 1 apple cider

Instructions:
1. In a medium bowl cream together the ice cream, butter, sugar and spices.
2. Re-freeze mixture.
3. In a medium pot heat apple cider to just Hot.
4. Place 6 tall or 12 short glasses on counter.
5. Scoop equal amounts of ice cream mixture into each glass.
6. Pour hot cider on top and serve with spoons for stirring.

ingredients_reels: Baileys Irish Cream | Amaretto
texte:
Irish Nut

Ingredients:
- 15 Baileys Irish Cream
- 15 Amaretto

Instructions:
1. Pour Bailey's in a shot glass and then pour in the Amaretto.
2. Drink.

nom: Roasted Asparagus (The Best I've Ever Tried!)
ingredients_reels: asparagus | olive oil | salt | cracked black pepper
texte:
Roasted Asparagus (The Best I've Ever Tried!)

Ingredients:
- 2 asparagus
- 2 olive oil
- 1 salt
- 1/2 cracked black pepper

Instructions:
1. Heat oven to 350°F.
2. In large bowl combine asparagus, oil, salt and pepper and toss well.
3. Place on baking sheet and roast 13-15 minutes.

ingredients_reels: shortening | brown sugar | vanilla extract | whole wheat flour | all-purpose flour | baking powder | baking soda | salt | milk
texte:
Graham Crackers

Ingredients:
- 1/2 shortening
- 3/4 brown sugar
- 1 vanilla extract
- 2 whole wheat flour
- 1 all-purpose flour
- 1 baking powder
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1/4 salt
- 1/4 milk

Instructions:
1. In a medium bowl, cream together the shortening and brown sugar.
2. Stir in the vanilla.
3. Combine the whole wheat flour, all purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt, stir into the creamed mixture alternately with the milk.
4. Cover and chill dough until firm.
5. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
6. Grease cookie sheets.
7. On a lightly floured surface, roll the dough out to 0.125 inch thickness.
8. Cut into rectangles.
9. Place 1/2 inch apart onto the prepared cookie sheets.
10. Bake for 10-12 minutes  in the preheated oven, or until crisp.
11. Edges will be golden brown.
12. Remove from baking sheet to cool on wire racks.

ingredients_reels: olive oil | red wine vinegar | Worcestershire sauce | salt | ketchup | onion | sugar
texte:
Sweet and Sour Salad Dressing:

Ingredients:
- 1 olive oil
- 1/4 red wine vinegar
- 1 Worcestershire sauce
- 1 salt
- 1/3 ketchup
- 1 onion
- 1/2 sugar

Instructions:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a jar with a tight fitting lid or in a blender and shake or blend well until combined; Store in the refrigerator until ready to use.

ingredients_reels: olive oil | garlic | fennel | kosher salt | fresh ground black pepper | water
texte:
Sauteed Fennel

Ingredients:
- 3 olive oil
- 2 garlic
- 2 fennel
- kosher salt
- fresh ground black pepper
- water

Instructions:
1. Heat a medium saute pan over medium-high heat until just smoking.
2. Add the oil, garlic, fennel, and start tossing, to coat fennel in oil.
3. Season with salt and pepper, to taste.
4. As the fennel starts to caramelize, add a splash of water to steam for 1 minute.
5. Remove from the heat.

ingredients_reels: dried lentils | chicken broth | water | onion | celery | carrot | green bell pepper | garlic | dried thyme | dried parsley | rubbed sage | pepper | diced tomatoes | tomato sauce | tomato paste
texte:
Savory Lentils and Vegetables

Ingredients:
- 2 dried lentils
- 2 chicken broth
- 2 water
- 1 onion
- 1 celery
- 1 carrot
- 1 green bell pepper
- 3 garlic
- 1 dried thyme
- 1 dried parsley
- 1 rubbed sage
- 1/2 pepper
- 1 diced tomatoes
- 1 tomato sauce
- 1 tomato paste

Instructions:
1. Add the first 12 ingredients to a large soup pot.
2. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
3. Cover, lower heat, and simmer for 30 minutes or until lentils are tender.
4. Add in tomatoes, tomato sauce, and tomato paste; stir to mix.
5. Cook over medium heat until thoroughly heated.
6. Season to taste with salt, pepper, or hot sauce.

nom: Baked Pork Chops With Apple & Sherry
ingredients_reels: boneless pork chops | apples | brown sugar | cinnamon | butter | salt | pepper | dry sherry
texte:
Baked Pork Chops With Apple & Sherry

Ingredients:
- 6 boneless pork chops
- 2 apples
- 1/4 brown sugar
- 1/2 cinnamon
- 2 butter
- salt
- pepper
- 1/2 dry sherry

Instructions:
1. Brown the chops in a skillet.
2. Heat oven to 350°F degrees.
3. Arrange apple slice in the bottom of an oven proof pan large enough to hold the 6 chops in a single layer. Sprinkle apples with the brown sugar& cinnamon, dot with the butter.
4. Top with the chops.
5. Pour in the sherry.
6. Cover with foil or lid.
7. Bake for approx 1 hour or until tender.

ingredients_reels: carrots | raisins | lemon zest | lemon juice | confectioners' sugar | salt | mayonnaise | pecans
texte:
"s Wonderful Carrot and Raisin Salad

Ingredients:
- 6 carrots
- 1 raisins
- 1 lemon zest
- 1/2 lemon juice
- 1/4 confectioners' sugar
- 1/2 salt
- 1/2 mayonnaise
- 1/2 pecans

Instructions:
1. Grate carrots coarsely.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Refrigerate.

nom: Pan-Fried Glazed Chicken With Basil - Ww
ingredients_reels: boneless skinless chicken breast halves | salt | fresh ground pepper | olive oil | honey | fresh basil | dried basil
texte:
Pan-Fried Glazed Chicken With Basil - Ww

Ingredients:
- 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 fresh ground pepper
- 2 olive oil
- 2 honey
- 1 fresh basil
- 2 dried basil

Instructions:
1. Sprinkle both sides of chicken with salt and pepper. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add chicken; cook 5 minutes or until lightly browned. Turn chicken, and cook 6 minutes or until chicken is done.
3. Stir in vinegar, honey, and basil; cook an additional 1 minute.

ingredients_reels: sherry wine | soy sauce | garlic cloves | honey | fresh basil | ground ginger | Chinese five spice powder | crushed red pepper flakes | pepper | boneless skinless chicken breast
texte:
Garlic Ginger Chicken Strips

Ingredients:
- 1/4 sherry wine
- 1/4 soy sauce
- 4 garlic cloves
- 1 honey
- 1 fresh basil
- 1/2 ground ginger
- 1/2 Chinese five spice powder
- 1/4 crushed red pepper flakes
- 1/4 pepper
- 1 boneless skinless chicken breast

Instructions:
1. Combine the first nine ingredients in a bowl. Remove 3 tablespoons for basting; cover and refrigerate. Place the chicken in a large resealable plastic bag; add the remaining marinade. Seal the bag and turn it around to coat it thoroughly. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
2. Drain and discard the marinade. Broil the chicken strips 3\"-4\" from the heat for 3 minutes; then turn the strips over. Baste with reserved marinade. Broil 4-5 minutes longer or until chicken juices run clear, turning occasionally. Remove from oven and serve. Enjoy!
3. To freeze: Place chicken and marinade in a freezer bag. Seal, label and freeze.
4. To serve: Thaw overnight in the fridge and cook as directed.

ingredients_reels: sausage | ham | bacon | frozen hash brown potatoes | bell pepper | onion | cheese | eggs | milk | salt | pepper
texte:
Cody's Crock Pot Breakfast Casserole

Ingredients:
- 1/2 sausage
- 1/2 ham
- 1 bacon
- 1 -2 frozen hash brown potatoes
- 1/2 bell pepper
- 3 -4 onion
- cheese
- 12 eggs
- 1 milk
- salt
- pepper

Instructions:
1. Brown the sausage and bacon.
2. In crock pot, layer the items until you have run out.
3. Be sure that the first layer is a meat.
4. Mix together the eggs and milk (salt and pepper to taste) and pour over the top.
5. Cook on low for approximately 8 hours.

nom: I'm a Little Nutty Pecan Pie Bars
ingredients_reels: unsalted butter | flour | brown sugar | salt | pecans | honey | heavy whipping cream
texte:
I'm a Little Nutty Pecan Pie Bars

Ingredients:
- 1 1/4 unsalted butter
- 2 flour
- 1 1/2 brown sugar
- 1/2 salt
- 8 pecans
- 1/3 honey
- 2 heavy whipping cream

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
2. Cut 3/4 cup butter into 1/2 inch pieces.
3. In a food processor blend butter, flour, 1/2 cup brown sugar and the salt until mixture becomes slightly crumbly.
4. Sprinkle mixture into a 9x13 baking pan and press evenly onto the bottom.
5. Bake on middle rack of oven for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
6. Coarsely chop pecans.
7. Melt remaining 1/2 cup butter and remaining 1 cup brown sugar, honey and cream in a heavy saucepan.
8. Simmer mixture stirring occasionally for 1 minutes.
9. Stir in pecans and then pour mixture over hot crust and spread evenly.
10. Bake on middle rack of oven for 20 minutes or until bubbling; remove and let cool.
11. When slightly cooled, run a sharp knife around the edge of the pan to loosen bars.
12. Cool completely in the pan and cut into bars.
13. Bars will keep for 5 days covered at room temperature.

ingredients_reels: water | olive oil | bananas | honey | rolled oats | all-purpose flour | salt | active dry yeast
texte:
Banana Oat Bread (Bread Machine)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 water
- 2 olive oil
- 4 -5 bananas
- 2 honey
- 3 rolled oats
- 2 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1 salt
- 2 active dry yeast

Instructions:
1. Follow bread machine instructions for order of ingredients, only MAKE SURE you add the mashed bananas as a LIQUID (with the water, honey, and oil).
2. Set bread machine on SWEET setting, light crust.

ingredients_reels: bacon | sugar | vinegar | sour cream
texte:
Brittany Salad Dressing

Ingredients:
- 8 bacon
- 5 sugar
- 4 vinegar
- 2 sour cream

Instructions:
1. A half-hour before serving, combine sugar, vinegar& sour cream until smooth.
2. Refrigerate (I prefer to refrigerate overnight).
3. Fry bacon until crispy, saving 1/4 of the fat.
4. Dry bacon on paper towels and chop into small pieces.
5. To serve, heat 1/4 cup bacon fat until piping hot and pour over crisp, chilled lettuce pieces.
6. Toss to coat.
7. Place individual servings on chilled plates& sprinkle with bacon pieces.
8. Top with sour cream mixture& garnish with cherry tomatoes.

ingredients_reels: plain yogurt | fresh lime juice | lime zest | horseradish | dijon-style mustard | white wine vinegar | fresh ground black pepper
texte:
Lime Salad Spritz

Ingredients:
- 1/4 plain yogurt
- 6 fresh lime juice
- 2 lime zest
- 2 horseradish
- 2 dijon-style mustard
- 2 white wine vinegar
- fresh ground black pepper

Instructions:
1. Place all ingredients in a bottle, put lid on and shake well to blend. You may put this in a spray bottle or just splash it on a salad.
2. Enjoy!

ingredients_reels: potatoes | half-and-half | parmesan cheese | salt | nutmeg | pepper | eggs
texte:
Scandinavian Potato Casserole

Ingredients:
- 6 potatoes
- 3/4 half-and-half
- 1/2 parmesan cheese
- 1 salt
- 1/4 nutmeg
- 1/4 pepper
- 3 eggs

Instructions:
1. Heat one inch salted water to boiling; add potatoes; heat to boiling again; reduce heat, cover and cook until potatoes are tender, about 20 to 25 minutes; drain.
2. Mash potatoes until no lumps remain; beat in half and half slowly; stir in cheese, salt, nutmeg, pepper and egg yolks.
3. Beat egg whites until stiff; fold into potato mixture; pour into ungreased 1 1/2 quart baking dish or souffle dish.
4. Cook uncovered in 375 degree oven until golden brown, about 45 minutes.

nom: Garlic Chicken With Artichokes and Mushrooms
ingredients_reels: garlic cloves | butter | boneless skinless chicken breasts | olive oil | mushroom | artichokes | sherry wine | white wine
texte:
Garlic Chicken With Artichokes and Mushrooms

Ingredients:
- 8 garlic cloves
- 3/4 butter
- 6 boneless skinless chicken breasts
- olive oil
- 2 mushroom
- 1/4 artichokes
- 1 sherry wine
- 1 -2 white wine

Instructions:
1. Saute 5 cloves in 1/2 Cup of butter in a large skillet.
2. Add chicken, sprinkle with salt and pepper.
3. Brown chicken, then remove chicken to a warm platter.
4. Add remaining 3 cloves garlic and 1/4 cup butter, olive oil. Brown the garlic and toss in mushrooms; add artichokes.
5. Heat, stir in wine. Let thicken.
6. Pour over chicken.
7. Serve with Rice or noodles.

ingredients_reels: eggs | granulated sugar | milk | butter | flour | salt | baking powder | blueberries
texte:
RBI's Blueberry Hot Bread

Ingredients:
- 2 eggs
- 1 granulated sugar
- 1 milk
- 1/4 butter
- 3 flour
- 1 salt
- 4 baking powder
- 2 blueberries

Instructions:
1. Beat together the eggs and sugar, until the mixture loses its granular consistency.
2. Add milk and melted butter.
3. Sift together flour, salt, baking powder.
4. Add liquid ingredients, mix to combine.
5. Toss blueberries in a little flour to keep them from sinking to the bottom of the bread.
6. Add them to the batter and pour into 2 regular well-greased loaf pans.
7. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees and bake from 30-40 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean in the center.
8. Serve warm with butter.
9. Freezes very well.

ingredients_reels: cream cheese | smoked trout | low-fat sour cream | green onions | lemon juice | fresh ground black pepper | dill | parsley
texte:
Smoked Trout Pate

Ingredients:
- 1 cream cheese
- 1 smoked trout
- 1/4 low-fat sour cream
- 2 green onions
- 2 lemon juice
- 1 fresh ground black pepper
- dill
- 1 parsley

Instructions:
1. Reserve about 1/4 of the fish meat and flake it roughly.
2. Place the remaining ingredients except the herbs in a food processor and work until smooth.
3. Check for seasonings and maybe add a little more lemon juice.
4. Add the herbs and pulse briefly.
5. Scrape into a bowl, fold through the reserved fish and refrigerate covered until required.
6. Spoon into serving dishes and serve with turkish bread, crackers and/or fresh veggie sticks.

ingredients_reels: butter | brown sugar | white sugar | baking powder | baking soda | salt | egg | vanilla | cinnamon | nutmeg | flour | dried sweetened cranberries | rolled oats
texte:
Cranberry Oatmeal Bar Cookies

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 1/2 brown sugar
- 1/2 white sugar
- 1/4 baking powder
- 1/4 baking soda
- 1/4 salt
- 1 egg
- 1/2 vanilla
- 1/4 cinnamon
- 1/8 nutmeg
- 1 flour
- 3/4 dried sweetened cranberries
- 3/4 rolled oats

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees, rack in the middle position.
2. Melt butter in a large microwave safe bowl.
3. Add both sugars and let cool a bit.
4. Add eggs, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, and vanilla.
5. Add flour and mix.
6. Add the cranberries and oats and mix everything up. The dough will be quite stiff.
7. With a spatula spread dough evenly into a greased 8x8 baking pan.
8. Bake at 350 for 25– 30 minutes.
9. Cut into bars when cool.
10. These freeze well if you roll them in foil and put them in a freezer bag.

ingredients_reels: flour | baking powder | salt | butter | milk | cinnamon | sugar | apples | brown sugar | hot water | butter | vanilla
texte:
Apple Pandowdy

Ingredients:
- 2 flour
- 2 baking powder
- 1 salt
- 1/2 butter
- 2/3 milk
- cinnamon
- 6 sugar
- 6 apples
- 1 brown sugar
- 2 hot water
- 1 butter
- 1 vanilla

Instructions:
1. Put first 3 ingredients in bowl, cut in butter till crumbly.
2. Add milk, form into 2 balls or leave it in one.
3. Roll into a rectangle (13x9) sprinkle with cinnamon to your taste, cover with apples, sprinkle with sugar then sprinkle more cinnamon.
4. Roll up like a jelly roll, the large side.
5. Cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces.
6. Sauce: mix all together till the butter melts and sugar is dissolved (it will be runny but that is good cause it is absorbed by the dough).
7. Pour into 13x9 dish, pour sauce in pan then add the cut pieces of the roll down in the liquid.
8. Bake 40 minutes at 350°F.
9. Maybe inverted on a serving dish and served with ice cream or whipped cream.

ingredients_reels: chicken wings | soy sauce | brown sugar | ground ginger | ground mustard | garlic cloves
texte:
Party Chicken Wings

Ingredients:
- 5 chicken wings
- 1 soy sauce
- 1 brown sugar
- 1 ground ginger
- 1 ground mustard
- 2 -3 garlic cloves

Instructions:
1. mix all ingredients together add chicken wings and marinate for 2 days (I have also marinated for only 1 day) drain marinade and bake at 350 for 1 and 1/2 hours stirring occasionally.

ingredients_reels: iceberg lettuce | cucumber | celery | red onions | scallions | sharp cheddar cheese | bacon | hard-boiled eggs | mayonnaise | sugar | sour cream | yogurt
texte:
Yummy 7 Layer Salad

Ingredients:
- 1 iceberg lettuce
- 1 cucumber
- 1 celery
- 1 1/2 red onions
- 1 scallions
- 6 sharp cheddar cheese
- 1/2 bacon
- 2 hard-boiled eggs
- 2 mayonnaise
- 2 sugar
- 1/2 sour cream
- 1 yogurt

Instructions:
1. Layer first 5 ingredients, one at a time, in a large glass bowl so you can see each layer.  Don't mix the ingredients.
2. Mix the dressing ingredients together and pour evenly over the salad in the bowl.
3. Add a layer of cheese, then a layer of bacon.
4. Then top with egg if using.

ingredients_reels: baby potatoes | ground cumin | ground paprika | salt | olive oil
texte:
Yummy Baked Taters or Wedges

Ingredients:
- 1 baby potatoes
- 2 ground cumin
- 1 ground paprika
- 1 salt
- 4 olive oil

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 220°C or 200°C if fan forced.
2. If using baby potatoes, wash and dry them and then cut into quarters. If using larger potatoes cut into rouughly 1 inch pieces.
3. I like to place the potatoes into a large plastic bag, or you can add them to a large mixing bowl. The plastic bag is the easiest and least messy option.
4. Add in the remaining ingredients and ensure thoroughly mixed.
5. Pour the potatoes out onto a flat tray in a single layer. I like to use cookies sheets. You dont need to grease the trays as the potatoes are already coated.
6. Place in the oven and turn after 20 minutes. Cook until done to your liking. Mine usually take 40 to 50 minutes.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | old fashioned oats | sugar | baking powder | ground cinnamon | nutmeg | egg | milk | banana | canola oil
texte:
Simplified Banana Oat Pancakes

Ingredients:
- 1 1/3 all-purpose flour
- 3/4 old fashioned oats
- 1 sugar
- 2 baking powder
- 1 ground cinnamon
- 1/2 nutmeg
- 1 egg
- 1 1/3 milk
- 1 banana
- 2 canola oil

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, combine the flour, oats, sugar, baking powder, cinnamon and nutmeg.
2. Combine the egg, milk, banana, and oil in a separate bowl.
3. Stir egg mixture into dry ingredients until just moistened.
4. Pour batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto a greased hot griddle.
5. Turn when bubbles form on top and cook until second side is golden brown.
6. Serve with your favorite topping or syrup.

ingredients_reels: bacon | yellow onion | green beans | chicken bouillon cube | water
texte:
Grandma's Green Beans

Ingredients:
- 2 bacon
- 1/2 yellow onion
- 4 green beans
- 1/2 chicken bouillon cube
- 1/2 water

Instructions:
1. Fry bacon til' it's crisp, on the stovetop. Add onion, cook until tender.
2. Drain \"all\" liquid off of canned green beans.
3. Add beans to bacon and onion mixture.
4. Add bullion cube and water.
5. Cook very slowly until beans \"shrivel\".
6. Sometimes, ok well maybe always I have this compulsive need to add things to whatever I am cooking, and 98% of the time you can beat it's gonna be GARLIC or SPICES. Soo- there ya' go. Add in some garlic if you dare, or maybe some seasoning salt? :) But whatever you do- ENJOY!

nom: Chicken Pasta With Sour Cream and Cheese Sauce (Zwt3 Western)
ingredients_reels: boneless skinless chicken breasts | white wine | white pepper | bacon | mushroom | garlic | butter | fettuccine pasta | sour cream | butter | monterey jack cheese | white wine | parmesan cheese | mozzarella cheese | parsley
texte:
Chicken Pasta With Sour Cream and Cheese Sauce (Zwt3 Western)

Ingredients:
- 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts
- 1/4 white wine
- 1 white pepper
- 1/2 bacon
- 1/2 mushroom
- 4 garlic
- 1 butter
- 1 fettuccine pasta
- 1 sour cream
- 1/2 butter
- 3/4 monterey jack cheese
- 1/2 white wine
- 1/2 parmesan cheese
- 1/4 mozzarella cheese
- parsley

Instructions:
1. Poach the chicken in white wine, uncovered, seasoned with a dash of white pepper, about 10 minutes.  Cut into small pieces and set aside.
2. Fry bacon bits till crisp. Remove from skillet and drain on a peper towel.  Set aside.
3. Over medium heat saute the mushrooms and garlic in butter for about 5 minutes.
4. Combine chicken, bacon and mushroom garlic mixture and keep warm.
5. Prepare and drain fettucine, tossing with a light coating of olive oil if desired.
6. Sauce:
7. Combine all sauce ingredients except parsley in a saucepan.  Over low heat, mix till cheese is melted and sauce becomes smooth.
8. Pour the sauce over the noodles and mix together well.
9. Top with chicken, bacon and mushroom mixture.
10. Garnish with chopped parsley.

ingredients_reels: boneless skinless chicken breast halves | egg | garlic powder | table salt | kosher salt | black pepper | chili powder
texte:
Crispy Baked Chicken Strips

Ingredients:
- 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves
- 1 egg
- 2 garlic powder
- 1 table salt
- 1/4 kosher salt
- 1/4 black pepper
- 1/4 chili powder

Instructions:
1. Cut chicken breasts into thin strips, about one inch wide.
2. Longer sections can be cut in half to have uniform pieces.
3. Mix cracker crumbs and seasonings well.
4. Dip chicken pieces into egg mixture, then dredge in crumb mixture.
5. Place on baking sheet sprayed with cooking spray.
6. Bake at 375 degrees F, for 10-12 minutes, until crispy on outside and lightly browned.
7. Dip into favorite sauce, or enjoy just as they are!

ingredients_reels: butter | dried basil | dried thyme | black pepper | garlic cloves | paprika | potatoes | cottage cheese
texte:
Herbed Potato With Cottage Cheese

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 1/4 dried basil
- 1/4 dried thyme
- 1/8 black pepper
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1/2 paprika
- 2 potatoes
- 2 cottage cheese

Instructions:
1. Place all ingredients except paprika, potato and cottage cheese into a cup and microwave 30 seconds or until butter is melted.
2. Stir mixture well, cut two slices half way into potato, fill with mixture and place a little over the outside.
3. Wrap with foil and bake for one hour at 180 celsius (350 Fahrenheit).
4. Remove potatoes from foil, spoon cottage cheese over top and sprinkle with paprika.

ingredients_reels: boneless skinless chicken breast | onion | bell peppers | olive oil | lime juice | garlic cloves | salsa | flour tortillas
texte:
Marinated Chicken Fajitas

Ingredients:
- 1 boneless skinless chicken breast
- 1 onion
- 2 bell peppers
- 2 olive oil
- 2 lime juice
- 2 garlic cloves
- 3/4 salsa
- 8 flour tortillas

Instructions:
1. Cut the chicken breast into strips.
2. Mix onions, peppers, olive oil, lime juice, garlic and salsa.
3. Add chicken and marinate 2-12 hours.
4. Broil or pan fry all together until chicken is done.
5. Divide among tortillas.
6. Top with extra salsa, shredded cheese, lettuce -- however you like.
7. ENJOY!

ingredients_reels: eggs | milk | flour | salt
texte:
Never Fail Popovers

Ingredients:
- 3 eggs
- 1 milk
- 1 flour
- 1/2 salt

Instructions:
1. Beat eggs slightly, add remaining ingredients, blend but don't worry about lumps.
2. Refrigerate 1/2 hour.
3. Grease generously 8 muffin cups.
4. Fill each 3/4 full.
5. Place pan in a cold oven.
6. Turn temperature to 450°F  Bake for 30 minutes.
7. Don't open oven while their cooking or they fall.

ingredients_reels: instant nonfat dry milk powder | sugar | cornstarch | salt | milk | butter | vanilla
texte:
Vanilla Pudding Mix

Ingredients:
- 4 instant nonfat dry milk powder
- 4 sugar
- 1 1/3 cornstarch
- 1/2 salt
- 2 milk
- 1 butter
- 1/2 vanilla

Instructions:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients into a large bowl, mixing well with each addition.  Pour into a food processor and process until a  fine powder.
2. At this stage you can put it into a jar with a good seal, label and add a card with the following instructions for gifting, or label it for your own future use.
3. Over double boiler, with water to boiling stage, put 1 cup of powdered pudding mix into saucepan, slowly adding milk while you stir (I used a whisk for lighter fluffier pudding) Stir constantly for approximately 10-15 minutes or until pudding comes to thickness of your liking. Remove from double boiler, add vanilla and butter, whisk or stir until throughly blended.
4. Pour into individual serving dishes and refrigerate.
5. NOTE:
6. Due to DH illness I used reconstituted dry milk for the 2 c milk, this does affect the flavor slightly.

ingredients_reels: French style green beans | butter | oregano leaves | garlic cloves | crushed red pepper flakes | salt | ground black pepper
texte:
Screamin' Green Beans

Ingredients:
- 16 French style green beans
- 2 butter
- 2 oregano leaves
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1 crushed red pepper flakes
- 1/2 salt
- 1 ground black pepper

Instructions:
1. Cook beans in a small amount of boiling water for about 10-15 minutes (or according to package).
2. Drain; keep warm.
3. Add all ingredients and cook on low until butter has melted and flavors are combined - stir continuously.
4. Serve.

ingredients_reels: garbanzo beans | tahini | garlic cloves | fresh lemon juice | cayenne | olive oil | kalamata olive | capers | red bell pepper | ground cumin | fresh parsley
texte:
Mediterranean Kalamata Hummus

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 garbanzo beans
- 1/4 tahini
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1/4 fresh lemon juice
- 1 cayenne
- 4 olive oil
- 3/4 kalamata olive
- 2 capers
- 1 red bell pepper
- 1 ground cumin
- 3 fresh parsley

Instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a food processor and puree. Add enough cold water to achieve a spreadable consistency.
2. Spoon puree onto a shallow plate and smooth the top with a spoon. Drizzle with remaining olive oil and strew with remaining parsley. Sprinkle remaining cumin and cayenne in a star pattern and serve with warm pita or veggies.
3. Enjoy!

ingredients_reels: butter | cream cheese | flour | salt
texte:
Tart Pastry

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 3 cream cheese
- 1 flour
- 1 salt

Instructions:
1. Dump everything into a bowl, roll up your sleeves and get your hands right into it.
2. Work the dough well and knead for a couple of minutes.
3. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes (or more) before proceeding with recipe.
4. I have made up this dough up to a week (or even longer) ahead of time, and kept in a compartment in the refrigerator, wrapped airtight in plastic wrap.  It is a wonderful thing to have on hand during the holidays to whip up a batch of tarts or tassies, fresh.

nom: Sauteed Chayote With Garlic and Herbs
ingredients_reels: butter | chayotes | fresh parsley | garlic cloves | green onions
texte:
Sauteed Chayote With Garlic and Herbs

Ingredients:
- 2 butter
- 2 chayotes
- 2 fresh parsley
- 3 garlic cloves
- 2 green onions

Instructions:
1. Melt butter in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chayote, 1 tablespoon parsley, and garlic.
2. Sauté until chayote is crisp-tender, about 3 minutes. Stir in green onions.
3. Transfer to bowl; sprinkle with 1 tablespoon parsley.

ingredients_reels: bacon | fresh mushrooms | garlic clove | green beans | soy sauce
texte:
Great Green Beans

Ingredients:
- 1/2 bacon
- 1/2 fresh mushrooms
- 1 garlic clove
- 2 green beans
- 1 1/2 soy sauce

Instructions:
1. Place bacon into a large saucepan over medium heat.
2. Cook until browned, stirring occasionally.
3. Add the mushrooms and garlic, and reduce the heat to medium-low.
4. Let cook for a few minutes to soften the mushrooms.
5. Stir in the green beans and soy sauce, and heat through.

nom: Salted in the Shell Sunflower Seeds
ingredients_reels: sunflower seeds | water | canning salt
texte:
Salted in the Shell Sunflower Seeds

Ingredients:
- 6 sunflower seeds
- 8 water
- 3/4 canning salt

Instructions:
1. Put sunflower seeds in colandar and wash with warm running water.
2. Shake dry in colandar.
3. Place in tall stockpot.
4. Add sunflower seeds.
5. Add 8 cups water and canning salt.
6. Cover.
7. Set in a cool room or cold porch.
8. The seeds will swell some.
9. Let set for 48 hours, the longer you set, the longer the brine has a chance to work.
10. I turned with a stainless steel spoon 4 times during this process.
11. Drain the seeds, save the brine, if you want to make another batch.
12. Pour the seeds into a terry cloth towel and wrap and press with your hand.
13. Spread out on  baking trays.
14. Place in a cold oven.
15. Heat oven to 250*.
16. Turn every hour with a spatula.
17. Dry from 3 to 4 hours. It depends on the amount of seeds you place on your trays.

ingredients_reels: zucchini | lemon juice | sugar | nutmeg | cinnamon | vanilla | flour | sugar | salt | margarine | cinnamon
texte:
Zucchini Bars

Ingredients:
- 6 -8 zucchini
- 2/3 lemon juice
- 1 sugar
- 1/2 nutmeg
- 1 cinnamon
- 1 vanilla
- 4 flour
- 3 sugar
- 1/2 salt
- 1 1/2 margarine
- 1 cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Cook zucchini in lemon juice until tender, use often.
2. Add 1 cup sugar, nutmeg and 1 teaspoon cinnamon and vanilla and let simmer for two minutes.
3. While zucchini cooks, combine the flour, 2 cups sugar, salt and margarine in a large bowl and mix well.
4. Add 1/2 cup of the crumb mixture to the zucchini to thicken, stir well, turn off the heat after thick.
5. Pat 1/2 of the remaining crumb mixture into a greased 9x13-inch pan.
6. Bake at 375°Fs for 10 minutes.
7. Spread zucchini evenly over the crust.
8. Add 1 teaspoon cinnamon to the remaining crumb mixture and spread over the top of the zucchini.
9. Bake at 375°F for 30-40 minutes, until bubbling around the crust.
10. Let cool before cutting into bars.  Can be warmed up in microwave and top with ice cream.

ingredients_reels: self-rising flour | sugar | margarine | egg | vanilla extract | milk
texte:
Easy Old-Fashion Sugar Cookies

Ingredients:
- 2 self-rising flour
- 1 sugar
- 1/2 margarine
- 1 egg
- 1 vanilla extract
- 1 milk

Instructions:
1. Cream margarine; add sugar, beat until fluffy.
2. Add egg and vanilla, stir in flour and milk. ( You may need to add a little more milk or flour to get the best consistency to roll out).
3. Roll into two logs, wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate.
4. When ready to bake, just slice into thin slices. Bake at 350' for 5 to 7 minutes or until bottoms are lightly browned; tops will be slightly moist.

ingredients_reels: avocados | lemon juice | kosher salt | chili powder | ground cumin | onion powder | roma tomatoes | cilantro | garlic clove | fresh chili pepper
texte:
Holy Guacamole!

Ingredients:
- 3 avocados
- 2 lemon juice
- 1/2 kosher salt
- 1/2 chili powder
- 1/2 ground cumin
- 2 onion powder
- 2 roma tomatoes
- 1 cilantro
- 1 garlic clove
- 1 fresh chili pepper

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, scoop out the entire avacados from their shells and lightly mash it with a spoon.
2. Pour in all the lemon juice and mix.
3. Next add in the salt, chili powder, cumin and onion powder.
4. Then Add the garlic, cilantro and diced tomatoes. Mix Everything Well.
5. Place the guacamole in the bowl you plan on serving it inches.
6. Lastly, take the red chili and cut three thick rings. Place on top of the guacamole as a garnish.
7. Serve with tortilla chips.

ingredients_reels: tomato juice | tomato sauce | olive oil | flour | active dry yeast | brown sugar | salt | oregano | dry basil | rosemary | pepper | garlic
texte:
Tomato Bread

Ingredients:
- 2 tomato juice
- 1/2 tomato sauce
- 2 olive oil
- 6 1/2 flour
- 2 active dry yeast
- 3 brown sugar
- 1 salt
- 3/4 oregano
- 1/2 dry basil
- 1/4 rosemary
- 1/4 pepper
- 2 garlic

Instructions:
1. Lightly grease large bowl and two loaf pans with olive oil.
2. In small saucepan, heat juice, sauce and 2 tbs olive oil to 120 F degrees.
3. Combine 3 cups flour with yeast and remaining ingredients.
4. Pour in tomato mix and beat 3 minutes.
5. Gradually add remaining flour until it holds together enough to turn out on floured surface.
6. If the dough is too sticky, and you may need to add a little more flour, but not too much or you will have a dry bread.
7. Knead about 5 minutes, until dough smooths out, place in lightly oiled bowl (olive is best here!), turning to coat dough with oil once, cover and let rise 1 hour.
8. Punch dough down, let rest 15 minutes, then shape into 2 loaves, and place in pans.
9. Cover pans and let rise 45 minutes.
10. Preheat oven to 375 F degrees.
11. Bake loaves 10 minutes, reduce heat to 350 F and bake 30-40 minutes more.
12. Bread is done when loaf sounds hollow when thumped with knuckle.
13. Tip loaves out immediately onto wire rack to cool.
14. *Note-Insteadof individual spices, you can also use 1 3/4 tsp of Italian Seasoning.

nom: Purple Cabbage and Carrot Saute (Low Carb)
ingredients_reels: purple cabbage | onion | carrots | garlic | parmesan cheese | lemon juice | sugar | salt | pepper | butter | olive oil
texte:
Purple Cabbage and Carrot Saute (Low Carb)

- 1 -2 parmesan cheese

- 1 sugar

Instructions:
1. In a skillet - heat your butter and olive oil together  over medium high heat.
2. add onions and saute for approximately 3 mnutes.
3. Add cabbage, garlic, salt, pepper, lemon juice & sugar and saute until well cooked - approximately 10 - 12 minutes oir longer.
4. 3 - 5 minutes before you are ready to serve - GENTLY stirr in the carrots - they only need to get warm.  Gentle stirring will keep the carrots from turning purple.
5. Serve.

ingredients_reels: potato | carrots | chicken broth | flour | salt | dried thyme leaves | pepper | boneless skinless chicken thighs | frozen baby peas | baking mix | milk
texte:
Crock Pot Southern Chicken & Dumplings

Ingredients:
- 1 potato
- 2 carrots
- 1 chicken broth
- 1/4 flour
- 1/2 salt
- 1/2 dried thyme leaves
- 1/4 pepper
- 2 boneless skinless chicken thighs
- 1 frozen baby peas
- 1 1/2 baking mix
- 1/2 milk

Instructions:
1. In a 3-4 quart crock pot, mix potato and carrots.
2. In medium bowl, combine chicken broth, flour and spices and blend well until smooth.
3. Pour over vegetables in crock pot.
4. Add chicken.
5. Cover crock pot.
6. Cook on LOW for 6-8 hours until chicken is thoroughly cooked and no longer pink in center.
7. Add peas and cover again.
8. Cook on HIGH for 20 minutes until peas are hot.
9. In small bowl, combine baking mix and milk and mix just until combined.
10. Do not over mix.
11. Drop by tablespoons onto hot chicken mixture in crock pot.
12. Cover and cook on HIGH for 20-25 minutes until dumplings are cooked through, are fluffy, and a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

ingredients_reels: water | white bread flour | brown sugar | salt | peanut butter | fast rise yeast
texte:
Peanut Butter Bread

Ingredients:
- 1 1/4 water
- 3 white bread flour
- 1/4 brown sugar
- 1/2 salt
- 1/2 peanut butter
- 2 fast rise yeast

Instructions:
1. Place ingredients in machine in the order suggested by the manufacturer.
2. Operate machine on regular setting for 1-1/2 pound loaf.
3. This recipe can also be made with rapid or delayed time bake cycles.

ingredients_reels: butter | light brown sugar | eggs | flour | baking powder | salt | chocolate chips | walnuts
texte:
Congo Bars

Ingredients:
- 2/3 butter
- 1 light brown sugar
- 3 eggs
- 2 3/4 flour
- 2 1/2 baking powder
- 1/2 salt
- 12 chocolate chips
- 1 walnuts

Instructions:
1. Melt the butter and add brown sugar; mix well and cool.
2. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well each time.
3. Add dry ingredients and mix well.
4. Add the nuts and chocolate bits.
5. Put in a greased 9x13 pan and bake 350 degrees for about 25-30 minutes.

ingredients_reels: black beans | boneless pork sirloin | chili powder | ground coriander | salt | onion | garlic | stewed tomatoes | water | fresh ground black pepper | fresh cilantro leaves
texte:
Mexican Pork & Black Beans

Ingredients:
- 1 black beans
- 1 boneless pork sirloin
- 1 chili powder
- 1 ground coriander
- 2 salt
- 1 onion
- 1 garlic
- 16 stewed tomatoes
- 2 water
- fresh ground black pepper
- fresh cilantro leaves

Instructions:
1. Put beans in crockpot.
2. Toss pork with chili powder, coriander and salt.
3. Lightly brown onion and garlic with pork in ungreased skillet.
4. Mix tomatoes into crockpot with their juice.
5. Add meat, pepper and 2 cups water.
6. Cover and cook 9 hours on low.
7. Ladle over rice and garnish with cilantro.

nom: Meyer Lemon Cake With Lemon-Cream Cheese Frosting
ingredients_reels: canola oil | all-purpose flour | baking powder | baking soda | salt | eggs | granulated sugar | lemon juice | lemon zest | vanilla | sour cream | unsalted butter | cream cheese | lemon juice | lemon zest | vanilla | powdered sugar
texte:
Meyer Lemon Cake With Lemon-Cream Cheese Frosting

Ingredients:
- 1 canola oil
- 2 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1 baking powder
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1/2 salt
- 3 eggs
- 2 granulated sugar
- 1/2 lemon juice
- 1 lemon zest
- 2 vanilla
- 1 sour cream
- 1/2 unsalted butter
- 6 cream cheese
- 2 lemon juice
- 1 lemon zest
- 1 vanilla
- 3 powdered sugar

Instructions:
1. Cake: Grease bottom, sides and center tube of a 9 or 10-inch fixed bottom tube pan with at least 3 3/4-inch high sides. Line bottom of pan with waxed paper or parchment; grease the paper.
2. Preheat oven to 325°.
3. Sift the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt into a medium bowel; set aside.
4. In a large bowl, beat eggs and sugar with an electric mixer on medium speed until thickened and lightened to a cream color, about 2 minutes.
5. On low speed, beat in 1 cup oil, lemon juice, lemon zest and vanilla until blended.
6. Blend in flour mixture; when incorporated, mix in sour cream until no white streaks remain.
7. Pour batter into prepared pan.
8. Bake on center oven rack until top feels firm and toothpick comes out clean. about 65 minutes.
9. Let cake rest in pan for 15 minutes, then run knife around edge of cake and tube in center.
10. Invert cake onto wire rack.
11. Leave cake bottom side up to cool.
12. Frosting: In a large bowl, use an electric mixer on low speed to beat butter, cream cheese, lemon juice, zest and vanilla until smooth.
13. Beat in sugar until frosting is smooth and fluffy, about 2 minutes.
14. Frost cake: Cake can be covered and stored in refrigerator for up to 3 days.
15. Serve cold or at room temperature.

ingredients_reels: mayonnaise | Dijon mustard | brown sugar | cider vinegar | buttermilk | celery seed | salt | pepper | red cabbage | green bell pepper | carrot | onion | blue cheese | bacon | sun-dried tomato
texte:
Blue Cheese Coleslaw Salad

Ingredients:
- 3/4 mayonnaise
- 1/4 Dijon mustard
- 1/4 brown sugar
- 1 1/2 cider vinegar
- 1 buttermilk
- 1/2 celery seed
- 1 salt
- 1/4 pepper
- 4 red cabbage
- 1 green bell pepper
- 1 carrot
- 1/2 onion
- 1 blue cheese
- 1/4 bacon
- 1/4 sun-dried tomato

Instructions:
1. Combine the 1st 8 ingredients at one time & mix well.
2. Prepare ea veggie ingredient & add, mixing well after ea new addition to ensure even distribution.
3. Refrigerate overnight & add blue cheese, mixing well just before serving.
4. Note: For a more asthetic presentation, I topped it off w/the crumbled bacon & diced sun-dried tomato.

ingredients_reels: ground beef | onion | water | garlic powder | dried parsley | dried oregano | cheddar cheese | gruyere | parmesan cheese | gruyere | medium pasta shells
texte:
Comforting Cheeseburger Pasta

Ingredients:
- 500 ground beef
- 1 onion
- 1 water
- 1 1/2 garlic powder
- 1 dried parsley
- 1 dried oregano
- 1 cheddar cheese
- 1 gruyere
- 1/2 parmesan cheese
- 2 -3 gruyere
- 3 medium pasta shells

Instructions:
1. Bring some water to boil in a large pan, add a little olive oil and cook pasta al dente, you do not want it to be to soft as there is extra cooking in the oven.
2. Brown beef in a pan, remove and wipe pan clean, heat a small amount of oil in pan add onion cook until onion softens.
3. Retuen beef to pan with soup, water, garlic, parsley, oregano and cheeses stir to combine and continuing stirring until all the cheese has melted. Stir in pasta.
4. Transfer mixture to an oven proof dish, sprinkle with parmesan and gruyere cheese. Bake in a 180°c oven until top browns about 8 Min's.
5. Serves 4-6 depending on appetites, it will keep a couple of days in the fridge so the leftovers make a good quick lunch you can reheat in the microwave.

ingredients_reels: soft tofu | maple syrup | salt | vanilla extract | walnuts | black walnut
texte:
Maple Tofu Pudding

Ingredients:
- 12 -14 soft tofu
- 1/4 maple syrup
- 1/3 salt
- 1 vanilla extract
- 1/4 walnuts
- 1/4 black walnut

Instructions:
1. Drain the tofu and cut it into small pieces.
2. Place the pieces in a blender.
3. Add the oil, maple syrup, salt and vanilla.  Put the lid on the blender.
4. Process the mixture for a minute or two, or until the pudding is quite smooth.
5. If necessary, turn off the blender, and scrape down the sides of the blender jar.
6. Then put the lid back on and process some more.
7. When the mixture is smooth, turn it into 4 small, resealable, half-cup containers.
8. Chill until serving time, or serve right away if desired.
9. If you like, you can sprinkle a tablespoon of finely chopped walnuts on top of each serving of pudding.
10. I prefer black walnuts, but any type will do.

ingredients_reels: broccoli florets | red onion | low-fat cheddar cheese | crisp bacon | light mayonnaise | vinegar
texte:
Broccoli Salad

Ingredients:
- 2 broccoli florets
- 1 red onion
- 1 low-fat cheddar cheese
- 1/2 crisp bacon
- 1/2 light mayonnaise
- 1 vinegar

Instructions:
1. Mix the mayonnaise and vinegar together.
2. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
3. Marinate in fridge for at least one hour.
4. Serve and enjoy!

ingredients_reels: rigatoni pasta | penne | onion | garlic cloves | whole tomatoes | ricotta cheese | mozzarella cheese | parmesan cheese | parsley | dried basil | dried oregano | black pepper | red pepper flakes | salt | olive oil
texte:
Vegetarian Baked Ziti

Ingredients:
- 1 rigatoni pasta
- 1 penne
- 2 onion
- 1 garlic cloves
- 1 1/4 whole tomatoes
- 8 ricotta cheese
- 1/4 mozzarella cheese
- 1/3 parmesan cheese
- 1/2 parsley
- 1/2 dried basil
- dried oregano
- 1/4 black pepper
- 1/4 red pepper flakes
- 1/4 salt
- 1/4 olive oil

Instructions:
1. Cook the ziti to just before al dente.
2. Coat a 9'x12\" baking dish with olive oil. Set aside.
3. In a skillet, heat the remaining olive oil over medium-high heat. Cook the onion until translucent.
4. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Don't let the garlic brown.
5. Crush the tomatoes with your hands and add to the skillet. Add in the juice from the can.
6. Cook for 3-5 minutes.
7. In a large bowl mix the ricotta and mozarella cheeses.
8. Add the parsley, basil, oregano, salt, red pepper, a few grinds of pepper, and mix.
9. Add the tomato-onion mixture and mix well.
10. When the ziti is drained add to the cheese mixture and toss well to coat the pasta.
11. Spoon the mixture into the baking dish.
12. Sprinkle the bread crumbs and parmesan cheese on top of the pasta.
13. Bake at 400F for 20-30 minutes, or until lightly browned.
14. Allow to rest for 5 minutes before serving.

ingredients_reels: butter | margarine | sugar | dates | egg | vanilla | walnuts | sweetened flaked coconut
texte:
Joni's Date Logs - Christmas

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 1 margarine
- 3 sugar
- 1 dates
- 1 egg
- 1/2 vanilla
- 3 walnuts
- 1 sweetened flaked coconut

Instructions:
1. Put butter, sugar, dates, and eggs in a heavy bottomed pan.  Bring to boil over medium heat, and stir.  When it starts to boil, stir constantly (about 10 minutes) until the liquid starts pulling away from the sides of the pan while you are stirring it, then remove from heat.
2. Add vanilla, walnuts and Rice Krispies, and mix in well.
3. Butter your hands and put enough mixture in the palm of your hand (about 2 T.).  Roll into logs with your hands.The logs should be about 3\" long by 1/2\" wide.   (The mixture will be hot, so be careful and work quickly).
4. Roll each log in flaked coconut and place on waxed paper until completely cool.  Store in a plastic container with cover.

ingredients_reels: butter | margarine | honey | brown sugar | eggs | vanilla | baking powder | baking soda | salt | cinnamon | zucchini | sweetened flaked coconut | walnuts | chocolate chips
texte:
Suprise Bars

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 1/2 margarine
- 1/2 honey
- 2 brown sugar
- 1 eggs

- 1/4 baking soda

ingredients_reels: salt | baking soda | ginger | cinnamon | shortening | sugar | egg | light molasses | flour | boiling water
texte:
Gingerbread

Ingredients:
- 3/4 salt
- 3/4 baking soda
- 1/2 ginger

- 1/4 shortening
- 1/2 sugar

3. Grease and wax paper an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.

5. Remove from pan while still warm.

nom: Black Bean, Chicken  and Corn Soup With Toasted Tortilla Strips
ingredients_reels: olive oil | onion | garlic | chicken breasts | diced green chilies | stewed tomatoes | tomato sauce | black beans | whole kernel corn | cooked long-grain rice | chicken broth | salt | fresh cracked pepper | cilantro | limes, juice and zest of | sour cream | parmesan cheese | flour tortillas | butter | salt | pepper
texte:
Black Bean, Chicken  and Corn Soup With Toasted Tortilla Strips

Ingredients:
- 1 olive oil
- 1 onion
- 1 garlic
- 2 -3 chicken breasts
- 1 diced green chilies
- 2 stewed tomatoes
- 2 tomato sauce
- 2 black beans
- 2 whole kernel corn
- 2 cooked long-grain rice
- 4 -6 chicken broth
- 1 salt
- 1/2 fresh cracked pepper
- 1 cilantro
- 2 limes, juice and zest of
- sour cream
- parmesan cheese
- 4 -6 flour tortillas
- butter
- salt
- pepper

Instructions:
1. In a large pot, saute the olive oil, onions and garlic until the onions are transparent (about 5 minutes).
2. Next, add the remaining ingredients (except for the cilantro and limes).
3. Stir well and allow soup to simmer for 20-30 minutes until ready to serve.  Before serving, stir in the cilantro, lime juice and zest to keep their flavors.
4. Garnish with sour cream, parmesan cheese and toasted tortilla strips.
5. Toasted Tortilla strips: Cut tortillas into 1/2 inch wide strips.
6. Place the tortilla strips on a large baking sheet (single layered) and spray them with pan spray, or you may baste them with melted butter.
7. Season with salt and pepper and place them in a 375 degree oven.  Bake until golden and crisp (about 10 minutes).
8. Make sure to turn strips over halfway through the baking process.

ingredients_reels: butter | green onions | eggs | dill weed | black pepper | cream cheese | feta cheese | fresh chives | scallion top
texte:
Spanakopita Breakfast Eggs

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 2 green onions
- 4 eggs
- 4 dill weed
- 1/2 black pepper
- 1/4 cream cheese
- 1 feta cheese
- 1 fresh chives
- 1 scallion top

Instructions:
1. In a medium skillet over moderate heat, melt the butter.  Add the green onions, spinach, and dill stirring occasionally, until spinach has wilted.
2. In a bowl whisk together the eggs, cream cheese , feta, dill, and pepper. Pour mixture over the spinach.
3. If scrambling the eggs, just stir until you reach desired texture of eggs and serve. Transfer to a serving plate and sprinkle with the chives or scallions.
4. OPTIONAL OMELETTE: (Make 2) Stir the eggs gently pushing the outer edges inward till the eggs begin to solidify. Leave it be for a minute or two but continue to shake pan a little to keep it loose from the pan.
5. When eggs are 2/3 of the way done, carefully 'flip' the pan with a quick jerk. If you don't know how to do that, you can slide the omelette onto a baking sheet and broil the top for a minute to continue cooking.

ingredients_reels: unsalted butter | low-sodium worcestershire sauce | Worcestershire sauce | black pepper | Tabasco sauce | lemon juice | garlic clove | dry mustard | salt

Lone Star Steakhouse Steak Sauce

1. Thoroughly mix all ingredients together in a saucepan and heat until the butter is completely melted.
2. Fire up the grill and break out the steaks.
3. Store refrigerated.

ingredients_reels: butter | margarine | orange marmalade
texte:
Orange-Glazed Baby Carrots (Light)

Ingredients:
- 2 butter
- 1 margarine
- 2 orange marmalade

Instructions:
1. In a covered medium saucepan cook the carrots in lightly salted boiling water for 5 minutes. Drain, set carrots aside.
2. In the same saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
3. Add the carrots and orange marmalade.
4. Cook and stir for 2 to 3 minutes or until carrots are tender and glazed.

ingredients_reels: unsalted butter | sugar | sugar | eggs | vanilla | all-purpose flour | baking powder | salt | buttermilk
texte:
Mean Chef's Vanilla Buttermilk Cupcakes

Ingredients:
- 6 unsalted butter
- 1 sugar
- 2 sugar
- 2 eggs
- 1 vanilla
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 2 baking powder
- 1/2 salt
- 2/3 buttermilk

Instructions:
1. Beat butter and all the sugar on medium speed until well blended. Add eggs and vanilla and beat on high speed until well blended.
2. Sift together flour, baking powder, and salt.
3. With mixer on low speed, add one third of the flour mixture, followed by a third of the buttermilk – repeat, alternating in thirds. When all the flour is incorporated beat mixture on medium speed just until well blended.
4. Fill paper-lined or buttered muffin cups (1/3-cup capacity) about three-fourths full with batter (about 1/4 cup in each).
5. Bake in a 350° oven until tops spring back when lightly touched in the center, 20 to 25 minutes. Cool on racks 5 minutes; remove from pans. Cool completely.
6. Decorate with your favorite frosting.

ingredients_reels: cherry pie filling | fresh lemon juice | flour | pecans | butter | brown sugar | cinnamon | allspice
texte:
Quick 'N Easy Cherry Pecan Cobbler

Ingredients:
- 1 cherry pie filling
- 1 fresh lemon juice

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Combine pie filling and lemon juice in 1 quart baking dish.
3. Mix all remaining ingredients in medium bowl.
4. Sprinkle over pie filling.
5. Bake for 15 minutes or until top is brown and cherries are bubbly.
6. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

ingredients_reels: unsalted butter | leeks | fresh ground black pepper | Roquefort cheese | blue cheese | fresh thyme leave | eggs | half-and-half
texte:
Roquefort Leek Tart

Ingredients:
- 1 unsalted butter
- 1 leeks
- 2 1/2 fresh ground black pepper
- Roquefort cheese
- 6 blue cheese
- 1 fresh thyme leave
- 3 eggs
- 1 1/2 half-and-half

Instructions:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Roll out pastry and line quiche or tart pan. Line with foil and weight with pastry weights or dry beans. Bake 10 minutes, remove foil and weights and bake until golden, about 15 minutes more.
2. While pastry bakes, heat butter in large skillet. Add leeks, season with pepper and sauté over low heat until soft but not brown. Remove from heat.
3. When pastry is done, remove from oven and lower oven heat to 375 degrees. Spread leeks in pastry. Add cheese and thyme. Mix eggs and half-and-half and pour over ingredients in pastry.
4. Bake tart 35 to 40 minutes, until filling feels fairly firm to the touch and has barely begun to brown. Serve warm or at room temperature.

ingredients_reels: white sugar | eggs | fresh lemon juice | lemons, zest of | unsalted butter
texte:
Quick Lemon Curd

Ingredients:
- 1 white sugar
- 3 eggs
- 1 fresh lemon juice
- 3 lemons, zest of

Instructions:
1. In a microwave bowl, whisk together the sugar and eggs until smooth.
2. Stir in lemon juice, lemon zest, and butter.
3. Cook in the microwave for one minute intervals, stirring after each minute until the mixture is thick enough to coat the back of a metal spoon.  It will be quite liquid but will set up somewhat overnight.
4. Remove from the microwave, and pour into sterile jars.
5. Store for up to 3 weeks in the refrigerator.

ingredients_reels: pears | liquid honey | butter | granulated sugar | molasses | all-purpose flour | egg | ginger | cinnamon | baking soda | ground cloves | salt | hot water
texte:
Pear Gingerbread Pudding.

Ingredients:
- 2 pears
- 2 liquid honey
- 1/2 butter
- 1/2 granulated sugar
- 1/4 molasses
- 3/4 all-purpose flour
- 1 egg
- 1 ginger
- 1 cinnamon
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1/4 ground cloves
- 1 salt
- 2/3 hot water

Instructions:
1. Grease an 8 inch square (2L) glass baking dish.  Spread pears in dish and drizzle honey over it.  Set aside.
2. In a large bowl beat butter with sugar until fluffy. , then beat in molasses and egg.  (The secret to loosening molasses is to let it sit in a small bowl of warm water.  I learned this from a cooking show and it works like a charm.).
3. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, ginger, cinnamon, ground cloves, baking soda and salt.  Stir into molasses mixture and alternately with hot water, making three additions of dry ingredients, and two additions of water.  Pour over pears.
4. Bake in a preheated 350 F degree (180 C) oven until straw or cake tester inserted in center of cake comes out clean.  Serve warm.  They say it takes about 30 minutes, but from my personal experience, in order for the straw or cake tester to come out clean it has to be in the oven between 40-45 minutes.

nom: Brazilian Chicken and Black Beans and Rice

ingredients_reels: eggs | sour cream | milk | instant coffee granules | raisins | flour | oats | sugar | baking powder | ground cloves | cinnamon | allspice | oats
texte:
Spicy Sour Cream Raisin Muffins

Ingredients:

Instructions:

nom: Chicken (Or Not) W/ Broccoli and Ziti
ingredients_reels: olive oil | boneless chicken breasts | garlic cloves | broccoli florets | ziti pasta | half-and-half | milk | fresh parmesan cheese | unsalted butter | dried red pepper flakes | water

ingredients_reels: active dry yeast | water | unbleached all-purpose flour | water | active dry yeast | unbleached all-purpose flour | salt
texte:
Basic Italian Bread

Ingredients:
- 1/2 active dry yeast
- 1 water
- 2 unbleached all-purpose flour
- 2 water
- 1 active dry yeast
- 5 -6 unbleached all-purpose flour
- 2 salt

Instructions:
1. Biga: Mix the yeast and water together, and then slowly start adding the flour, mixing well. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit at room temperature for up to 6 hours, or refrigerate overnight.
2. Bread: Place the water in a large bowl, sprinkle the yeast over top and mix well. Let sit 10 minutes until bubbly.
3. Add the biga, flour, and salt and stir with a wooden spoon (or mix with your hands) until everything is mixed. The dough will be fairly wet and sticky at this point.
4. Cover and let stand in a warm spot for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours until doubled in volume. Punch down the dough, folding it over on itself two or three times, cover and let rise once more until doubled, about 1 hour.
5. To bake the following day, refrigerate the dough at this time and leave it overnight.
6. Turn out your dough onto a floured baking sheet, and without overworking it too much, shape into one large or two smaller round or oval shaped loaves, using as much extra flour as needed to keep it from sticking. Slash across the tops of the loaves with a serrated knife or razor just prior to baking.
7. Preheat the oven to 350° F and place a casserole dish with boiling water on the lower oven rack. Bake for 30 minutes, turn the baking sheet around, and reduce the heat to 300°F and bake for another 30-45 minutes. Bread should be golden brown and should sound hollow when you tap the bottom.
8. Allow the bread to cool to room temperature and serve.
9. Baking Tip: You could also use a baguette pan to make long thin loaves, or spread your dough across a well-oiled cookie sheet to make focaccia.
10. Variations:*Roasted Garlic & Basil Bread: Coarsely chop 1-2 heads (bulbs) roasted garlic and add to flour along with about 1 teaspoon crushed dried basil.
11. Rosemary Bread: Add 4 Tablespoons finely chopped fresh rosemary to the flour. Brush the loaves with water and sprinkle with coarse sea salt just prior to baking.
12. Olive Bread: Add 12 ounces flavorful, pitted olives, coarsely chopped to the flour.
13. *To roast garlic: Heat oven to 350°F Peel away paper like skin from around the garlic bulbs leaving just enough to hold bulb intact. Trim tops of garlic bulbs about 1/2 inch to expose cloves. Place bulbs stem ends down on 12 inch square of foil. Drizzle each bulb with 2 teaspoons olive or vegetable oil. Wrap securely in foil and place in pie plate or shallow baking pan.
14. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until garlic is tender when pierced with toothpick or fork.
15. Cool slightly. Gently squeeze garlic out of cloves (1 ounce bulb of roasted garlic= about 1 Tablespoon mashed garlic).

ingredients_reels: brown sugar | butter | egg | vanilla | flour | baking soda | salt | chocolate chips

Chocolate Chip Cookies

ingredients_reels: fuyu persimmons | baking soda | butter | sugar | eggs | lemon juice | vanilla | flour | baking powder | salt | ground cloves | cinnamon | ground nutmeg | walnuts | raisins | powdered sugar
texte:
Fuyu Bundt Cake

Ingredients:
- 3 fuyu persimmons
- 2 baking soda
- 1/2 butter
- 1 2/3 sugar

- 2 vanilla
- 2 flour

Instructions:
1. Grease and flour a bundt cake pan.
2. Preheat oven to 350.
3. Blend baking soda with chopped fuyus. Set aside.
4. In a large bowl beat butter with sugar. Add eggs, lemon juice and vanilla and beat until fluffy.
5. Stir in fuyu mix.
6. Sift together flour, baking powder, salt, ground cloves, cinnamon and nutmeg.
7. Stir flour mixture into fuyu mixture until just blended.

11. When cool, dust with powdered sugar, if desired.

ingredients_reels: powdered sugar | pecans | butter | light rum | vanilla extract | flour | baking powder | salt | sugar | powdered sugar | butter | light rum | half-and-half
texte:
Butter-Rum Sandwich Cookies

Ingredients:
- 1/2 powdered sugar
- 1/3 pecans
- 1 butter
- 2 light rum
- 1/2 vanilla extract
- 2 flour
- 1/2 baking powder
- 1/4 salt
- 3 sugar
- 1 1/3 powdered sugar
- 1/4 butter
- 1 1/2 light rum
- 1 -2 half-and-half

Instructions:
1. COOKIES: Combine the powdered sugar and pecans in a food processor fitted with a metal blade.
2. Cover and process until the pecans are very finely chopped, 45-60 seconds.
3. Combine the sugar mixture, butter, rum, and vanilla in a large bowl; cream with an electric mixer on medium speed until creamy, scraping sides of bowl often, 2-3 minutes.
4. Reduce mixer speed to low; add the flour, baking powder, and salt, stirring until well mixed (1-2 minutes).
5. Divide dough in half; shape each piece into a 10\" long roll on a lightly floured surface.
6. Flatten the sides to form a triangle on a sheet of waxed paper, using the paper to help create the shape.
7. Wrap each half in plastic wrap; refrigerate until firm, about 2 hours.
8. Preheat oven to 375°F.
9. Cut each dough log into 1/4\" slices; space 1\" apart on ungreased cookie sheets.
10. Sprinkle cookies with the pearl sugar; bake for 9-11 minutes, or until the edges begin to brown.
11. Transfer cookies to wire racks and cool completely.
12. Meanwhile, make the FROSTING: Combine all the frosting ingredients (except the half-and-half) in a small bow.
13. Beat with an electric mixer on low speed, adding enough half-and-half for desired spreading consistency.
14. For each sandwich cookie, spread 3/4 teaspoons frosting on the bottom of a cookie, sugar side down; top with a second cookie, sugar side up.
15. Squeeze together gently; repeat until all cookies have been assembled.

ingredients_reels: butter | vegetable shortening | cream cheese | vanilla extract | confectioners' sugar | salt
texte:
Crusting Cream Cheese Icing/Frosting

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 1/2 vegetable shortening
- 1 cream cheese
- 1 vanilla extract
- 3 1/2 confectioners' sugar
- 1/2 salt

Instructions:
1. Cream butter, shortening, cream cheese and extracts. Gradually add confectioner's sugar and salt. Beat on low speed until nice and creamy. If you want whiter icing, try to use butter without dyes available at most health food stores.
2. This recipe is for a stiff consistency. For a thinner consistency, use 3 pounds of powdered sugar instead.
3. If you want a very smooth cake, let the cake sit for 15 minutes after icing (longer for a thinner icing). Then using your spatula or fondant smoothing tool (this works best) smooth it with the non-printed side of a Viva paper towel. To do this, take your paper towel and lay it on your icing (after it crusts) and lightly rub over the paper towel with your spatual or fondant smoothing tool to get a smooth surface. If the icing sticks to the paper towel, you didn't let it \"crust\" long enough. Stick it in the fridge for 20 minutes or so to let it \"crust\" then try again. Don't let it set too much tho then it will be difficult to smooth it.
4. This recipe will ice, fill and decorate an 8\" double layer cake with icing left over.
