- 5 all-purpose flour
- 4 cream of tartar
- 2 baking soda
- 1 milk
- 1 salt
- 1 1/2 cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Combine potatoes, sugar, eggs, and butter.
2. Sift together flour, baking soda, cream of tartar, salt, and cinnamon.
3. Add to potato mixture alternately with milk, ending with dry ingredients.
4. If dough is too wet to roll out, add a little more flour.
5. Chill 1 1/2 hours in fridge.
6. Turn out onto a well floured board and roll out 1/4\" thick.
7. Cut with a floured doughnut cutter.
8. Fry doughnuts and holes in 360F.
9. deep fat.
10. Turn only once.
11. Drain on paper towels, then cool on a rack.
12. Leave plain or roll in cinnamon sugar.

nom: Two Second Ginger, Cream & Grape Dessert
ingredients_reels: green seedless grapes | red seedless grapes | sour cream | crystallized ginger
texte:
Two Second Ginger, Cream & Grape Dessert

Ingredients:
- 2 green seedless grapes
- 2 red seedless grapes
- 3/4 sour cream
- 6 crystallized ginger

Instructions:
1. Place a 1/2 cup of green grapes and a 1/2 cup red grapes in an individual serving dish.
2. Add a quarter of the our cream on top.
3. Drizzle 1 1/2 tbs of chopped ginger on top.
4. Repeat 4 times.
5. Serve.

ingredients_reels: papaya | vanilla ice cream | creme de cassis
texte:
Papaya Cream

Ingredients:
- 1 papaya
- 2 -3 vanilla ice cream
- 1 creme de cassis

Instructions:
1. Put cut up papaya chunks and ice cream in blender.
2. Blend until smooth and creamy.
3. Serve in dessert glasses.
4. Add Creme de Cassis if desired.

nom: Anman - Steamed Buns With Azuki (Sweet Red Bean) Paste
ingredients_reels: azuki beans | water | sugar | salt | flour | sugar | salt | instant yeast | baking powder | milk | water | vegetable shortening
texte:
Anman - Steamed Buns With Azuki (Sweet Red Bean) Paste

Ingredients:
- 1 1/3 azuki beans
- 4 water
- 1 sugar
- 1/2 salt
- 1 1/3 flour
- 3 1/2 sugar
- 1 salt
- 3/4 instant yeast
- 3/4 baking powder
- 1 1/3 milk
- 3 1/3 water
- 1 vegetable shortening

Instructions:
1. Making the Azuki Paste.
2. Put the azuki beans in a large pot and fill with water.  Let them soak overnight.
3. Bring the beans to a boil.
4. Turn down the heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
5. Remove the beans from the pot and drain them.
6. Put the beans back in the pot and add 4 cups of water.
7. Brings the beans to a boil.
8. Turn down the heat and simmer the beans for around an hour, until they're soft.
9. Drain the beans again.
10. Put the beans back in the pot and add the sugar and salt.
11. Simmer and stir the beans until they're thickened.
12. Remove from heat and cool.
13. Making the Buns.
14. Combine the flour, suar, salt, yeast, and baking powder and mix well.
15. Add the milk and water and mix well.
16. Add the shortening and knead the dough until it's smooth (add a little extra flout if it gets too sticky).
17. Let the dough rest for around 30 minutes, it will rise slightly.
18. Divide the dough into 10 balls and flatten them.
19. Take 1-2 spoonfulls of azuki paste, roll into a ball, and place in the center of one of the flattened dough balls.
20. Wrap the dough around the azuki and pinch it closed on top (twist if needed).
21. Repeat for the remaining dough balls.
22. Let the anman sit for 15 minutes.
23. Steam the anman for 15-20 minutes (a bamboo steamer works best).  Add a little bit of white vinegar to the water to prevent discoloration.

ingredients_reels: baking potatoes | bacon | light sour cream | 2% low-fat milk | margarine | salt | pepper | garlic powder | low-fat cheddar cheese | green onions
texte:
Ultimate Twice Baked Potatoes

Ingredients:
- 4 baking potatoes
- 6 bacon
- 1 light sour cream
- 1/2 2% low-fat milk
- 4 margarine
- 1/2 salt
- 1/2 pepper
- 1/2 garlic powder
- 1 low-fat cheddar cheese
- 6 green onions

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
2. Wrap potatoes in foil& bake in preheated oven for 1 and 1/2 hours.
3. Meanwhile, place bacon in a large, deep skillet.
4. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown.
5. Drain, crumble and set aside.
6. When potatoes are done allow them to cool for 10 minutes.
7. Slice potatoes in half lengthwise and scoop the flesh into a large bowl; save skins.
8. To the potato flesh add sour cream, milk, margarine, salt, pepper,garlic powder, 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 the green onions.
9. Mix with a hand mixer until well blended and creamy.
10. Spoon the mixture into the potato skins.
11. Top each with remaining cheese, green onions and bacon.
12. Bake for another 15 minutes.

ingredients_reels: butter | salt | eggs | milk | flour | shortening
texte:
Yorkshire Pudding or Popovers

Ingredients:
- 3 butter
- 1/2 salt
- 3 eggs
- 1 milk
- 1 flour
- shortening

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F.
2. Grease LARGE muffin tin's well.
3. In medium bowl beat eggs until frothy.
4. Add milk and butter.
5. Beat in flour and salt.
6. Fill muffin tins 3/4 full; bake 1 hour.
7. Do not be alarmed if filling puffs up around sides and appears to grow, this is normal.
8. A wonderful side to any traditional meal.
9. Serve with gravy, butter, salt or my favorite-just plain.

ingredients_reels: mascarpone cheese | creamy peanut butter | Splenda sugar substitute | banana | graham crackers
texte:
Simple Peanut Butter Banana Grahams

Ingredients:
- 2 mascarpone cheese
- 2 creamy peanut butter
- 1 Splenda sugar substitute
- 1 banana
- 4 graham crackers

Instructions:
1. Beat mascarpone and peanut butter in small bowl on low speed until well blended and creamy.  Chill for about 20 minutes in refrigerator.
2. Break graham crackers in half so you have 2 squares from each, 8 altogether.
3. Spread about 1/2 tablespoon of peanut butter mixture on each square.
4. Slice banana into coins, not too thick, and place 2 slices on top of peanut butter mixture.
5. Enjoy!

ingredients_reels: confectioners' sugar | margarine | crunchy peanut butter | graham cracker crumbs | chocolate chips
texte:
Peanut Butter Chocolate Bars

Ingredients:
- 1 confectioners' sugar
- 1 margarine
- 1 1/4 crunchy peanut butter
- 4 graham cracker crumbs
- 1 chocolate chips

Instructions:
1. Sift the confectioners sugar into a mixing bowl. Add melted buter and peanut butter.
2. Mix on medium speed of electric mixer until well mixed.
3. Add graham cracker crumbs to the peanut butter mixture. Use your hands  to squish it together until the crumbs are well mixed.
4. Dump the mixture into the pan. Use your hands to spread it around. Press very hard to make it one big flat piece.
5. Melt chocolate chips in saucepan over very low heat. Stir until creamy and completely melted.
6. Pour the melted chocolate over the peanut butter layer. Use the spoon to spread it evenly like frosting.
7. Wait until the chocolate hardens (putting it in the refrigerator makes it faster) and cut it into tiny squares.

ingredients_reels: catsup | Worcestershire sauce
texte:
Steak and Shake Special Sauce

Ingredients:
- 1 catsup
- 4 Worcestershire sauce

Instructions:
1. Mix catsup and Worcestershire sauce together in a bowl.
2. Refrigerate.
3. Serve on top on of cooked spaghetti topped with recipe #27171, shredded cheese, chopped onion.
4. Use about 2 tablespoons per serving.

ingredients_reels: brown sugar | butter | margarine | light corn syrup | sugar | cinnamon | eggs | milk | vanilla
texte:
Overnight Caramel French Toast II

Ingredients:
- 1 brown sugar
- 1/2 butter
- 2 margarine
- 12 light corn syrup
- 1/4 sugar
- 1 cinnamon
- 6 eggs
- 1 1/2 milk
- 1 vanilla

Instructions:
1. In small saucepan over med heat, bring brown sugar, butter and corn syrup to a boil, stirring constantly.
2. Remove from heat and pour into a greased 13 x 9 baking dish.
3. Top with 6 slices of bread.
4. Combine sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon; sprinkle half over the bread.
5. Place remaining bread on top.
6. Sprinkle with remaining cinnamon-sugar mixture; set aside.
7. In a large bowl, beat egg, milk, vanilla and remaining cinnamon.
8. Pour over bread.
9. Cover and chill for 8 hours or overnight.
10. Remove from frig 30 minutes before baking.
11. Bake, uncovered, at 350* for 30-35 minutes.
12. *Notethat cooking time does not reflect chill time.

ingredients_reels: water | fresh shrimp | onions | fresh ground pepper | peppercorn | bay leaves | garlic cloves | cider vinegar | lemon juice
texte:
Pickled Shrimp (Paula Deen)

Ingredients:
- 7 1/2 water
- 2 1/2 fresh shrimp
- 3 onions
- fresh ground pepper
- peppercorn
- 4 bay leaves
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1 cider vinegar
- 1 lemon juice

Instructions:
1. Bring the water to a boil in a large saucepan.
2. Add the shrimp and cook until just  pink, no more than 3 to 5 minutes.
3. Drain well and rinse in cold water to prevent further cooking.
4. Peel and devein shrimp, leaving tails on.
5. In a large glass airtight jar (about 1 1/2 quarts) layer shrimp and onions and top each layer with ground black pepper, peppercorns, bay leaf and clove of garlic.
6. Keep layering until jar is about 2/3 full.
7. Pour vinegar and lemon juice over layers until jar is almost full.
8. Leave space at the top so you can gently shake jar to remixs ingredients.
9. Seal jar tightly and chill for a few days up to 2 weeks.
10. Turn jar upside down to remix every other day or so.
11. Serve chilled as an appetizer.

ingredients_reels: margarine | boneless chicken breast halves | fresh mushrooms | onion | dry white wine | chicken bouillon | parsley | garlic powder | oregano | salt | pepper | flour | water
texte:
Naples Valley Chicken

Ingredients:
- 4 margarine
- 4 -6 boneless chicken breast halves
- 1/2 fresh mushrooms
- 1/2 onion
- 1 dry white wine
- 1 chicken bouillon
- 1 parsley
- 1 garlic powder
- 1 1/2 oregano
- 1 salt
- 1 pepper
- 4 flour
- 1/2 water

Instructions:
1. Brown chicken breasts in melted margarine, remove and set aside.
2. Saute mushrooms and onions in the same pan until tender.
3. Return chicken to pan.
4. Add wine, bouillon, parsley, garlic powder, oregano, salt, and pepper.
5. Cover chicken and simmer 40 minutes.
6. Remove chicken.
7. Blend flour and water into pan juices.
8. Stir until thickened.
9. Return chicken to pan.
10. Heat through or refrigerate until serving time, then reheat.

nom: Chicken and Lentil Curry With Cucumber Yogurt
ingredients_reels: olive oil | onions | garlic cloves | curry powder | nutmeg | cinnamon | fresh ground pepper | boneless skinless chicken breast | sea salt | chicken broth | tomato sauce | lentils | bay leaves | plain low-fat yogurt | cucumber | lemon juice | mango chutney | fresh cilantro
texte:
Chicken and Lentil Curry With Cucumber Yogurt

Ingredients:
- 1 olive oil
- 2 onions
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1 curry powder
- 1/4 nutmeg
- 1/4 cinnamon
- 1/4 fresh ground pepper
- 1 boneless skinless chicken breast
- sea salt
- 1 1/2 chicken broth
- 1 1/4 tomato sauce
- 2/3 lentils
- 2 bay leaves
- 1/3 plain low-fat yogurt
- 1/4 cucumber
- lemon juice
- mango chutney
- fresh cilantro

Instructions:
1. Heat oil in large pan over medium heat. Add onions and cook until sizzling. Cover, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 10 to 15 minutes. Uncover and cook until liquid is almost absorbed, about 8 minutes.
2. Add garlic, curry powder, nutmeg, cinnamon, and pepper. Cook until onion starts to turn golden brown and spices are fragrant.
3. Add broth, tomato sauce, lentils, and bay leaves.
4. Add chicken breasts.
5. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until lentils are tender, about 20 minutes.
6. Meanwhile, combine yogurt, cucumber, lemon juice, and a pinch of sea salt in a small bowl. Cover and chill until ready to serve.
7. Remove and discard bay leaves from curry. Transfer to serving bowls. Serve with a dollop of cucumber yogurt and mango chutney (if using). Garnish with cilantro leaves (if using).

ingredients_reels: brown sugar | boneless skinless chicken breasts | garlic clove | salted butter | salt | pepper
texte:
Garlic Brown Sugar Chicken

Ingredients:
- 4 brown sugar
- 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts
- 1 garlic clove
- 2 salted butter
- salt
- pepper

Instructions:
1. Melt the butter in a frying pan.
2. Brown the garlic in the butter.
3. Add chicken breasts to garlic and butter and cook thoroughly, adding salt and pepper as you like it.
4. When chicken is fully cooked add brown sugar on top of each breast, or just sprinkle over if using smaller pieces.
5. Allow the brown sugar to melt into the chicken (about 5 minutes).
6. Serve with your favorite carb, and veggie or salad.

ingredients_reels: carrots | orange, rind of | maple syrup | mace | nutmeg | butter
texte:
Maple Glazed Carrots

Ingredients:
- 8 carrots
- 1/2 orange, rind of
- 1 maple syrup
- 3 mace
- 1 nutmeg
- 3 butter

Instructions:
1. Peel carrots; cut into sticks.
2. Pour the orange juice into a 4 cup microwave safe dish.
3. Heat 1 minute at high .
4. Add the carrots and the orange rind.
5. Stir to coat the carrots with the orange juice.
6. Cover and microwave 8 to 9 minutes at high.
7. Stir again, then add the remianing ingredients.
8. Microwave, uncovered 2 minutes at high.
9. Stir then check for doneness.
10. If necessary, cook another 1 minute at High.

ingredients_reels: granulated sugar | sour cream | eggs | vanilla | tart apples | all-purpose flour | baking soda | baking powder
texte:
Moist Apple Bread

Ingredients:
- 1 granulated sugar
- 8 sour cream
- 2 eggs
- 2 vanilla
- 1 1/4 tart apples
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 1/2 baking soda
- 2 baking powder

Instructions:
1. In a large mixing bowl, beat together granulated sugar, sour cream, eggs and vanilla on low speed with an electric mixer until combined.
2. Beat on medium speed for two minutes.
3. Sift together dry ingredients, in separate bowl.
4. Add to sour cream mixture, beat on low speed until combined.
5. Stir in apples.
6. Turn into a greased 9x5x3 inch loaf pan.
7. Bake at 350 for 55 to 60 minutes.
8. Cool on rack for 10 minutes.
9. Remove bread from pan; cool completely.

ingredients_reels: margarine | shortening | sugar | eggs | milk | all-purpose flour | baking powder | salt | lemon | sugar
texte:
Our Favourite Lemon Loaf

Ingredients:
- 1/2 margarine
- 1 shortening
- 2 sugar
- 1/2 eggs
- 1 1/2 milk
- 1 all-purpose flour
- 1/2 baking powder
- 1 salt
- 1 lemon
- 1/4 sugar

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, cream butter and sugar.
2. Add eggs, one at a time, beating until creamy.
3. Blend in milk.
4. In another bowl, mix together flour, baking powder, salt and lemon rind.
5. Pour into batter.
6. Stir to moisten.
7. Scrape into greased 9 x 5 inch loaf pan.
8. Bake in 350f degree oven for 55 to 60 minutes.
9. Cool in pan for 5 minutes.
10. Remove to rack and while still hot, with a toothpick poke holes all over the top of the loaf, and spoon glaze evenly over.
11. Cool.
12. Glaze: Combine lemon juice and sugar in saucepan.
13. Stir and heat till sugar is dissolved.
14. Spoon evenly over top of hot loaf.

ingredients_reels: onion | butter | paprika | potatoes | salt
texte:
Paprikas Burgonya ( Paprika Potatoes)

Ingredients:
- 1 onion
- 2 butter
- 1 paprika
- 6 potatoes
- salt

Instructions:
1. Saute finely chopped onion in butter.
2. Add paprika when onions are lightly browned; then add potatoes and salt.
3. Cover and keep stewing, adding enough water to keep potatoes from sticking.  Turn now and again with pancake turner.
4. Simmer until potatoes are soft.
5. Before serving add a little sour cream, if desired.

ingredients_reels: fresh Brussels sprouts | olive oil | butter | salt | ground black pepper | water
texte:
Roasted Brussels Sprouts

Ingredients:
- 2 1/2 fresh Brussels sprouts
- 1/2 olive oil
- 1 butter
- 1 salt
- 1/2 ground black pepper
- 1/2 water

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees.
2. Trim ends of Brussels sprouts, leaving sprouts whole.  Wash sprouts with cold water; drain well.
3. In a large bowl, combine oil, butter, salt, and pepper.  Add sprouts, tossing gently to coat.
4. Place in a 13x9-inch baking dish.  Add 1/2 cup water, and bake for 30 minutes, or until tender.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | baking powder | baking soda | cinnamon | salt | butter | granulated sugar | brown sugar | eggs | vanilla | chocolate chips | old fashioned oats | sweetened flaked coconut | pecans
texte:
Big Ol Cowboy Cookies

Ingredients:
- 3 all-purpose flour
- 1 baking powder
- 1 baking soda
- 1 cinnamon
- 1 salt
- 1 1/2 butter
- 1 1/2 granulated sugar
- 1 1/2 brown sugar
- 3 eggs
- 1 vanilla
- 3 chocolate chips
- 3 old fashioned oats
- 2 sweetened flaked coconut
- 2 pecans

Instructions:
1. Heat over to 350°.
2. Mix flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt in bowl.
3. Beat butter on medium speed until smooth and creamy, gradually beat in sugars, beat to combine.
4. Add eggs one at a time, add vanilla.
5. Stir in flour mixture until just combined.
6. Add chocolate chips, oats, coconut and pecans.
7. For each cookie drop 1/4 cup dough onto ungreased baking sheet (I use a large ice cream scoop).
8. Bake at 350° for 17-19 minutes or until edges are lightly browned.
9. Cool cookies on rack.

ingredients_reels: milk | butter | water | egg | sugar | salt | dry yeast | flour
texte:
Coffee Cake Dough

Ingredients:
- 1 milk
- 1/2 butter
- 1/4 water
- 1 egg
- 1/2 sugar
- 1 salt
- 1 dry yeast
- 4  - 4 1/2 flour

Instructions:
1. Scald milk.
2. Stir in sugar, salt and lard.
3. Cool to lukewarm.
4. Measure water into large warm bowl.
5. Sprinkle in yeast, stir until dissolved.
6. Stir in milk mixture, egg and half of flour.
7. Beat until smooth.
8. Add remaining flour to make a stiff batter.
9. Cover loosely.
10. Keep in cool place for at least 2 hours.
11. (Dough may be kept in refrigerator up to 3 days).
12. Take 1/2 of the dough and pat dough into a greased 13\" x 9-1/2\" x 2\" pan, pushing dough up pan sides to form a ridge.
13. Add the topping of your choice from the following recipes: Recipe #40284, Recipe #40283, Recipe #40282, Recipe #40279, Recipe #40270 and Recipe #40276.
14. Cover and let rise until doubled (45 to 60 minutes).
15. Bake at 375° for 35 minutes or until done.

ingredients_reels: potatoes | olive oil | onion | eggs
texte:
Spanish Potato Tortilla

Ingredients:
- 3 potatoes
- 1/4 olive oil
- 1 onion
- 6 eggs

Instructions:
1. Cook potatoes in boiling salted water until tender. Drain well and slice.
2. Heat oil in 20cm frying pan. Add potato slices and onion and fry for 5 minutes until tender and golden.
3. Whisk eggs and season well. Pour over potato and onion mixture.
4. Cook tortilla over low heat for 10 minutes until eggs set.
5. Loosen edges of tortilla with spatula and slide onto a plate and turn the tortilla over to cook the underside again for another 5-10 minutes. Or you can finish under a grill the top side to brown.
6. Stand for 10 minutes before cutting to serve.

ingredients_reels: sweet potatoes | butter | eggs | dark brown sugar | milk | vanilla extract | light molasses | salt | cinnamon | nutmeg | clove | orange zest
texte:
Jazz Fest Sweet Potato Pone

Ingredients:
- 2 1/2 sweet potatoes
- 1/4 butter
- 2 eggs
- 1/4 dark brown sugar
- 1/2 milk
- 1 1/2 vanilla extract
- 1/4 light molasses
- 1/2 salt
- 1/2 cinnamon
- 1/4 nutmeg
- 1/8 clove
- 1 orange zest

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F.
2. Cook the potatoes unpeeled until tender throughout.
3. Let cool, Peel and mash the potatoes, then stir in melted butter.
4. In a bowl, beat the eggs, add sugar.
5. Add milk, vanilla, molasses, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves and orange zest.
6. Beat until well blended.
7. Stir into mashed sweet potatoes, then mix until well blended.
8. Place the mixture into a buttered 1-1/2 quart baking dish.
9. Optionally, you may sprinkle the top of the pone with additional brown sugar.
10. Cover with foil and bake for 50 minutes; uncover, then bake for 10 minutes.
11. Allow the pone to cool completely before serving.

ingredients_reels: lean ground beef | onion | garlic cloves | tomato sauce | tomato paste | salt | dried oregano | cottage cheese | parmesan cheese | asiago cheese | mozzarella cheese
texte:
Crock Pot Lasagna

Ingredients:
- 1 lean ground beef
- 1 onion
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1 tomato sauce
- 1 tomato paste
- 1 1/2 salt
- 1 dried oregano
- 12 cottage cheese
- 1/2 parmesan cheese
- 12 asiago cheese
- 16 mozzarella cheese

Instructions:
1. Brown ground beef, onion and garlic in frypan.
2. Add tomato sauce, tomato paste, salt and oregano.
3. Cook long enough to get it warm.
4. Spoon a layer of meat sauce onto the bottom of the slow cooker.
5. Add a double layer of uncooked lasagna noodles (break to fit) and top with cheeses.
6. Repeat with sauce, noodles and cheeses until all are used up.
7. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 5 hours.

ingredients_reels: fat-free mayonnaise | low-fat sour cream | skim milk | lemon juice | lemon, zest of | broccoli florets
texte:
Broccoli with Creamy Lemon sauce

Ingredients:
- 2 fat-free mayonnaise
- 4 1/2 low-fat sour cream
- 1 skim milk
- 2 lemon juice
- 1 lemon, zest of
- 1 1/4 broccoli florets

Instructions:
1. Combine all the ingredients except the broccoli in the top of a double boiler, Cook over simmering water 5 minutes or until heated through, stirring constantly.
2. Serve over hot cooked broccoli.
3. This is also very good over hot cooked green beans.

ingredients_reels: tart apples | brown sugar | cinnamon | butter
texte:
Shaker Fried Apples

Ingredients:
- 8 tart apples
- 1/2 brown sugar
- 1 cinnamon
- 2 1/2 butter

Instructions:
1. Cut unpeeled apples into six wedges from core to stem; remove seeds and core.  Place the apples in a skillet and sprinkle with sugar, cinnamon, and dot with butter.
2. Place a lid or foil on top of the skillet tightly.  Place on a cold stove and set the heat to low and cook until tender, checking and stirring occasionally.
3. Remove the lid and cook 3-5 minutes longer.

ingredients_reels: skinless chicken breasts | salt | pepper | paprika | butter | margarine | pearl barley | onion | dry basil | chicken broth | dry sherry | frozen artichoke hearts | parsley
texte:
Chicken & Barley Casserole

Ingredients:
- 4 skinless chicken breasts
- salt
- pepper
- paprika
- 4 -5 butter
- 1/4 margarine
- 1 pearl barley
- 1 onion
- 1 dry basil
- 2 chicken broth
- 1/4 dry sherry
- 1 frozen artichoke hearts
- parsley

Instructions:
1. Sprinkle chicken with salt, pepper and paprika.
2. In a wide frying pan over medium heat, melt 2 tablespoons of the butter.  Add the chicken and cook until well browned on both sides.  Add a little more butter if needed.  Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
3. In the same pan, melt the remaining butter.  Add the mushrooms and cook until soft.  Remove mushrooms from pan and set aside.
4. Add barley and onion to pan.  Cook, stirring, until onion is soft.  Add basil and one 14 oz. can chicken broth.  Bring to a boil, then cover the pan, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 30 minutes.
5. Stir in the mushrooms and arrange the chicken pieces over the barley mixture.  Pour the other can of chicken broth and sherry over all.  Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.  Gently mix in artichoke hearts and continue to simmer until barley is tender (about 10 more minutes).
6. To serve, skim off any excess fat and sprinkle with parsley.

ingredients_reels: fresh broccoli | vinegar | rice vinegar | soy sauce | sugar | sesame seeds
texte:
Sesame Broccoli

Ingredients:
- 1/2 fresh broccoli
- 1 vinegar
- 1 rice vinegar
- 1 soy sauce
- 1 sugar
- 1 sesame seeds

Instructions:
1. Trim and wash broccoli; drain. Cook broccoli spears in a small amount of boiling salted water 1/4 cup) just until tender, about 5 minutes. (Or microwave (1 - 2 tablespoons water) for 3 minutes for 1000 watt microwave, adjust your time according to wattage!).
2. Drain and arrange broccoli spears in a serving dish.
3. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, combine vegetable oil, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, and sesame seed; bring to a boil.
4. Pour 1/2 the sauce over the hot broccoli, turning spears to coat thoroughly. Serve immediately.
5. (Note: Serving size is 2, although there is enough sauce for 4+ servings. I save the balance for dressing leftover rice --  makes an excellent salad topping served warm.

ingredients_reels: beer | self rising flour | sugar | butter
texte:
Tastefully Simple " Copycat" Beer Bread

Ingredients:
- 12 beer
- 3 self rising flour
- 1/3 sugar
- 3 butter

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F Spray a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with Baker’s cooking spray.
2. Combine flour and sugar; stir in beer (you might have to use your hands to get it mixed thoroughly). Dough will be sticky.
3. Pour into prepared loaf pan; brush top with melted butter.
4. Bake for 50-60 minutes or until top is golden brown.
5. Cool slightly; remove from pan and finish cooling.

nom: Mustard Chicken and Cabbage - Hcg Phase 2
ingredients_reels: boneless skinless chicken breasts | cabbage | brown mustard | low sodium soy sauce | garlic powder | salt | pepper
texte:
Mustard Chicken and Cabbage - Hcg Phase 2

Ingredients:
- 3 1/2 boneless skinless chicken breasts
- 2 cabbage
- 1 brown mustard
- 1 low sodium soy sauce
- garlic powder
- salt
- pepper

Instructions:
1. Cube the chicken into bite sized pieces, add to a hot pan. Cook for 2 mins and add a 1/4 cup water to loose from bottom of pan. Turn and immediately add the cabbage. Stir frequently until cabbage starts to wilt and chicken is cooked through.
2. Add mustard, soy sauce, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
3. Pour all into a bowl and enjoy.

ingredients_reels: milk | sugar | salt | shortening | dry yeast | water | eggs | all-purpose flour
texte:
Sweet Dough

Ingredients:
- 1/2 milk
- 1/2 sugar
- 1 1/2 salt
- 1/4 shortening
- 1/2 dry yeast
- 1/2 water
- 2 eggs
- 5 all-purpose flour

Instructions:
1. Scald milk and stir in sugar, salt and shortening.
2. Cool to lukewarm.
3. Dissolve yeast in very warm water.
4. Stir until dissolved, then stir into the lukewarm milk mixture.
5. Add beaten eggs and 3 cups flour.
6. Beat until smooth and stir in an additional 2 cups flour.
7. Turn dough out onto lightly floured board and knead until smooth and elastic.
8. Place in a greased bowl and brush top with soft shortening.
9. Cover and let rise in a warm place, free from draft, until double in bulk (about 1 hour).
10. Punch down and turn out onto lightly floured board.
11. Use as desired to make any of the following sweet breads.

ingredients_reels: baking potatoes | scallion | onion | egg | flour | salt | ground black pepper | extra virgin olive oil
texte:

ingredients_reels: fresh rhubarb | orange zest | sugar | cornstarch | butter | nutmeg | all-purpose flour | sugar | baking powder | salt | butter | milk | egg

ingredients_reels: butter | shortening | brown sugar | sugar | egg | flour | baking soda | cream of tartar | vanilla

Angel Cookies

ingredients_reels: sugar | margarine | milk | peanut butter | vanilla | rolled oats
texte:
Peanut Butter No Bake Cookies

nom: Mrs. Field's Soft and Chewy Peanut Butter Cookies

ingredients_reels: fresh cranberries | frozen cranberries | orange, zest of | sugar | all-purpose flour | yellow cornmeal | salt | baking powder | baking soda | unsalted butter | egg | water
texte:
Orange Cranberry Bread

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 fresh cranberries
- 1 frozen cranberries
- 1 orange, zest of
- 1 1/2 sugar
- 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1/2 yellow cornmeal
- 1 1/2 salt
- 1/2 baking powder
- 3 baking soda
- 1 unsalted butter
- 1/2 egg
- 1/2 water

Instructions:
1. Position a rack in the middle of the oven and preheat oven to 325.
2. Grease an 8x5 or 9x5 loaf pan.  Cut a piece of wax paper or parchment paper to line the bottom of the pan, then grease the bottom again.  (otherwise your lovely loaf might stick to the pan!).
3. Sort the cranberries and discard any soft ones.  Coarsely chop the cranberries (I pulse a couple of times with my food processor) and place in a small saucepan over low heat. Add the orange zest & 1/2 cup of the sugar and heat slowly just to a simmer, stirring to dissolve the sugar. Set aside to cool.
4. In a bowl stir together the flour, cornmeal, salt, baking powder & baking soda.
5. In a separate bowl combine the butter and remaining 1/2 cup sugar. Beat until light & fluffy, about 3 minutes. Beat in the egg.
6. Stir in half the flour mixture, and then the orange juice & water. Stir in the remaining flour mixture and then the cooled cranberry mixture. Don't overmix.
7. Spoon the batter into the prepared loaf pan. Place in the oven and bake until a toothpick inserted in the center of the loaf comes out clean, 55-60 minutes.
8. Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes. Turn out onto a wire rack, peel the wax paper from the bottom of the loaf, and cool completely. Slice & serve.
9. Note:  This recipe doesn't double well.  The batter is light & airy, and too voluminous even for my Kitchenaid stand mixer.  If I want to make 2 loaves, I mix them up separately.  But I put each loaf in the oven as soon as it is mixed up because the baking powder is already activated.  Then I know if, for example, 10 minutes have passed before the 2nd loaf goes in, I will pull the 1st loaf out when the timer goes off, then set the timer again for another 10 minutes for the 2nd loaf.

ingredients_reels: flour | baking powder | sugar | salt | buttermilk | eggs | butter | fresh blueberries

Nif's Creamy Garlic Salad Dressing

ingredients_reels: flour | salt | butter | water | lean ground lamb | onion | salt | pepper | water | egg
texte:
Bridies

Ingredients:
- 4 flour
- 1/4 salt
- 1/2 butter
- water
- 1 lean ground lamb
- 1 onion
- 1/4 salt
- 1/8 pepper
- 1/4 water
- 1 egg

Instructions:
1. ---To prepare the pastry---.
2. In a large mixing bowl, sift together the flour and salt.
3. Add the butter and cut into the flour until the mixture resembles fine bread crumbs.
4. Mix in enough cold water to hold the mixture together.
5. Form into a ball.
6. Wrap in wax paper or plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator for 30-45 minutes.
7. ---To prepare the filling---.
8. In a large bowl, mix together the uncooked ground meat, onion, salt, pepper and water; set aside.
9. ---Assembly---.
10. Remove the pastry from the refrigerator.
11. Lightly sprinkle your work surface with flour.
12. Roll out the pastry to about 1/8-inch thickness.
13. Cut into 6-7 circles approximately 5 to 6 inches in diameter.
14. Evenly divide the filling among the circles, placing the meat mixture on one half of the circle.
15. Brush the edge lightly with the beaten egg.
16. Fold the pastry over the filling and seal by lightly crimping the edge.
17. Brush the top with beaten egg.
18. Repeat with remaining filling and dough circles.
19. Place on baking sheets greased with shortening or non-stick cooking spray and bake at 350°F for 50 minutes or until golden brown on top.

nom: Eggplant Rolls filled with Basil and Cheese
ingredients_reels: onion | olive oil | garlic | tomatoes | sugar | eggplant | mozzarella cheese | boursin cheese | basil leaves | olive oil | fresh basil leaf
texte:

- 2 tomatoes
- 1 sugar
- 1 eggplant
- 1 mozzarella cheese
- 1/2 boursin cheese
- 1/4 basil leaves
- 2 -3 olive oil
- fresh basil leaf

Instructions:
1. For sauce: Cook onion in oil over moderately-low heat, stirring, for 3 minutes.
2. Stir in garlic and cook, stirring, until onion is softened.
3. Add tomatoes, sugar and salt to taste and cook over moderate heat for 20 minutes.
4. Puree mixture in processor until completely smooth and continue cooking over moderately-high heat for 5-10 minutes until thickened.
5. Make rolls: Preheat broiler.
6. In a bowl, stir together mozzarella, goat cheese and shredded basil.
7. Pat eggplant dry.
8. Arrange 1 layer of eggplant in a baking pan and brush with some of the oil.
9. Broil 4 inches away from heat source for 3-4 minutes, or until golden.
10. Turn, brush with remaining oil, and broil 3-4 minutes more.
11. Transfer to a large platter to cool.
12. Spread a mounded teaspoon of the cheese mixture lengthwise down the middle of each eggplant slice, leaving a 1 inch border at the wide end and, beginning at the narrow end, roll up jelly roll fashion.
13. Arrange rolls, seam side down, in a oiled pyrex baking dish just large enough to hold rolls in one layer and broil for 3 minutes or until cheese is just melted and bubbling.
14. Transfer to serving plates, spoon sauce over and garnish with basil.

11. Bake at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
12. Bon appetit!

ingredients_reels: honey | molasses | brown sugar | egg | lemon juice | lemon zest | all-purpose flour | baking soda | ground cinnamon | ground cloves | ground allspice | ground nutmeg | candied citron peel | hazelnuts | white sugar | water | confectioners' sugar
texte:
Lebkuchen

Ingredients:
- 1/2 honey
- 1/2 molasses
- 3/4 brown sugar
- 1 egg
- 1 lemon juice
- 1 lemon zest
- 2 3/4 all-purpose flour
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1 ground cinnamon
- 1 ground cloves
- 1 ground allspice
- 1 ground nutmeg
- 1/3 candied citron peel
- 1/3 hazelnuts
- 1 white sugar
- 1/2 water
- 1/4 confectioners' sugar

Instructions:
1. In a medium saucepan, stir together the honey and molasses. Bring the mixture to a boil, remove from heat and stir in the brown sugar, lemon juice, lemon zest, and lastly the egg.
2. In a large bowl, stir together the flour, baking soda, cinnamon, cloves, allspice and nutmeg. Add the molasses mixture to the dry ingredients and mix well. Stir in the citron and hazelnuts. Cover dough and chill overnight.
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Grease cookie sheets. Using a small amount of dough at a time, roll out on a lightly floured surface to 1/4 inch thickness. Cut into small rectangles and place them 1 inch apart onto the prepared cookie sheet.
4. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes in the preheated oven, until no imprint remains when touched lightly.
5. Combine the sugar and water in a small saucepan. Heat to between 234 and 240 degrees F (soft ball stage). Remove from heat and stir in the confectioners' sugar.
6. Quickly brush the icing over the cookies while they are still hot (Important!) and remove them to wire cooling racks. If icing becomes sugary while brushing cookies, re-heat slightly- adding a little water until crystals dissolve.
7. Store in an airtight container with a cup of orange or apple for a few days to mellow. (I never did understand that part of the instructions, and my friend had no clarification - but I take it to mean store with a cut-up apple or orange - maybe a small cup of juice? I don't know - I just stored the cookies in an airtight container by themselves!).

nom: Lemon-blueberry Cake With White Chocolate Frosting
ingredients_reels: cake flour | salt | baking powder | baking soda | unsalted butter | sugar | fresh lemon juice | lemon, rind of | eggs | buttermilk | buttermilk | fresh blueberries | white chocolate | cream cheese | unsalted butter | fresh lemon juice | blueberries | lemon slice
texte:
Lemon-blueberry Cake With White Chocolate Frosting

Ingredients:
- 3 1/3 cake flour
- 1/2 salt
- 1/2 baking powder
- 1/2 baking soda
- 3/4 unsalted butter
- 2 sugar
- 1/3 fresh lemon juice
- 1 lemon, rind of
- 4 eggs
- 1 buttermilk
- 2 buttermilk
- 2 1/2 fresh blueberries
- 11 white chocolate
- 12 cream cheese
- 3/4 unsalted butter
- 2 fresh lemon juice
- blueberries
- lemon slice

Instructions:
1. For cake: Preheat oven to 350°F and butter and flour two 9 inch round cake pans; line bottoms with rounds of parchment or waxed paper (I used the flour/oil spray with great results).
2. Sift first 4 ingredients into medium bowl.
3. Beat butter in large bowl with electric mixer until fluffy.
4. Gradually add sugar, scraping down sides of bowl occasionally and beat until well mixed.
5. Add lemon juice and peel, then eggs 1 at a time and mix well.
6. Beat in dry ingredients in 4 additions alternately with buttermilk in 3 additions.
7. Fold in berries and pour equally into two pans.
8. Bake cakes until tester inserted into center comes out clean, about 40 minutes.
9. Cool cakes in pans on racks.
10. For frosting: Stir white chocolate in top of double boiler set over barely simmering water until almost melted.
11. Remove from over water and stir until smooth and cool to lukewarm.
12. Beat cream cheese and butter in large bowl until blended.
13. Beat in lemon juice, then cooled white chocolate.
14. Take cakes out of pans and peel off parchment.
15. Place 1 cake layer, flat side up, on platter.
16. Spread with 1 cup frosting- (Don't be stingy with middle layer of frosting).
17. Top with second cake layer, flat side down.
18. Spread remaining frosting over top and sides of cake.
19. Garnish with additional blueberries and lemon slices, if desired.
20. (Can be made 1 day ahead; Cover with cake dome; refrigerate; Let stand at room temperature 1 hour before serving).

ingredients_reels: liquid honey | soy sauce | garlic | salt | pepper | acorn squash
texte:
Honey Roasted Squash Rings

Ingredients:
- 1/4 liquid honey
- 2 soy sauce
- 1 garlic
- 1/4 salt
- 1/4 pepper
- 2 acorn squash

Instructions:
1. Whisk first 5 ingredients together in a large bowl.
2. Halve each squash crosswise, peel & scoop out seeds.
3. Cut into 1 inch thick rings & toss in honey mixture until well coated.
4. At this point, you can cover & refrigerate for up to 6 hours.
5. Arrange squash rings on a greased, foil lined, rimmed baking sheet & drizzle with honey mixture.
6. Bake in preheated 350F oven, turning once & basting with liquid, until tender & golden- about 30 to 40 minutes.

ingredients_reels: okra | olive oil | red onions | kosher salt | garlic cloves | diced tomatoes
texte:
Okra & Tomatoes

Ingredients:
- 1 okra
- 3 olive oil
- 1 1/2 red onions
- 1 1/2 kosher salt
- 2 -3 garlic cloves
- 15 1/2 diced tomatoes

Instructions:
1. Clean and trim okra just before cooking.  Cut each okra  in half lengthwise, if there are any pieces longer than 4 inches, cut them in half crosswise and then lengthwise.
2. Heat the olive oil in a deep sided skillet over medium heat and add the onions along with the salt; cook until they begin to soften, approximately 4 minutes.
3. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute longer.
4. Add the tomatoes and bring the mixture to a boil.
5. Decrease the heat to low and add the okra. Stir to combine.
6. Cook, uncovered for 20 minutes.
7. Serve immediately.

ingredients_reels: dry penne pasta | fresh broccoli | shrimp | butter | margarine | all-purpose flour | low sodium chicken broth | parmesan cheese | black pepper
texte:
Alfredo Perfecto

Ingredients:
- 2 1/4 dry penne pasta
- 1 fresh broccoli
- 1 shrimp
- 6 butter
- 1/4 margarine
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 1 low sodium chicken broth
- 1 parmesan cheese
- black pepper

Instructions:
1. Put on a large pot of salted water to boil; when boiling, cook penne till al dente stage and drain well.
2. Meanwhile, wash and trim broccoli (or just use frozen), slice into bite size pieces and florets, and microwave until crisp-tender, about 3 or 4 minutes; drain well and set aside.
3. Have cooked shrimp waiting in the fridge.
4. In a large heavy saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
5. Whisk in flour, then gradually whisk in milk and stock; keep whisking to ensure the mixture has no lumps.
6. When sauce comes to a boil, stir in parmesan cheese; when thoroughly combined, stir in broccoli and shrimp.
7. Let mixture come back to a bubbling simmer, then let simmer for 1 or 2 minutes-- just long enough for the shrimp to warm up.
8. Add freshly ground black pepper to taste, and stir.
9. Turn off heat, stir in well-drained pasta, and pour mixture into an attractive serving bowl; serve hot.

ingredients_reels: cucumbers | onion | salt | pepper | of fresh mint | garlic clove | dried oregano | plain yogurt | heavy cream
texte:
Mint Cucumber Salad

Ingredients:
- 3 cucumbers
- 1/2 onion
- 1 salt
- 1/4 pepper
- 1 of fresh mint
- 1 garlic clove
- 3/4 dried oregano
- 8 plain yogurt
- 2 heavy cream

Instructions:
1. Place cucumbers and onion in a mixing bowl.
2. Combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl; mix well.  Pour over cucumber/onion salad.  Toss to coat well.
3. Chill at least 3 hours before serving.

ingredients_reels: fresh cranberries | frozen cranberries | water | granulated sugar | fresh lemon juice | sherry wine
texte:
Cranberry Sauce with Jalapeno Peppers

Ingredients:
- 12 fresh cranberries
- 1 frozen cranberries
- 1 water
- 2 granulated sugar
- 2 fresh lemon juice
- 1/2 sherry wine

Instructions:
1. Rinse cranberries in cold water; drain.
2. In a medium size saucepan mix water and sugar and bring to boil on medium-high heat; stir to dissolve.
3. Add cranberries and Jalapeno peppers and return to boil.
4. Reduce heat, cover and boil gently, for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
5. Add lemon juice and sherry and stir well to blend.
6. Remove from heat and let cool completely at room temperature.
7. Refrigerate in a glass container with lid.
8. Serve with turkey or chicken.
9. CAUTION when handling the Jalapeno peppers.
10. Wear plastic gloves, or wash hands thoroughly after handling, using any toothpaste.
11. Then wash again with soap and water.
12. You can also use a mixture of bleach and water to remove all pepper heat.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | baking soda | baking powder | salt | cinnamon | nutmeg | clove | allspice | Crisco shortening | brown sugar | white sugar | eggs | unsweetened applesauce | water | raisins | walnuts | confectioners' sugar
texte:
Wonderful Applesauce Spice Cake

Ingredients:
- 2 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 baking soda
- 1/4 baking powder
- 1 1/2 salt
- 1 cinnamon
- 1/2 nutmeg
- 1/2 clove
- 1/2 allspice
- 1/2 Crisco shortening
- 1 brown sugar
- 1 white sugar
- 2 eggs
- 1 1/2 unsweetened applesauce
- 1/2 water
- 1 raisins
- 1 walnuts
- confectioners' sugar

Instructions:
1. Set oven to 350°F.
2. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
3. In a medium bowl sift together flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt and spices.
4. In a large bowl cream together the shortening and brown sugar and white sugar together until light and fluffy (about 3-4 minutes).
5. Add in the eggs to the creamed mixture, beating well after each addition.
6. Add in the dry ingredients alternately with the applesauce and water.
7. Stir in raisins and nuts.
8. Pour into prepared baking pan.
9. Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until cake tests done.
10. Cool, dust with confectioners' sugar or serve topped with whipped cream.
11. Delicious!

ingredients_reels: small red potatoes | Greek oregano | salt | pepper | olive oil
texte:
Roasted Oregano Potatoes

Ingredients:
- 3 small red potatoes
- 2 Greek oregano
- 1 salt
- 1/2 pepper
- 1/3 olive oil

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350.
2. place cut up potatoes in a single layer in a large baking dish.  Srinkle with oregano, salt and pepper; toss around alittle to coat evenly.
3. Drizzle the olive oil over potatoes.
4. Bake at 350, uncovered for about an hour or until potatoes are to desired tenderness.

nom: Convection Oven Roast Chicken (For Toaster Oven)
ingredients_reels: roasting chickens | kosher salt | fresh ground black pepper | fresh herb | garlic clove | onion | lemon zest | extra virgin olive oil | fresh lemon juice
texte:
Convection Oven Roast Chicken (For Toaster Oven)

Ingredients:
- 1 roasting chickens
- 3/4 kosher salt
- 1/2 fresh ground black pepper
- fresh herb
- 1 garlic clove
- 1 onion
- 4 lemon zest
- 1 extra virgin olive oil
- 1 fresh lemon juice

Instructions:
1. Place the toaster oven rack to the lowest position in the oven. Preheat the oven to 400°F on the convection setting.
2. Remove giblets and neck from cavity of chicken, reserve for another use or discard. Rinse chicken with cold water and pat dry.
3. Place a baking rack into the broiling pan (that is lined with foil) add 1/4 cup water to the pan and lightly spray the baking rack with cooking spray.
4. Tuck the wings under and place the chicken on the baking rack pan. Clean work surface and hands with soap and hot water before continuing.
5. Combine the salt and pepper. Rub half the mixture in the cavity of the chicken; then place the herb sprig(s), garlic halves, onion quarters and lemon zest in the cavity of the chicken.
6. Loosely tie the legs together. Rub the chicken with the olive oil and remaining salt and pepper. Drizzle with the lemon juice.
7. Place the chicken in the oven and roast at 400°F for 20 minutes, then lower the temperature to 375°F and continue to roast for an additional 12 minutes per pound longer.
8. Considering my chicken was 5 lbs. I will roast it for 60 minutes.  You will have to calculate the time according to your chicken's weight by multiplying 12 minutes times the size per pound of your chicken.
9. The Internal temperature of the chicken should be 170°F when tested in the breast, and 180°F when tested in the dark meat.
10. Juices should run clear.
11. Turn off oven and remove the chicken to a platter. Let stand 10 - 15 minutes before carving (may cover loosely with foil if desired, but skin will lose its crispness).
12. Bon Appetit!

ingredients_reels: sharp white cheddar cheese | parmesan cheese | baking mix | skim milk | black pepper | ham
texte:
Cheddar 'n Ham Muffins

Ingredients:
- 1 sharp white cheddar cheese
- 1 parmesan cheese
- 1 3/4 baking mix
- 1 skim milk
- 1/2 black pepper
- 1/4 ham

Instructions:
1. Mix first four ingredients together, add pepper and ham.
2. Mix well and spoon into muffin pans 1/2 full.
3. Bake in preheated 400 oven 12-15 minutes until golden brown.

ingredients_reels: boneless chicken breasts | flour | salt | poultry seasoning | butter | margarine
texte:
Chicken Ala Rice Krispies

Ingredients:
- 4 boneless chicken breasts
- 1 1/2 flour
- 2 salt
- 1/2 poultry seasoning
- 1/4 butter
- 1/4 margarine

Instructions:
1. In one bowl, mix cereal crumbs, seasonings & flour.
2. Place the melted butter in another bowl.
3. Dip the breasts into melted butter then coat with the cereal mixture.
4. Place into a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
5. Drizzle remaining melted on top of chicken and coat with remaining mixture if you like extra breading.
6. Bake, uncovered at 400°F for 30 minutes or a bit longer for outside crispiness.

ingredients_reels: sweet potatoes | cream cheese | unsalted butter | eggs | brown sugar | dry sherry | salt | black walnut | nutmeg
texte:
Sweet Potato Casserole With Walnuts

Ingredients:
- 4 sweet potatoes
- 8 cream cheese
- 1/2 unsalted butter
- 2 eggs
- 1/4 brown sugar
- 2 1/2 dry sherry
- 1/4 salt
- 3/4 black walnut
- 1/2 nutmeg

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. With electric mixer (do not use a food processor)whip all ingredients, except walnuts and nutmeg, until light.
3. Stir in walnuts and put in a buttered casserole dish.  Spread evenly and grate fresh nutmeg over the top.
4. Bake 45 minutes until golden.

ingredients_reels: butter | shallots | sugar | dry white wine | gruyere cheese | all-purpose flour | ground nutmeg | sourdough baguette
texte:
Gruyere Fondue With Caramelized Shallots

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 1 1/4 shallots
- 1 sugar
- 1 1/2 dry white wine
- 14 gruyere cheese
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 1 ground nutmeg
- 1 sourdough baguette

Instructions:
1. Melt butter in heavy medium skillet over medium heat.
2. Add thinly sliced shallots and sauté 3 minutes.
3. Reduce heat to low; sprinkle shallots with sugar, salt and pepper.
4. Sauté until shallots are caramelized, about 15 minutes.
5. Transfer shallots to small bowl.
6. Add 1 1/2 cups wine to skillet; boil 1 minute.
7. Pour wine into heavy medium saucepan; set over medium-low heat.
8. Toss cheese with flour in medium bowl to coat.
9. Add half of caramelized shallots to wine; add cheese mixture by handfuls, stirring until cheese melts and is smooth before adding more.
10. Thin with more wine if mixture is too thick.
11. Season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
12. Transfer cheese mixture to fondue pot.
13. Set pot over candle or canned heat burner.
14. Top fondue with remaining caramelized shallots.
15. Serve with bread cubes.

nom: Puerto Rican Pork a La Criolla
ingredients_reels: boneless pork loin roast | fresh coarse ground black pepper | garlic | dried oregano | cider vinegar | olive oil | salt
texte:
Puerto Rican Pork a La Criolla

Ingredients:
- 1 boneless pork loin roast
- 1 fresh coarse ground black pepper
- 4 garlic
- 1 dried oregano
- 1 1/2 cider vinegar
- 1 1/2 olive oil
- 3/4 salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
2. Combine pepper, garlic, oregano, vinegar, olive oil and salt in a small bowl, then rub this mixture all over the pork roast.
3. Place roast in a shallow baking pan and roast, uncovered, at 350 degrees F for about 1-1/2 hours; meat thermometer should read 165 to 170 degrees F.
4. Remove from oven and let rest 10 minutes before slicing.

ingredients_reels: English muffins | eggs | Canadian bacon | cheddar cheese
texte:
Breakfast Sandwiches- OAMC

Ingredients:
- 24 English muffins
- 2 eggs
- 24 Canadian bacon
- 24 cheddar cheese

Instructions:
1. Scramble eggs in a large skillet. If you want a uniform shape, cook in greased canning rings.
2. Assemble sandwiches with one egg, one slice of meat, one slice of cheese.
3. Wrap each sandwich individually in plastic wrap, then freeze and place in zip-top bags.

ingredients_reels: butter | key lime zest | vanilla extract | salt | powdered sugar | key lime juice | milk
texte:
Key Lime Buttercream Frosting

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 1 1/2 key lime zest
- 1 vanilla extract
- 1/8 salt
- 1 powdered sugar
- 3 key lime juice
- 1 -2 milk

Instructions:
1. 1. Beat first 4 ingredients at medium speed with an electric mixer until creamy.
2. 2. Gradually add powdered sugar alternately with Key lime juice, 1 tablespoons at a time, and 1 tablespoons milk, beating at low speed until blended and smooth after each addition. Beat in up to 1 tablespoons additional milk for desired consistency.

ingredients_reels: butter | margarine | onion | paprika | garlic | caraway seed | marjoram | boneless beef chuck | all-purpose flour | beef broth | tomato paste | Worcestershire sauce | potatoes | salt | ground black pepper | sour cream
texte:
Hungarian Goulash

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 1 margarine
- 1 onion
- 1 paprika
- 1 garlic
- 1 caraway seed
- 1/4 marjoram
- 1 1/2 boneless beef chuck
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 2 beef broth
- 2 tomato paste
- 1 Worcestershire sauce
- 2 potatoes
- 1 salt
- 1/2 ground black pepper
- 4 sour cream

Instructions:
1. In a large stock pot over medium-high heat, add the butter or margarine. Add the onions and sauté until softened, 3 to 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Reduce the heat to medium and add the paprika, garlic, caraway seeds, dill seed, and marjoram. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
2. Add the beef and stir to combine. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently. Add the flour and stir until it is absorbed into the onions and beef, 1 to 2 minutes. Add the broth, tomato paste, and Worcestershire sauce. Bring to a boil and stir to deglaze and dislodge any bits of food that have stuck to the bottom of the pan and to incorporate the flour. Scrape your stirring spoon to free any flour that has adhered to it.
3. Reduce the heat, cover, and simmer for 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Add the potatoes, cover and simmer for 30 to 45 minutes, or until the meat is tender, stirring occasionally. Season with salt and pepper. Top each serving with 1 tablespoon of sour cream, if using.

ingredients_reels: butter | brown sugar | eggs | vanilla | flour | baking powder | salt | white chocolate chips
texte:
Blonde Brownies

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 1 1/2 brown sugar
- 2 eggs
- 1 vanilla
- 1 1/2 flour
- 1/2 baking powder
- 1/2 salt
- 1 white chocolate chips

Instructions:
1. Melt butter and then gently sitr until just mixed all ingredients except chips.  Do not beat the mixture.
2. Add chips.
3. Place into greased 13 x 9  baking pan.
4. Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.
5. Cool and cut into bars.

nom: Crock Pot Cheesy Chicken and Mushrooms
ingredients_reels: bacon | boneless skinless chicken breasts | seasoning salt | salt | pepper | parmesan cheese | mushrooms | onion | garlic | swiss cheese
texte:
Crock Pot Cheesy Chicken and Mushrooms

Ingredients:
- 5 -7 bacon
- 6 boneless skinless chicken breasts
- seasoning salt
- salt
- 1 pepper
- 1/3 parmesan cheese
- 1 mushrooms
- 1 onion
- 2 garlic
- 1 -2 swiss cheese

Instructions:
1. In a large skillet, cook the bacon until crisp; drain on paper towels then crumble (leave the bacon drippings in the pan).
2. Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper the, brown in the bacon drippings for about 5 minutes on each side.
3. Place the breasts in a 4-6-quart slow cooker.
4. Sprinkle with mushrooms.
5. In the same skillet heat the soup and Parmesan cheese with onions and garlic for 5 minutes until bubbly, then pour over the chicken and mushrooms.
6. Cover and cook on LOW setting for about 4 hours.
7. After about 4 hours sprinkle with the cheese cubes and bacon.
8. Cover and cook on HIGH for about 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

ingredients_reels: shrimp | olive oil | green bell pepper | orange bell pepper | onion | fresh green beans | garlic cloves | roma tomatoes | white wine | dried oregano | dried basil | red pepper flakes | kosher salt | cracked black pepper | parmesan cheese
texte:
Saucy Herbed Shrimp

Ingredients:
- 1 shrimp
- 1 olive oil
- 1 green bell pepper
- 1 orange bell pepper
- 1 onion
- 1/2 fresh green beans
- 2 garlic cloves
- 2 roma tomatoes
- 1/2 white wine
- 1 dried oregano
- 1/2 dried basil
- 1/2 red pepper flakes
- 1/2 kosher salt
- 1 cracked black pepper
- 1/2 parmesan cheese

Instructions:
1. Cut all vegetables ahead as this dish cooks quickly.
2. Pour oil into large skillet and heat.
3. Add minced garlic and onion: stir until nearly translucent.
4. Add green beans, both bell peppers: stir until nearly done, leaving them crisp tender.
5. Add shrimp, wine, and seasonings: stir until shrimp is pink & wine is reduced.
6. Add tomatoes and stir in; cook one minute more.
7. Spoon over pasta or rice.  Sprinkle with grated parmesan & serve hot.
8. I also topped this with a sprinkle of French Grey sea salt & more fresh cracked black pepper.

ingredients_reels: hash browns | bacon | onion | bell pepper | cheddar cheese | eggs | milk | salt | pepper
texte:
Crock Pot Breakfast Casserole

Ingredients:
- 16 hash browns
- 1/2 bacon
- 1/2 onion
- 1/2 bell pepper
- 3/4 cheddar cheese
- 6 eggs
- 1/2 milk
- 1/2 salt
- 1/2 pepper

Instructions:
1. Place a layer of frozen hash browns on the bottom of the crock pot, followed by a layer of bacon, then onions, bell pepper and cheese.
2. Repeat the layering process two more times, ending with a layer of cheese.
3. Beat the eggs, milk, salt and pepper together.
4. Pour over the crock pot mixture.
5. Cover and cook on low 8-10 hours.  Note based on harsh review: If you know your slow cooker runs hot, reduce the time accordingly.  I have made this many times at the stated time with great results - best between 8-9 hours, well done at 10, but not burnt.

ingredients_reels: radish | scallions | fresh chives | fresh lemon juice | salt | fresh curly-leaf parsley | lemon zest | lemon slices
texte:
Turp Salatsi (Radish Salad)

Ingredients:
- 1 radish
- 1/4 scallions
- 1 fresh chives
- 1/2 fresh lemon juice
- salt
- fresh curly-leaf parsley
- lemon zest
- 3 lemon slices

Instructions:
1. *Tip: the sharpness/saltiness of the sumac and lemon juice mean you won't need to use very much salt (or any). Taste first then decide if the salt is necessary.
2. Cut the radishes into thin slices.
3. Arrange the radishes and onions or chives on a pretty plate.
4. Sprinkle the lemon juice, sumac and salt all over the radishes.
5. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.
6. When ready to serve, garnish with the parsley. lemon zest and lemon slices.
7. Can be served chilled or at room temperature.
8. Good with kebabs, bean dishes, grilled chicken, etc.
9. Yield is estimated.

ingredients_reels: milk | milk | egg | butter | margarine | brown sugar | salt | yellow cornmeal | bread flour | celery seeds | poultry seasoning | dried sage | pepper | active dry yeast
texte:
Stuffing Bread (Bread Machine)

Ingredients:
- 1 milk
- 1 milk
- 1 egg
- 2 butter
- 2 margarine
- 1 1/2 brown sugar
- 1/3 salt
- 3 yellow cornmeal
- 5 bread flour
- 1 1/2 celery seeds
- 3/4 poultry seasoning
- 1/2 dried sage
- 1/2 pepper
- 2 1/4 active dry yeast

Instructions:
1. In bread machine pan, place all ingredients in order given.
2. Select the BASIC BREAD setting, and the crust colour setting.
3. Bake according to bread machine directions.
4. Check dough after 5 minutes of mixing; add 1-2 Tbsp water or flour if needed.

ingredients_reels: boneless chicken breasts | chicken broth | lemon pepper seasoning | ground cumin | olive oil | garlic clove | onion | whole corn | green chilies | lime juice | great northern beans | monterey jack cheese
texte:
White Chicken Chili

Ingredients:
- 2 boneless chicken breasts
- 2 chicken broth
- 1/2 lemon pepper seasoning
- 1 ground cumin
- 1 olive oil
- 1 garlic clove
- 1/2 onion
- 1 whole corn
- 1 green chilies
- 2 -3 lime juice
- 1 great northern beans
- monterey jack cheese

Instructions:
1. In a medium to large size pot, combine chicken broth, ground cumin, lemon pepper and olive oil.  Bring to a boil.
2. Add chicken and bring to a low boil then reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 20-30 minutes or until chicken is done.
3. Remove chicken from broth and cut into bite size pieces.  Return back to broth.
4. Add the garlic, onion, corn, green chilies, lime juice and beans to the broth.  Return to a boil.
5. Simmer until thoroughly heated, about 45-60 minutes.
6. Pour into bowl and sprinkle with cheese.

ingredients_reels: garlic cloves | Dijon mustard | white wine vinegar | kosher salt | pepper | olive oil
texte:
Basic Vinaigrette With Variations

Ingredients:
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1 Dijon mustard
- 3 white wine vinegar
- 1 kosher salt
- 1/4 pepper
- 1/2 - 2/3 olive oil

Instructions:
1. Whisk the garlic cloves, mustard, vinegar, kosher salt, and pepper together in a bowl.
2. While whisking, slowly drizzle in the olive oil to emulsify.
3. Taste for salt and pepper.
4. Variations:
5. Use any other vinegar you have, including red wine vinegar and balsamic.
6. Leave out the garlic or add herbs as you like.
7. Add 1 teaspoon dried oregano and/or substitute lemon juice for the vinegar for a Greek-like dressing. I would leave out the mustard for this but the dressing will not emulsify as well without it.

ingredients_reels: potatoes | onion | mayonnaise | dried dill | dried chives | dried parsley | white pepper
texte:
Low Sodium Dilled Potato Salad

Ingredients:
- 5 potatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 mayonnaise
- 4 dried dill
- 3 dried chives
- 1 dried parsley
- 1 white pepper

Instructions:
1. Mix together and best when made the night ahead.
2. All of the dried herbs can be substituted with fresh herbs.  Sometimes use more than 1/2 jar real mayonnaise.  I do not like my potato salad to be dry.  I usually keep adding until it is VERY creamy.  I do not add salt to this recipe but usually leave it up to the individual.  Most people do not even realize that I have not added salt to this until I tell them.

ingredients_reels: pecans | butter | vanilla essence | sugar | flour
texte:
Pecan Balls

Ingredients:
- 1 pecans
- 1/2 butter
- 1 vanilla essence
- 2 sugar
- 1 flour

Instructions:
1. Beat butter, sugar, vanilla together until light and fluffy.
2. Add flour, mix to a stiff paste.
3. Add processed pecans.
4. Roll into 30 small balls.
5. bake at 180 degrees C (350 F) for 10 minutes.

texte:
Thai Coconut Peanut Chicken

ingredients_reels: chocolate | sweetened condensed milk | butter | caster sugar | vanilla essence | cake flour | all-purpose flour | salt | baking powder | buttermilk
texte:
Granny Greta's Upside Down Cake

Ingredients:
- 100 chocolate
- 1 sweetened condensed milk
- 180 butter
- 250 caster sugar
- 2 vanilla essence
- 1 cake flour
- 375 all-purpose flour
- 1/2 salt
- 1 baking powder
- 175 buttermilk

Instructions:
1. POSTSCRIPT, actually: I have had complaints that the cake sticks. Point taken -- but it should be clear that the tin should really be well prepared. The best tin for this is the loose-bottomed kind. Cut a round of nonstick baking paper LARGER than the bottom of the cake tin, grease tin well with butter (not marge, which sticks), lay the round over it and press the excess paper up against the (greased) tin. This will prevent the oily liquid from the choccie layer escaping while baking. Grease the bottom paper again. Grease the sides, and best cover that with nonstick paper as well, and grease again. This preparation is a bit of a pain, and I've had no trouble with this cake sticking, but it's obvious one does have to prepare the tin well. Put the cake on a smallish cookie tin -- in case some of the topping does escape. You don't want a mess in your oven.
2. Preheat oven to 180 deg C/350 deg F. Grease a cake tin of 24 cm in diameter with butter. Line with baking paper, and grease the paper with butter as well.
3. Break up the chocolate bar, and melt in a pot with the tin of sweetened condensed milk over medium heat, stirring, until smooth. Scrape out into the prepared greased tin, and tilt until this mixture is level. Put into your freezer, making sure that the tin is standing level. Don't freeze! You only want to firm it up.
4. Next, cream the butter and sugar (you can add a squirt of lemon juice to speed up the process).
5. Beat the eggs and vanilla in another small bowl.
6. Add to the butter-sugar mixture and beat well together.
7. Add the dry ingredients and the buttermilk and mix well.
8. Ladle the batter carefully over the hardened chocolate-condensed milk layer, and level the batter.
9. Bake for about 1 hour or until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean.
10. Leave to cool in the pan for about 30 mins., and then invert on to a cake plate.
11. Remove the baking paper carefully. The topping might have made little air holes, which is normal and can be disguised if you prefer.
12. If you want to, decorate with fresh garden mint and sour cherries, OR sift confectioner's sugar over one half and cocoa powder over the other half. You could also use whipped cream, but I find that overly rich with this cake.

nom: Baked Rigatoni With Eggplant and Sausage
ingredients_reels: kosher salt | extra virgin olive oil | Italian sausage | eggplant | onion | garlic cloves | whole tomatoes | basil | rigatoni pasta | fresh mozzarella cheese | fresh ground black pepper | parmigiano-reggiano cheese
texte:
Baked Rigatoni With Eggplant and Sausage

Ingredients:
- kosher salt
- extra virgin olive oil
- 6 Italian sausage
- 1 eggplant
- 1 onion
- 3 garlic cloves
- 28 whole tomatoes
- 1 basil
- 1 rigatoni pasta
- 1 fresh mozzarella cheese
- fresh ground black pepper
- 1 parmigiano-reggiano cheese

Instructions:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat for the pasta.
2. Oil a 9x13 pan with olive oil.
3. Heat a 3 Tbsp of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Add the sausages and toss in the hot oil for 3 to 4 minutes, you want them nicely browned on the outside but still rare on the inside. Put the sausages in the baking dish.
5. Turn the heat down to medium.
6. Add 1/3 cup of oil to the skillet and get it hot. Add as many eggplant pieces as you can comfortably fit in a single layer and sprinkle well with salt. Cook, turning, for 7 to 8 minutes, until the eggplant is nice and browned, crisp on the outside and soft on the inside. Use a spatula to put the eggplant into the baking dish with the sausage. Cook the rest of the eggplant pieces, adding more oil to the pan, as needed, and putting the finished eggplant into the baking dish.
7. Add another 3 Tbsp olive oil to the skillet, then the onion and garlic, and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until translucent.
8. Dump the whole can of tomatoes and their juices into a bowl and crush the tomatoes with your hands to break them up; add that to the pan with the basil and cook it down until pulpy and relatively thick. This will take about 15 minutes.
9. Add the rigatoni to the boiling pasta water, give it a stir, and cook for 6 to 7 minutes, it should be slightly firm as it will cook further in the oven. Ladle out 1/2 cup of the pasta cooking water and reserve; the drain the rigatoni.
10. Preheat the oven to 450°F.
11. Chop the sausages into nice big, bite-size chunky pieces and return the pieces to the baking dish. Add the tomato sauce, rigatoni, and the reserved pasta water.
12. Break up half the mozzarella over the mixture, season with salt and pepper, and gently mix with your hands or a spatula until combined.
13. Dust with the Parmigiano and drizzle with olive oil. Bake for 15 minutes.
14. Spread the remaining mozzarella in an even layer over the top and continue to bake for another 10 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.

ingredients_reels: ground cinnamon | turmeric | fresh ground black pepper | nutmeg | ground cardamom | ground cloves | chicken drumsticks | chicken thighs | fresh thyme | garlic cloves | olive oil | olive oil | onion | lemon | chicken broth | salt
texte:
Ras El-Hanout, Moroccan Spiced Chicken

Ingredients:
- 1/4 ground cinnamon
- 1 turmeric
- 1 1/2 fresh ground black pepper
- 3/4 nutmeg
- 3/4 ground cardamom
- 3/4 ground cloves
- 4 chicken drumsticks
- 4 chicken thighs
- 1 fresh thyme
- 5 garlic cloves
- 1/2 olive oil
- 1 olive oil
- 1 onion
- 1 lemon
- 3 chicken broth
- salt

Instructions:
1. To make the Ras al-hanout spice mixture:  Combine the cinnamon, turmeric, black pepper, nutmeg, cardamom and cloves in a small bowl.
2. Thoroughly pat the chicken dry and dredge in the ras al-hanout spices until pieces are nicely covered but not over-loaded.  Place in a bowl or large dish and scatter thyme and garlic over the chicken.  Pour 1/2 C olive oil over and toss to coat thoroughly.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight if possible, or several hours.
3. Remove marinated chicken and place on counter for 30 minutes.  Heat 1 T. olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat.  Remove chicken from the dish, keeping the marinade, and brown chicken on all sides in the hot oil.  (Do not rush this as the browning will help keep the chicken from feeling \"dusty\" from the spice mix covering it.  This is also why you do not want to over-load the chicken with the spice mix.)
4. Set the chicken aside and add the onion to the Dutch oven, cook until translucent.
5. Return the chicken to the Dutch oven, adding the lemon and the reserved marinade.  Sprinkle generously with salt.  Add enough broth to almost cover the chicken, bring to a simmer, cover and cook until the chicken has begun to pull away from the bones and is quite tender, about 1 hour and 15 minutes.
6. Remove the lid the last 15 minutes of cooking time to reduce the broth.  If it needs to reduce further, remove the chicken and boil the broth until nicely reduced to approximately 2 cups, but you can reduce it less if you want more sauce.  You can thicken the sauce with cornstarch mixed with water.
7. Serve with white rice or other grain of choice.

ingredients_reels: flour | sugar | dry buttermilk | baking powder | baking soda | salt | ground cinnamon | ground nutmeg
texte:
Universal Muffins Mix

Ingredients:
- 18 flour
- 5 sugar
- 2 1/4 dry buttermilk
- 6 baking powder
- 2 baking soda
- 2 salt
- 3 ground cinnamon
- 3 ground nutmeg

Instructions:
1. Combine ingredients and break up any lumps.
2. Store in a large airtight container labeled with the date and contents. Store in a cool, dry place. Shelf life: 6 to 8 months. Makes enough for about 5 batches of 24 muffins each.To make 24 regular-sized muffins:
3. Preheat oven to 400°. Coat muffin tins with cooking spray.
4. In a large bowl, beat:
5. 3 to 4 eggs.
6. 3 teaspoons vanilla.
7. 2 cups water.
8. UP TO 1 cup oil or butter.
9. Stir in 5-1/2 cups muffin mix and any additional ingredients (listed below) just until moistened. The batter should be lumpy.
10. Fill muffin tins full. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, or until muffins are golden brown.
11. Applesauce muffins: 1 cup applesauce omit oil.

ingredients_reels: olive oil | ground beef | ground lamb | onions | garlic cloves | dried oregano | dried basil | ground cinnamon | salt | ripe olives | tomato sauce | butter | flour | salt | milk | eggs | eggplants | olive oil | salt | potatoes | parmesan cheese | kasseri cheese | white cheddar cheese
texte:
Moussaka

Ingredients:
- 1/4 olive oil
- 2 ground beef
- 2 ground lamb
- 2 onions
- 1 garlic cloves
- 2 dried oregano
- 1 dried basil
- 1 ground cinnamon
- 3/4 salt
- 15 ripe olives
- 1/4 tomato sauce
- 2 butter
- 1/4 flour
- 2 salt
- 2 milk
- 1/2 eggs
- 2 eggplants
- olive oil
- salt
- 2 -3 potatoes
- 1 parmesan cheese
- 1 kasseri cheese
- 1 white cheddar cheese

Instructions:
1. In large, heavy saucepan, heat 1/4 cup oil; saute finely ground meat, onion and garlic until lightly browned; add oregano, basil, cinnamon, salt, ripe olives (if using) and tomato sauce; Cover and simmer slowly about 30 minutes; uncover and simmer slowly another 30 minutes.
2. While sauce simmers, prepare Bechamel Sauce (recipe below) and eggplant; cut ends from eggplant (1 large or 2 small) and cut in 1/2-inch-thick slices (if using large, flask-type eggplant, peel the skin off in strips with a vegetable peeler - creating a striped look - with some of the peel left on and some off.  If using Japanese-style (the longish, purply-white ones), don't bother to peel at all); Place on a cookie sheet and brush with remaining olive oil; Place under broiler and broil until light brown; Remove from oven, salt lightly, turn eggplant and repeat process; Then position rack in center of oven and heat to 350 degrees.
3. There are three ways you can prepare the potatoes for this delicious casserole:  1) shallow-fry potato rounds in olive oil until golden-brown or, 2) for fewer calories, arrange the potato slices in your baking pan, brush lightly with olive oil, bake for 15 minutes, continue with assembly, or 3) if you want to cut calories further, parboil them for 8 minutes; drain well on paper towels.
4. To assemble: In 13x9x2-inch baking dish, arrange layer of potatoes, overlapping slightly, season lightly (there will be only one layer of potatoes, so use them all up); next, do a layer of eggplant; sprinkle some Parmesan, kaseri (or cheddar) and bread crumbs over eggplant; layer meat sauce, freshly grated cheeses, crumbs and Bechamel Sauce until all is used; bake 45-50 minutes at 350 degrees or until flecked golden-brown on top.
5. To make Bechamel Sauce: In saucepan, melt butter over medium-low heat; whisk in flour and cook slowly until smooth and lightly cooked (2-3 minutes); add salt and remove from heat; add milk, whisking rapidly and return to heat; cook until thick and bubbly, whisking constantly; allow to cool 5 minutes, whisking once in a while to prevent a skin from forming; incorporate eggs and grated cheese with wire whisk to make fluffy sauce.
6. Freezer Notes:  Once the baked moussaka has completely cooked, cut serving-size pieces, double-wrap in foil and freeze.  Defrost in the usual manner and reheat in microwave (or oven) for a delicious, quick meal, when there's little time to cook and dinner is ready and waiting in the freezer!

texte:
Cuban Bread (Pan Cubano)

Ingredients:
- 4 unbleached all-purpose flour
- 4 sugar
- 2 salt
- 2 1/4 active dry yeast
- 4 butter
- 1 1/4 water

Instructions:
1. Manual Method: In a large bowl, combine all of the ingredients and stir till the dough starts to leave the sides of the bowl. Transfer the dough to a lightly greased surface, oil your hands, and knead it for 6 to 8 minutes, or until it begins to become smooth and supple. Transfer the dough to a lightly greased bowl or dough-rising bucket, cover the bowl or bucket, and allow the dough to rise till puffy though not necessarily doubled in bulk, about 1 hour, depending on the warmth of your kitchen. Gently fold the dough in upon itself and turn it upside-down after 30 minutes; this \"turn\" helps eliminate some of the excess carbon dioxide and redistributes the yeast's food, both imperative for optimum yeast growth.
2. Mixer Method: Combine the ingredients as directed at left, using a flat beater paddle or beaters, then switch to the dough hook(s) and knead for 5 to 8 minutes. Transfer the dough to a lightly greased bowl or dough-rising bucket, cover the bowl or bucket, and allow the dough to rise, with a turn, as directed above.
3. Bread Machine Method: Place all of the ingredients into the pan of your machine, program the machine for Manual or Dough, and press Start. Examine the dough about 10 minutes before the end of the final kneading cycle, and adjust its consistency with additional water or flour as needed, to produce a smooth, supple dough. Allow the machine to complete its cycle.
4. Divide the dough into six pieces, and shape each piece into a rough log. Let the logs rest for 15 minutes, covered, then shape each piece into a smooth batard shape (a log about 8 inches long, slightly tapered at each end). Place the loaves on a parchment-lined or lightly greased baking sheet.
5. Let the loaves rise, covered, for 1 hour. Brush or spray them with water, and slash one long lengthwise slit down the middle of each loaf. Preheat the oven to 375°F while the loaves are rising. Bake the bread for about 30 minutes, or until it's golden brown. Remove it from the oven, and cool it on a rack. The loaves may be made one day in advance and stored at room temperature, or several weeks in advance and frozen.

texte:
Cider Simmered Beef - Crock Pot

Ingredients:
- 2 olive oil
- 1 beef eye round
- 2 onions
- 1 celery rib
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1 ground allspice
- 1/2 ground ginger
- 1/4 pepper
- 1 apple cider
- 2 molasses
- 2 cold water
- 2 cornstarch
- salt
- parsley

Instructions:
1. Heat oil in a large nonstick fry pan over medium high heat, add beef and brown well on all sides.
2. Meanwhile, in a 4 quart or larger slow cooker, combine onions celery, garlic, allspice, ginger and pepper.
3. In a small bowl, mix cider and molasses.
4. Place beef on top of onion mixture, pour in cider mixture.
5. Cover and cook at low setting until beef is tender when pierced, about 9 1/2 to 10 hours.
6. Lift roast to a warm platter and keep warm.
7. Skim and discard fat from liquid.
8. Then blend in cornstarch mixture.
9. Increase cooker heat to high, cover and cook, stirring several times, until sauce is thickened (about 15 more minutes).
10. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
11. To serve:
12. Remove and discard string from beef; slice beef across the grain.
13. Spoon some of the sauce over meat, sprinkle with parsley.
14. Serve remaining sauce in a bowl or pitcher to add to taste.
15. The onion-y brown sauce is good served over baked or mashed potatoes or broad noodles.
16. Complete menu with chilled sparkling cider, a platter of sliced cucumbers and bell pepper rings and a crusty loaf.

ingredients_reels: leek | head cauliflower | chicken broth | water | unsalted butter | rice | parmigiano-reggiano cheese | salt | pepper
texte:
Cauliflower and Leek Risotto

Ingredients:
- 1 leek
- 1 head cauliflower
- 3 1/2 chicken broth
- 1 1/2 water
- 3 unsalted butter
- 1 rice
- 1 1/2 parmigiano-reggiano cheese
- salt
- pepper

Instructions:
1. Wash leek well in a bowl of cold water, then lift out and drain. Blanch leek and cauliflower in a 4- to 5-quart pot of boiling salted water, uncovered, 1 minute. Drain in a sieve and transfer to a bowl of cold water to stop cooking. Drain well.
2. Bring broth and water to a boil in a 2- to 3-quart saucepan and keep broth at a bare simmer, covered.
3. Heat 2 tablespoons butter in a 4-quart heavy pot over moderately high heat until foam subsides, then sauté cauliflower and leek, stirring, 2 minutes. Add rice and cook, stirring, 1 minute. Add 1 cup simmering broth and cook at a strong simmer, stirring, until absorbed, about 2 minutes. Continue simmering and adding broth, about 1/2 cup at a time, stirring frequently and letting each addition be absorbed before adding the next, until rice is just tender and creamy looking, 20 to 25 minutes. (There may be leftover broth.)
4. Remove from heat and stir in cheese, remaining tablespoon butter, and salt and pepper to taste. Thin with a little remaining broth as desired and serve immediately.
