6. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until cheese melts and soup is thoroughly heated.
7. Yield: 5 cups.

nom: Brown Sugar and Mustard Glazed Corned Beef
ingredients_reels: corned beef brisket | light brown sugar | water | brown mustard
texte:
Brown Sugar and Mustard Glazed Corned Beef

Ingredients:
- 1 corned beef brisket
- 1/2 light brown sugar
- 1/2 water
- 1/2 brown mustard

Instructions:
1. Rinse off the brisket under running water.
2. Trim off excess fat.
3. Place in large stock pot and cover with water. AT this point you may use the seasoning packet that came with the corned beef.
4. Bring to a boil.
5. Lower the heat to simmer.
6. Cook about 3 hours until very tender (skimming fat as necessary). Add more water if needed to keep covered.
7. CROCK POT DIRECTIONS: If desired, cook corned beef in crock pot until tender. Continue on past this point.
8. Preheat oven to 325º.
9. In a sauce pan, combine the brown sugar and 1/2 cup water. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
10. After about 5 minutes, stir in mustard.
11. Continue simmering another 2-3 minutes.
12. Place the brisket on a rack in a roaster.
13. Thinly coat meat with glaze.
14. Put in oven and bake for 30 minutes, reglazing every 10 minutes.
15. Remove from oven and let rest at least 15 minutes.
16. Slice thin to serve.

ingredients_reels: Bisquick baking mix | salt | basil | garlic powder | chicken leg | egg | margarine
texte:
Easy Bisquick Chicken Legs

Ingredients:
- 1 Bisquick baking mix
- 1/2 salt
- 1/2 basil
- 1/2 garlic powder
- 1 -2 chicken leg
- 1/4 egg
- 3 margarine

Instructions:
1. Heat oven to 450°F Line cookie sheet with foil; spray with cooking spray.
2. In 1-gallon resealable food-storage plastic bag, stir together Bisquick® mix, salt, basil and garlic powder.
3. Dip half the chicken strips into egg; place in bag of Bisquick mixture. Seal bag; shake to coat. Place chicken on cookie sheet. Repeat with remaining chicken. Drizzle melted margarine over chicken.
4. Bake 12 to 14 minutes, turning after 6 minutes with pancake turner, until no longer pink in center.

ingredients_reels: ground beef | onions | garlic cloves | canned red kidney beans | tomato sauce | stewed tomatoes | macaroni | water | chili powder | ground cumin | sharp cheddar cheese
texte:
Macaroni Chili - Oamc

Ingredients:
- 2 ground beef
- 1 1/2 onions
- 2 garlic cloves
- 31 canned red kidney beans
- 2 tomato sauce
- 2 stewed tomatoes
- 1 1/2 macaroni
- 1/2 water
- 4 chili powder
- 2 ground cumin
- 2/3 sharp cheddar cheese

Instructions:
1. In large skillet cook ground beef, onions and garlic until beef is browned.  Drain.
2. In large dutch oven pour in meat mixture, add beans, tomato sauce, tomatoes with juices, marcaroni, water, chili powder and cumin.
3. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
4. Cover and simmer about 10 minutes more or until the macaroni is tender but firm.
5. Place in containers, sprinkle with cheese and freeze.

ingredients_reels: cauliflower florets | sweet onion | garlic cloves | olive oil | ground black pepper | fresh thyme | salt | lemon juice
texte:
French Roasted Cauliflower With Thyme

Ingredients:
- 2 cauliflower florets
- 1 sweet onion
- 3 garlic cloves
- 2 olive oil
- 1/4 ground black pepper
- 1 fresh thyme
- 1/2 salt
- lemon juice

Instructions:
1. Preheat an oven to 400°F.
2. Mix cauliflower, onions, and garlic together in a large roasting pan.
3. Drizzle the vegetables with the oil, season them with the pepper and thyme, and toss gently to coat.
4. Roast the vegetables uncovered for 20-35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they turn golden brown. If you like, squeeze a little lemon juice over when serving. The smaller you chop the cauliflower, the less time it takes to bake. I love the crunchy brown bits, that's why I chop it all up so small! Enjoy!

ingredients_reels: rice | evaporated milk | brown sugar | butter | vanilla | nutmeg | eggs | raisins
texte:
Old Fashioned Rice Pudding

Ingredients:
- 2 1/2 rice
- 1 1/2 evaporated milk
- 2/3 brown sugar
- 3 butter
- 2 vanilla
- 1/2 - 1 nutmeg
- 3 eggs
- 1/2 - 1 raisins

Instructions:
1. Thoroughly combine rice with all remaining ingredients.
2. Pour into lightly greased crock-pot.
3. Cover and cook on high for 2 hours.
4. (or LOW: 4-6 hours).
5. Stir after first hour.
6. This recipe may be doubled if desired.

ingredients_reels: ground beef | onion | celery | garlic clove | shell macaroni | frozen chopped spinach | swiss cheese | milk | salt | rosemary | pepper
texte:
Ground Beef and Spinach Casserole

Ingredients:
- 1 ground beef
- 1 onion
- 1/4 celery
- 1 garlic clove
- 1 shell macaroni
- 1 frozen chopped spinach
- 1/2 swiss cheese
- 3/4 milk
- 1 salt
- 1/2 rosemary
- 1/4 pepper

Instructions:
1. Cook beef, onion, celery, and garlic in heavy skillet until meat is brown and vegetables are tender. In large bowl, combine meat mixture with remaining ingredients. Turn into a 2 quart casserole dish. Cover and bake in 350* oven 30 minutes or until hot.

ingredients_reels: onion | olive oil | ghee | cinnamon stick | green cardamoms | cloves | bay leaf | ginger paste | garlic paste | chili powder | ground cumin | ground coriander | salt | green pepper | canned tomatoes | green chilies | fresh coriander
texte:
Brians Favourite Prawn Curry

Ingredients:
- 1 onion
- 3 olive oil
- 1 ghee
- 6 cinnamon stick
- 6 green cardamoms
- 1 cloves
- 1 bay leaf
- 1 ginger paste
- 1 garlic paste
- 1 chili powder
- 1 ground cumin
- 1/2 ground coriander
- 1 salt
- 1 1/2 green pepper
- 450 canned tomatoes
- 2 green chilies
- 2 fresh coriander

Instructions:
1. Fry onion in oil or ghee until just tender. (3 to 4 minutes).
2. Add cinnamon stick, cardamoms, cloves and bay leaf.
3. Fry for one minute and then add ginger and garlic pastes.
4. Add chilli, cumin, coriander and salt. Fry for half a minute.
5. Add chopped green pepper and tomatoes, then bring to boil.
6. Turn down heat and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes.
7. Add prawns and let them 'poach' in the sauce for three minutes or so, or until done.
8. Add chopped green coriander leaves and chopped chillies.
9. Serve with rice.

ingredients_reels: margarine | sugar | egg | molasses | flour | ginger | baking soda | cinnamon | salt | sugar | white chocolate chips | margarine
texte:
Dipped Gingersnaps

Ingredients:
- 3/4 margarine
- 1 sugar
- 1 egg
- 1/4 molasses
- 2 flour
- 1 ginger
- 2 baking soda
- 1 cinnamon
- 1/2 salt
- 1 sugar
- 2 white chocolate chips
- 2 margarine

Instructions:
1. Cream sugar and margarine together.
2. Add egg and molasses and mix well.
3. Add all dry ingredients and mix.
4. Roll into 1 inch balls, and then roll into sugar to coat.
5. Bake 8-10 minutes at 350°F.
6. Remove to wire racks to cool.
7. Melt chips with margarine in small saucepan over low heat.
8. Dip cookies halfway; shake off excess.
9. Place on waxed paper lined baking sheets to harden.

ingredients_reels: plums | all-purpose flour | baking powder | salt | sugar | cinnamon | milk | egg | unsalted butter | unsalted butter | sugar | cinnamon
texte:
Plum Puffs

Ingredients:
- 2 plums
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 1 baking powder
- 1/2 salt
- 1/2 sugar
- 1/2 cinnamon
- 1/2 milk
- 1 egg
- 1/4 unsalted butter
- 2 unsalted butter
- 1/2 sugar
- 1/2 - 1 cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F Grease a 12-cup muffin pan.
2. Mix together flour, baking powder, salt, 1/2 cup sugar, and 1/2 tsp cinnamon. Add 1 cup plum pulp (see instructions at end of recipe), cream, egg, and 1/4 cup melted butter and stir until combined (should still be lumpy, not smooth).
3. Spoon batter into muffin cups to about 2/3 full. Bake about 20 minutes or until centers are set. Remove puffs from pan immediately.
4. While puffs are baking, combine cinnamon and sugar. As soon as the puffs are removed from the pan, dip tops into melted butter, then into cinnamon-sugar mixture.
5. To make plum pulp: Wash plums and place in a large pot. Add a little water (about 1/4 to 1/2 cup) to pot--just enough to make some steam. Cover and heat over very low heat until the fruit is soft. Pour the juice and some fruit into a colander set over a large bowl (to catch juices and pulp). Mash the fruit around with a potato masher (not too hard--you don't want to break the pits!) until most of the pulp and skins have been pressed through the colander. Discard the pits, add some more fruit to the colander, and repeat until all the fruit has been pressed through. 2 lbs of plums should yield about 3 cups pulp, which may be used for this recipe, frozen in containers or freezer bags, or made into jam. Look for European plums, not Asian plums as they are not as good for cooking.

ingredients_reels: low-fat plain yogurt | sugar-free instant vanilla pudding mix
texte:
Low Cal Yummy Fruit Dip

Ingredients:
- 1 low-fat plain yogurt
- 1  - 1 1/2 sugar-free instant vanilla pudding mix

Instructions:
1. Mix together.
2. Let it sit for a few minutes to thicken.
3. This can be made individually with just a little yogurt and the pudding mix to taste.
4. Serve with fresh fruit.

ingredients_reels: bananas | vanilla pudding mix | chocolate pudding mix | milk
texte:
best ever Banana Pudding

Ingredients:
- 6 bananas
- 1 vanilla pudding mix
- 2 chocolate pudding mix
- 4 milk

Instructions:
1. peel and slice bananas into 1/4\" slices.
2. crumble the vanilla wafers into med chunks.
3. then layer the banana slices and wafers into 1/2\" alternating layers till you fill up a large bowl.
4. then mix the 4 cups of milk in accordance with the directions for the pudding.
5. then pour the pudding covering the bananas and wafers.
6. cover tightly with foil and refrigerate for 24 hrs.

ingredients_reels: Bisquick baking mix | milk | mozzarella string cheese | butter | garlic powder
texte:
String Cheese Sticks

Ingredients:
- 2 1/4 Bisquick baking mix
- 2/3 milk
- 8 mozzarella string cheese
- 1 butter
- 1/4 garlic powder

Instructions:
1. Stir bixquick and milk until soft dough forms and then beat 30 seconds with a spoon.
2. Place dough on flat surface that has been sprinkled with dry bisquick mix.
3. Roll the dough around to coat it and knead 10-12 times.
4. Roll the dough to 1/4\" thick.
5. Cut into 8 rectangles about 6x2 each.
6. Put cheese sticks onto each dough cut-out, and roll the dough around it.
7. Pinch edge into roll to seal, seal edges and gently roll back and forth to further seal.
8. Place sticks on ungreased cookie sheet.
9. Bake at 450 degrees for 8-10 minutes or until golden brown.
10. Mix butter and garlic and brush it over the cheese sticks once you remove them from the oven.

ingredients_reels: apples | lemon juice | celery | dried cherries | golden raisin | lettuce leaf | mayonnaise | plain yogurt | fresh tarragon | dried tarragon | honey | lemon juice
texte:
Chicken Waldorf Salad

Ingredients:
- 2 -3 apples
- 1 lemon juice
- 1/4 celery
- 2 dried cherries
- 1/2 golden raisin
- 1/4 lettuce leaf
- mayonnaise
- 1/4 plain yogurt
- 1/4 fresh tarragon
- 2 dried tarragon
- 1 honey
- 1 lemon juice

Instructions:
1. Dice apples, place in a bowl and toss with lemon juice.
2. Add celery, chicken, nuts,& dried fruit.
3. Mix together dressing and toss with chicken mixture.
4. Arrange lettuce on plates& spoon salad over the top.
5. (Or tear lettuce& toss.).

ingredients_reels: apple cider | brown sugar | cinnamon sticks | whole cloves
texte:
Hot Perked Apple Cider

Ingredients:
- 8 apple cider
- 1/2 brown sugar
- 10 cinnamon sticks
- 6 whole cloves

Instructions:
1. Pour cider into large percolator (8-10 cup).
2. Place remaining ingredients in percolator basket.
3. Perk 10 minutes.
4. Pour into mugs.
5. Garnish each with a cinnamon stick (from the Percolator basket) and serve.

ingredients_reels: spaghetti | sun-dried tomato packed in oil | eggs | salt | ground black pepper | parmesan cheese | Fontina cheese | butter | extra virgin olive oil
texte:
Pasta Frittata

Ingredients:
- 8 spaghetti
- 1/2 sun-dried tomato packed in oil
- 4 eggs
- 1 1/2 salt
- 1/2 ground black pepper
- 3/4 parmesan cheese
- 3/4 Fontina cheese
- 1 butter
- 1 extra virgin olive oil

Instructions:
1. Ahead of time:  Cook spaghetti in a large pot of boiling salted water until tender, but not too soft, about 8 minutes; drain.  Toss with sun-dried tomatoes and set aside to cool.
2. When the pasta is cool:  In a large bowl, whisk the eggs, salt, pepper, parmesan and fontina cheese to blend.
3. Add the pasta and toss to coat.
4. Melt butter and oil in a 9 1/2 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat.
5. Transfer pasta mixture to the skillet, pressing to form an even layer.  Cook until the bottom is golden brown, about 3 minutes.
6. Place skillet under broiler and broil until top is golden brown, about 5 minutes.
7. Cool to room temperature, then invert the frittata onto a platter and cut into wedges.

ingredients_reels: dried garbanzo beans | tahini | lemon juice | olive oil | garlic cloves | salt | ground cumin
texte:
Hummus from Dried Chickpeas

Ingredients:
- 1 dried garbanzo beans
- 1 tahini
- 3/4 lemon juice
- 1/2 olive oil
- 6 -8 garlic cloves
- 1 -2 salt
- 1 ground cumin

Instructions:
1. Bring chickpeas to boiling then simmer about 1/2 hour until tender.
2. Drain chickpeas, reserving liquid. Let stand until cool enough to handle. (Using warm to hot chickpeas makes it possible to process a softer  texture that will then stiffen to a nice, spreadable paste).
3. Process in blender or food processor in 2-3 batches according to the size/capability of your equipment. Use enough of the chickpea cooking liquid to get a texture like soft peanut butter.
4. Mix the batches together in a large bowl.
5. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. (If you need more garlic return a half batch to the blender, process it smooth, and stir back into the rest).
6. Pack in freezer containers of an appropriate size for your household.
7. Tip -- This makes a nice hostess gift when attractively packaged.
8. Tip -- Tahini often separates in the can or jar. Rather than trying to mix it in the can then measure it just put the whole can/jar into the blender, whip it up, and pour back the excess.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | toasted wheat germ | baking powder | baking soda | salt | egg substitute | granulated sugar | zucchini | carrot | brown sugar | applesauce
texte:
Carrot-Zucchini Loaves

Ingredients:
- 2 3/4 all-purpose flour
- 1/2 toasted wheat germ
- 2 baking powder
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1/2 salt
- 3/4 egg substitute
- 1 granulated sugar
- 1 zucchini
- 1 carrot
- 1/2 brown sugar
- 1/2 applesauce

Instructions:
1. Grease bottom and 1/2 inch up the sides of two 8x4x2-inch loaf pans. Set aside.
2. In a large mixing bowl stir together flour, wheat germ, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Make a well in the center of dry mixture.
3. In a medium mixing bowl combine eggs, granulated sugar, zucchini, carrot, brown sugar, and applesauce; mix well. Add all at once to dry mixture. Stir just until moistened (batter should be lumpy). Pour batter into loaf pans.
4. Bake in a 350 degree F oven for 45 to 55 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted near center comes out clean. (If necessary, cover loosely with foil during last 10 to 15 minutes of baking to prevent overbrowning.) Cool in pans on wire racks 10 minutes. Remove from pans and cool thoroughly on wire racks. Wrap and store overnight before slicing. Makes 2 loaves.
5. Make-Ahead Tip: Prepare, bake, and cool loaves completely. Place loaves in freezer containers or bags and freeze for up to 1 month. Before serving, thaw the wrapped loaf overnight in the refrigerator.

ingredients_reels: salsa | canned black beans | zucchini | fat free tortillas | monterey jack pepper cheese
texte:
Quesadilla

Ingredients:
- 1 salsa
- 1 canned black beans
- 1 zucchini
- 8 fat free tortillas
- 1/4 monterey jack pepper cheese

Instructions:
1. Combine salsa, beans and zucchini .
2. Spread 1/4 of mixture over 4 tortillas, top with 3 Tbsps cheese .
3. Cover each with remaining tortillas.
4. Heat large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
5. Cook each quesadilla, turning once until cheese is melted (about 1 minute each side)
6. Cut into quarters, serve .

nom: Arugula (Rocket) and Blue Cheese Mashed Potatoes
ingredients_reels: olive oil | red onion | garlic cloves | vermouth | white wine | salt | dried herbs | arugula | milk | blue cheese | mashed potatoes
texte:
Arugula (Rocket) and Blue Cheese Mashed Potatoes

Ingredients:
- 1 olive oil
- 1 red onion
- 4 garlic cloves
- 1/4 vermouth
- 1/2 white wine
- 1 salt
- 1/2 dried herbs
- 8 arugula
- 1/2 milk
- 1/2 blue cheese
- 6 mashed potatoes

Instructions:
1. In a large pan heat oil over medium high heat. Add onions, and garlic cook about 3-4 minutes the pan.
2. Deglaze the pan with vermouth.
3. Add salt, pepper flakes, herbs, nutmeg and arugula.
4. Remove to a dish and set aside.
5. In the same pan heat milk add cheese to melt.
6. Add potatoes and mix together.
7. Toss in the wilted arugula.
8. Season with additional salt and pepper if needed.

ingredients_reels: flour | baking powder | baking soda | salt | butter | sugar | eggs | bananas | buttermilk
texte:
Banana Bread

Ingredients:
- 2 flour
- 2 baking powder
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 butter
- 1/2 sugar
- 2 eggs
- 2 -3 bananas
- 1/2 buttermilk

Instructions:
1. Sift flour, baking soda, baking powder, and the salt together.
2. Cream the butter and sugar together.
3. Mash bananas until there are no large chunks.
4. Add eggs, mashed bananas, buttermilk to the butter and sugar mixture and mix together.
5. Add to flour mixture alternately.
6. When well blended, pour into a greased bread pan and bake in a pre-heated 350 degree oven for 1 hour.

ingredients_reels: ketchup | seasoned rice vinegar | apple cider | apple cider vinegar | brown sugar | soy sauce | Worcestershire sauce | prepared yellow mustard | garlic powder | ground black pepper | cayenne | imitation bacon bits | apple | onion | green bell peppers
texte:
Apple Barbecue Sauce!

Ingredients:
- 1 ketchup
- 2/3 seasoned rice vinegar
- 1/2 apple cider
- 1/4 apple cider vinegar
- 1/2 brown sugar
- 1/8 soy sauce
- 1/8 Worcestershire sauce

- 3/4 garlic powder
- 1/4 ground black pepper
- 1/4 cayenne
- 1/3 imitation bacon bits
- 1/3 apple

Instructions:
1. Mix together the ketchup, rice vinegar, apple juice or cider, cider vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, garlic powder, white pepper, cayenne, and bacon bits in a large saucepan.
2. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Stir in  apple, onion, and bell pepper. Reduce the heat and simmer, uncovered, 10 to 15 minutes or until it thickens slightly. Stir it often.
3. Allow to cool, then pour into sterilized glass jars. Refrigerate for up to 2 weeks.
4. VARIATION: To make this sauce a little hotter, add more cayenne pepper to taste, approximately another 1/4 to 1/2 teaspoon. Be careful; a little cayenne goes a long way.

nom: Quick Garlic Roast Chicken With Rosemary & Lemon
ingredients_reels: boneless skinless chicken breasts | garlic cloves | fresh rosemary | extra virgin olive oil | lemon, juice and zest of | dry white wine | chicken broth
texte:
Quick Garlic Roast Chicken With Rosemary & Lemon

Ingredients:
- 2 1/2 boneless skinless chicken breasts
- 6 garlic cloves
- 3 fresh rosemary
- 3 extra virgin olive oil
- 1 lemon, juice and zest of
- 1 dry white wine
- 1/2 chicken broth

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees.
2. Cut chicken into large chunks.  (I used 4 breasts and cut each one into three pieces.).
3. In a 9x13 baking dish put the garlic, rosemary, extra-virgin olive oil, lemon zest, and seasoning.
4. Add chicken and toss to coat.
5. Place in oven for 20 minutes.
6. Add wine & lemon juice and combine with pan juices.
7. Return to oven and turn oven off.
8. Let stand for 5 minutes longer, then remove chicken from oven.
9. Spoon pan juices over chicken and serve.

ingredients_reels: eggs | milk | sugar | ground nutmeg | cinnamon | vanilla extract | pecans | butter | butter | maple syrup
texte:
Baked Pecan French Toast

Ingredients:
- 4 eggs
- 1 milk
- 1/4 sugar
- 1/4 ground nutmeg
- 1/2 cinnamon
- 1 vanilla extract
- 1/2 pecans
- 2 butter
- butter
- maple syrup

Instructions:
1. Place the eggs, milk, sugar, nutmeg or cinnamon and vanilla in a medium mixing bowl and whisk to combine.
2. Mist the bottom of a 12 by 8-inch glass casserole with vegetable oil spray or brush with melted butter.
3. Place the bread slices in a single layer in the pan.
4. Pour the egg mixture over the bread, distributing it evenly.
5. Turn the bread slices once.
6. Cover the pan with plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator overnight.
7. The next morning, preheat the oven to 425 degrees.
8. Remove the pan from the refrigerator and remove the plastic wrap.
9. Sprinkle the bread slices with pecans and drizzle with melted butter.
10. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until bread slices puff up and pecans are deep brown but not burned.
11. Serve warm with maple syrup.
12. Instead of a cup of milk, use 2/3 cup orange juice and 1/3 cup of the milk.
13. You can vary this further by adding a little grated orange zest with the pecans before baking.

ingredients_reels: sour cream | dry mustard | black pepper | salt | garlic powder | Worcestershire sauce | mayonnaise | blue cheese
texte:
Blue (Bleu) Cheese Dressing (The Chart House)

Ingredients:
- 3/4 sour cream
- 1/2 dry mustard
- 1/2 black pepper
- 1/2 salt
- 1/3 garlic powder
- 1 Worcestershire sauce
- 1 1/3 mayonnaise
- 6 blue cheese

Instructions:
1. With an electric mixer on low speed, beat together first 6 ingredients for 2 minutes.
2. Add mayonnaise and beat an additional 30 seconds.
3. Increase speed to medium and beat for 2 minutes.
4. Fold in bleu cheese.
5. Refrigerate for at least 24 hours before serving.
6. Note: Sometimes I will add 1/2 the bleu cheese, when adding the mayo. This gives the dressing a smoother consistency when serving to younger taste buds. Cooking time is 24hr. refrigeration.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | sugar | butter | baking powder | milk | eggs | vanilla | fresh apricots
texte:
Apricot Snack Cake

Ingredients:
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 sugar
- 1/2 butter
- 1 baking powder
- 1 milk
- 2 eggs
- 1 vanilla
- 2 fresh apricots

Instructions:
1. Combine flour and sugar in a mixing bowl.  Cut in butter to make crumbs. Set 3/4 cup of crumb mixture aside for topping.

ingredients_reels: potatoes | cream cheese | half-and-half | milk | salt
texte:
Creamy Mashed Ranch Potatoes

Ingredients:
- 4 -5 potatoes
- 1 cream cheese
- 1 half-and-half
- 4 -6 milk
- salt

Instructions:
1. Peel and cube potatoes.
2. Boil until tender.
3. Drain and mash.
4. Beat in cream cheese til smooth.
5. Stir in rest of ingredients.
6. Serve hot.

nom: Embarrassingly Simple, Utterly Delicious Chicken With Onions
ingredients_reels: roasting chickens | garlic powder | onion | sweet wine
texte:
Embarrassingly Simple, Utterly Delicious Chicken With Onions

Ingredients:
- 2 roasting chickens
- garlic powder
- 1 onion
- 2 sweet wine

Instructions:
1. Put the chicken in a baking pan.  Sprinkle with garlic powder.  (Don't be skimpy; you can never have too much garlic on chicken!).

3. Unceremoniously, pour the wine over the chicken.
4. Cover and bake at 350F for 90 minutes; then uncover and bake for another 30 minutes to get nice, crispy onions, and a lovely glazed skin.

ingredients_reels: flour | baking soda | cornmeal | egg | 1% fat buttermilk | vanilla
texte:
Easy Cornmeal Buttermilk Pancakes

Ingredients:
- 1/3 flour
- 3/4 baking soda
- 1 1/8 cornmeal
- 1 egg
- 1 1/8 1% fat buttermilk
- 1 vanilla

Instructions:
1. Combine flour, baking soda and cornmeal.
2. Add egg, buttermilk and vanilla.
3. Stir until just mixed.
4. Pour by 1/4 cup into a hot pan.
5. Cook until bubbles appear, flip.
6. Makes about 10 pancakes.

ingredients_reels: corn tortillas | Crisco shortening
texte:
Tortilla  Formed Salad Bowl Shells

Ingredients:
- 6 corn tortillas
- 1 Crisco shortening

Instructions:
1. Heat oven 350*.
2. One flat baking tray.
3. Grease 6 oven proof soup or popcorn bowls on the inside, Reserve 7th bowl.
4. Place each tortilla inside greased bowl.
5. Stack  filled bowls inside of each other.
6. Place the 7th empty bowl inside of the 6th bowl.
7. Place a weight inside the bowl that is heat resistant.
8. Bake 12 minutes.
9. Remove tray from oven. Do not move the bowls.
10. Let them cool down. Then remove the bowls.
11. Put plastic wrap in between.
12. If you form homemade tortillas, bake a little longer to form the shells. It seems they have more moisture in them.
13. Make only 6 at each time.

ingredients_reels: egg | water | olive oil | salt | white flour
texte:
Handmade Fresh Pasta

Ingredients:
- 1 egg
- 1 water
- 1 olive oil
- 1/2 salt
- 1 -2 white flour

Instructions:
1. Recipe can be doubled, tripled, etc. I usually make a LOT and store in the fridge.
2. Combine the first 4 ingredients and whisk together well with a fork.
3. Add 1/2°C flour and mix with the fork until all lumps are gone.
4. Keep adding flour little by little until a non-sticky ball is formed. (You will use between 1 & 1-1/4°C of flour, depending on the humidity, etc.
5. Knead WELL about 10 minutes. Add light coating of flour as needed, until a firm ball is formed.
6. Allow it to sit for 30 minutes.
7. Cut off billiard ball-sized pieces and roll them out flat on a well-floured board. (Maybe 1-2 mm. thick).
8. Fold thrice (3x) and cut noodles with a sharp knife roughly 4 mm. thick. - Similar to cutting soba noodles (Japanese buckwheat noodles) though with the thickness of udon noodles.
9. Stretch out pasta and let dry (either hanging or on a plate) for a few minutes up to an hour.

nom: How to Cut up a Chicken
ingredients_reels: whole chicken | cold water
texte:
How to Cut up a Chicken

Ingredients:
- 1 whole chicken
- cold water

Instructions:
1. You will need a pair of sharp, good-quality kitchen shears and a sharp knife at least 6 inches long.
2. Unwrap the chicken and drain any extra blood into the sink. Rinsing the chicken in cold water is optional. It can tidy up a chicken that is messy from processing and packing, but it makes the bird slippery to handle.
3. If there are pads of fat just inside the cavity pull them away (as long as the bird is cold the fat will be solid enough to handle).
4. Remove the giblets. Top brand birds will have the full set. Discount brand birds will have random giblets -- anywhere from none at all to doubles.
5. Cut off the wingtips with the kitchen shears.
6. Cut the skin connecting the thigh to the body with the shears or the knife.
7. Bend the thigh backwards to dislocate the joint. Use the shears to cut the thigh from the body.
8. Bend the leg joint backwards to dislocate it. (Dislocating the joints is optional, but makes it easier). Cut through the joint from the inner side of the bend.
9. Bend the wing back to find the joint. Dislocate it if possible (the wing joints are very sturdy and sometimes can't be dislocated until the white meat is cut to expose them). Cut through the wing joint with the shears from the inside of the bend.
10. Using the shears, cut the breast free of the back following the line of the ribs (there is usually a thin line of fat just on the breast side of that line).
11. Note -- The difficulty of cutting through the shoulder bones will depend on the age of the chicken. Fryers are easy, stew hens more difficult. If you're cutting a turkey you'll need to break the joint.
12. Use the knife to divide the breast lengthwise into thirds. Cut the meat down to but not through the bones.
13. Cut the breast bones with the shears.
14. Note -- for a large roaster, or stew hen you may wish to halve each of these pieces crosswise to yield a total of 6 pieces of white meat.
15. Alternately, if you want the breast divided in half you can use the knife to cut the skin exactly down the center then slide it down on one side of the breastbone. Complete the cut with the shears. Sometimes, depending upon the intended use, its even desirable to slide the knife along both sides of the breastbone and then use the shears to cut it out completely.
16. The chicken is now ready to use for whatever purpose you wanted chicken parts.
17. If you wish to bone the breasts, its now easy to see where you need to slide a thin, razor-sharp knife to free the meat.
18. Note -- gather the trimmings, including the fat, and save in the freezer until you have enough for chicken stock. (Recipe #219819 requires trimmings from only 2-3 chickens).
19. Tip -- It's easier to skin the chicken if you grab the slippery skin with a damp dishcloth.
20. Tip -- If there are pinfeathers I find that a grill lighter makes the best tool to singe them off.
21. Tip -- If there are broken feathers too large to singe, a pair of washed, needlenose pliers gets a better grip than tweezers. They are inexpensive so you can keep a pair in your utensil drawer just for this purpose.

texte:
Best Roast Potatoes Ever

Ingredients:
- 4 potatoes
- 4 vegetable shortening
- 3 -4 bay leaves
- sea salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 F, 200 C, gas mark 6; peel the potatoes and cut them into evenly sized halves or chunks.
2. Put the potatoes into a large saucepan, cover with cold salted water and bring to the boil; drain the water off as soon as it comes to the boil  - this step isn’t to cook the potatoes: it heats them through so they start roasting more quickly - return the potatoes to the hot pan and dry them over the heat (it is important that the potatoes are dry for roasting, otherwise they are likely to stick to the baking tray).
3. Slide a large baking tray into the oven to heat up for a few minutes, add the vegetable fat to the potatoes in the hot pan and let it melt; turn the potatoes in the melted fat until they are shiny and well coated, then tip them onto the hot baking tray.
4. Place the tray in the oven for about 45 minutes; add the bay leaves, if using, 15 minutes into the cooking time; turn and baste the potatoes a few times during cooking.
5. To serve, lift the potatoes from the baking tray with a slotted spoon, sprinkle with sea salt if desired: NOTE - if you are unable to serve the potatoes immediately, do not cover them (they’ll loose their crispiness); instead keep them warm in the oven until you are ready.

Instructions:
1. Mix yeast into warm water.

7. Cut into strips of desired length, and brush on garlic sauce.
8. Stick into a proof box for about 15 minutes. If you do not have a proof box, try to put the pans of dough in the warmest (not hot!) spot in your kitchen, such as nearby an oven. Or if you live in a hot place like Florida, put them in your car for a bit.
9. Once they grow a little, throw them into the oven at about 425°. Check on them after 10 minutes and pull them out when they turn a nice golden brown.
10. Brush more of the sauce on, lightly, and sprinkle with the grated cheese. Best enjoyed warm. :).

ingredients_reels: bananas | coconut milk | sugar | salt | mint leaf
texte:
Banana in Coconut Milk

Ingredients:
- 4 bananas
- 14 coconut milk
- 2 sugar
- 1 salt
- 1 mint leaf

Instructions:
1. Heat coconut milk until boiled.
2. Add banana, sugar and salt and cook for 5 minutes.
3. Add mint leaf and turn off the heat.

ingredients_reels: flour | sugar | salt | eggs | milk | apples | butter | sugar | cinnamon
texte:
Apfelpfannkuchen (Apple Pancakes)

Ingredients:
- 2/3 flour
- 2 sugar
- 1/4 salt
- 4 eggs
- 1/2 milk
- 2 apples
- 3/4 butter
- 2 sugar
- 1/4 cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Sift together the flour, sugar, and the salt.
2. Beat eggs and milk together.
3. Gradually add flour mixture; beat until smooth.
4. Saute apples in 1/4 c of butter until tender.
5. Mix sugar and the cinnamon together.
6. Toss with apples.
7. Melt 2 T butter in a deep frypan.
8. Pour in the batter to a depth of about 1/4-inch.
9. When set, place 1/4 of the apples on top; cover with more batter.
10. Fry pancake until lightly browned on both sides.
11. Keep warm.
12. Repeat the procedure 3 times, until all batter and apples are used.
13. Serve immediately.

ingredients_reels: dry yeast | granulated sugar | water | water | salt | polenta | all-purpose flour | milk | brown sugar
texte:
Mesa Grill Bread/Rolls

Ingredients:
- 1 dry yeast
- 1 granulated sugar
- 1/2 water
- 1 water
- 1 salt
- 1/2 polenta
- 5 1/4 all-purpose flour
- 1 milk
- 2 brown sugar

Instructions:
1. Put yeast, water and sugar in mixer bowl and let proof.
2. Meanwhile put water and salt in saucepan, bring to boil, add polenta, bring to boil again stirring, remove from heat.
3. Add flour,milk and brown sugar to yeast/water, add polenta, stir/mix/knead (depending on whether you are doing it by hand or mixer with dough hook) until it is soft as a baby's ass but a bit sticky.
4. Cover with plastic, proof for 15 minutes.
5. Form loaves/rolls, cover with towel and proof for 1/2 hour.
6. Score loaves/rolls,egg wash and sprinkle with additional polenta.
7. Bake at 350 until golden.

ingredients_reels: sugar-free instant pudding mix | soymilk
texte:
Instant Soymilk Pudding

Ingredients:
- 1 sugar-free instant pudding mix
- 1  - 1 1/2 soymilk

Instructions:
1. Empty pudding mix into a bowl.
2. Add soymilk and whisk until smooth.
3. Refrigerate until set.
4. NOTE:  Try with different flavors of pudding and soy milk!  Or, make double chocolate pudding by using chocolate pudding with chocolate soy milk.  I usually use Soy Slender, but I'm sure your favorite brand will work just fine.

ingredients_reels: extra virgin olive oil | boneless skinless chicken thighs | andouille sausage | onion | celery ribs | green bell pepper | red bell pepper | dried thyme | dried oregano | sweet paprika | salt | cayenne pepper | long grain rice | tomatoes | chicken broth | medium shrimp | fresh parsley | green onions
texte:
Chicken, Shrimp and Andouille Jambalaya

Ingredients:
- 2 extra virgin olive oil
- 1 1/2 boneless skinless chicken thighs
- 1 andouille sausage
- 1 onion
- 2 celery ribs
- 1/2 green bell pepper
- 1/2 red bell pepper
- 1/2 dried thyme
- 1/4 dried oregano
- 1/4 sweet paprika
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 - 1/2 cayenne pepper
- 1 1/2 long grain rice
- 1 tomatoes
- 2 chicken broth
- 8 medium shrimp
- 2 fresh parsley
- 3 green onions

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
2. In a large pan or Dutch oven, brown chicken in hot oil on both sides; remove and drain.
3. Add andouille, onion, celery, bell pepper, thyme, oregano, paprika, salt, and cayenne pepper to the pan, cooking and stirring for about 5 minutes until onions are tender.
4. Add rice, tomatoes with juice, and broth; bring to a boil.
5. Place rice mixture in a baking dish or oven-proof casserole; top with chicken; cover (can use foil) and bake at 350 degrees F for 40-45 minutes or until rice and chicken are done and tender.
6. Stir in shrimp, parsley, and green onions; cover and cook 5-8 minutes longer or until shrimp curl and turn bright pink and serve.

nom: Italian Sausage with Tomatoes and Penne
ingredients_reels: penne pasta | Italian sausage | beef broth | grape tomatoes | cherry tomatoes | fresh basil | green onions | olive oil
texte:
Italian Sausage with Tomatoes and Penne

Ingredients:
- 3 penne pasta
- 1 Italian sausage
- 1/2 beef broth
- 1 grape tomatoes
- 2 cherry tomatoes
- 1/4 fresh basil
- 6 green onions
- 2 olive oil

Instructions:
1. Prepare pasta according to package directions.
2. Spray a large skillet with non-stick cooking spray.
3. Over medium heat, cook sausage for 4-6 minutes or until browned.
4. Add in broth and stir; cover and cook 5 minutes.
5. Add in squash, tomatoes, and 2 tablespoons of the basil.
6. Bring to a boil, lower heat, cover and simmer 5 minutes, stir occasionally.
7. Add in onions; simmer uncovered for 1 minute.
8. Check seasoning to taste, add salt/pepper if desired.
9. In a big mixing bowl, add cooked penne, oil, and remaining basil; toss to coat.
10. Spoon pasta into individual serving plates or bowls; top with sausage mixture.
11. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese if desired.

ingredients_reels: water | steel cut oats | dried cranberries | golden raisin | maple syrup | ground cinnamon | salt | brown sugar | maple syrup | walnuts | pecans | milk
texte:
Fruited Irish Oatmeal

Ingredients:
- 5 water
- 2 steel cut oats
- 1 dried cranberries
- 1/4 golden raisin
- 1/4 maple syrup
- 1/4 ground cinnamon
- 1/4 salt
- 1 brown sugar
- 1/2 maple syrup
- walnuts
- pecans
- milk

Instructions:
1. Add the water, oats, apple juice, cranberries, raisins, apricots, 1/4 cup maple syrup, cinnamon, and salt to a 4-quart slow-cooker; stir to combine.
2. Cover and cook on LOW for 6-7 hours.
3. Serve with brown sugar or additional maple syrup, chopped nuts and milk.

ingredients_reels: banana peppers | mustard | vinegar | sugar | flour | water
texte:
Hot Mustard

Ingredients:
- 5 banana peppers
- 1 mustard
- 1 vinegar
- 6 sugar
- 1 1/2 flour
- 2 water

Instructions:
1. Puree about 5 pounds of banana peppers in a food processor.
2. Again to yield 1 quart and a cup of the final product.
3. Add mustard, vinegar, and sugar to a stockpot.
4. Cook over medium heat until dissolved.
5. Add the pepper puree, bring to a boil.
6. Meanwhile, add 1 1/2 cups of flour to 2 cups of water.
7. Whisk until dissolved-- no lumps.
8. Add to boiling pepper, vinegar, mustard, sugar mixture.
9. Return to a boil.
10. Can as suggested by manufacturer.

ingredients_reels: sausage | tomatoes | tomato sauce | onion | celery | white rice | salt | black pepper | water | black-eyed peas
texte:
Hoppin' John Soup

Ingredients:
- 1 sausage
- 1 tomatoes
- 1 tomato sauce
- 1 onion
- 1/2 celery
- 1/2 white rice
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 black pepper
- 4 water
- 1 black-eyed peas

Instructions:
1. Cook sausage, drain and crumble.
2. Place sausage in a large saucepan along with all other ingredients EXCEPT black-eyed peas.
3. Bring to a boil and let simmer about 25 minutes until rice is done.
4. Add drained peas and cook 15 more minutes.
5. Serve with your favorite cornbread.  Warmed leftovers are delicious!

ingredients_reels: boiling water | dates | butter | flour | salt | baking soda | sugar | egg | cheddar cheese | walnuts
texte:
date nut loaf

Ingredients:
- 3/4 boiling water
- 1 dates
- 2 butter
- 1 3/4 flour
- 1 salt
- 1 baking soda
- 1/2 sugar
- 1 egg
- 1 cheddar cheese
- 1 walnuts

Instructions:
1. pour boiling water over dates and butter, let it stand until cool.
2. preheat oven to 325.
3. mix the dry ingredients together, add the date mixture, egg, cheese and walnuts, mix until blended, by hand scrape into a greased loaf pan, let it sit 20 minutes.
4. bake 50-60 minutes until a toothpick inserted to center comes out dry.
5. turn out to rack to cool serve with butter.

ingredients_reels: green tomato | salt | pepper | white cornmeal | bacon drippings
texte:
Fried Green Tomatoes II

Ingredients:
- 1 green tomato
- salt
- pepper
- white cornmeal
- bacon drippings

Instructions:
1. Slice tomatoes about 1/4 inch thick, season with salt and pepper and then coat both sides with cornmeal.
2. In a large skillet, heat enough bacon drippings to coat the bottom of the pan, and fry tomatoes until lightly browned on both sides.
3. This recipe was from the back of Fannie Flagg's novel, \"Fried Green Tomatoes at the Whistle Stop Cafe\".

ingredients_reels: potatoes | onions | margarine | garlic cloves | salt | pepper | paprika
texte:
Potatoes Lyonnaise

Ingredients:
- 3 potatoes
- 2 onions
- 2 margarine
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1/2 salt
- 1/8 pepper
- 1/8 paprika

Instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a deep, 3 quart micro-safe casserole dish.
2. Cover.
3. Cook on HIGH 9-11 minute or until potatoes and onions are tender, stirring every 5 minutes.
4. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

ingredients_reels: plum tomatoes | sea salt | sugar | fresh coarse ground black pepper | crushed red pepper flakes | fennel seed | bay leaf | dried thyme | garlic | olive oil | fresh lemon juice | olive oil
texte:
Spicy Oven Dried Tomatoes

Ingredients:
- 4 plum tomatoes
- 1/4 sea salt
- 1/4 sugar
- 1 fresh coarse ground black pepper
- 1 crushed red pepper flakes
- 1 fennel seed
- 1 bay leaf
- 1 dried thyme
- 3 garlic
- 2 olive oil
- 2 fresh lemon juice
- olive oil

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 225.
2. Cut the tomatoes in half lengthwise.
3. Seed and squeeze out the excess juice without crushing the tomatoes.
4. Lay the tomatoes in a single layer, cut side up, on a baking sheet.
5. In a small bowl, combine all the spice ingredients and the lemon juice.
6. Sprinkle the tomatoes with the spice mixture.
7. Drizzle or spray the tomatoes with a small amount of olive oil.
8. Bake in the oven for 8 hours or overnight, or until the tomatoes are medium-dry.
9. Remove from the oven, cool completely and serve.
10. To store, transfer the tomatoes into a jar, and pour over a thin layer of olive oil to seal the top.
11. Cover tightly with the jar lid.
12. Will keep for about 3 weeks in the refrigerator.

nom: Baby Bella and Green Bean Salad
ingredients_reels: fresh green beans | garlic cloves | red wine vinegar | Dijon mustard | coarse salt | fresh ground black pepper | olive oil | green onions | baby portabella mushrooms | fresh parsley
texte:
Baby Bella and Green Bean Salad

Ingredients:
- 1 fresh green beans
- 3 garlic cloves
- 2 red wine vinegar
- 1 Dijon mustard
- 1/2 coarse salt
- fresh ground black pepper
- 1/4 olive oil
- 4 green onions
- 1/2 baby portabella mushrooms
- 2 fresh parsley

Instructions:
1. Heat salted water in a large saucepan until boiling; cook the beans until tender, about 7 minutes.  Drain beans; set aside to cool.
2. Whisk together the garlic, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper to taste in a small bowl; slowly whisk in the olive oil, adding in a steady stream, until smooth.
3. Combine the reserved beans, green onions, mushrooms and parsley in a large bowl.  Pour dressing over vegetables; toss lightly.
4. Chill 30 minutes before serving.

ingredients_reels: carrots | butter | margarine | onion | flour | salt | pepper | prepared mustard | milk | cheddar cheese | butter | margarine
texte:
Potluck Cheesy Carrot Casserole

Ingredients:
- 12 carrots
- 1/4 butter
- 1/2 margarine
- 1/4 onion
- 1 flour
- 1/4 salt
- 1/4 pepper
- 1 prepared mustard
- 2 milk
- 8 cheddar cheese
- 2 butter
- 1/2 margarine

Instructions:
1. Cook carrots in salted water until tender.  You should have 6 cups.  Drain.
2. Melt first amount of butter in saucepan.  Add onion and saute until clear and soft.
3. Mix in flour, sailt, pepper and celery salt.
4. Stir in mustard and milk until it boils and thickens.
5. Layer in 2 litre casserole as follows:  1/2 carrots, 1/2 cheese slices, 1/2 carrots, 1/2 cheese slices, all of the sauce.
6. Melt second amount of butter in small saucepan.  Stir in crumbs.
7. Spread over all.
8. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees F for 25 - 30 minutes until browned and heated through.

ingredients_reels: water | butter | margarine | flour | sugar | eggs | sour cream | baking soda | salt | butter | margarine | milk | powdered sugar | vanilla | pecan halves
texte:
Swiss Chocolate Squares & Icing

Ingredients:
- 1 water
- 1/2 butter
- 1 1/2 margarine
- 2 flour
- 2 sugar
- 2 eggs
- 1/2 sour cream
- 1 baking soda
- 1/2 salt
- 1/2 butter
- 6 margarine
- 1 1/2 milk
- 4 1/2 powdered sugar
- 1 vanilla
- pecan halves

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
2. Combine water, butter and chocolate in saucepan; bring to a boil.
3. Remove from heat.  Mix together flour and sugar.
4. Stir in flour and sugar.
5. Add eggs, sour cream, baking soda and salt.  Mix well.
6. Pour into greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 jelly roll pan.
7. Bake at 375 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes.
8. Frost while warm with milk chocolate frosting.
9. Cool.
10. Cut into squares.
11. For the Frosting:   Combine butter, chocolate and milk in saucepan.
12. Boil 1 minute.  Remove from heat.  Add sugar.
13. Beat until smooth.
14. Stir in vanilla.
15. Spread on squares.
16. Garnish with pecan halves if desired.

ingredients_reels: extra firm tofu | fresh oregano | fresh parsley | garlic | hot red pepper flakes | white wine vinegar | extra virgin olive oil | salt
texte:
Grilled Tofu with Chimichurri

Ingredients:
- 16 extra firm tofu
- 2 fresh oregano
- 1 fresh parsley
- 2 garlic
- 1/4 hot red pepper flakes
- 3 white wine vinegar
- 2 extra virgin olive oil
- salt

Instructions:
1. Cut tofu block in half to get 2 pieces of 1/2 inch tofu from the 1 inch block.
2. With the 2 pieces still together, slice them both in half width wise, then cut the halves in half to get 8 1/2 inch thick pieces.
3. Blot the cut tofu dry between paper towels.
4. In a food processor or spice mill, grind the oregano, parsley, garlic, and pepper flakes until finely minced.
5. Add the vinegar and 1 tbsp oil to the spice mixture and blend until a rough sauce forms.
6. Transfer spice mixture to a bowl and season with salt to taste.
7. Brush tofu slices with remaining tbsp of olive oil, then grill over medium flame or in a grill pan on medium high heat for about 5 minutes per side.
8. Plate the tofu slices after grilling and spoon sauce over grilled pieces just before serving.

nom: Apple Dip        (It's Not Just for Apples Anymore)
ingredients_reels: cream cheese | marshmallow creme | cinnamon
texte:
Apple Dip        (It's Not Just for Apples Anymore)

Ingredients:
- 1 cream cheese
- 1 marshmallow creme
- 1/4 cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Let cream cheese soften just slightly at room temperature.
2. With a mixer, combine cream cheese and marshmallow creme until smooth.
3. Add cinnamon and stir.
4. Refrigerate until serving.

ingredients_reels: shortening | granulated sugar | vanilla | eggs | all-purpose flour | baking powder | baking soda | sour cream | butter | light brown sugar | cinnamon | pecans | golden raisins | chocolate pieces
texte:
Coffee Cake Goldmine

Ingredients:
- 1/2 shortening
- 3/4 granulated sugar
- 1 vanilla
- 3 eggs
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 1 baking powder
- 1 baking soda
- 1 sour cream
- 6 butter
- 1 light brown sugar
- 2 cinnamon
- 3/4 pecans
- 3 golden raisins
- 3 chocolate pieces

Instructions:
1. For the topping: Cream butter, brown sugar and cinnamon together.
2. Stir in pecans, raisins and chocolate pieces, and mix well then set aside.
3. For the cake: Cream shortening.
4. Add sugar, beating until light.
5. Add vanilla.
6. Beat in eggs, one at a time, beating well after each egg.
7. Sift together the flour, baking soda and baking powder.
8. Stir in flour mixture alternately with sour cream, beating well after each addition.
9. Place 1/2 of the batter mixture into a greased and lined (bottom) 10 inch tube pan.
10. Sprinkle with 1/2 of the topping mixture, then add second 1/2 of batter mixture and sprinkle the top evenly with the remaining topping.
11. Bake at 350 deg.
12. for 50 minutes until tester comes out clean.
13. Cool on a rack in the pan, and when cool invert onto a plate to serve.

ingredients_reels: mayonnaise | chili sauce | butter | margarine | corned beef | corned beef | swiss cheese | sauerkraut
texte:
A Better Reuben Sandwich

Ingredients:
- 1/4 mayonnaise
- 2 chili sauce
- 1 butter
- 8 margarine
- 2 corned beef
- 12 corned beef
- 8 swiss cheese
- 3/4 sauerkraut

Instructions:
1. Combine mayonnaise, chili sauce and horseradish in a small bowl; set aside.
2. Spread one side of each slice of bread with butter.
3. Generously spread the mayonnaise mixture on the other side of each slice of bread Place 1 slice of cheese on 4 slices of bread on top of the mayonnaise spread.
4. Arrange corned beef over cheese.
5. Top corned beef with saurkraut.
6. Place another slice of cheese over the saurkraut.
7. Close sandwiches with the rest of the prepared bread, mayo side down and butter side up.
8. Cook on a pre-heated griddle or large skillet over medium-low heat for 4 or 5 minutes per side until bread is toasted and cheese is melted.

ingredients_reels: cucumber | onions | sugar | cider vinegar | mustard seeds | celery seeds | turmeric | salt
texte:
Refrigerator Pickles

Ingredients:
- cucumber
- 3 onions
- 4 sugar
- 4 cider vinegar
- 1 1/2 mustard seeds
- 1 1/2 celery seeds
- 1 1/2 turmeric
- 1/3 salt

Instructions:
1. Slice and layer cucumbers and onion in a gallon jar.
2. Mix remaining ingredients in a large pan and bring to a boil.
3. Carefully pour over cucumbers and onions.
4. Cool.
5. Stir.
6. Keep in fridge.

ingredients_reels: water | granulated sugar | fresh lemon juice | rose water
texte:
Blushing Rose Lemonade

Ingredients:
- 5 1/3 water
- 1 granulated sugar
- 1 1/3 fresh lemon juice
- 2 1/2 - 3 1/2 rose water

Instructions:
1. Combine water and sugar in a saucepan and heat over medium-low heat, stirring just until the sugar has dissolved.
2. Remove from heat and let cool.
3. Add to pitcher and stir in lemon juice.
4. Add rose water to taste.
5. Chill well before serving.

ingredients_reels: cooked rice | yellow bell peppers | red bell peppers | green beans | spring onions | onion | carrots | coriander leaves | fresh parsley leaves | mushrooms | olive oil | canola oil | salt | black pepper | coriander powder | cumin powder | low sodium soy sauce
texte:
Rice Salad

Ingredients:
- 3 cooked rice
- 2 yellow bell peppers
- 2 red bell peppers
- 1 green beans
- 2 spring onions
- 1 onion
- 2 carrots
- 1 coriander leaves
- 10 fresh parsley leaves
- 1 1/2 mushrooms
- 1 olive oil
- 1 canola oil
- 1 salt
- 1/2 black pepper
- 2 coriander powder
- 1 1/2 cumin powder
- low sodium soy sauce

Instructions:
1. Heat oil in a big pan on high flame.
2. When heated, add all the chopped vegetables except coriander/parsley leaves.
3. Sauté for 2-3 minutes on high flame.
4. Add salt, black pepper powder, coriander powder, cumin powder and soy sauce.
5. Turn off the heat.
6. Allow the mixture to cool down at least to the room temperature.
7. Take a big salad bowl.
8. Put rice in the same.
9. Add the cooled mixture.
10. Add finely chopped coriander/parsley leaves.
11. Add the lemon juice and mix thoroughly.
12. Serve cold.
13. You can decorate the same with lemon wedges, diced tomatoes and mixture of coarsely crushed salted peanuts and walnuts.

ingredients_reels: butter | baking powder | flour | cinnamon | milk | sugar | egg | vanilla extract | banana
texte:
Breadless French Toast

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 1/4 baking powder
- 1/2 flour
- 1 -2 cinnamon
- 1/2 milk
- 1 -2 sugar
- 1 -2 egg
- 1 vanilla extract
- 1 banana

Instructions:
1. pre-heat oven to 425.
2. Put butter into pan (I used an 11x8 pan for 2 servings) and put pan in oven until butter is melted, then remove.
3. Mix flour, baking and cinnamon together. Add milk and mix well.
4. Add egg (one at a time if you are using more than 1 egg) and then add sugar and mix well.
5. Add vanilla. Cut up a banana into what ever size pieces you would like (I did slices in half), fold banana pieces into mixture.
6. Pour mixture into pan and bake for 15-20 minutes depending on how many eggs you used.
7. I topped mine with powdered sugar.

nom: Super Easy Stove Top Stuffing Meatloaf
ingredients_reels: hamburger meat | eggs | Stove Top stuffing mix | beef broth | salt | ketchup
texte:
Super Easy Stove Top Stuffing Meatloaf

Ingredients:
- 2 hamburger meat
- 2 eggs
- 6 Stove Top stuffing mix
- 1 beef broth
- 1/4 salt
- 1/4 - 1/2 ketchup

Instructions:
1. In a large mixing bowl put the hamburger meat, eggs, stuffing, broth and salt.
2. Mix well.
3. Place the mixture in a bread loaf pan.
4. Bake at 350F for 60-70 minutes, or until done.
5. The last 15 minutes of cooking, spread the ketchup on top of the meatloaf.
6. If you don't want to use ketchup, put a can of condensed cream of mushroom soup on top of the meatloaf right before you put it in the oven.

ingredients_reels: burrito-size flour tortillas | butter | parmesan cheese | paprika | curry powder
texte:
Tortilla Stars

Ingredients:
- 8 burrito-size flour tortillas
- 1/4 butter
- 3/4 parmesan cheese
- 1 paprika
- curry powder

Instructions:
1. Place oven rack in middle position. Heat to 400°F Coat baking sheet(s) with non-stick cooking spray. Have ready 3 inch and 2 inch star cookie cutters.
2. Working with 1 tortilla at a time, brush one side with butter; sprinkle with cheese. Gently press to adhere. Turn tortilla over, brush with egg white and sprinkle with 2 to 2 1/2 teaspoons of a topping.
3. Cut 3 inch stars from edge of tortilla, 2 inch stars from center (bake scraps for snacks). Place cheese side down on baking sheet(s).
4. Bake on middle oven rack 6 to 8 minutes until light golden and crisp.
5. Remove to wire rack to cool.

ingredients_reels: sun-dried tomatoes | garlic clove | fresh parsley | cream cheese
texte:
Sun-Dried Tomato and Parsley Dip

Ingredients:
- 4 sun-dried tomatoes
- 1 garlic clove
- 1/2 fresh parsley
- 150 cream cheese

Instructions:
1. In a tall bowl combine all the ingredients. Blend together using a hand-held blender. Alternatively you could also use a food processor or blender.
2. Enjoy!

ingredients_reels: ground beef | onion | tomato sauce | chili powder | Worcestershire sauce
texte:
Old-Time Hot Dog Sauce

Ingredients:
- 1/2 ground beef
- 1 onion
- 1 tomato sauce
- 1 chili powder
- 1/2 Worcestershire sauce

Instructions:
1. In a large skillet, saute ground beef and onion over medium heat, stirring often, until beef is browned.  Add tomato sauce, chili powder, and Worcestershire sauce.  Bring mixture to a boil, lower heat, and simmer for 10 minutes.
2. NOTE:  For a real taste treat, place cooked hot dogs on rolls and top with sauce;  you should have enough for about 10.  Add your favorite regular toppings, too.  To make the sauce taste as if it came from a New York pushcart, add a little cinnamon.  Oregano will give it a Greek or Italian flavor and a teaspoon of ground cumin will make it an authentic chili dog.

ingredients_reels: bacon | butter | onion | potatoes | eggs | salt | black pepper | milk
texte:
Bauernfruhstuck

Ingredients:
- 6 bacon
- 1 butter
- 1 onion
- 4 potatoes
- 6 eggs
- 1/2 salt
- black pepper
- 1/4 milk

Instructions:
1. Fry the bacon until crisp. Remove and drain on paper towel. Remove bacon fat from pan, add the butter and saute the chopped onion until soft.
2. Add the potatoes and brown lightly.
3. Beat the eggs lightly and add the salt, pepper, milk and finally the bacon (chopped).
4. Pour the egg mixture over the onions and potatoes and stir occasionally until cooked.

ingredients_reels: cocoa powder | sugar | butter | eggs | vanilla | chocolate chips
texte:
Fast & Easy Chocolate Brownies

Ingredients:
- 1 cocoa powder
- 2 sugar
- 1/2 butter
- 4 eggs
- 2 vanilla
- chocolate chips

Instructions:
1. Mix all ingredients well.
2. Put mixture in greased pan.
3. Bake in oven for 20 minutes at 300°F.

ingredients_reels: water | water | rice wine | cider vinegar | Dijon mustard | olive oil | dried dill weed | chives
texte:
New Potatoes With Dijon Vinaigrette

Ingredients:
- 11 water
- 2 water
- 1/4 rice wine
- 3 cider vinegar
- 2 Dijon mustard
- 1 olive oil
- 1/2 dried dill weed
- 1 chives

Instructions:
1. MICROWAVE DIRECTIONS:.
2. With potato peeler, remove strip of peel from around center of each potato.
3. In 2-quart casserole, combine potatoes and 2 tablespoons water; cover tightly.
4. Microwave on high 8 to 10 minutes or until tender, stirring once 1/2 way through cooking.
5. Drain well.
6. DIJON VINAIGRETTE:.
7. In a small bowl, combine all vinaigrette ingredients; blend well.
8. Pour over potatoes; toss to coat.
9. Let stand 10 to 15 minutes or until serving time.
10. Just before serving, toss potatoes again.
11. Serve warm or at room temperature, spooning vinaigrette over potatoes.
12. CONVENTIONAL DIRECTIONS:.
13. With potato peeler, remove strip of peel from around center of each potato.
14. Place potatoes in medium saucepan; add enough water to cover.
15. Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to low; simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.
16. Drain well.
17. Continue as directed above.

ingredients_reels: eggs | flax seed | ricotta cheese | baking powder | salt
texte:
Helen's High-Protein Low-Carb Pancakes

Ingredients:
- 3 eggs
- 1/4 flax seed
- 1/2 ricotta cheese
- 1 baking powder
- 1/2 salt

Instructions:
1. Mix all ingredients together and stir well.  (Optional: You may also add one packet of artificial sweetener if you are accustomed to recipes that call for sugar.).
2. Spoon onto preheated, oiled griddle and cook as usual.
3. Serve with butter and low-carb syrup, or sour cream and berries.
4. Note: If you want the batter a little thinner, stir in water, 1 tablespoon at a time.  Batter will thicken as it sits, so if you refrigerate it till the next day, you will probably need to thin it.  If the batter is too thin, stir in a little more flax.
5. Also note: Flax seed should always be fresh ground (keep a dedicated coffee grinder for this purpose) or stored in the freezer.  You may use either regular (brown) flax, or golden flax, which produces a lighter texture and color.  You can often get it in bulk bins at your health food store for a great price.

Cranberry & White Chocolate Cluster Squares

texte:

ingredients_reels: dry yeast | salt | sugar | all-purpose white flour | water | olive oil
texte:
Greek Pita Bread

Ingredients:
- 2 1/4 dry yeast
- 2 salt
- 1 sugar
- 4 all-purpose white flour
- 1 1/2 water
- 1 olive oil

Instructions:
1. Combine the yeast and sugar in a small bowl, add 1/2 cup of the warm water and let it stand for 10 minutes to proof and ferment it.
2. Dissolve the salt in the remaining warm water.
3. Put the flour in a large mixing bowl, making a well in the middle and put the dissolved yeast and salt water into it.
4. With your hands, blend it into a dough.
5. You may need a bit more or less water depending on your flour.
6. Knead the dough in the bowl with your fists for 10-15 minutes or until it is smooth.
7. Pour the oil over the dough and knead it again until the oil is absorbed.
8. Cover the dough in the bowl with a towel and set it in a draft free area to rise to double it's bulk (1-2 hours), then punch it down and knead it again for a few minutes.
9. Preheat your oven to 350°F.
10. Cut pieces of dough, egg size or larger, depending on the size of the pita desired, shape them into balls with your hands and roll them out over a lightly floured board or pastry cloth to 1/4 inch thickness.
11. Set 2 or 3 pites on a lightly oiled cookies sheet and bake them on the lower rack 2 to 3 minutes each side.
12. Pitas should be white and soft.
13. Wrap the baked pitas in a clean towel until they are cool, then store them in plastic bags to prevent them from drying out.
14. When you are ready to use them, heat a bit of oil in a shallow skillet and fry them a minute or so on each side, or until golden brown.
15. Use them immediately, because they get hard when they dry out.
