3. Pour olive oil in large 4 quart glass casserole dish with lid.
4. Put the vegetables in dish.
5. In small saucepan heat the water and chicken boullion cubes or chicken base to make chicken broth. Bring to a boil.
6. Pour broth over the vegetables.
7. Add chili powder and lemon peel, lemon juice and stir.
8. Cover, bake 20 minutes.
9. Check and stir once during the cooking time.
10. Add fish or chicken fillets on top.
11. Bake 20 minutes turning the fillets once.
12. Place thick fish fillets on top,not thin or they may break apart. Vegetable broth may be used to serve over rice or potatoes. Serve in the baking dish.

ingredients_reels: boneless chicken breast | butter | Worcestershire sauce | Dijon mustard | spicy brown mustard
texte:
Crispy Onion Dijon Chicken

Ingredients:
- 1  - 1 1/2 boneless chicken breast
- 1/2 butter
- 1 Worcestershire sauce
- 2 Dijon mustard
- 1 spicy brown mustard

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Just melt, don't cook, butter in small saucepan or microwave.
3. Add worcestershire sauce and mustard.
4. Dip chicken in butter mixture and coat well with crushed onions.
5. Place in baking dish and bake for 45 minutes or until juices run clear.

ingredients_reels: bacon | dark brown sugar | ginger | clove | cinnamon
texte:
Chagrin Falls Bacon

Ingredients:
- 1 bacon
- 1/4 dark brown sugar
- 1/4 ginger
- 1/4 clove
- 1/4 cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Take a baking pan and line it with foil.  Then place a rack on the foil and set aside.
2. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
3. Mix together the brown sugar and spices in a bowl.
4. Cut the bacon in half so each original piece is now 2 pieces.
5. Dredge the bacon pieces in the brown sugar mixture, coating well.
6. Put each piece of bacon on the rack.
7. Cook for 20-30 minutes.
8. Use tongs to remove from the rack (they will be VERY hot!) and place on wax paper to cool.
9. Can be frozen.

ingredients_reels: apples | cranberry sauce | oats | margarine | brown sugar
texte:
Cranberry Crunch

Ingredients:
- 2 apples
- 1 cranberry sauce
- 1 oats
- 2 margarine
- 1/3 brown sugar

Instructions:
1. Mix cranberries and apples and place on bottom of ovenproof dish (approximately 8x8).
2. Melt margarine in microwave-safe bowl.
3. Add oats and brown sugar and mix well.
4. Pour on top of cranberry-apple mixture.
5. Do not pat down.
6. Bake at 350 for 30-45 minutes.
7. Serve warm or cold.

ingredients_reels: sugar | ground cinnamon | flour | baking soda | salt | dark brown sugar | sugar | salted butter | eggs | pure vanilla extract
texte:
Cinnamon Sugar Butter Cookies

Ingredients:
- 3 sugar
- 1 ground cinnamon
- 2 1/2 flour
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1/4 salt
- 1 dark brown sugar
- 1/2 sugar
- 1 salted butter
- 2 eggs
- 2 pure vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 300°F
2. In a small bowl combine sugar and cinnamon for topping; set aside.
3. In a medium bowl combine flour, soda and salt. Mix well with a wire whisk; set aside.
4. In a large bowl blend sugars with an electric mixer set at medium speed.
5. Add the butter and mix to form a grainy paste. Scrape sides of bowl, then add eggs and vanilla extract.
6. Mix at medium speed until light and fluffy. Add the flour mixture and blend at low speed just until combined. DO NOT OVERMIX.
7. Shape dough into 1-inch balls and roll each ball in cinnamon-sugar topping.
8. Place on ungreased cookie sheets, 2-inches apart.
9. Bake for 18-20 minutes or until done.
10. Immediately transfer cookies with a spatula to a cool, flat surface.
11. (I'm not sure of the yield, so I've just included an estimate).

ingredients_reels: frozen corn kernels | milk | flour | cornmeal | egg | salt | pepper | butter
texte:
Corn Oysters

Ingredients:
- 2 frozen corn kernels
- 1/4 milk
- 1/3 flour
- 1 cornmeal
- 1/2 egg
- 1/4 salt
- 2 pepper
- 2 butter

Instructions:
1. Put the frozen corn in a colander. Rinse it until the ice crystals melt.
2. Pour the corn into a bowl.
3. Stir in the milk, flour or corn meal, salt, and pepper.
4. Lay paper towels on top of a plate and set it aside.
5. Set a skillet over medium-high heat on the stove.
6. Heat the butter and oil in the skillet until the butter is melted.
7. Put tablespoon-fulls of batter in the hot skillet.
8. Cook until golden-brown. Repeat with the other side.
9. Drain the oysters on the paper towels and cover with foil to keep them warm.
10. Repeat with the others and serve hot.

ingredients_reels: brewed coffee | Stolichnaya vodka | Kahlua | Creme de Cacao | half-and-half | sugar
texte:
Frigid Russian

Ingredients:
- 4 brewed coffee
- 1 Stolichnaya vodka
- 1 Kahlua
- 1 Creme de Cacao
- 1 half-and-half
- 1 sugar

Instructions:
1. Prepare coffee ahead and freeze in an ice cube tray.
2. In a blender, combine vodka, Kahlua, creme de cacao, cream, and sugar.
3. Blend to mix very well.
4. Add the frozen coffee cubes and blend until the drink is smooth.

nom: Six Layer Dessert -My Version of Sex in a Pan
ingredients_reels: graham cracker crumbs | pecans | brown sugar | butter | margarine | cream cheese | Cool Whip | instant pudding mix | milk
texte:
Six Layer Dessert -My Version of Sex in a Pan

Ingredients:
- 1  - 1 1/2 graham cracker crumbs
- 1/2 pecans
- 1/4 brown sugar
- 1/4 - 1/2 butter
- 8 margarine
- 1 cream cheese
- 3 Cool Whip
- 4 1/2 instant pudding mix
- milk

Instructions:
1. In bowl, mix graham crumbs,pecans,brown sugar and melted butter.
2. Press into 9x13 pan.
3. Bake at 350°F for about 5-10 minutes, until lightly browned.
4. Cool.
5. iIn bowl-fold in whipped cream to cream cheese.
6. Spread on cooled crust.
7. Place in refrigerator.
8. In 3 separate bowls mix each pudding, using 1 1/2 cup of milk per pudding instead of the 2 cups the box asks for.
9. Spread each layer of pudding on top of the cheese layer,careful to not blend the puddings.
10. Generously sprinkle the top with skor crumbs.
11. ENJOY!

ingredients_reels: butter | margarine | light brown sugar | egg | all-purpose flour | ground cardamom | ground cinnamon | baking powder | baking soda | salt | applesauce | golden raisin
texte:
Oatmeal Raisin Applesauce Muffins

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 3/4 margarine
- 1 light brown sugar
- 1 egg
- 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1 ground cardamom
- 1/4 ground cinnamon
- 1/4 baking powder
- 3/4 baking soda
- 1/2 salt
- 1 applesauce
- 1/2 golden raisin

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 350°; grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
2. In a mixing bowl, cream the butter and brown sugar together until light and fluffy.
3. Add in the egg; beat well.
4. In another mixing bowl, combine the flour, cardamom, baking powder, baking soda, and salt; stir to combine.
5. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture alternately with applesauce; blend well.
6. Fold in raisins, oats, and nuts.
7. Spoon batter into prepared muffin tin, filling 3/4 full.
8. Bake for 25-30 minutes; let cool, then remove from pan; may sprinkle with icing sugar, if desired.

ingredients_reels: rice | water | salt | butter | powdered sugar | ground cinnamon
texte:
Sweet Rice With Cinnamon (Roz Mafooar)

Ingredients:
- 1 1/3 rice
- 2 2/3 water
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 butter
- 1/4 powdered sugar
- ground cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Heat rice, water, and salt to boiling, stirring once or twice.
2. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 14 minutes. Remove from heat.
3. Fluff rice lightly with fork, then cover and let steam 5-10 minutes.
4. Stir in butter and powdered sugar.
5. Sprinkle with cinnamon and serve warm.

nom: Roasted Potatoes With Whole Garlic and Rosemary
ingredients_reels: potatoes | garlic | fresh rosemary | extra virgin olive oil | salt | fresh ground black pepper
texte:
Roasted Potatoes With Whole Garlic and Rosemary

Ingredients:
- 6 potatoes
- 1 garlic
- 1 fresh rosemary
- 1/4 extra virgin olive oil
- salt
- fresh ground black pepper

Instructions:
1. Bring 4 quarts water to boil.  Preheat oven to 425ºF.
2. Cut potatoes into 1-inch cubes and blanch 2 minutes in boiling water.  Remove and drain.  Place on baking sheet and add garlic, rosemary and olive oil.  Season with salt and fresh pepper and place in oven for 30 to 40 minutes, until golden-brown.  Remove and serve immediately.

nom: Honey, Mustard and Rosemary Roast Pork
ingredients_reels: beer | Dijon mustard | honey | olive oil | fresh rosemary | dried rosemary | garlic | boneless pork loin roast
texte:
Honey, Mustard and Rosemary Roast Pork

Ingredients:
- 3/4 beer
- 1/2 Dijon mustard
- 6 honey
- 1/4 olive oil
- 2 fresh rosemary
- 2 dried rosemary
- 2 garlic
- 1/2 boneless pork loin roast

Instructions:
1. Whisk first 6 ingredients to blend in 8x8x2-inch glass baking dish. Add pork and turn to coat. Let stand at room temperature 1 hour or cover and refrigerate overnight, turning occasionally.
2. Preheat oven to 350°F Transfer pork to rack set in roasting pan; reserve marinade. Roast until thermometer inserted into center registers 150°F., about 55 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes.
3. Strain marinade into heavy medium saucepan. Add cream and juices from roasting pan. Boil sauce until reduced to 1 1/2 cups, about 15 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
4. Slice pork; arrange on platter. Drizzle some sauce over. Serve, passing extra sauce separately.
5. Serves 4 to 6.

nom: Easy Boneless Pork Chop With an Amazing Flavour.
ingredients_reels: boneless pork chops | applesauce | butter | sage | rosemary | garlic clove | olive oil | apple | salt | pepper
texte:
Easy Boneless Pork Chop With an Amazing Flavour.

Ingredients:
- 4 boneless pork chops
- 3 applesauce
- 100 butter
- 1 sage
- 1 rosemary
- 1 garlic clove
- 2 olive oil
- 1 apple
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 pepper

Instructions:
1. First you need to make the spread/coating, as this is where all the flavours will come from. Start by mixing the butter, apple sauce and oil together.
2. Finely chop the rosemary and sage if using fresh herbs. Add to the mixture.
3. Crush the garlic clove. Add to the mixture.
4. Season the spread with salt and pepper.
5. The coating needs to be of quite a stiff consistency so you can coat the meat well, the instructions here should make it well but if it is not quite stiff enough, blend a little more butter into it.
6. Take the pork and score the meat with lines all over.
7. Place each chop on its own piece of foil - enough so it can be wrapped tightly when ready.
8. Smear the coating all over the meat, massaging it in, generously.
9. Wrap in foil tightly and place in the oven on gas mark 4/170C for 30 minutes.
10. Remove from the oven and allow time for foil to cool slightly, open up the parcels and place 2 wedges of the chopped bramley apple on each piece of meat.
11. If the meat is looking a little dry then add more spread/covering. Wrap again and return to the oven. I usually allow an extra 30 minutes but be sure to check the meat through the whole duration to prevent burning or over cooking.
12. Serve when ready with your favourite side dish - honey roasted parsnips and roast potatoes are my favourite.

ingredients_reels: butter | light brown sugar | molasses | egg | all-purpose flour | baking powder | salt | ground ginger | ground cinnamon | ground allspice | powdered sugar | butter | vanilla extract | milk | ground nutmeg
texte:
Old-Fashioned Gingerbread

Ingredients:
- 8 butter
- 1/2 light brown sugar
- 1/2 molasses
- 1 egg
- 2 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1 baking powder
- 1/2 salt
- 1 ground ginger
- 1 ground cinnamon
- 1/2 ground allspice
- 2 powdered sugar
- 1/3 butter
- 1 vanilla extract
- 2 milk
- 1 ground nutmeg

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Cream together butter and sugar, then beat in molasses and egg.
3. Mix all dry ingredients together in a separate bowl.
4. Add the dry ingredients to the creamed butter/sugar mixture and mix until well blended.
5. Cover and refrigerate for one hour.
6. Roll out dough on a lightly floured surface to about a 3/4-inch thickness.
7. Cut into 3-inch squares, or use your choice of cookie cutters to cut out shapes.
8. Place on cookie sheets and bake 7-8 minutes.
9. Transfer to a rack to cool completely.
10. If you plan to ice your gingerbread, prepare the icing now.
11. Mix all icing ingredients together in a small bowl until smooth.

ingredients_reels: flour | baking powder | salt | sugar | eggs | butter | milk
texte:
The Best Ever Waffles

Ingredients:
- 1 1/3 flour
- 4 baking powder
- 1/2 salt
- 2 sugar
- 2 eggs
- 1/2 butter
- 1 3/4 milk

Instructions:
1. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together all dry ingredients.
2. Separate the eggs, adding the yolks to the dry ingredient mixture, and placing the whites in a small mixing bowl.
3. Beat whites until moderately stiff; set aside.
4. Add milk and melted butter to dry ingredient mixture and blend.
5. Fold stiff egg whites into mixture.
6. Ladle mixture into hot waffle iron and bake.

ingredients_reels: apples | water | sugar | cinnamon
texte:
Chunky Applesauce

Ingredients:
- 6 apples
- 1/3 water
- 1/2 sugar
- 3/4 cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Put all ingredients in crockpot.
2. Cover and cook on low 8 hours.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | salt | dried yeast | warm water
texte:
Gary Rhodes - Homemade Crumpets

Ingredients:
- 4 all-purpose flour
- 2 salt
- 2 dried yeast
- 2 1/2 warm water

Instructions:
1. Sift together the flour and salt.
2. Mix the yeast with a few tablespoons of the warm water.
3. Whisk three-quarters of the remaining warm water into the flour and then add the yeasty liquid.
4. Cover and leave in a warm place until the mixture has risen.
5. Once risen, check the consistency.
6. If the batter is very thick, loosen with the remaining water.
7. The batter should now be left to stand for 8-10 minutes.
8. Warm a non-stick frying pan on a low heat.
9. Butter some crumpet rings or small tartlet rings.
10. Place the rings into the frying pan and pour in some of the batter until half-full (1/4 to 1/2 inches deep).
11. Cook on a low heat until small holes appear and the top has started to dry.
12. The bottom of the crumpet will now be golden and it can be turned over and cooked for another minute.
13. The crumpets are now ready for lots of melting butter!
14. Note: The crumpets can be cooked without turning - simply cook until the tops are completely dry.
15. The finely grated zest of 1 lemon can also be added to the batter to give a lemon bite.

ingredients_reels: beef roast | garlic cloves | butter | molasses | ketchup | brown sugar | lemon juice | onions
texte:
BBQ Beef on a Bun

Ingredients:
- 2 -3 beef roast
- 3 garlic cloves
- 2 butter
- 2 molasses
- 2 ketchup
- 1/4 brown sugar
- 1 lemon juice
- 4 onions

Instructions:
1. Cook roast in oven with garlic, 1 c water some salt,and pepper on 325 for 3-4 hours till falls apart tender.
2. In a sauce pan brown onions in butter. Lower heat and add ketchup till bubbling.
3. Add brown sugar and molasses, taste to check if there is enough brown sugar. If not add  1T-2T more.
4. Add lemon juice and cook for about 10 more minutes.  Add meat and cook 10 min more.
5. Serve over buns or rolls with cheddar cheese and onion slices if desired.

ingredients_reels: ground beef | onion | water | ketchup | Worcestershire sauce | paprika | sugar | salt | ground mustard | garlic powder | all-purpose flour | cold water | mashed potatoes
texte:
Hamburger Goulash

Ingredients:
- 2 1/2 ground beef
- 1 onion
- 2 water
- 3/4 ketchup
- 2 Worcestershire sauce
- 2 paprika
- 1 -2 sugar
- 1 salt
- 1/2 ground mustard
- 1/4 garlic powder
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 1/4 cold water
- mashed potatoes

Instructions:
1. In a Dutch oven, cook beef and onion ove rmedium heat until meat it no longer pink; drain.
2. Add the next 8 ingredients.  Bring to a boil.
3. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 20 minutes.
4. In a bowl, combine flour and cold water until smooth; stir into the meat mixture.  Bring to a boil.
5. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.
6. Serve or noodles or mashed potatoes.

ingredients_reels: flour | cornmeal | salt | powdered milk | baking powder
texte:
Cornbread  Jar Mix

Ingredients:
- 1 flour
- 1 cornmeal
- 1 salt
- 1/3 powdered milk
- 1 baking powder

Instructions:
1. Sift ingredients together and put into a bag.
2. Label: Put dry ingredients into mixing bowl.
3. In small bowl, combine 1 cup water, 1 egg, and 1/3 cup oil.
4. Stir into dry ingredients and mix well.
5. Pour into a well-buttered pie plate.
6. Bake at 425 degrees for 25 minutes, or until golden.

ingredients_reels: dates | water | plain flour | butter | rose water | water | icing sugar
texte:
Ma'amoul (Lebanese Date Stuffed Pastries)

Ingredients:
- 8 dates
- 1/4 water
- 8 plain flour
- 4 butter
- 2 rose water
- 2 water
- icing sugar

Instructions:
1. Combine the dates and 1/4 cup water in a jsmall pan over a gentle heat and cook until softened, then set aside to cool.
2. Sift the flour into a bowl, and add the diced, chilled butter and rub the butter into the flour until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
3. Combine the orange-blossom water or rose water with the 2 tablespoons of water and sprinkle over the flour; then mix into the flour using a round-bladed knife.  Cover the dough and rest for approximately 30 minutes.
4. Take a spoonful of dough and shape into a round, make a hollow with your finger and spoon a little of the date stuffing into the hollow, then seal the opening and reshape into a round.
5. Continue until the dough runs out.
6. Place the pastries on a lightly greased baking sheet, cover loosely with foil and bake in a pre-heated moderate oven (180°C; 350°F) for 20-25 minutes.  Remove the foil about halfway through the cooking, but keep an eye on them to ensure that they do not brown.
7. Remove and cool on wire racks until firm.
8. When thoroughly cooled, roll in sifted icing sugar.

ingredients_reels: apple butter | cinnamon | clove | water | canola oil | brown sugar | eggs | all-purpose flour | baking soda | salt
texte:
Apple Butter Bread

Ingredients:
- 3/4 apple butter
- 2 cinnamon
- 1/2 clove
- 1/2 water
- 1/2 canola oil
- 1 1/4 brown sugar
- 2 eggs
- 1 3/4 all-purpose flour
- 1 baking soda
- 3/4 salt

Instructions:
1. In a mixing bowl, combine the apple butter, cinnamon and cloves.
2. Whisk in the water, then oil, then brown sugar, then the eggs (not all together). Mix until smooth.
3. Sift together (important so you don't get white lumps in your dark bread), flour, baking soda and salt.  Then combine with the apple butter mixture and mix until smooth.
4. Pour into a greased 9-inch loaf pan or 3 to 4 mini-loaf pans.
5. Bake at 350F for 65-70 minutes for the 9-inch pan or 45-50 minutes for the mini-loaves.
6. Let stand for 10-15 minutes to cool slightly before removing from the pans and letting cool completely on a wire rack.

ingredients_reels: butter | confectioners' sugar | vanilla extract | 2% low-fat milk
texte:
Vanilla Buttercream Frosting

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 4 1/2 confectioners' sugar
- 1 1/2 vanilla extract
- 5 -6 2% low-fat milk

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, cream butter until light and fluffy.  Beat in the confectioners' sugar, vanilla and enough milk to achieve desired consistency.
2. Almond Buttercream Frosting : Substitute 1/2 to 3/4 teaspoon almond extract for the vanilla.
3. Chocolate Buttercream Frosting : Reduce confectioners' sugar to 4 cups and add 1/2 cup baking cocoa; increase milk to 6-7 tablespoons.
4. Lemon Buttercream Frosting : Substitute 5-6 tablespoons lemon juice for the milk; add 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel.
5. Orange Buttercream Frosting : Substitute 5-6 tablespoons orange juice for the milk; add 1 teaspoon grated orange peel.
6. Peanut Butter Frosting : Substitute peanut butter for the butter; increase milk to 6-8 tablespoons.
7. Peppermint Buttercream Frosting : Substitute 1/2 to 3/4 teaspoon peppermint extract for the vanilla.

nom: Honey Grain Light Wheat Bread (Bread Machine - Abm)
ingredients_reels: water | butter | honey | salt | bread flour | whole wheat flour | quick-cooking oats | dry active yeast
texte:
Honey Grain Light Wheat Bread (Bread Machine - Abm)

Ingredients:
- 1 water
- 2 butter
- 1 1/2 honey
- 1 salt
- 2 1/4 bread flour
- 1 whole wheat flour
- 1/2 quick-cooking oats
- 2 dry active yeast

Instructions:
1. All ingredients should be at room temperature.
2. Add to bread machine as your model's instructions direct.  Mine are as follows.
3. Add liquid ingredients to bread pan.
4. Add dry ingredients, except yeast, to bread pan.
5. Make a well in dry ingredients and carefully add yeast.
6. Select the \"Wheat\" or \"Whole Wheat\" Setting on your machine.
7. Choose crust color, if applicable.
8. Press Start!

nom: Pasta with Zucchini and Roasted Garlic
ingredients_reels: rotini pasta | garlic | dried thyme | dried rosemary | canola oil | zucchini
texte:
Pasta with Zucchini and Roasted Garlic

Ingredients:
- 1 rotini pasta
- 8 garlic
- 1/2 dried thyme
- 1/2 dried rosemary
- 2 canola oil
- 3 zucchini

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven or toaster oven to 450 degrees.
2. Lay a 12-inch square piece of foil on the counter and put the garlic on it.
3. Sprinkle the thyme and rosemary over the garlic.
4. pour the oil over the garlic and herbs.
5. Draw up the edges of the foil and make a sealed packet; bake 20 minutes.
6. While the garlic is baking, Cook Pasta according to package directions.
7. Two minutes before Pasta is done ADD the Zucchini to the cooking pasta, Cook 2 minutes.
8. Drain Zucchini and Pasta.
9. Open the foil and MASH the garlic lightly with a spoon.
10. Toss mashed garlic with the pasta and zucchini.
11. Season with salt and pepper and serve.

ingredients_reels: chicken breasts | olive oil | butter | shiitake mushrooms | olive oil | garlic cloves | basil pesto | campanelle pasta
texte:
Chicken & Shiitake  Mushroom Basil Pesto

Ingredients:
- 4 chicken breasts
- 1 olive oil
- 1 butter
- 8 shiitake mushrooms
- 1 olive oil
- 2 garlic cloves
- basil pesto
- campanelle pasta

Instructions:
1. Heat oil and butter over med high heat. Add chicken and cook till golden brown on both sides.
2. Remove from heat and cut into bite size pieces. Set aside.
3. Heat oil over med high heat. add garlic. Saute till garlic starts to turn golden. Add Mushrooms and saute till mushrooms are nice and soft.
4. Add chicken and let flavors blend 3-4 minute.
5. Add Basil pesto and saute 3-4 min more.
6. Toss with pasta and serve immediately!

nom: Roasted Vegetable Pita With Creamy Feta Dressing
ingredients_reels: eggplant | chickpeas | red bell pepper | onion | garlic cloves | tomatoes | basil leaves | olive oil | fresh oregano | fresh thyme | salt | feta cheese | plain yogurt | milk | olive oil | lemon juice | brown sugar | salt | garlic powder | fresh dill | dried dill
texte:
Roasted Vegetable Pita With Creamy Feta Dressing

Ingredients:
- 1 eggplant
- 1/2 chickpeas
- 1 red bell pepper
- 1 onion
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1 tomatoes
- 1/4 basil leaves
- 2 -4 olive oil
- 1 1/2 fresh oregano
- 1 fresh thyme
- 1/4 - 1/2 salt
- 2 -4 feta cheese
- 1/2 plain yogurt
- 1/2 milk
- 4 olive oil
- 4 lemon juice
- 3 -4 brown sugar
- 1  - 1 1/2 salt
- 1/2 garlic powder
- 1/2 fresh dill
- 4 dried dill

Instructions:
1. Prepare and cut the vegetables. Combine in a mixing bowl all of the above ingredients, except the tomatoes, basil leaves, dressing, and pita halves. You may leave the chickpeas out, if you wish.
2. Toss vegetable mixture to lightly glaze the vegetables with olive oil.
3. Spoon vegetable mixture onto a broiler pan or cookie sheet coated with nonstick cooking spray. Broil 5 minutes, add tomatoes and basil leaves to vegetable mixture and stir. Baste with additional marinade and broil for an additional 5 minutes or until vegetables are just tender and lightly browned. Tomatoes and basil should be just warmed; if you prefer the tomato softer, add with vegetable mixture at the beginning.
4. Prepare the dressing while vegetables are broiling.
5. Divide the vegetable mixture evenly between pita halves. Drizzle with Creamy Feta Dressing. Serve.
6. Creamy Feta Dressing:.
7. Combine all ingredients except the dill into a blender and blend until smooth.
8. Scrape the sides of the blender as needed. Add more milk as needed to get a consistency that is rather thin and pourable.
9. Pour into a bowl and sir in dill. Add more lemon juice if a tangier taste is preferred. Enjoy! This makes enough for 2-4 servings.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | baking powder | salt | Splenda granular | Egg Beaters egg substitute | butter | vanilla | pistachios
texte:
Pistachio Biscotti    (Diabetic)

Ingredients:
- 2 3/4 all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 baking powder
- 1 salt
- 1 Splenda granular
- 1/2 Egg Beaters egg substitute
- 5 butter
- 1 vanilla
- 1 pistachios

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees F. Lightly spray two cookie sheets; set aside. In a large bowl combine flour, baking powder, salt, and Splenda. Make a well in the center of the flour mixture. Place EggBeaters (You may need another 1/4 cup of EggBeaters depending on the asorbtion of the flour) in the well and stir into the flour mixture. Add butter and, vanilla, stir until dough starts to form a ball. Stir in nuts.
2. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface; divide into three equal portions. Shape each portion into a 14-inch-long log. Place logs about 3 inches apart on prepared cookie sheets; flatten logs slightly until about 1-1/2 inches wide. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until firm and light brown. Remove from oven and place cookie sheets on wire racks; cool 15 minutes.
3. Transfer logs to cutting board. Use a serrated knife to cut each roll diagonally into 1/2-inch slices. Place slices, cut sides down, on cookie sheets. Bake for 10 minutes. Turn cookies over; bake 10 to 15 minutes more or until crisp and golden brown. Transfer to a wire racks and let cool.
4. Makes about 84 cookies.

ingredients_reels: butter | onion | all-purpose flour | chicken broth | evaporated milk | baking potatoes
texte:
Carnation's Baked Potato Soup

Ingredients:
- 1/4 butter
- 1/4 onion
- 1/4 all-purpose flour
- 1 chicken broth
- 1 evaporated milk
- 2 baking potatoes

Instructions:
1. Melt butter in large saucepan over medium heat.
2. Add onion; cook, stirring occasionally, for 1 to 2 minutes or until tender.
3. Stir in flour.
4. Gradually stir in broth and evaporated milk.
5. Scoop potato pulp from 1 potato (reserving the skin); mash.
6. Add pulp to broth mixture.
7. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until mixture comes just to a boil.
8. Dice remaining potato skin and potato; add to soup; heat through.
9. Spoon into bowls.
10. Sprinkle each with your desired toppings.

ingredients_reels: boneless skinless chicken breast halves | kosher salt | fresh ground black pepper | olive oil | parmesan cheese
texte:
Simple Pan-fried Chicken Breasts

Ingredients:
- 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves

- 1 fresh ground black pepper
- 1 olive oil
- 2 parmesan cheese

Instructions:

ingredients_reels: dried garbanzo beans | skinless chicken | black pepper | ginger | salt | garlic cloves | olive oil | lemon juice | garlic cloves | turmeric | salt | ginger | onion | parsley | cinnamon stick | sweet butter | cornstarch
texte:
Ginger Chicken With Chickpeas (Moroccan Tagine)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 - 1 dried garbanzo beans
- 2 -3 skinless chicken
- 1 black pepper
- 3/4 ginger
- 1/2 salt
- 3 garlic cloves
- 2 olive oil
- 1 lemon juice
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1 turmeric
- 1 salt
- 1/4 ginger
- 1/2 onion
- 1/4 parsley
- 1 cinnamon stick
- 3 -4 sweet butter
- 2 cornstarch

Instructions:
1. Cover dried chick-peas with water & soak overnight. You can do this in advance & then freeze the chick-peas. When ready to use take out of the freezer & thaw.
2. Blend salt, ginger, pepper, garlic, oil, & lemon juice in a bowl. Take a skewer (preferably) or sharp knife & poke several holes into the chicken. Then dip the chicken into the mixture so that all sides are covered. Place chicken into a glass & cover with the remaining mixture. Let it marinate for at least 2 hours.
3. Drain the soaked chick-peas or thaw the ones already prepared. Place chick-peas, 1/2 tsp salt, & fresh water into a sauce pan or pressure cooker & cover with lid. If using a pan, cook chick-peas for 45 minutes. If using a pressure cooker, cook for 15 minutes (after it starts to hiss).
4. Drain chick-peas & submerge in a bowl of cold water. Gently rub the chick-peas to remove their skins. Immediately remove skinned peas from the water & place into another bowl.
5. Place 3 cups of water, chicken & any juices in the bowl into the large pot or pressure cooker. Add salt, turmeric, ginger, parsley, 2 cloves garlic, cinnamon stick, & butter. If using a pot bring to boil, reduce heat, cover, & simmer for 1 hour, turning the chicken frequently in the sauce. If using a pressure cooker, cover & cook for 8 minutes (after it starts to hiss).
6. Remove chicken, place back in the glass bowl & cover to stay warm. Add onions & cooked chick-peas to the pot. Bring to a rolling boil & cook until the onions are very tender & the sauce has reduced to about 2 cups. Mix cornstarch & a little water to make a thin paste, add to sauce to thicken. After the sauce has thicken some return chicken back into the pot to reheat.
7. To serve, place chicken into a deep dish & cover with sauce.

- 2 onions

- 14 poultry seasoning
- 2 rubbed sage
- 2 seasoning salt
- black pepper

Instructions:
1. In a large frypan fry the bacon until crisp; (do not drain the drippings) remove and crumble; set aside.

3. Add in chopped celery, onions and garlic; sauté until tender.
4. Add HALF of the bread cubes to the butter; stir to coat, and keep stirring with a wooden spoon until the bread cubes are lightly browned and the butter is absorbed.
5. Transfer to a large bowl (or finish in the frypan, if you have a large enough frypan to hold all ingredients) and add in remaining bread cubes, salt, pepper and poultry seasoning or sage (if using).
6. Add in crumbled bacon and the cranberries or other ingredients that you choose to use; mix to combine.
7. Drizzle with the chicken broth (mixing with a wooden spoon) until you have reached the desired moistness, you might have to add in more than 1 cup, but do not add in too much or your bread will become too \"soggy\".
8. Immediately stuff the turkey, and cook.

- 2 unsalted butter
- 2 sugar
- 1 fine salt
- 3 unsalted butter
- 1/2 kosher salt
- 1/8 - 1/4 garlic powder
- 1 dried oregano

Instructions:
1. Make the dough: Place 1/4 cup warm water in the bowl of a mixer; sprinkle in the yeast and set aside until foamy, about 5 minutes. Add the flour, butter, sugar, fine salt and 1 1/4 cups plus 2 tablespoons warm water; mix with the paddle attachment until a slightly sticky dough forms, 5 minutes.
2. Knead the dough by hand on a floured surface until very smooth and soft, 3 minutes. Roll into a 2-foot-long log; cut into 16 1 1/2-inch pieces. Knead each piece slightly and shape into a 7-inch long breadstick; arrange 2 inches apart on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Cover with a cloth; let rise in a warm spot until almost doubled, about 45 minutes.
3. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F.
4. Make the topping: Brush the breadsticks with 1 1/2 tablespoons of the butter and sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt.
5. Bake until slightly golden, about 15 minutes.
6. Meanwhile, combine the remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt with the garlic powder and oregano.
7. Brush the warm breadsticks with the remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons melted butter and sprinkle with the flavored salt.
8. Serve warm with salad.

nom: Cinnamon Buns for the Bread Machine
ingredients_reels: water | egg | vanilla extract | all-purpose flour | sugar | butter | salt | dry milk | butter | brown sugar | cinnamon | pecans | raisins | butter | vanilla | hot water | confectioners' sugar
texte:
Cinnamon Buns for the Bread Machine

Ingredients:
- 3/4 water
- 1 egg
- 2 vanilla extract
- 3 all-purpose flour
- 6 sugar
- 1/4 butter
- 1 salt
- 2 dry milk
- 1 1/2 butter
- 1/4 brown sugar
- 1/3 cinnamon
- 1 pecans
- 1/2 raisins
- 3 butter
- 1 vanilla
- 3 hot water
- 2 confectioners' sugar

Instructions:
1. Add ingredients according to manufacturer's suggested order and set on dough cycle.
2. Turn onto lightly floured board.
3. Roll out to a rectangle about 10x18 inches.
4. Brush with melted butter; sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar mixture and pecans, if used.
5. Starting at long end, carefully roll up; pinch seams together.
6. Measure and cut 1-inch slices.
7. Place cut side up on a buttered baking sheet.
8. Cover with a slightly dampened towel and let rise in a warm place for about 45 minutes to 1 hour.
9. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes, or until browned.
10. Drizzle with cinnamon bun glaze or thin icing of your choice.
11. Icing: Melt butter in a medium saucepan; add hot water and vanilla.
12. Remove from heat then stir in confectioners' sugar.
13. Add more hot water, 1/2 to 1 teaspoon at a time, until desired consistency.

ingredients_reels: ground beef | whole kernel corn | chunky salsa | sliced ripe olives | cream-style cottage cheese | sour cream | tortilla chips | cheddar cheese | chopped tomato
texte:
Layered Mexican Casserole

Ingredients:
- 1/2 ground beef
- 1 whole kernel corn
- 1 chunky salsa
- 1 sliced ripe olives
- 1 cream-style cottage cheese
- 1 sour cream
- 5 tortilla chips
- 2 cheddar cheese
- 1/2 chopped tomato

Instructions:
1. Brown meat; drain.
2. Add corn and salsa; cook until thoroughly  heated.
3. Reserve 2 tablespoons olives; stir remaining olives into meat mixture.
4. Combine cottage cheese and sour cream.
5. In 2 quart casserole, layer 2 cups chips, half of meat mixture, 3/4 cup Cheddar cheese and half of cottage cheese mixture. Repeat layers; cover.
6. Bake at 350° F for 35 minutes.
7. Stand up remaining chips around edge of casserole. Top casserole with tomato, reserved olives and remaining Cheddar cheese. Continue baking 10 minutes.

ingredients_reels: potatoes | sesame seeds | red chili powder | curry powder | coriander powder | black pepper | salt | fresh parsley | coriander leaves
texte:
Just 5 Minutes Sesame Potatoes

Ingredients:
- 4 potatoes
- 6 sesame seeds
- 1 red chili powder
- 1 curry powder
- 1 coriander powder
- 1/2 black pepper
- salt
- 3 fresh parsley
- coriander leaves

Instructions:
1. Heat oil in a heavy bottomed skillet/pot.
2. Do not smoke the same.
3. Add sesame seeds and wait till they begin to crackle.
4. Lower the heat and add all the other spices.
5. Take care as not to burn the same.
6. Immediately add cubed potatoes and keep sauteeing and tossing on high heat for 5 minutes.
7. Let the potatoes go brown on the edges.
8. Transfer them to the serving bowl and garnish with fresh sprigs of parsley and coriander leaves.
9. Enjoy with the noodles, rice, pasta, salads and breads.

ingredients_reels: olive oil | fresh mushrooms | onion | orzo pasta | chicken broth | carrot | dried marjoram | pepper | broccoli florets
texte:
Orzo-Broccoli Pilaf

Ingredients:
- 2 olive oil
- 1 fresh mushrooms
- 1/2 onion
- 2/3 orzo pasta
- 1 chicken broth
- 1/2 carrot
- 1 dried marjoram
- 1/8 pepper
- 2 broccoli florets

Instructions:
1. In a large saucepan heat olive oil over medium-high heat.
2. Cook and stir the mushrooms and onion until onion is tender.
3. Stir in orzo.
4. Cook and stir about 2 minutes or until orzo is lightly browned.
5. Remove from heat.
6. Carefully stir in chicken broth, carrot, marjoram, and pepper.
7. Bring to boiling: reduce heat.
8. Simmer, covered, about 15 minutes or until orzo is tender but still firm.
9. Remove saucepan from heat: stir in broccoli.
10. Let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
11. Serve.

ingredients_reels: butter | granulated sugar | eggs | flour | baking soda | salt | buttermilk | lemons | fresh lemon juice | frozen blueberries | powdered sugar | butter | lemons | fresh lemon juice
texte:
Lemon Blueberry Bread

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 2 granulated sugar
- 3 eggs
- 3 flour
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1/2 salt
- 2/3 buttermilk
- 2 lemons
- 2 fresh lemon juice
- 8 frozen blueberries
- 8 powdered sugar
- 1/4 butter
- 1 1/2 lemons
- 1/4 fresh lemon juice

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees.
2. Important: grease and flour two loaf pans.
3. Cream butter and sugar.
4. Add eggs and beat until smooth.
5. Add buttermilk.
6. Mix dry ingredients together and add to buttermilk mixture.
7. Blend well.
8. Mix in lemon juice and zest.
9. Gently fold in blueberries and only mix until incorporated.
10. Pour batter into loaf pans.
11. Bake loaves on the middle rack of the oven for 60 to 65 minutes.
12. Cool bread 10 minutes, remove from pan and place on a large cookie sheet, top side up.
13. For icing: Combind icing ingredients in a bowl.
14. Beat icing with an electric mixer until smooth.
15. Drizzle icing over the warm loaves.
16. The icing will harden when the bread cools to room temperature.
17. I thought I should mention, if you make this bread without the addition of the blueberries, the baking time is closer to 50 minutes and I recommend increasing the amount of buttermilk from 2/3 cup to 1 cup.

ingredients_reels: extra virgin olive oil | water | head of garlic | onion | water | chicken bouillon cubes | carrots | green cabbage | broccoli florets | tomato sauce | small shell pasta | dried basil | pepper
texte:
Garlic Vegetable Pasta Soup

Ingredients:
- 1 extra virgin olive oil
- 1/4 water
- 1 head of garlic
- 1 onion

- 3 chicken bouillon cubes
- 1 1/2 carrots
- 3 green cabbage
- 1 1/2 broccoli florets
- 1 tomato sauce
- 3/4 small shell pasta
- 1 dried basil
- 1/4 pepper

Instructions:
1. In large soup pot heat the olive oil and water.
2. Add the garlic and onion and saute 5 minutes.
3. Add the 7 cups water, bouillion, and carrots.
4. Bring to a boil, cook 5 minutes and add cabbage, broccoli, tomato sauce, pasta shells, and seasonings.
5. Bring to another boil, stir, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | all-purpose flour | olive oil | boneless skinless chicken breast halves | fat-free evaporated milk | nonfat milk | garlic powder | salt | Dijon mustard | light margarine | green onions
texte:
Farmhouse Chicken and Gravy

Ingredients:
- 1 all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1 olive oil
- 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves
- 1 fat-free evaporated milk
- 2 nonfat milk
- 1/4 garlic powder
- 1/4 salt
- 1/4 Dijon mustard
- 1 light margarine
- 2 green onions

Instructions:
1. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.  Cook the flour for 2 minutes, or until light golden brown, stirring constantly. Transfer to a small bowl.
2. Reduce heat to medium.  Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom.  Cook the chicken smooth side down for 3 minutes.  Turn and cook for 3 more minutes or until no longer pink.  Transfer to serving plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
3. Meanwhile, whisk 1/4 cup of broth into bowl with browned flour until completely blended.  Whisk in the remaining broth, milk, garlic powder, salt, and mustard.  Pour into skillet, scraping with a falt spatula to dislodge any browned bits.  Increase heat to medium high and bring to a boil.  Cook for 4 minutes, or until reduced to about 1/2 cup, stirring frequently.  Remove from the heat.  Stir into the margarine.  Spoon over chicken.  Sprinkle with the green onions.

ingredients_reels: onion | butter | fresh pumpkin | chicken broth | fresh ginger | curry | turmeric | half-and-half cream | salt
texte:
Creamy Ginger Pumpkin Soup

Ingredients:
- 1 onion
- 1 butter
- 1 fresh pumpkin
- 2 chicken broth
- 2 fresh ginger
- 2 curry
- 1 turmeric
- 1 half-and-half cream
- salt

Instructions:
1. Melt the butter in a large pot and add onions, cook until tender approx 5 minute.
2. Add pumpkin, broth and ginger and cook over medium heat for approx 15 min until pumpkin is very tender.
3. Puree with hand blender (or pour mix into regular blender) until you have a smooth texture.
4. Add curry, tumeric and cream/milk and heat through without boiling. Add salt to taste.
5. Serve with crusty bread.

ingredients_reels: butter | sugar | plain flour | butter | margarine | sugar | sweetened condensed milk | chocolate | butter
texte:
Caramel Shortcake or Millionaire's Shortbread

Ingredients:
- 8 butter
- 4 sugar
- 12 plain flour
- 8 butter
- 4 margarine
- 4 sugar
- 1 sweetened condensed milk
- 8 chocolate
- 1 butter

Instructions:
1. BASE (first 3 ingredients):
2. Cream butter and sugar.
3. Add the flour and stir to make a mixture that is soft and will go together when squashed.
4. Lightly knead and then roll out or place into a deep Swiss roll tin.
5. Press into place with the palm of your hand until even.
6. Prick all over with a fork.
7. Bake in the oven for 25 minutes gas 4.
8. Cool in the tin.
9. FILLING (middle four ingredients):
10. Place the butter, sugar, syrup, and condensed milk into a pan and bring slowly to a boil.
11. Stir until the sugar is dissolved.
12. Once boiling keep on a slow boil stirring all the time for about 5 to 7 minutes.
13. Caramel should be thick and golden.
14. Allow to cool.
15. When cool pour over the biscuit mixture and leave to set.
16. TOPPING (last 2 ingredients):
17. Melt the chocolate and butter over a pan of simmering water.
18. Spread over top of the caramel layer.
19. Cut into squares or fingers once set.
20. Do not be put off by the stages; very easy and worth the wait.  It looks like you have been in the kitchen and slaving over the cooker for hours. You will get compliments with this one.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | sea salt | baking powder | egg | stevia powder | vanilla flavoring | salted butter | chocolate chips
texte:
Chocolate Chip Cookies

Ingredients:
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 3/4 sea salt
- 3/4 baking powder
- 1 egg
- 1/2 stevia powder
- 1 vanilla flavoring
- 1 salted butter
- 1 1/4 chocolate chips

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F.
2. Lightly grease a cookie sheet and set aside.
3. In a medium mixing bowl, sift together the flour, salt, and baking powder, and set aside.
4. Place the egg, stevia, and vanilla in a large mixing bowl, and beat well with a wooden spoon or an electric hand-held mixer.
5. Slowly add the butter, continuing to beat until the mixture is smooth and creamy.
6. Add the flour mixture to the butter mixture, 1/2 cup at a time, stirring well with a wooden spoon after each addition.
7. Fold in the chocolate chips.
8. Drop heaping teaspoons of batter on the cookie sheet, about 2 inches apart.
9. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the cookies are golden brown.
10. Note; Instead of greasing a cookie sheet, you can cover it with parchment paper, which makes for quick and easy cleanup.

ingredients_reels: elbow macaroni | butter | egg | salt | dry mustard | hot water | sharp cheddar cheese | milk | seasoned croutons
texte:
Beyond Macaroni & Cheese

Ingredients:
- 8 elbow macaroni
- 1 butter
- 1 egg
- 1 salt
- 1 dry mustard
- 1 hot water
- 3 sharp cheddar cheese
- 1 milk
- 1/2 seasoned croutons

Instructions:
1. Combine macaroni, butter, and egg in a large mixing bowl.
2. Dissolve salt and mustard in hot water; stir into macaroni.
3. Mix in cheese, reserving enough for topping.
4. Lightly spray a 2-qt casserole dish with no-stick cooking spray; pour in macaroni; pour milk evenly over macaroni; top with croutons and remaining cheese.
5. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes or until custard is set and top is crusty.
6. This macaroni and cheese is best baked for about 25 minutes, removed from the oven, topped with croutons and cheese, then returned to the oven to finish baking. Doing this keeps the topping a nice (not overdone) golden-brown.
7. NOTE: 8 ounces elbow macaroni equals 2 cups before cooking. I often use rounded cups of dry macaroni when making this recipe.

nom: Baked Ham Glazed With Pineapple and Chipotle Peppers
ingredients_reels: smoked ham | brown sugar | crushed pineapple | chipotle chile in adobo | adobo sauce | nutmeg | fresh ginger | cornstarch | salt
texte:
Baked Ham Glazed With Pineapple and Chipotle Peppers

- 1 -2 chipotle chile in adobo
- 1 adobo sauce
- 1/4 nutmeg
- 1/4 fresh ginger
- 2 cornstarch
- 1/4 salt

Instructions:
1. Mix  cornstarch with a little cold water to dissolve.
2. Place all ingredients except for ham in a blender and blend smooth, in a small saucepan over medium heat bring to a boil them simmer till thickened.
3. Preheat oven to 375 ° F.
4. Place ham, cut end down, in a large baking pan and score skin.
5. Bake ham for 15 minutes.
6. Brush glaze over ham and bake for another hour or until internal temperature reads 140 °F.
7. Baste half way through baking.

ingredients_reels: sugar | warm water | dry yeast | flour | salt | olive oil | water | olive oil | za'atar spice mix | sea salt
texte:
Za'atar Focaccia by Penzeys

Ingredients:
- 1 sugar
- 1/4 warm water
- 1 1/4 dry yeast
- 3 1/4 flour
- 1 salt
- 2 olive oil
- 1 water
- 1 olive oil
- 1 za'atar spice mix
- 1/4 sea salt

Instructions:
1. Stir sugar and warm water together in a small bowl. Sprinkle yeast over the top.
2. Let stand for ten minutes. Stir to dissolve yeast.
3. Measure flour and salt into large bowl. Stir. Make a well in the center. Add yeast mixture to well. Stir with spoon until mixed.
4. Make a well once more and add olive oil and water to well. Stir.
5. Turn out onto floured surface. Knead for 9-10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
6. Place in greased bowl, turning once to greased top.
7. Cover with clean towel.
8. Let stand in oven with light on and door closed for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until doubled in bulk.
9. Punch dough down. Place on greased baking sheet.
10. Press or roll out into 12 inch circle. Makes 1 round flat bread.
11. Topping:
12. Make dents with finger in surface. Drizzle with olive oil. Sprinkle with Zatar and sea salt. Let stand uncovered for 30 minutes.
13. Bake at 400 degrees for about 25 minutes. Serve warm or cold, cut in wedges.

ingredients_reels: boneless chicken breast halves | green onion | crushed pineapple | crystallized ginger | lemon juice | low sodium soy sauce | brown sugar | garlic powder

texte:
Blueberry Cobbler

- 2/3 skim milk

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Combline flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
3. Stir in milk and mix well into a smooth batter.
4. Melt butter in 1 1/2 quart baking dish in microwave on high for one minute.
5. Pour batter into melted butter.
6. Add blueberries on top of batter.  (Do not stir.).
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 40-45 minutes.

ingredients_reels: walnuts | pecans | all-purpose flour | granulated sugar | baking powder | baking soda | salt | white chocolate chips | eggs | unsalted butter | bananas | pure vanilla extract | demerara sugar
texte:
Best Chocolate Banana Bread

Ingredients:
- 1/2 walnuts
- 1 3/4 pecans
- 1/4 all-purpose flour
- 1 granulated sugar
- 1 baking powder
- 1/4 baking soda
- 1/4 salt
- 1/2 white chocolate chips
- 2 eggs
- 1/2 unsalted butter
- 3 bananas
- 1 pure vanilla extract
- demerara sugar

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (180 degrees C) and place oven rack to middle position. Butter and flour (or spray with a non stick vegetable/flour spray) the bottom and sides of a 9 x 5 x 3 inch (23 x 13 x 8 cm) loaf pan. Set aside.
2. Place the nuts on a baking sheet and bake for about 8 - 10 minutes or until lightly toasted. Let cool and then chop coarsely.
3. In a large bowl whisk together the flour, cocoa powder, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Set aside.
4. In a medium-sized bowl combine the mashed bananas, eggs, melted butter, and vanilla. With a rubber spatula or wooden spoon, lightly fold the wet ingredients (banana mixture) into the dry ingredients until just combined and batter is thick and chunky. Fold in the nuts and chocolate chips.  Scrape batter into prepared pan and sprinkle the top of the bread with coarse brown sugar (optional). Bake until bread has risen and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean,( I baked it for 50 minutes, and removed it carefully from the pan and let it cool) about 55 to 65 minutes. Place on a wire rack to cool and then remove the bread from the pan. Serve warm or at room temperature.

ingredients_reels: brandy | Amaretto

Godchild Cocktail

Pudding or Waffle Sauce

ingredients_reels: cabbage | bacon | onions | cider vinegar | garlic
texte:
German Warm Cabbage Salad (Krautsalat)

Ingredients:
- 1 cabbage
- 1/4 bacon
- 2 onions
- 1/2 cider vinegar
- 2 garlic

Instructions:
1. Cut the bacon into tiny bits.
2. Fry it in a big deep frying pan and fish out all the bits after they are crisp.
3. Cut up the onion and garlic and fry them in the bacon fat.
4. When they are brown, pour in the vinegar.
5. Bring it just up to a simmer, add all the cabbage and bacon, toss it as you would a salad, and serve it.
6. The cabbage doesn't cook, but it wilts a little under the hot vinegar.

ingredients_reels: water | salt | rolled oats | brown sugar | butter | dry yeast | warm water | flour
texte:
Oatmeal Bread

Ingredients:
- 3 water
- 3 salt
- 3 rolled oats
- 2/3 brown sugar
- 2 butter
- 2 dry yeast
- 1/2 warm water
- 6  - 6 1/2 flour

Instructions:
1. Dissolve the yeast in the warm water and proof for a few minutes while you get the rest ready.
2. In a pan, place the water and salt and bring to a boil; add the rolled oats, but do not boil.
3. Stir in and cool to lukewarm the brown sugar and butter.
4. When lukewarm, stir in the yeast mixture and mix well.
5. Add the flour gradually until the dough is a good consistency to knead.
6. Knead 100 times.
7. Let rise in a greased bowl until double (about 1 1/2 hours).
8. Punch down and divide in half.
9. Put each half in a greased bread pan.
10. Rise again for about 1 hour or until almost double in size.
11. Bake at 375 degrees for 40-45 minutes, putting foil on top after about 25-30 minutes to prevent it browning too much.

ingredients_reels: butter | margarine | zucchini | flour | eggs | salt | pepper
texte:
Vegetarian Zucchini Patties

Ingredients:
- 2 butter
- 3 margarine
- 3 1/2 zucchini
- 1/4 flour
- 2 eggs
- 1/2 salt
- 1/8 pepper

Instructions:
1. Heat the butter and oil together in a 12-inch skillet over moderate heat.
2. Meanwhile, quickly mix the zucchini with the flour, eggs, salt and pepper to form a batter.
3. Drop Tablespoonful of batter into hot butter and oil to form 6 patties 2 to 2 1/2 inches in diameter.
4. Flatten each patty slightly with the back of a spoon.
5. Reserve the remaining batter.
6. Cook the patties for about 4 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown and crusty.
7. Remove them to a platter covered with paper toweling and set in a keep-warm (250 F) oven.
8. Use the remaining batter cook 6 more patties in the same manner, adding 1 more Tablespoon of oil to the skillet, if needed.

ingredients_reels: Brussels sprout | red bell pepper | olive oil | garlic cloves | brown sugar | salt | black pepper | water | apple cider vinegar
texte:
Garlicky Brussels Sprouts Saute

- 1/8 black pepper

4. Add water and cook 5 minutes or more until most of the liquid is evaporated. Stir in vinegar and season to taste with additional salt or pepper to taste. Serve immediately.

ingredients_reels: stewed tomatoes | onion | garlic cloves | carrots | celery ribs | tomato paste | green pepper | basil | oregano | salt | pepper | parsley | olive oil

ingredients_reels: Bisquick baking mix | milk | lean ground beef | onion | salt | pepper | tomatoes | eggs | cheddar cheese | Bisquick baking mix | Worcestershire sauce
texte:
Cheeseburger Pie

nom: Pasta Caprese (Pasta With Tomatoes, Mozzarella & Fresh Basil

ingredients_reels: tomato sauce | chili powder | cocoa powder | oregano | garlic powder | cumin | Tabasco sauce | warm water | flour

Let simmer for 10 minutes, to thicken. ingredients_reels: hazelnuts | salt
texte:
Toasted Hazelnuts

Ingredients:
- 1 hazelnuts
- 1/8 salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
2. Spread the nuts out on a metal baking pan or a large sheet pan with ridges.
3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until they are very hot and fragrant.
4. Carefully dump nuts into a dish towel which you’ve spread across the counter - a ridged dish towel or one with some sort of embroidery works well because it provides more friction.
5. Bring the ends of the dish towel up around the still-hot hazelnuts and wrap them up like a present.
6. Using your hands, rub them between the towel and the work surface so that the friction created by the rubbing loosens the skin.
7. Discard the skins and enjoy the toasted hazelnuts whole or crush them for your favorite recipe.

ingredients_reels: water | white bread flour | dry milk | sugar | salt | butter | cinnamon | raisins | active dry yeast
texte:
Raisin Bread

Ingredients:
- 3/4 water
- 2 white bread flour
- 1 dry milk
- 1 sugar
- 1 salt
- 1 butter
- 1/2 cinnamon
- 1/2 raisins
- 2 active dry yeast

Instructions:
1. Place ingredients in machine in the order given.
2. Operate machine according to manual instructions.
3. Note: To keep raisins whole in the bread, add them after the 1st beep, or kneading cycle.
4. If using rapid bake cycle, add raisins with other ingredients.

ingredients_reels: ground beef | oregano | basil | black pepper | linguine | spaghetti | parmesan cheese | eggs | butter | low fat cottage cheese | mozzarella cheese
texte:
Spagagña

Ingredients:
- 1 ground beef
- 1 oregano
- 1 basil
- 1 black pepper
- 1/2 linguine
- 8 spaghetti
- 1/3 parmesan cheese
- 2 eggs
- 2 butter
- 1 low fat cottage cheese
- 1 mozzarella cheese

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Brown ground beef in a skillet. Drain fat.
3. Stir in spaghetti sauce, oregano, basil and black pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes.
4. Combine cooked linguini, Parmesan cheese, eggs, and butter in large bowl; mix well.
5. Spray 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray.
6. Put 1/2 of the linguine mixture in the bottom of the baking dish; spread so it covers the bottom.
7. Spread 1/2 of the cottage cheese over the noodles.
8. Pour 1/2 of the sauce over the linguine and cottage cheese.
9. Sprinkle 1/2 of the mozzarella cheese over first three layers.
10. Repeat the four layers in the same order.
11. Bake until mixture is bubbly and cheese is melted, about 25 minutes.

ingredients_reels: oranges | brown sugar | flaked coconut | Cointreau liqueur
texte:
Halo-Halo

Ingredients:
- 4 oranges
- 2 brown sugar
- 2 flaked coconut
- 4 Cointreau liqueur

Instructions:
1. In a dry skillet, lightly toast the coconut flakes until slightly browned and fragrant. Remove from skillet into a bowl and stir in the brown sugar, mix well. Set aside.
2. Peel the oranges so that the whole outer skin is removed, like if you wanted to filet the oranges.
3. Slice the oranges (about 1/2 inch thick slices).
4. Layer oranges and flaked coconut into 4 glasses. The top layer should be coconut.
5. Sprinkle one tablespoon cointreau over each glass.
6. Chill for at least one hour, serve cold.
7. Garnish with whipped cream or any topping you like.

nom: Sugar and Spice Bacon (Or Turkey Bacon)
ingredients_reels: bacon | brown sugar | sugar | Splenda sugar substitute | cinnamon | nutmeg | allspice | clove | cayenne
texte:
Sugar and Spice Bacon (Or Turkey Bacon)

Ingredients:
- 6 bacon
- 1 brown sugar
- 1 sugar
- 1/2 Splenda sugar substitute
- 1/4 cinnamon
- 1/8 nutmeg
- 1/8 allspice
- 1/8 clove
- 1 cayenne

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350*.
2. Place bacon slices on a cookie sheet and bake for 10 minutes.
3. Mix together remaining ingredients.  If you are using regular bacon, you may want to add garlic powder instead of garlic salt.  I always use the lower sodium bacon and Turkey bacon, so I feel like I can add the garlic salt :).
4. Remove from oven, flip bacon and sprinkle this side generously with sugar mixture.  Return to oven for 5-7 minutes, until bacon is looking fairly crisp, but not completely done.
5. Remove from oven and flip bacon again.  Sprinkle this side with sugar mixture and return to oven until bacon reaches your desired doneness.  (I usually allow about 5 more minutes.
6. Remove bacon to paper towel lined plate to use in other recipes or start digging in, being careful not to burn your little fingers on the melty sugar!

ingredients_reels: unsalted butter | onion | fresh thyme | heavy cream | yukon gold potato | kosher salt | fresh ground pepper | romano cheese
texte:
Creamy Potato Gratin

Ingredients:
- 1/2 unsalted butter
- 1 onion
- 1 fresh thyme
- 1 heavy cream
- 1 yukon gold potato
- 1/2 kosher salt
- 1/4 fresh ground pepper
- 1/4 romano cheese

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees; butter a 1 1/2 quart gratin dish.
2. In large skillet, melt butter over medium high heat.
3. Reduce heat to medium; add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes, or until golden.
4. Stir in thyme.
5. Remove skillet from heat, set aside.
6. In medium saucepan, bring cream to boil.
7. Stir in potatoes and cook 5 minutes, or until potatoes are just tender.
8. Stir in salt and pepper.
9. With slotted spoon, alternately layer potatoes, onion mixture and cheese in prepared dish.
10. Drizzle any remaining cream mixture from pan over gratin.
11. Bake 35-40 minutes, or until top is golden brown.

ingredients_reels: flour | salt | butter | celery | turnip | leeks | scallion | carrots | cheddar cheese | mace | black pepper | cayenne
texte:
Cheese Pasties

Ingredients:
- 3 flour
- 1 salt
- 1 butter
- 3 celery
- 1 turnip
- 3/4 leeks
- 2/3 scallion
- 1 1/3 carrots
- 12 cheddar cheese
- 1 mace
- 1/4 black pepper
- 1/4 cayenne

Instructions:
1. To make crust: combine salt and flour. Cut butter into flour with fingers until it resembles coarse corn meal.
2. Sprinkle on cold water and stir until dough sticks together.
3. Form dough into a ball and refrigerate for 15-30 minutes.  Do not over-chill!
4. To make Filling: Mix together the filling ingredients in a large bowl.
5. Preheat oven to 375°F.
6. Cut the ball of dough into 6 pieces. Roll out each piece about 1/8 inch thick and Cut a 9 inch circle out of each piece.
7. Put 1/6 of the filling in the middle of each pastry circle.
8. Pull one edge over the filling to make a half-circle.
9. Seal the edges together like a turnover.  Turn the edges over and press with a fork to double-seal.
10. Cut slits in the top of the pasties so that steam can escape.
11. BAke for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 350 F and bake for another 15-20 minutes until lightly golden.
12. Remove from oven, and allow the pasties rest for 5 minutes before serving.

ingredients_reels: green beans | butter | onion | sweet Hungarian paprika | flour | sour cream | salt
texte:
Green Beans Prapice

Ingredients:
- 1 green beans
- 4 butter
- 3/4 onion
- 1 sweet Hungarian paprika
- 2 flour
- 1 sour cream
- 1/2 salt

Instructions:
1. Add the beans to a pot of boiling salted water, reduce the heat to medium and cook uncovered 10-15 minutes or until just tender, drain.
2. Melt butter in a large skillet, add the onions and cook 4-5 minutes or until they are translucent.
3. Remove pan from heat, add paprika and stir until onions are well coated.
4. In a small bowl, wire whisk the flour into the sour cream, add to the onions, add salt and mix.
5. Return the skillet to the stove and simmer on low heat 4-5 minutes or until the sauce is smooth and creamy.
6. Gently stir in the beans and simmer 5 minutes.

nom: Nordstrom Lime and Chicken Cilantro Salad Dressing
ingredients_reels: seasoned rice vinegar | lime juice | garlic clove | chipotle chiles | honey | salt | canola oil | cilantro
texte:
Nordstrom Lime and Chicken Cilantro Salad Dressing

3. - Mince garlic and set aside.
4. - Puree Chipotle chilies in food processor.
5. - Add all ingredients except oil and cilantro to processor and blend.
6. - Slowly add stream of oil to form emulsion.
7. - Add cilantro to processor and pulse to combine.
8. Toss this dressing with baby greens, corn, chicken breasts, plum tomatoes, jack cheese, roasted red pepper and toasted pumpkin seeds.

ingredients_reels: chicken breast | flour | mozzarella cheese | colby-monterey jack cheese | penne pasta | butter | half-and-half
texte:
Chicken & Cheese Penne Pasta

Ingredients:
- 1 chicken breast

5. Bake in oven for 20-25 minutes.

ingredients_reels: butter | icing sugar | milk
texte:
Vienna Cream Frosting (Better Than Cream!)

Ingredients:
- 1/4 butter
- 1 3/4 icing sugar
- 2 milk

Instructions:
1. Beat the butter in a small bowl with an electric mixer. You need to beat it for a fair length of time -until it is as white as possible.
2. Gradually beat in half of the sugar, all the milk and then the remaining sugar.
3. If you would like the mixture thicker- add in some extra icing sugar one spoonful at a time until the consistency is right.  If the mixture is too thick- gradually (and I mean gradually) add in some more liquid until the consistency is achieved.).
4. VARIATIONS:
5. To make it chocolate- add in 2 or 3 tablespoons of cocoa with the sugar and a little extra milk if required.
6. Coffee- add 3 teaspoons of instant coffee in 2 tablespoons of hot water(omit the milk).
7. Lemon- substitute lemon juice for the milk. You can also add in some lemon zest.
8. orange- use orange juice in place of the milk.
9. Different colours/flavours- add food colouring and flavours of your choice (in place of some liquid in the recipe).
10. For pink I add some rosewater and a few drops of cochineal.

ingredients_reels: beef roast | beef broth | ketchup | cider vinegar | onions | garlic cloves | brown sugar | carrots | celery ribs
texte:
Better Than Mom's Pot Roast

- 4 -5 beef roast
- 2 beef broth
- 2 ketchup
- 1/2 cider vinegar
- 2 onions
- 2 garlic cloves
- 6 brown sugar

- 5 celery ribs

Instructions:
1. Season both sides of roast with salt and pepper.
2. Combine broth, ketchup, vinegar, onions, garlic, and sugar in slow cooker.
3. Add roast and top with carrots and celery.
4. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours, until meat is tender.

ingredients_reels: dried dates | baking soda | apples | crystallized ginger | ground ginger | boiling water | butter | caster sugar | egg | self raising flour
texte:
Apple and Date Loaf

Ingredients:
- 1 dried dates
- 1 baking soda
- 380 apples
- 2 crystallized ginger
- 2 ground ginger
- 1/4 boiling water
- 2 butter
- 3/4 caster sugar
- 1 egg
- 2 self raising flour

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 180°C.
2. In a bowl put the dates, baking soda, apple, crystallised ginger, ground ginger and boiling water, stir well.
3. In another bowl mix the butter and sugar together and then beat in the egg. Gradually blend in the date mixture and sifted flour.
4. Spoon into a greased and floured loaf tin. Bake for 1 hour or until the loaf is cooked when tested with a skewer.
5. Cool in the tin for 10 minutes before transferring to a cake rack to cool.

ingredients_reels: boneless skinless chicken breast halves | parmesan cheese | salt | dried thyme | dried basil | butter | margarine | lemon wedge
texte:
Tasty Chicken Nuggets

Ingredients:
- 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves
- 1/2 parmesan cheese
- 1/4 salt
- 1 dried thyme
- 1 dried basil
- 1 butter
- 100 margarine
- lemon wedge

Instructions:
1. Cut the chicken into cubes (4 cm) Mix the breadcrumbs, cheese, salt, thyme and basil.
2. Spread the mixture on a plate.
3. Dip the chicken cubes in the melted butter.
4. Coat with the breadcrumb mixture.
5. Arrange the cubes in a single row on a baking tin which is lined with foil.
6. Bake in a preheated oven (200C) for around 8 mins and serve with lemon wedges.

Cheesy Meatloaf

Instructions:
1. Saute mushrooms, onion and garlic in butter until soft, 5-6 minutes.

ingredients_reels: ground beef | turkey | barbecue sauce | bacon | American cheese | lettuce
texte:
Ultimate Bacon Cheeseburger

Ingredients:
- 2 ground beef
- 3/4 turkey
- 8 barbecue sauce
- 4 bacon
- 4 American cheese
- lettuce

Instructions:
1. Mix meat and 1/2 cup of the barbecue sauce.
2. Shape into 8 thin patties.
3. Top 4 of the patties each with 2 bacon slices, 1 tablespoons barbecue sauce and 1 cheese singles.
4. Top each with second patty.  Press edges of patties together; seal with fork.
5. Grill patties over medium coals 7 to 9 minutes on each side or until cooked through.
6. Fill rolls with patties and lettuce.

ingredients_reels: beer | sesame seeds | honey | Dijon mustard | pepper | garlic | chicken pieces
texte:
Honey Sesame Dump Chicken - OAMC

Ingredients:
- 1/2 beer
- 3 sesame seeds
- 3 honey
- 2 Dijon mustard
- 1/2 pepper
- 2 garlic
- 1 1/2 chicken pieces

Instructions:
1. For immediate cooking: Pre-heat oven to 350°F Place all ingredients into a large baking dish, turn chicken to coat.
2. Bake until chicken juices run clear (45-60 minutes for chicken pieces, or 20-30 minutes for chicken breasts).
3. For freezing: Place all ingredients into a 1 Gallon freezer bag.
4. Lay flat in freezer.
5. To thaw and cook: Take the bag out of the freezer the night before, make sure the baggie is completely closed.
6. Place the bag in the refrigerator to thaw.
7. Preheat the oven to 350°F Empty the contents of the bag into a large baking dish and bake until the juices run clear (45-60 minutes for chicken pieces, or 20-30 minutes for chicken breasts).

Instructions:

8. When ready to serve add Whiskey Sauce and heat under broiler for a few minutes.

12. Cool and add Whiskey.

Taco Salad

nom: Easy Cheesy Spinach and Bacon Dip

texte:
Apple-Topped Cream Cheese Coffee Cake

ingredients_reels: fat-free chicken broth | vegetable broth | water | onion | Dijon mustard | dried thyme | salt | black pepper | garlic | cremini mushrooms | boneless skinless chicken breast | low-fat sour cream
texte:
Dijon Chicken Mushroom Stroganoff

- 2 onion

- 1/4 dried thyme

Instructions:

10. Serve with noodles.

ingredients_reels: boneless skinless chicken breasts | swiss cheese | asparagus
texte:
Chicken and Asparagus Roulades

ingredients_reels: blueberries | sugar | water | milk

Blueberry Milk(Finland)
