- 2 milk

Instructions:
1. In a small saucepan, heat blueberries, sugar and water over medium high heat until boiling. Reduce heat to medium-low, and let simmer for 10-15 minutes to reduce until it is thickens slightly and makes a syrup. Remove from heat and strain through a fine-mesh strainer if desired. Refrigerate.
2. Whisk together 1/4 cup blueberry syrup with 1 cup cold milk to serve.
3. This recipe will also work with strawberries, blackberries, lingonberries, and cherries.

nom: Pommes De Terre a L'etouffee (Pan Fried Potatoes)
ingredients_reels: potatoes | onions | garlic cloves | canola oil
texte:
Pommes De Terre a L'etouffee (Pan Fried Potatoes)

Ingredients:
- 2 potatoes
- 2 onions
- 4 garlic cloves
- 150 canola oil

Instructions:
1. peel and wash potatoes and cut into very thin slices.
2. chop peeled onions and garlic finely.
3. heat oil in heavy iron casserole and add the potato slices in layers with onion and garlic and seasoning in between.
4. cover the pan and cook over medium to brisk heat.
5. at first sign of steam take a large flat spoon or fllodslice and turn the potatoes over, in sections, to cook on the other side.
6. Do this twice BUT ONLY TWICE more.
7. after 25-30 mins of cooking time serve at once.
8. Note; if potatoes tend to stick to pan lower heat, DO NOT ADD ANY LIQUID.

ingredients_reels: flour | whole wheat flour | salt | sugar | butter | milk
texte:
Unleavened Communion Bread

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 flour
- 1/2 whole wheat flour
- 1/4 salt
- 1/3 sugar
- 1/2 butter
- 3 milk

Instructions:
1. Sift dry ingredients into a bowl.
2. Cut in butter with a pastry blender or 2 knives.
3. Add enough milk to pull dough together.
4. Turn dough onto very lightly floured surface and kneed gently for 5 minutes or so.
5. Weigh dough, and divide into three portions.
6. Use 3 small pieces of parchment paper, drawing circles (5 1/2\", using a small lid) in pencil, and placing the penciled side down so that the pencil marks do not show on the finished breads.
7. Place each portion onto the parchment paper.
8. Flatten and shape each loaf into size wanted, (using the markings as a guide) and score. (I flatten to about 1/4\" and score with biscuit cutter, pizza wheel, and a fork).
9. The photos show how I score the loaves. I score them so there will be 40 pieces per loaf.
10. Bake at 400° to 15-20 minutes until slightly brown at the edges. (I place the parchment and bread on a pizza stone to bake and bake them one at a time since my stone only accommodates one).

ingredients_reels: beets | margarine | maple syrup | lemon
texte:
Maple Glazed Beets

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 beets
- 3 margarine
- 2 maple syrup
- 1 lemon

Instructions:
1. Heat the oven to 400 degrees F.
2. Place the beets in a roasting pan.
3. Dot with 1 tablespoon of margarine, and roast the beets, covered, for about 30 minutes.
4. Melt the other 2 tablespoons of margarine in the microwave.
5. Stir in the maple syrup and 1 tablespoon of the lemon juice.
6. Pour this mixture over the beets.
7. Bake, covered, for another 30 minutes, or until the beets are tender and the sauce is thick.
8. Sprinkle with the lemon zest and serve.

ingredients_reels: flat leaf parsley | bulgur | onion | tomatoes | lemon juice | olive oil | salt
texte:
Lebanese Tabbouli

Ingredients:
- 6 flat leaf parsley
- 1/2 bulgur
- 1 onion
- 3 tomatoes
- 1/4 lemon juice
- 1/4 olive oil
- 1 salt

Instructions:
1. chop parsley, onion and tomato very fine.
2. add bulger, lemon juice, olive oil and salt.
3. toss and serve chilled.
4. pre soak bulgur in hot water to make soft, drain water before mixing into salad.

ingredients_reels: unsalted butter | all-purpose flour | baking powder | baking soda | salt | cottage cheese | milk | eggs | honey
texte:
Creamy Cottage Cheese Waffles

Ingredients:
- 4 unsalted butter
- 1 3/4 all-purpose flour
- 2 baking powder
- 1/4 baking soda
- 1/2 salt
- 1 cottage cheese
- 1 milk
- 2 eggs
- 2 1/2 honey

Instructions:
1. Preheat your waffle iron.
2. Preheat the oven to 200 degrees if you won't be eating immediately.
3. Melt butter, reserve.
4. Whisk dry ingredients.
5. In a seperate bowl, beat cottage cheese, milk, eggs, honey. Don't try to beat out the curds of cheese. Gradually add dry ingredients to the cottage cheese mixture, stirring only until the dry ingredients are incorporated. Stir in butter.
6. Spray grids and spoon out 1/2 cup batter onto the hot iron. Use a wooden spoon to smooth the batter almost to the edge of the grids. Close the lid and bake until browned.
7. Serve immediately, or keep in a slingle layer, on a rack in the preheated oven.

ingredients_reels: onion | butter | carrots | celery rib | caraway seed | water | cabbage | smoked kielbasa | Polish sausage | diced tomatoes | brown sugar | white kidney beans | white vinegar | salt | pepper | fresh parsley
texte:
Sausage Cabbage Soup

Ingredients:
- 1 onion
- 1 butter
- 1 carrots
- 2 celery rib
- 1 caraway seed
- 1 water
- 2 cabbage
- 2 smoked kielbasa
- 1/2 Polish sausage
- 1 diced tomatoes
- 1 brown sugar
- 1 white kidney beans
- 1 white vinegar
- 1 salt
- 1/4 pepper
- fresh parsley

Instructions:
1. In a 3-qt. saucepan, saute onion in oil and butter until tender.
2. Add carrots and celery; saute for 3 minutes. Add caraway; cook and stir 1 minute longer. Add water, cabbage, sausage, tomatoes and brown sugar; bring to a boil.
3. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
4. Add beans, vinegar, salt and pepper.
5. Simmer, uncovered, for 5-10 minutes or until heated through.
6. Sprinkle with parsley.
7. Yield: 6 servings.

ingredients_reels: flour | baking powder | baking soda | salt | cinnamon | nutmeg | brown sugar | eggs | butter | raisins | walnuts | rolled oats | applesauce
texte:
Applesauce Oatmeal Loaf

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 flour
- 1 baking powder
- 1 baking soda
- 1/2 salt
- 1 cinnamon
- 1/2 nutmeg
- 2/3 brown sugar
- 2 eggs
- 1/3 butter
- 1 raisins
- 3/4 walnuts
- 1 1/2 rolled oats
- 1 applesauce

Instructions:
1. Heat oven to 350*.
2. Grease and flour a 9 inch loaf pan.
3. Sift flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg into lg mixing bowl.
4. Add brown sugar, eggs, and all remaining ingredients.
5. Mix until throughly combined.
6. Pour into pan.
7. Bake for 55 minutes, or until a pick comes out clean.
8. Cool on wire rack.

ingredients_reels: phyllo pastry | butter | sugar | ground cinnamon | walnuts | water | lemon juice | honey
texte:
Greek Baklava

Ingredients:
- 1 phyllo pastry
- 1 butter
- 3/4 sugar
- 1 ground cinnamon
- 2 walnuts
- 1/2 water
- 1/4 lemon juice
- 1/4 honey

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 325. Layer half of the sheets of phyllo one sheet at a time, in a greased 11x7x2 baking pan, brushing each sheet evenly with butter and folding ends over if necessary to fit into pan.
2. Keep unused sheets covered with plastic wrap while assembling baklava to prevent drying.
3. Mix 1/4 cup of the sugar and cinnamon; stir in walnuts.
4. Sprinkle nut mixture evenly over buttered phyllo in pan.
5. Layer remaining phyllo, one sheet at a time, over nut mixture, brushing each sheet evenly with butter.
6. Cut diagonally into squares, cutting completely through all layers.
7. Bake in preheated oven until crisp and golden, about one hour.
8. Combine remaining sugar, the water, lemon juice and honey in small saucepan; cook and stir over low heat until sugar dissolves.
9. Heat to boiling; pour evenly over hot baklava.
10. Let stand loosely covered 8 hours or overnight.

nom: Whole Wheat Buttermilk Pancakes (With Wheat Germ)
ingredients_reels: eggs | canola oil | buttermilk | baking soda | wheat germ | whole wheat pastry flour | salt | cinnamon | nutmeg | sugar
texte:
Whole Wheat Buttermilk Pancakes (With Wheat Germ)

Ingredients:
- 2 eggs
- 1/4 canola oil
- 2 buttermilk
- 2 baking soda
- 1/2 wheat germ
- 1/2 whole wheat pastry flour
- 1/2 salt
- 1 cinnamon
- 1/2 nutmeg
- 2 sugar

Instructions:
1. Whisk together the dry ingredients in a large bowl (whole wheat flour, wheat germ, baking soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg) until well blended.
2. In a bowl, gently mix the wet ingredients (eggs, oil and buttermilk).
3. Slowly add dry to wet and mix until blended.
4. Heat stove top griddle or frying pan on medium-high heat.
5. Pour about 1/4 cup batter for each cake onto the griddle.
6. Cook until bubbles appear, and begin to gently break, then flip pancakes.
7. Cook another minute or so on the other side.
8. Serve with butter and maple syrup.

nom: Chicken Tagine with Figs, Olives, and Pistachios
ingredients_reels: olive oil | ground coriander | ground cumin | ground cinnamon | turmeric | lemon, zest of | lemon juice | harissa | chicken thighs | olive oil | onions | carrots | garlic | ginger | button mushrooms | dried figs | all-purpose flour | tomato paste | lemon juice | pitted black olives | pistachio nuts | pine nuts | fresh parsley
texte:
Chicken Tagine with Figs, Olives, and Pistachios

Ingredients:
- 2 olive oil
- 2 ground coriander
- 2 ground cumin
- 1 1/2 ground cinnamon
- 1 1/2 turmeric
- 1 lemon, zest of
- 1 1/2 lemon juice
- 1 1/2 harissa
- 8 chicken thighs
- 2 olive oil
- 2 onions
- 2 carrots
- 2 garlic
- 2 ginger
- 6 button mushrooms
- 8 dried figs
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 1 3/4 tomato paste
- 2 lemon juice
- 1 pitted black olives
- 3/4 pistachio nuts
- 1/3 pine nuts
- 2 -3 fresh parsley

Instructions:
1. Mix together 2 tbsp olive oil,coriander, cumin, cinnamon, turmeric, lemon zest and juice, and harissa paste.
2. Coat chicken thighs in spice mix.
3. Brown chicken on all sides (in 2 tbsp olive oil) in a large skillet then transfer to crockpot.
4. Add onions, carrots, garlic and ginger to the skillet and cook for about 5 minutes or until just starting to get soft.
5. Stir in mushrooms and figs, and gradually add flour to pan.
6. Cook mixture for about 1 minute, then whisk in chicken stock, tomato paste, and lemon juice.
7. Bring mixture to a boil, then transfer to crockpot, stirring to combine ingredients.
8. Cover and cook on high for 3-5 hours or until chicken is cooked and tender.
9. About 20 minutes before tagine is done, stir in olive and nuts.
10. To serve, garnish with parsley if desired.

ingredients_reels: walnuts | light corn syrup | sugar | salt
texte:
Easy Candied Walnuts

Ingredients:
- 8 walnuts
- 1/4 light corn syrup
- 2 sugar
- 1 salt

Instructions:
1. Set oven to 325°F.
2. Generously spray a baking/cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray or line with parchment paper.
3. In a medium bowl, toss the walnuts with sugar and salt, then drizzle the corn syrup over and toss with two forks to coat.
4. Spread the nuts on the baking sheet (some nuts will stick together).
5. Bake until the nuts are a deep golden and the sugar mixture is bubbling, stirring occasionally to break up lumps (this should take about 15 minutes of baking time).
6. Cool completely on the baking sheet.

ingredients_reels: brown sugar | margarine | butter | corn syrup | sugar | cinnamon | pecans
texte:
Petite Caramel Rolls

Ingredients:
- 1/4 brown sugar
- 1/4 margarine
- 2 butter
- 1 corn syrup
- 2 sugar
- 1/2 cinnamon
- 1/4 pecans

Instructions:
1. Heat oven to 375°F.
2. In bowl, combine brown sugar, margarine and corn syrup; blend well and spread in the bottom of a ungreased 8 or 9 inch round cake pan.
3. Separate dough into 4 rectangles, firmly press perforations to seal.
4. In small bowl combine sugar and cinnamon, sprinkle mixture evenly over rectangles.
5. Sprinkle 1 T of pecans on each rectangle.
6. Starting at shorter side, roll up each rectangle and pinch edges to seal.
7. Cut each roll into 4 slices.
8. Place cut side down, over brown sugar mixture in pan.
9. Bake at 375F for 20 to 27 minutes or until golden brown.
10. Cool in pan for 1 minute, invert onto serving platter or foil.
11. Serve warm or cool.

ingredients_reels: flour | ginger | baking soda | cinnamon | clove | salt | butter | sugar | egg | water | molasses | white sugar
texte:
Big Soft Ginger Cookies

Ingredients:
- 1 1/4 flour
- 2 ginger
- 1 baking soda
- 3/4 cinnamon
- 1/2 clove
- 1/4 salt
- 3/4 butter
- 1 sugar
- 1 egg
- 1 water
- 1/4 molasses
- 2 white sugar

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350º.
2. Sift together flour, ginger, baking soda, cinnamon, cloves, and salt.  Set aside.
3. In a large bowl, cream together the margarine and 1 cup sugar until light and fluffy.  Add egg, beating well after addition.  Stir in the water and molasses.  Gradually stir in the sifted ingredients into the molasses mixture.  Roll dough into walnut sized bals and roll in remaining 2 tbsps. of sugar.  Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet and slightly flatten.
4. Bake 8 to 10 minutes.
5. Allow cookies to cool 5 minutes on sheet before removing to rack to cool completely.

ingredients_reels: fresh strawberries | red wine vinegar | cracked pepper
texte:
Strawberry-peppercorn Vinaigrette Dressing

Ingredients:
- 1 fresh strawberries
- 2 red wine vinegar
- 1/8 cracked pepper

Instructions:
1. Place ingredients in food processor or blender.
2. Process or blend until smooth.

ingredients_reels: butter | onions | water | chicken bouillon granules | all-purpose flour | milk | swiss cheese | pepper | chives | parsley
texte:
Cheesy Swiss Onion Soup

Ingredients:
- 7 butter
- 1 1/2 onions
- 3 water
- 1 1/2 chicken bouillon granules
- 4 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1/4 milk
- 1 3/4 swiss cheese
- 1 1/2 pepper
- chives
- parsley

Instructions:
1. Melt 3 tablespoons of butter; toss with bread cubes.
2. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet.
3. Bake at 350° for 7 minutes; turn and bake 7 minutes longer or until toasted.
4. Meanwhile, in a large saucepan, sauté onions in remaining butter until lightly browned, about 12 minutes.
5. Stir in water and bouillon; bring to a boil.
6. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
7. Combine flour and 1/2 cup of milk until smooth; gradually stir into onion mixture.
8. Stir in remaining milk.
9. Bring to a boil; boil for 2 minutes, stirring until thickened.
10. Reduce heat to low; stir in 3/4 cup Swiss cheese and pepper.
11. Ladle into 4 oven proof bowls; sprinkle with reserved croutons and remaining cheese.
12. Broil 4 inches from heat until cheese is melted and bubbly.
13. Garnish with chives.

ingredients_reels: flour | baking powder | baking soda | butter | sugar | egg | vanilla extract
texte:
Easy Sugar Cookies

Ingredients:
- 2 3/4 flour
- 1 baking powder
- 1 baking soda
- 1 1/2 butter
- 1 1/2 sugar
- 1 egg
- 1 vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit or 175 degrees Celsius.
2. Mix the flour, baking powder, and baking soda together in a bowl; set the mixture aside.
3. Cream the butter and sugar.
4. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
5. Once combined, slowly blend in the dry ingredients until evenly mixed.
6. Searate dough into tablespoon-sized balls.
7. Place onto an ungreased cookie sheet.
8. Place on center rack and bake for 5 to 7 minutes (or until golden brown). Let the cookies sit for 2 minutes before cooling on wire racks.

nom: Sauteed Zucchini With Cherry Tomatoes, Garlic and Basil
ingredients_reels: olive oil | zucchini | garlic cloves | cherry tomatoes | fresh basil | salt | fresh ground black pepper
texte:
Sauteed Zucchini With Cherry Tomatoes, Garlic and Basil

Ingredients:
- 2 olive oil
- 2 zucchini
- 2 garlic cloves
- 3/4 cherry tomatoes
- 2 fresh basil
- 1/2 salt
- fresh ground black pepper

Instructions:
1. Heat a 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat; add the olive oil, swirling to coat the pan.  Add zucchini; cook, stirring often, until slightly browned, about 2 minutes.
2. Add the garlic; cook, stirring, until just fragrant, about 30 seconds.  Add the tomatoes; stir until softened, about 1 minute.  Stir in the basil, salt and pepper to taste.

ingredients_reels: butter | sugar | eggs | vanilla extract | flour | baking powder | salt | oats | chocolate chips | marshmallows
texte:
Chewy Oatmeal Brownies

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 1 sugar
- 2 eggs
- 2 vanilla extract
- 1/2 flour
- 1/2 baking powder
- 1/2 salt
- 1/2 oats
- 1 chocolate chips
- 1/2 marshmallows

Instructions:
1. Combine sugar, eggs and vanilla with a fork.
2. Combine dry ingredients (up to oats) in separate bowl.
3. Mix wet and dry ingredients together well with fork.
4. Stir in nuts.
5. Spread batter evenly in a greased 8 x 8 pan.
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minututes.

ingredients_reels: boneless skinless chicken breast halves | sage leaves | sage leaves | flour | olive oil | lemon juice | chicken broth | unsalted butter
texte:
Sage and Lemon Chicken

Ingredients:
- 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves
- 4 sage leaves
- 2 sage leaves
- flour
- 1 olive oil
- 1 lemon juice
- 1/4 chicken broth
- 1 unsalted butter

Instructions:
1. Place chicken breasts between wax paper or plastic wrap and pound to 1/2 inch thickness.
2. Press 2 or 3 sage leaves on the surface of each breast.
3. Combine flour,salt and pepper to taste on a plate, and gently dust chicken with the seasoned flour.
4. Heat olive oil in a medium skillet and add chicken, sage-side down.
5. Brown for 3 to 5 minutes, then turn over chicken and brown 3 minutes longer.
6. Set chicken aside and pour off any fat.
7. Add lemon juice and broth to the skillet and scrape up any browned bits with a wooden spoon.
8. Return chicken to skillet and simmer for 5 minutes or until heated through.
9. Place chicken on 2 serving plates then add butter to skillet and swirl to melt.
10. Spoon sauce over chicken.

ingredients_reels: sugar | flour | whole wheat flour | baking soda | salt | butter | regular margarine | water | eggs | sour cream | butter | regular margarine | milk | confectioners' sugar | vanilla extract
texte:
Whole Wheat Chocolate Cake

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 sugar
- 1 flour
- 3/4 whole wheat flour
- 2 baking soda
- 1 salt
- 1 butter
- 1 regular margarine
- 1/4 water
- 2 eggs
- 1/2 sour cream
- 1/2 butter
- 6 regular margarine
- 1/4 milk
- 1 confectioners' sugar
- 1 vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. Stir together sugar, flour, whole wheat flour, baking soda and salt in a mixing bowl.
2. Combine butter, water and cocoa in saucepan.
3. Bring mixture to a boil, stirring constantly.
4. Remove from heat.
5. Pour into flour mixture.
6. Mix well, using wooden spoon.
7. Blend in eggs and sour cream, mixing well.
8. Pour batter into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
9. Bake in preheated 375 degree F. oven 30 minutes or until cake tests done.
10. Cool in pan on rack.
11. Meanwhile prepare Cocoa Frosting.
12. COCOA FROSTING: Combine butter, milk, and cocoa in saucepan.
13. Cook over medium heat until butter is melted and mixture is smooth.
14. Stir in confectioners' sugar, that has been sifted.
15. Continue cooking over low heat until confectioners' sugar is completely dissolved.
16. Remove from heat.
17. Stir in vanilla.
18. Frost cake immediately.
19. Pierce warm cake with fork.
20. Pour Cocoa Frosting over all.
21. Cool completely.
22. Cut into squares.

ingredients_reels: rolled oats | brown sugar | wheat germ | ground cinnamon | wheat flour | raisins | salt | honey | egg substitute | canola oil | vanilla extract
texte:
Granola Bars!

Ingredients:
- 2 rolled oats
- 3/4 brown sugar
- 1/2 wheat germ
- 3/4 ground cinnamon
- 1 wheat flour
- 3/4 raisins
- 3/4 salt
- 1/2 honey
- 1/4 egg substitute
- 1/2 canola oil
- 2 vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350ºF.  Generously grease a 9x13 inch-baking pan.  In a large bowl, mix together the oats, brown sugar, wheat germ, cinnamon, flour, raisins and salt. Make a well in the center, and pour in the honey, egg, oil and vanilla. Mix well using your hands. Pat the mixture evenly into the prepared pan.
2. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes in the preheated oven, until the bars begin to turn golden at the edges. Cool for 5 minutes, then cut into bars while still warm. Do not allow the bars to cool completely before cutting, or they will be too hard to cut.

ingredients_reels: sugar | cocoa powder | margarine | water | vanilla
texte:
Chocolate Fudge Frosting - Dairy Free

Ingredients:
- 2 sugar
- 1/2 cocoa powder
- 1/2 margarine
- 1/4 water
- 1 vanilla

Instructions:
1. Mix all ingredients except vanilla.
2. Bring to full rolling boil and boil for 1 minute.
3. Remove from heat, add vanilla and beat until creamy.

nom: Grilled Pineapple With Rum Reduction Sauce
ingredients_reels: pineapple | vanilla extract | brown sugar | rum
texte:
Grilled Pineapple With Rum Reduction Sauce

Ingredients:
- 1 pineapple
- 1 vanilla extract
- 1/2 brown sugar
- 1/2 rum

Instructions:
1. Cut the pineapple into 8 wedges, remove core and rind with a knife.
2. Place the wedges into a freezer bag with the brown sugar, seal the bag and massage brown sugar onto the wedges.
3. Allow the pineapple to macerate in the brown sugar for anywhere from two hours to two days; refrigerate if macerating more than a few hours.  The pineapple should release enough juice to dissolve the brown sugar completely.
4. Heat the grill to medium heat.
5. Add the vanilla and rum to the bag, seal and shake.
6. Remove the pineapple from the bag and place it on the grill.
7. When the pineapple becomes caramel colored on the bottom side, rotate it.  Repeat for each of the 3 sides of each wedge, then remove from the grill.
8. Pour the juice from the bag into a saucepan and reduce over medium heat to a thick syrup (be careful of flare-ups during the first minutes since there will be alcohol from the rum and vanilla extract).
9. Serve the pineapple alongside a main dish or serve with ice cream and drizzle with the reduction sauce.

ingredients_reels: self raising flour | ice cream
texte:
ice cream muffins

Ingredients:
- 2 self raising flour
- 2 ice cream

Instructions:
1. measure 2 cups ice cream and allow to soften.
2. add to 2 cups of flour and stir until mixed.
3. spoon into paper muffin cups and bake in 375 oven approx.
4. 15-18 minutes.
5. I know this sounds crazy but they really work!

ingredients_reels: rice | water | milk | flour | sugar | fresh lemon rind | vanilla | cinnamon
texte:
Rizogalo - Rice Pudding

Ingredients:
- 4 rice
- 1 water
- 1 milk
- 1 1/2 flour
- 1/2 sugar
- 1/2 fresh lemon rind
- vanilla
- cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Boil water; add rice, stir once and simmer for 15 minutes.
2. Add milk and simmer 30 minutes longer, stirring occasionally.
3. Mix flour with 4 tablespoons water.
4. Add to rice mixture slowly and stir.
5. Add sugar and simmer for 15 minutes.
6. Remove from heat, add vanilla or lemon rind, and pour into 4 individual custard cups or small dishes.
7. Sprinkle with cinnamon.

nom: Sauteed Cherry Tomatoes with Mediterranean Herbs
ingredients_reels: extra virgin olive oil | cherry tomatoes | fresh basil | salt
texte:
Sauteed Cherry Tomatoes with Mediterranean Herbs

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 extra virgin olive oil
- 2 cherry tomatoes
- 3 fresh basil
- salt

Instructions:
1. In a large nonstick skillet, heat the oil over medium-high heat.
2. Add the tomatoes and cook, tossing and stirring often, until the skins begin to split, about 3 minutes.
3. Do not over cook.
4. Remove from the heat and toss with the herbs; season with salt and pepper.
5. Serve immediately.
6. Makes 4-6 servings.

ingredients_reels: dry yeast | warm water | flour | sugar | salt | butter | butter | egg | milk
texte:
Better Batter Butter Rolls

Ingredients:
- 1/2 dry yeast
- 1/2 warm water
- 4 1/2 flour
- 1/4 sugar
- 1 salt
- 1 butter
- 2 butter
- 1 egg
- 1 milk

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water (110); let stand until bubbly (about 15 minutes).
2. Stir together 2 cups of flour, sugar and salt.
3. Add 6 tablespoons of melted butter, along with egg, yeast mixture and milk.
4. Beat 5 minutes to blend well.
5. Gradually add remaining flour.
6. Cover bowl; Let batter rise for about 45 minutes or until doubled in size.
7. Pour the remaining melted butter into a 9\" X 13\" baking pan; Tilt pan to coat the bottom.
8. Beat batter down and drop by spoonfuls into buttered pan. Makes about 15 rolls.
9. Drizzle remaining 2 tablespoons of butter onto rolls.
10. Cover and let rise for 30 minutes (Almost doubled in size).
11. Bake at 350 deg F for 15 to 20 minutes or until done.
12. (Rolls will sound hollow when tapped on top lightly when they are done).

ingredients_reels: shortening | butter | sweetened condensed milk | vanilla
texte:
Condensed Milk Frosting

Ingredients:
- 1/2 shortening
- 1/2 butter
- 14 sweetened condensed milk
- 5 vanilla

Instructions:
1. Beat shortening and butter for approximately 5 minutes.
2. Add condensed milk and beat another 5 minutes.
3. Add vanilla and beat again until desired thickness.

ingredients_reels: shallots | flour | canola oil | salt
texte:
Crispy Fried Shallots

Ingredients:
- 10 -15 shallots
- 4 flour
- canola oil
- 1 salt

Instructions:
1. Heat the oil to 360°F.
2. Separate the shallot slices into rings and place them in a medium bowl.
3. Make certain the shallots are not moist, since otherwise they may splatter when they go into the oil.
4. Sprinkle flour over the shallots and toss them lightly to coat evenly.
5. Working with a small quantity, sprinkle the shallots over the oil and stir gently to keep them separated.
6. Fry until golden brown, about 12-14 minutes.
7. Remove with a slotted spoon, then put on paper towels to drain the oil.
8. Sprinkle with salt while still warm.
9. Continue frying the rest of the shallots, salting each batch while it is still warm.
10. Use as a garnish for Spiced Carrot Soup, Recipe #108333.

nom: Asparagus With Fresh Tomato Yogurt Sauce
ingredients_reels: asparagus | plain yogurt | mayonnaise | lemon juice | diced tomato | salt | fresh ground pepper
texte:
Asparagus With Fresh Tomato Yogurt Sauce

Ingredients:
- 2 asparagus
- 1/3 plain yogurt
- 2 mayonnaise
- 1 lemon juice
- 1 diced tomato
- salt
- fresh ground pepper

Instructions:
1. Cut asparagus in 2 or 3 pieces.
2. Cook in boiling salted water until just tender but still bright green* (Tip- Watch the cut surface. When the white center changes from opaque to translucent, check for doneness) Drain and rinse with cold water to stop the cooking process.
3. Pat dry with paper towels.
4. While asparagus is cooking, combine the yogurt, mayonnaise, lemon juice, tomatoes, salt and fresh ground pepper.
5. Place the asparagus on a flat plate and spoon the sauce across the center.
6. Serve at room temperature.

ingredients_reels: pumpkin puree | evaporated milk | eggs | sugar | salt | cinnamon | pecans | butter | margarine
texte:
Dawn's Pumpkin Pecan Dump Cake

Ingredients:
- 1 pumpkin puree
- 1 evaporated milk
- 3 eggs
- 1 sugar
- 1 salt
- 3 cinnamon
- 1 pecans
- 1 1/2 butter
- 1 margarine

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350.
2. In a mixing bowl, combine first 6 ingredients, until well blended.

4. Sprinkle DRY cake mix on top, then cover with pecans.
5. Pour melted margarine or butter over top.
6. Bake 50-60 mins., or until golden brown.
7. Serve with Cool Whip or whipped cream on top.

ingredients_reels: flour | baking powder | baking soda | salt | bananas | sugar | eggs
texte:
Banana Bread

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 flour
- 2 baking powder
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1 salt
- 2 -5 bananas
- 1/2 sugar
- 2 eggs

Instructions:
1. Prehead oven to 350°F.
2. Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt together.
3. Smash bananas.
4. Whisk egg whites and sugar until stiff or take on a creamy look.
5. Mix egg yolks with smashed bananas and 1/2 of the amount of flour.
6. Then gradually add in the remaining flour.
7. Fold in egg whites/sugar mixture into the banana mixture (Note: do not overmix) Pour mixture into a greased tin and bake for approximately 1 hour.

ingredients_reels: celery | onion | parsley | black pepper | sage | hot chicken broth | turkey broth | salt
texte:
Emaw's Cornbread Dressing

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 celery
- 1 onion
- 2 parsley
- 1/2 black pepper
- 1 1/2 sage
- 9 hot chicken broth
- 8 -9 turkey broth
- salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Mix all the ingredients except stock.
3. Pour hot stock over everything and mix well.
4. Pour into a large casserole or roasting pan.
5. I use a 12 x 14 x 6 pan.
6. Bake for at least one hour, depending on the size pan you use, you may have to bake an additional half hour.

ingredients_reels: self-raising flour | sugar | salt | beer | pesto sauce | milk | sesame seeds
texte:
Pesto Beer Bread

Ingredients:
- 3 self-raising flour
- 1 sugar
- 1 salt
- 375 beer
- 1/2 pesto sauce
- milk
- sesame seeds

Instructions:
1. Sift flour into a bowl. Blend in sugar & salt.
2. Add enough beer to make a smooth pliable dough.
3. Using floured fingers press out onto a lightly floured surface and spread with pesto.
4. Roll up like a swiss roll and place in a greased 10 x 20cm loaf tin.
5. Brush lightly with milk & sprinkle with sesame seeds.
6. Bake at 220 C for 30-40 mins or until hollow when tapped.

ingredients_reels: English cucumber | celery | parsley | fresh dill | sugar | white vinegar | salt
texte:
Scandinavian Cucumber Salad

Ingredients:
- 1 English cucumber
- 1 celery
- 1 parsley
- fresh dill
- 1 sugar
- 2 white vinegar
- 1 salt

Instructions:
1. Slice the cucumbers fairly thin.
2. Finely chop the celery, parsley, and dill. Add to the cucumbers.
3. Mix together the remaining ingredients and pour over the cucumbers.
4. Cover and chill for a minimum of 1 hour. Stir before serving.

ingredients_reels: fat-free ricotta cheese | sugar | cinnamon | vanilla | flour tortillas
texte:
Sweet Tortilla Roll-Ups

Ingredients:
- 1/2 fat-free ricotta cheese
- 2 sugar
- 2 cinnamon
- 1/4 vanilla
- 4 flour tortillas

Instructions:
1. Set oven to broil.
2. In a mixing bowl blend ricotta cheese, sugar, cinnamon and vanilla.
3. Spread about 2 tablespoons of filling down center of each tortilla.
4. Fold ends of each tortilla in and roll up like a burrito.
5. Place on cookie sheet and broil approximately.
6. 1 minute.
7. Serve warm.

ingredients_reels: potato | green onions | parsley | Dijon mustard | salt | lemon zest | black pepper | Tabasco sauce | egg | salmon
texte:
Salmon Cakes - Canadian Living

Ingredients:

- 3 green onions
- 1/4 parsley
- 1 Dijon mustard
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 lemon zest
- 1/4 black pepper
- 1/4 Tabasco sauce

Instructions:
1. In large bowl, mash potatoes until smooth; stir in onions, parsley, mustard, salt, lemon zest, pepper and tabasco sauce. Blend in the egg. Fold in salmon. Let cool for 5 minutes.
2. Using your hands, shape into eight 3/4-inch (2 cm) thick patties.
3. In a large nonstick skillet, cook on medium heat using oil or cooking spray.  It should take about 5 minutes per side to get to a nice golden brown.

ingredients_reels: avocados | fresh basil | chopped tomato | green onions | fresh lime juice | salt | crushed red pepper flakes | tortilla chips
texte:
Basil Guacamole

Ingredients:
- 2 avocados
- 3/4 fresh basil
- 1/2 chopped tomato
- 2 green onions
- 1 fresh lime juice
- 1/4 - 1/2 salt
- 1/4 crushed red pepper flakes
- tortilla chips

Instructions:
1. In a bowl mash avocado with a fork.
2. Stir in basil, tomato, green onion, lime juice, salt, and red pepper.
3. Serve immediately with tortilla chips.
4. Makes about 2 cups.

ingredients_reels: sugar | salt | bread flour | active dry yeast | milk | butter | butter | cinnamon | sugar | pecans | walnuts | powdered sugar | milk | butter | vanilla
texte:
Bread Machine Yeast Coffee Cake (Abm)

Ingredients:
- 1/4 sugar
- 1 salt
- 2 1/4 bread flour
- 2 active dry yeast
- 1 milk
- 7/8 butter
- 1 butter
- 2 cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Add all cake ingredients to bread pan.

3. Grease a 9 inch round pan or an 8 x 8 inch square pan.
4. After cycle is through (about 90 minutes), remove dough and pat dough into prepared pan.

8. Preheat oven to 375* and bake cake for 20-25 minutes, until golden.
9. Cool 10 minutes in pan on wire rack.
10. Drizzle with optional glaze, if desired.

12. Spread or drizzle glaze over slightly warm cake.

ingredients_reels: extra virgin olive oil | red wine vinegar | lemon juice | Dijon mustard | garlic clove | sour cream | mayonnaise | extra-sharp cheddar cheese | green onions | sea salt | fresh ground black pepper
texte:
Cheddar Cheese Dressing

ingredients_reels: butter | Worcestershire sauce | lemon juice | sugar | paprika | garlic powder | pork

Tangy Pork

ingredients_reels: soy sauce | dry sherry | brown sugar | garlic cloves | pepper | barbecue sauce | pineapple chunks | pork
texte:
Polynesian Barbecued Pork (Crock Pot)

Ingredients:

ingredients_reels: eggs | cottage cheese | sour cream | lemon juice | salt | baking soda | flour
texte:
Cottage Cheese/Sour Cream Pancakes

Ingredients:
- 2 eggs
- 2/3 cottage cheese
- 3/4 sour cream
- 2 lemon juice
- 3/4 salt
- 1/2 baking soda

Instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients.
2. Let the batter stand undisturbed for 10 minutes.
3. Fry in a large pan, in melted butter on a moderately hot griddle.  Serve hot.

ingredients_reels: garlic cloves | Dijon mustard | lime juice | chicken pieces
texte:
Garlic Dijon Dump Chicken

Ingredients:
- 2 garlic cloves
- 4 Dijon mustard
- 2 lime juice
- 1 1/2 chicken pieces

Instructions:
1. For immediate cooking: Preheat oven to 350°F Place all ingredients into a large baking dish, turn chicken to coat. Bake until chicken juices run clear (45-60 minutes for chicken pieces, or 20-30 minutes for chicken breasts).
2. For freezing: Place all ingredients into a 1-gallon freezer bag. Lay flat in freezer.

nom: Country-Style Pork Loin in the Crock Pot

texte:
Country-Style Pork Loin in the Crock Pot

- 1 onion powder
- 1 ground mustard
- 2 canola oil

Instructions:
1. Cut pork roast in half.
2. In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the flour, onion powder and mustard. Add pork, one piece at a time, and shake to coat.

5. Pour broth over pork.
6. Cover and cook on low for 5-6 hours or until tender.
7. Remove pork and keep warm.
8. For gravy, pour 2-1/2 cups cooking juices into a large saucepan. Combine cornstarch and water until smooth; stir into juices. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.

ingredients_reels: butter | white sugar | water | vanilla | flour | pecans | powdered sugar
texte:
Best Pecan Sandies

Ingredients:

- 2/3 white sugar

Instructions:
1. Cream to gether butter and sugar until smooth.
2. Beat in water and vanilla.
3. Stir in the flour and pecans until well blended (I use the mixer).
4. Cover dough and chill at least 4 hours (can be chilled over night).
5. Preheat oven 325 degrees.
6. Shape dough into walnut sized balls or cresents.
7. Place 2 inches apart onto cookie sheets.
8. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes.
9. Roll in powdered sugar while still warm.
10. I like to double roll them in the powdered sugar.

ingredients_reels: butter | sugar | brown sugar | eggs | vanilla | flour | cocoa powder | baking soda | baking powder | salt | white chocolate chips
texte:
Reverse Chocolate Chip Cookies

Ingredients:

- 3/4 sugar

Instructions:
1. preheat oven at 350 degrees.
2. Melt butter in microwave or in double boiler, pour into large bowl.
3. Add sugars and beat until desolved.
4. While beating add eggs one at a time and add vanilla.
5. When wet ingredients are well mixed, add dry ingredients except chocolate chips in order listed.
6. Fold in chocolate chips.
7. Form with your hands little pucks about 2inches in diameter using 1 oz of dough and place on parchemin paper lined cookie sheet, do not overload cookie sheet.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | salt | shortening | butter | water
texte:
Pastry Crust (Pie Crust)

Ingredients:
- 2 1/4 all-purpose flour
- 3/4 salt
- 1/2 shortening
- 5 butter
- 5 -7 water

Instructions:
1. Add flour and salt to food processor work bowl fitted with multi-purpose blade.  Pulse for 2 seconds to blend.
2. Add shortening and butter.  Pulse 3-4 times, about 2-3 seconds each time, until mixture is crumbly.
3. Sprinkle 5 tablespoons ice-cold water over mixture and pulse 1-3 times, about 2-3 seconds each time, until mixture pulls away from sides of work bowl and starts to form a loose ball.  If necessary you can add up to 1-2 more tablespoons of water a bit at a time, but don't let it get too wet.
4. Remove from bowl and form into 2 balls.
5. On a lightly floured surface, roll each ball into a circle.
6. Use crusts as directed in your recipe, for one double-crust pie, or two single-crust pies.

nom: Four Cheese Panini With Basil Tomatoes

3. Cut panini in half and serve at once.

ingredients_reels: mini marshmallows | water | icing sugar | Crisco shortening
texte:
Marshmallow Fondant

Ingredients:
- 16 mini marshmallows
- 2 -5 water
- 2 icing sugar
- 1/2 Crisco shortening

Instructions:
1. Melt marshmallows and 2 tablespoons of water in a microwave or double boiler: Put the bowl in the microwave for 30 seconds, open microwave and stir, back in microwave for 30 seconds more, open microwave and stir again, and continue doing this until melted.
2. It usually takes about 2 ½ minutes total. Place 3/4 of the powdered sugar on the top of the melted marshmallow mix.
3. Now grease your hands GENEROUSLY - palms, backs and in between fingers, then heavily grease the counter you will be using and dump the bowl of marshmallow/sugar mixture in the middle.
4. Start kneading like you would bread dough. You will immediately see why you have greased your hands.
5. Keep kneading, this stuff is sticky at this stage! Add the rest of the powdered sugar and knead some more.
6. Re-grease your hands and counter when the fondant is sticking. If the mix is tearing easily, it is to dry, so add water (about ½ tablespoon at a time then knead it in). It usually takes me about 8 minutes to get a firm smooth elastic ball so that it will stretch without tearing when you apply it to the cake.
7. Its best if you can let it sit, double wrapped, overnight (but you can use it right away if there are no tiny bits of dry powdered sugar). If you do see them, you will need to knead and maybe add a few more drops of water.
8. Prepare the fondant for storing by coating it with a good layer of Crisco shortening, wrap in a plastic- type wrap product and then put it in a re-sealable or Ziploc bag. Squeeze out as much air as possible.
9. MM Fondant will hold very well in the refrigerator for weeks. If I know that I have a cake to decorate, I usually make 2 batches on a free night during the week so it is ready when I need it.  Take advantage of the fact that this fondant can be prepared well in advance.

nom: Cappuccino Recipe Without an Expensive Machine
ingredients_reels: skim milk | sugar | brewed coffee
texte:
Cappuccino Recipe Without an Expensive Machine

Ingredients:
- 1 skim milk
- 1 sugar
- 1 1/2 brewed coffee

Instructions:
1. 1) After your coffee has brewed, combine the sugar & milk and heat it in your microwave for 2 minutes at the highest setting.
2. 2) Next, whip the heated milk/sugar mix in your blender for about one minute until it's a fluffy foam.
3. 3) Fill your cup two thirds full with the coffee and top it off with your heated froth.

ingredients_reels: boneless skinless chicken breasts | flour | pineapple chunks in juice | cider vinegar | soy sauce | sugar | ginger | chicken bouillon cube | cold water | cornstarch | green pepper | cooked rice
texte:
Waikiki Beach Chicken and Pineapple

Ingredients:
- 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts
- 1/2 flour
- 1 pineapple chunks in juice
- 3/4 cider vinegar
- 2 soy sauce
- 1 sugar
- 1/2 ginger
- 1 chicken bouillon cube
- 1/4 cold water
- 2 cornstarch
- 1 green pepper
- 3 cooked rice

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F and spray a 9x13 baking pan or dish with cooking spray.
2. Set aside.
3. Trim any visible fat from chicken breasts and dry thoroughly with paper towels.
4. Coat chicken with flour, shaking off any excess.
5. Place chicken in prepared dish and place in oven while preparing sauce.
6. Drain juice from pineapple into a medium saucepan and set pineapple chunks aside.
7. Add the vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, ginger, and bouillon cube to saucepan.
8. Combine cornstarch and water and blend until smooth.
9. Add to saucepan and bring to boil over medium-high heat, whisking slowly to dissolve sugar.
10. Boil for two minutes, whisking vigorously.
11. The sauce should thicken and turn clear after boiling for about 1 minute or so.
12. Pour sauce over chicken and lower oven temperature to 350°F.
13. Bake for 20 minutes.
14. Meanwhile, remove stem and seeds from green pepper and remove white veins.
15. Slice into rings and set aside.
16. Distribute pineapple chunks and pepper rings evenly over chicken and bake 20 more minutes.
17. To serve, place about 2/3 cup rice on plate and top with a chicken breast.
18. Top with plenty of the pineapple and pepper rings and drizzle a generous amount of the sauce over all.
19. Serve at once.
20. NOTE: Be sure to use Heinz apple cider vinegar, not a store brand in the sauce.
21. Using any other brand will make the sauce foam up and boil over in addition to having a poor flavor.

ingredients_reels: oatmeal | flour | baking powder | baking soda | butter | brown sugar | salt | dates | sugar | water | butter | vanilla | walnuts
texte:
Date Bars from my Childhood

- 1/2 salt
- 1 dates

3. Set aside to cool a bit.
4. Prepare the crust: Combine all dry ingredients with the melted butter.

ingredients_reels: butter | margarine | cream cheese | sugar | vanilla | sugar | cinnamon
texte:
Easy Cheese Danish

Ingredients:
- 3 butter

- 1 sugar

- sugar

1. Unroll 2 pkgs.
2. Crescent rolls onto a cookie sheet, pinch edges together.

4. Unroll crescent rolls cut into strips, lace on top of cream cheese mixture.

ingredients_reels: Brussels sprouts | butter | onion | carrot | flour | dried marjoram | pepper | nutmeg | vegetable broth | egg | half-and-half | dry white wine | salt
texte:
German Brussels Sprouts Soup

Ingredients:
- 2 Brussels sprouts
- 2 butter

- 1 carrot
- 2 flour
- 1/4 dried marjoram

- 1/8 nutmeg

Instructions:

2. Add chicken broth and cook and stir as you bring mixture to a boil. Stir in halved Brussels sprouts; reduce heat. Cover and simmer until Brussels sprouts are just tender, about 7 minutes (may be shorter if using frozen thawed sprouts).
3. In a small bowl, beat together egg, milk and wine and stir into soup. Heat until soup returns to a boil.
4. Serve.

ingredients_reels: green chilies | cayenne pepper | sharp cheddar cheese | eggs | egg substitute
texte:
Mexican Cheese Squares

- 1/2 cayenne pepper
- 1 sharp cheddar cheese

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Spread green chilis (and jalapenos, if using) in bottom of pan.
3. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper.
4. Sprinkle cheese over green chili peppers.
5. Pour beaten eggs over all.
6. Bake for 30-40 minutes or until firm in the center.
7. Cool.
8. Cut into 1-inch squares and serve hot or at room temperature.

10. To serve, thaw, microwave on defrost until warm.
11. Cool.
12. Cut into squares and serve.

ingredients_reels: zucchini | kosher salt | garlic cloves | canola oil
texte:
Garlicky FLASH Zucchini

Ingredients:
- 1 zucchini
- 1/2 kosher salt
- 2 -4 garlic cloves
- 1 canola oil

Instructions:
1. Slice the zucchini lengthwise into 1/3-inch-thick slices, and then diagonally to make 1/3-inch wide batons. Drop them in a bowl, sprinkle with the kosher salt and toss thoroughly with your fingers. Transfer the zucchini to a colander set over the bowl. Let rest for no more than 30 minutes, then lift out and blot dry with paper towels.
2. Meanwhile, crush the garlic through a press and set aside.
3. Heat a big, heavy cast-iron skillet or wok over a high flame. When it's hot enough to make a droplet of water dance, add the oil and swirl it around until it just starts to smoke. Keeping the heat as high as possible, add the blotted zucchini all at once. Spread it out in a single layer and keep it in the blazing-hot pan for 30 seconds or so to encourage some browning.
4. When you're sure you see brown spots on the underside of the zucchini pieces, add in the garlic and stir-fry continuously with a slotted spoon until most of the zucchini is a mix of bright green skin and creamy flesh with golden-brown spots, and just tender. It shouldn't take more than a minute or two. Serve immediately.

texte:
Magical Creamy Chocolate Banana Oatmeal

- 1/4 ground cinnamon
- 1/4 vanilla extract
- 1 banana

Instructions:
1. Bring 2 1/4 cups chocolate ilk and the salt to a gentle boil in a medium saucepan.
2. Stir in dried oats and cinnamon.  Reduce heat.
3. Gently boil, uncovered, over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
4. Remove from heat; let stand for 2 to 3 minutes to slightly absorb excess milk in mixture.
5. To serve, stir vanilla into oatmeal, then gently stir in banana.
6. Spoon oatmeal into bowls and pour 2 T chocolate milk over each serving.

ingredients_reels: unsalted butter | granulated sugar | eggs | lemon, zest of | flour | baking powder | baking soda | kosher salt | fresh lemon juice | buttermilk | vanilla extract | confectioners' sugar | fresh lemon juice
texte:
Incredible Lemon Cake

Ingredients:
- 1/2 unsalted butter
- 2 1/2 granulated sugar
- 4 eggs
- 1/3 lemon, zest of
- 3 flour
- 1/2 baking powder
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1 kosher salt
- 3/4 fresh lemon juice
- 3/4 buttermilk
- 1 vanilla extract
- 2 confectioners' sugar
- 3 1/2 fresh lemon juice

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Grease and flour 2 (8 1/2 x 4 1/4 x 2 1/2-inch) loaf pans, lining the bottom with parchment paper, if desired.
3. Cream, using paddle attachment, butter and 2 C granulated sugar in bowl of electric mixer until light and fluffy, approximately 5 minutes.
4. With mixer on medium speed, add eggs, 1 at a time, and the lemon zest.
5. Sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt into a bowl.
6. In another bowl, combine 1/4 C lemon juice, buttermilk and vanilla.
7. Alternately add flour and buttermilk mixtures to batter, beginning and ending with flour mixture.
8. Divide batter evenly between pans, smoothing the tops.
9. Bake 45 minutes- 1 hour, until tester comes out clean.
10. When cakes are done, cool 10 minutes.
11. Meanwhile, combine 1/2 C granulated sugar and 1/2 C lemon juice in small saucepan, cooking over low heat until sugar dissolves.
12. Remove cakes from pans and set on wire rack over jelly pan (best to set upside down on rack so that syrup is spooned onto the bottom of the cake as it will absorb better than spooning over the top).
13. Spoon lemon syrup over cakes.
14. Allow cakes to cool completely.
15. Glaze: Combine confectioners' sugar and lemon juice in a bowl, mixing with whisk until smooth.
16. Pour over the tops of the cakes and allow to drizzle down the sides.
17. Garnish with 2 lemon slices and some greens (e. g., Italian parsley or mint leaves), as desired.

ingredients_reels: flour | salt | sugar | baking powder | milk | eggs | vanilla | butter | butter | brown sugar | flour | cinnamon | powdered sugar | milk | vanilla

ingredients_reels: flour | sugar | baking powder | salt | egg | shortening | milk | vanilla | walnuts

Old Fashioned Walnut Bread

ingredients_reels: mayonnaise | ketchup | horseradish | Worcestershire sauce | kosher salt | smoked bacon | iceberg lettuce | cherry tomatoes | scallions | blue cheese | fresh ground pepper | fresh parsley
texte:

- 1 horseradish

- kosher salt
- 6 smoked bacon
- 1 iceberg lettuce
- 5 cherry tomatoes
- 4 scallions
- 1/2 blue cheese
- fresh ground pepper
- 1 fresh parsley

Instructions:
1. Make the dressing by whisking the mayo, ketchup, horseradish, Worcestershire sauce and salt to taste in a small bowl to smooth.
2. Cook the bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crisp, then transfer with a slotted spoon to a paper towel lined plate to drain.

nom: Gingerbread Cake With Brown Sugar Sauce
ingredients_reels: egg | canola oil | molasses | sugar | ginger | ground cloves | cinnamon | salt | baking soda | boiling water | all-purpose flour | brown sugar | all-purpose flour | salt | water | vanilla
texte:
Gingerbread Cake With Brown Sugar Sauce

Ingredients:
- 1 egg
- 1/2 canola oil
- 1/2 molasses
- 1/2 sugar
- 3/4 ginger
- 1/4 ground cloves
- 1/4 cinnamon
- 1/2 salt
- 1 baking soda
- 1/2 boiling water
- 1 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1 brown sugar
- 1/4 all-purpose flour
- 1/2 salt
- 2 water
- 1 vanilla

Instructions:
1. For cake:  Beat egg in mixing bowl until frothy.  Beat in cooking oil and molasses.
2. Add sugar, ginger, cloves, cinnamon and salt.  Beat slowly to combine.
3. Dissolve baking soda in boiling water and add to batter.  Slowly mix in flour.
4. Turn into greased 8x8 or 9x9 pan.  Bake at 350°F for about 35-40 minutes or until an inserted toothpick comes out clean.
5. Serve warm with brown sugar sauce.  (Freezes well).
6. For sauce:  Mix brown sugar, flour and salt together well in medium saucepan.  (This enables water to be mixed in with no lumps).
7. Stir in water and vanilla.  Heat, stirring, over medium heat until sauce boils and thickens (makes about 2 1/2 cups).  Serve warm.

ingredients_reels: chicken broth | garlic cloves | fresh basil | parmesan cheese | pine nuts
texte:
Low Fat Pesto Sauce

Ingredients:
- 2/3 chicken broth
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1 fresh basil
- 1/3 parmesan cheese
- 2 pine nuts

Instructions:
1. Combine stock and garlic and heat in the microwave on high for 5 minutes (or heat on the stove). Allow to cool.
2. Chop basil in food processor. Add cooled stock, Parmesan cheese and pine nuts. Whirl until everything is finely chopped and blended.
3. Meanwhile, cook pasta of your choice. Toss sauce with pasta. Serve with additional Parmesan cheese if desired. Use as a topping for fish, chicken or potatoes also. Makes 4 servings.

ingredients_reels: unbleached all-purpose flour | sugar | baking powder | baking soda | salt | nutmeg | honey | milk | unsalted butter | egg
texte:
Honey Muffins

Ingredients:
- 2 unbleached all-purpose flour
- 1/4 sugar
- 2 baking powder
- 1 baking soda
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 nutmeg
- 1/2 honey
- 1/2 milk
- 1/3 unsalted butter
- 1 egg

Instructions:
1. In a large mixing bowl, add the first 6 ingredients; stir to combine.
2. In another bowl, add the honey, milk, butter, and egg; whisk to combine and until mixture is smooth.
3. Add liquid ingredients to dry ingredients.
4. Fold in just until moistened (do not overmix).
5. Pour batter into 12 muffin tins that have been lightly buttered or sprayed with non-stick spray.
6. Bake at 400° for about 20 minutes or until pick comes out clean.
7. Cool in pan on a wire rack before turning out of pan.

ingredients_reels: self rising flour | milk | egg | shortening
texte:
Self Rising Biscuits

Ingredients:
- 2 self rising flour
- 2/3 milk
- 1 egg
- 3 shortening

Instructions:
1. Mix together.
2. Place onto floured surface.
3. Roll to 1/2 inch thickness.
4. Cut.
5. Bake at 450 for 10 to 12 minutes.

ingredients_reels: cooked white rice | canola oil | boneless skinless chicken thighs | boneless skinless chicken breast | onion | gingerroot | garlic | garam masala | chili powder | ground cumin | tomato sauce | nonfat sour cream | fat-free evaporated milk | butter | lemon juice | bay leaf
texte:
Indian Chicken Makhani

Ingredients:
- 2 cooked white rice
- 1 canola oil
- 1 boneless skinless chicken thighs
- 1 boneless skinless chicken breast
- 1 onion
- 1 gingerroot
- 2 garlic
- 1 garam masala
- 1 chili powder
- 1/2 ground cumin
- 1 tomato sauce
- 1 nonfat sour cream
- 2 fat-free evaporated milk
- 2 butter
- 1 lemon juice
- bay leaf

Instructions:
1. Start cooking rice.
2. Cook chicken in oil in a large pot over med-high heat until just starting to brown.
3. Add onion and some salt, stir until the onion is soft.
4. Add ginger and garlic; stir for 2 minutes. Sprinkle on garam masala, chili powder, cumin, and red pepper, stirring for 2 minutes.
5. Stir in remaining ingredients and bring to a boil.
6. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes.
7. Remove bay leaf and stir in prepared rice. Taste for more salt and black pepper.
8. Plate and garnish with chopped scallions/green onions and/or cilantro (if desired).

ingredients_reels: part-skim mozzarella cheese | parmesan cheese | all-purpose flour
texte:
WW Cheese Crisps

Ingredients:
- 1 part-skim mozzarella cheese
- 2 parmesan cheese
- 1 all-purpose flour

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 400*.
2. Spray 2 baking sheets with nonstick spray.
3. Combine all the ingredients in a small bowl.
4. Drop the cheese mixture by tablespoons onto the greased cookie sheets.
5. You should have about 16.
6. Bake 5- 7 minutes, until cheese melts and edges are a darker brown.
7. Remove from the oven and let sit on the baking sheet for one minute, then remove and place on paper towels to finish cooling.
8. Crisps can be stored in an airtight container up 2 days at room temperature.

ingredients_reels: warm water | dry yeast | sugar | margarine | egg | self rising flour
texte:
Spoon Rolls

Ingredients:
- 2 warm water
- 1 dry yeast
- 1/4 sugar
- 3/4 margarine
- 1 egg
- 4 self rising flour

Instructions:
1. Dissolve yeast in warm water (using wood or plastic spoon and plastic or glass bowl) Add remaining ingredients as listed.
2. Grease muffin pan, or spray with pam.
3. Fill each muffin space 1/2 full.
4. Bake on 425 F.
5. about 20 minutes.
6. Mixture will be soupy and will not need to rise.
7. If you don't want to bake all of these at the same time, the dough may be kept in the refrigerator for several days.

ingredients_reels: water | old fashioned oats | quick-cooking oats | salt | dried cherries | vanilla extract | 1% low-fat milk
texte:
Cherry Vanilla Oatmeal

Ingredients:
- 1 3/4 water
- 1 old fashioned oats
- 1/8 quick-cooking oats
- 1/4 salt
- 1/2 dried cherries
- 2 vanilla extract
- 1/4 1% low-fat milk

Instructions:
1. Put water, oats, salt and cherries into a medium sized saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat and simmer for about 5 minutes for old fashioned oats, or 1 minute for quick cooking oats.
2. Remove from heat. Stir in the vanilla extract and cherry jam.
3. Put into serving bowls and pour 2 tablespoons of milk over each bowl.

ingredients_reels: water | tea bags | sugar | Splenda sugar substitute
texte:
Southern Sweetened Iced Tea

Ingredients:
- 2 water
- 2 tea bags
- 1 sugar
- Splenda sugar substitute

Instructions:
1. Fill a 2 qt pitcher (that's pitcha in the South) about halfway up with ice.
2. Clip the clothespin onto the side of the pitcher and\"hang\" the tea bags through it (keeps the paper from getting in the tea and makes the bags easier to retrieve- you don't want to be seen with your hand in the pitcher here in the South).
3. Pour the sugar or Splenda on top of the ice cubes and now fill the pitcher up with water.
4. Let sit about an hour, pull out tea bags and serve.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | baking powder | salt | white sugar | milk | egg | butter | vanilla
texte:
Pancake

Instructions:

3. In a small bowl, beat eggs lightly, then add melted butter and beat until mixed, finally lightly beat in milk and vanilla.  Next pour wet ingredients into the well in the large bowl, and mix until smooth.
4. Heat lightly oiled griddle or large frying pan over medium high heat.  Pour 1/4 cup of batter onto frying pan and wait till bubbles form, flip then brown other side and serve.

ingredients_reels: flour | salt | black pepper | butter | margarine | milk | water
texte:
City "Chicken"

- 1 black pepper
- 1 butter
- 1/4 margarine

- 2 water

Instructions:
1. Thread pork cubes onto 4\" bamboo skewers.
2. Combine the flour, salt, and pepper on a plate.
3. Roll skewered pork in flour mixture.
4. Reserve left over flour mixture.
5. Brown meat in butter.
6. Combine the milk, water, and leftover flour mixture.

ingredients_reels: carrot | tamari soy sauce | soy sauce | extra virgin olive oil | parmesan cheese | parsley | roasted sunflower seeds | penne
texte:
Carrot Pasta Sauce

- 1 tamari soy sauce

- 1 parsley

- 8 penne

Instructions:
1. Chop the onions well and saute them in a skillet with the oil for about 10 minutes. Add the grated carrots and cook for other 5-8 minutes adding your soy sauce and a few Tablespoons of the pasta water to keep the sauce moist. When ready puree the sauce in a hand blender and put it back in the skillet.
2. In the meantime cook the pasta as directed and before draining it save few spoons of its water. Add the pasta to the skillet and mix until well combined. Serve the pasta topped with sunflower seeds, parsley, parmesan cheese and a swirl of olive oil.

nom: It's a Gouda!  Hot Ham Sandwich
ingredients_reels: Dijon mustard | mustard | honey | ground cayenne pepper | ham | onions | shallot | gouda cheese
texte:
It's a Gouda!  Hot Ham Sandwich

7. Fold to close sandwich before serving. Enjoy warm or wrap tightly to serve later.

ingredients_reels: milk | active dry yeast | water | butter | molasses | salt | whole wheat flour | bread flour | walnuts
texte:
Whole Wheat-Walnut Bread

Ingredients:
- 1/2 milk
- 1 active dry yeast
- 1 water
- 3 butter
- 2 molasses
- 1 1/2 salt
- 2 whole wheat flour
- 1 1/2 bread flour
- 2 walnuts

Instructions:
1. In large bowl, combine warm milk and yeast; stir to dissolve.
2. Let stand until foamy, about 5 minutes.
3. Stir in warm water, butter, molasses, salt, whole-wheat flour, and 1/2 cup bread flour.
4. Stir in another 3/4 cups bread flour and knead mixture in bowl until a ball forms.
5. Transfer dough to lightly floured surface and knead until is smooth and elastic, 7 to 10 minutes.
6. Add additional flour just to keep dough from sticking.
7. Shape dough into ball and place in greased bowl, turning dough to grease top.
8. Cover with plastic wrap and then a towel and let rise in warm place until doubled in volume (about 1 hour).
9. Punch down dough.
10. Turn it onto lightly floured surface and knead in walnuts.
11. Cut dough in half; cover and let rest for 10 minutes.
12. (Resting makes the dough easier to shape).
13. Grease two large cookie sheets.
14. Shape each dough half into an oval and place on cookie sheets.
15. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and let rise until doubled (about 45 minutes).
16. With sharp knife or razor blade, cut three slashes across the tops of loaves.
17. Preheat oven to 375°F.
18. Lightly dust loaves with flour.
19. Bake until loaves sound hollow when tapped on bottom, about 30 minutes.
20. Transfer to rack to cool.

ingredients_reels: honey | sugar

ingredients_reels: zucchini | garlic cloves | extra virgin olive oil | salt | fresh ground black pepper | fresh basil | fresh parsley
texte:
Zucchini Marinata (Marinated Zucchini Salad)

Ingredients:

Instructions:
1. Note: It is your choice to peel or not peel the zuchhini.

3. Cover bowl and refrigerate 4-8 hours, stirring occasionally.
4. Once you are ready to serve the salad, remove the garlic cloves. Save one garlic clove, finely minced and toss back into the salad along with the fresh herb of choice. *Important*: stir in the fresh herbs with the zucchini mixture [just] before serving.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | white sugar | baking powder | banana | milk | unsalted butter | egg | vanilla extract | light muscovado sugar | golden syrup | vanilla ice cream

Banana Caramel Self Saucing Pudding

ingredients_reels: lumpia skins | ground beef | ground pork | green onion | carrot | celery | egg | soy sauce | ground pepper | flour | water
texte:
Lumpia (Filipino Egg Roll)

Ingredients:
- 1 lumpia skins
- 1/2 ground beef
- 1/2 ground pork
- 1 green onion
- 1 carrot
- 1 celery
- 1 egg
- 4 soy sauce
- 1/2 ground pepper
- 1/4 flour
- 1/4 water

Instructions:
1. Brown beef and pork, until almost completely cooked. Drain fat. Cool and process in food processor or chop up into fine pieces (like Taco Bell taco meat or a little coarser) with fork.
2. Combine meats, vegetables, egg, sauces, pepper in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 1 hour for flavors to set inches I like to prepare my filling the day before so it can marinate all night.
3. Prepare wrapper (by separating) and place on a separate plate. Place 1 to 2 T of filling in the center of the wrapper.
4. Fold left edge over all the way, then bring down top and bottom, then roll the rest of the way to the right, making a roll. hard to explain without a picture, but you'll figure it out -- looks like an egg roll when done, only thinner and longer.  Seal with with flour and water mixture.
5. After you have assembled all the lumpia, heat your oil (I use the deep fryer) to 375 degrees. Cook until golden brown, turning often, approximately 3 minutes. Drain on paper towels.
6. Serve with sweet and sour sauce.
7. Note: the wrapper packages usually have instructions for rolling the wrap. Times vary by experience and methods used.

ingredients_reels: whole wheat flour | water | tap water | salt | whole wheat flour | butter
texte:
Roti / Phulkas

Ingredients:
- 2 whole wheat flour
- 1 water
- tap water
- 2 salt
- whole wheat flour
- butter

Instructions:
1. Put the flour in a mound on a kneading surface.
2. Make a well in the centre and add salt into it.
3. Then adding a little water at a time incorporate it into the flour and knead the flour into a soft smooth dough with water (a finger pushed in presses without much pressure) Then coat it with the oil and leave to rest for 30 minutes covered in a damp cloth.
4. Shape into smooth a little bigger than walnut sized balls/ medium lemon sized balls (You can go bigger too if this seems like too much of trouble as the lesser the size the more rolls) Roll these into a ball between your palms well to make sure there are no cracks.
5. Flatten a bit between your palms.
6. Coat with flour on both sides.
7. On a well dusted surface, roll these into 1/8” thick rounds which should be around 6 inches in diameter.
8. (Keep the pressure while rolling as light as possible and soon you with practise the roti starts rotating with the rolling pin movement and you do not have to turn it manually to get a perfect circle).
9. Place on a plate with butter paper between each.
10. Place the griddle over the fire, and heat till a drop of water thrown over it, evaporates immediately with a sizzling sound.
11. Place a rolled chapatti over the hot griddle for around 10-15 secs.
12. till flecks appear on the underside.
13. Lower flame and turn over and cook for 40 secs or so.
14. With practice you can use this time to roll out the next ball so you do not need to roll them all out to start with.
15. As soon as brown flecks appear on the underside again increase the flame to full and remove the tava and turn the roti over.
16. Now slide the tava out and with a pair of metal tongs place the lesser cooked side over the nakes flame.
17. The roti will puff out immediately like a ball.
18. Turn to the other side of neceesary (I don't as the fine rotis should cook).
19. Take off the flame and brush with a drop of ghee/ butter immediately (if using) Now on the high flame put the tava back on and the next roll.
20. Proceed to finish the whole lot.
21. Alternatively if you are not comfortable with cooking on a direct flame: When you cook the second side on low for 40 secs.
22. Flip over on the tava itself.
23. Put on high and use a cloth towel to press the roti down at various points.
24. It should fluff up this way too.
25. Steam the rotis wrapped in foil to reheat.
26. or roast on griddle but this takes away the softness.
27. Note: The remaining unused dough should be refrigerated (not frozen) in a plastic bag for use later (but please use within a couple of days.
