- 1/4 cumin
- 1/4 salt
- 1/4 black pepper

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Peel carrots and cut julienne-style (into 2\" long x 1/4\" wide strips) or slice thin.
3. Place carrots and other ingredients into a 9\" x 13\" baking pan and toss to combine thoroughly.
4. Spread out into a thin layer.
5. Roast for 15 minutes.  Remove pan from oven, toss carrots and spread out into a thin layer.  Roast for another 15 minutes or until carrots are tender.

ingredients_reels: all-purpose flour | granulated sugar | salt | unsalted butter | dried cranberries
texte:
Cranberry Shortbread

Ingredients:
- 2 1/2 all-purpose flour
- 1/2 granulated sugar
- 1/4 salt
- 1 unsalted butter
- 1/2 dried cranberries

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees F.
2. Stir together flour, sugar & salt, then cut in butter until mixture resembles fine crumbs.
3. Stir in cranberries, then form into a ball & knead until smooth.
4. Divide dough in half.
5. On a lightly floured surface, pat or roll each dough portion to a 1/2-inch thickness.
6. Use a knife & cut into 24 2\"x1\" strips, then place these strips 1 inch apart on an ungreased baking sheet.
7. Bake 20-26 minutes or until bottoms just start to brown.
8. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then remove & cool completely on wire rack.

ingredients_reels: fresh yeast | milk | flour | butter | egg | salt | sugar | onion | bacon | creme fraiche | eggs | pepper | nutmeg
texte:
Zwiebelkuchen ( Southwest German Onion Cake)

Ingredients:
- 25 fresh yeast
- 1/4 milk
- 375 flour
- 60 butter
- 1 egg
- 1/8 salt
- 1/8 sugar
- 1 onion
- 150 bacon
- 500 creme fraiche
- 4 eggs
- 1/8 pepper
- 1/8 nutmeg

Instructions:
1. For the dough:
2. Dissolve the yeast in the lukewarm milk, and add the sugar and a dash of the flour, stir, cover and keep in a warm place for ten minutes.
3. Add the rest of the dough ingredients in the pastry mixer and blend until you have a ball.
4. Cover and keep in a warm place for twenty minutes until the dough rises.
5. Preheat the oven to 225°C.
6. Sautée the onion'rings' with the bacon in a large skillet, until the onions are transparent, and soft, but not caramelized.
7. This should take about 10-15 minutes.
8. In a seperate bowl, mix the eggs, the creme fraiche, the nutmeg, and pepper together with a whisk until well incorporated and smooth.
9. Roll the dough out into a flat, large roasting pan (you want something with a slight edge to it) and then pour the onion and bacon mixture over the dough and spread it out to cover the dough evenly.
10. Pour the egg-creme fraich mixture over the top and put it in the oven for 30-40 minutes, or until golden brown on top.

ingredients_reels: active dry yeast | granulated sugar | warm water | all-purpose flour | kosher salt | extra virgin olive oil
texte:
Cuisinart Food Processor Pizza Dough

Ingredients:
- 2 active dry yeast
- 1 granulated sugar
- 1 1/4 warm water
- 3 1/3 all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 kosher salt
- 3 extra virgin olive oil

Instructions:
1. In a 2 cup liquid measure, dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water. Let stand until foamy, about 3-5 minutes. Insert dough blade in work bowl and add flour, salt and 2 teaspoons olive oil.
2. With machine running on dough speed, pour liquid through small feed tube as fast as flour will absorb it. Process until dough cleans sides of work bowl and forms a ball. Then process for 30 seconds to knead dough, which may be slightly sticky. Coat dough evenly with 2 teaspoons olive oil; transfer to a plastic food storage bag and seal the top. Let rise in a warm place for about 45 minutes. While dough is rising , prepare any pizza toppings.
3. Place dough on a lightly floured surface and punch down. Roll into desired crust sizes.

ingredients_reels: frozen raspberries | sugar | cornstarch | maple syrup
texte:
Raspberry Topping for Cheesecake

Ingredients:
- 1 frozen raspberries
- 2 sugar
- 2 cornstarch
- 1/3 maple syrup

Instructions:
1. Drain defrosted raspberries- reserving liquid.
2. Add water to the liquid, if needed to measure 1/2 cup.
3. In a small saucepan, combine sugar and cornstarch, add berry liquid and maple syrup.
4. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture boils and thickens, boil 1 minute.
5. Stir in raspberries and cool to room temperature before serving.

ingredients_reels: potatoes | fresh parsley leaves | olive oil | salt | garlic clove
texte:
Dalmatian Boiled Potato

Ingredients:
- 300 potatoes
- 10 fresh parsley leaves
- 1 olive oil
- 3 salt
- 1 garlic clove

Instructions:
1. If you use baby potato just “shave” the skin, otherwise, peal potato and cut into 5 cm large pieces.
2. Cook in salted water until soft.
3. Put olive oil, finely minced garlic and parsley in pot, add well strained potato and stir. Leave it on fire not more than one minute stirring all the time to cover potato with garlic and parsley. Serve hot with fish.

ingredients_reels: lemons | sugar | water
texte:
The Best Ever Lemonade

Ingredients:
- 6 lemons
- 1 sugar
- 6 water

Instructions:
1. Scrub the lemons well and cut into halves.  Place into a large heat resistant pitcher.  Add the sugar.
2. Bring the water to a boil in a saucepan.  Pour it over the lemons, stirring to dissolve the sugar.  Cool for 20 minutes.  Squeeze the juice from the lemons into the pitcher and discard the lemons.  Strain the lemonade into another pitcher and chill until serving time.
3. Serve over ice in tall glasses with a garnish of mint.  Add a dash of grenadine for pink lemonade.

ingredients_reels: butter | lemon | garlic cloves | avocados | potatoes | salt | pepper
texte:
Avocado Mashed Potatoes

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 1 lemon
- 2 garlic cloves
- 2 avocados
- 1 1/2 potatoes
- salt
- pepper

Instructions:
1. Peel and quarter the potatoes, then wash them thoroughly.
2. Place the potatoes in a large pot with enough cold, salted water to cover them and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 min, or until cooked through, and drain.
3. Meanwhile put butter, lemon and garlic in a saucepan over very, very low. Let it simmer for 20-30 minutes. Discard lemon and garlic.
4. Gently mash the avocado.
5. When potatoes are done, drain and mashed to your liking. Fold in avocado and butter.
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
7. If you like creamer mashed potatoes, you can add some milk.

nom: Oven Fried Bacon - No Mess, No Cleanup!
ingredients_reels: bacon | pepper
texte:
Oven Fried Bacon - No Mess, No Cleanup!

Ingredients:
- 8 bacon
- 1/2 pepper

Instructions:
1. Use a 4 sided pan like a jelly roll pan.
2. Line pan with tinfoil.
3. Fold parchment paper to fit over tinfoil in pan. Must use parchment paper & line the pan for easy cleanup, important step!
4. Set oven to 400*.
5. After lining pan lay strips of bacon on parchment paper.
6. Put in preheated 400* for 15 minutes, I turn bacon over after 10 minutes.
7. Take out when crispy & lay on paper towels.
8. When pan cools roll up tinfoil & parchment paper & throw away, no pan to wash!

ingredients_reels: boneless skinless chicken breast | extra virgin olive oil | fettuccine pasta | heavy cream | butter | garlic | cornstarch | broccoli floret | parmesan cheese | black pepper | salt
texte:
Chicken Con Broccoli (Olive Garden style)

Ingredients:
- 1 boneless skinless chicken breast
- 2 extra virgin olive oil
- 4 1/2 fettuccine pasta
- 1 heavy cream
- 2 butter
- 2 garlic
- 2 cornstarch
- 1 broccoli floret
- 2 parmesan cheese
- black pepper
- salt

Instructions:
1. First, cook the Broccoli.
2. In a medium saucepan, cook the chicken in the olive oil, letting each side brown.
3. Leave remaining oil drippings in pan, setting the chicken aside for now.
4. In salted walter, boil the pasta, not quite all the way, (it will be simmered later).
5. Drain the pasta, and place it back into pot.
6. In the remaining olive oil from chicken, over medium, brown the garlic.
7. When caremelized, add the heavy cream & cornstarch and stir well.
8. Stir once in a while, allowing the sauce to thicken.
9. When prepared, add the sauce to the pasta combining fettuccini pasta.
10. Chop the chicken into cubes, toss in into pasta, add broccoi.
11. Combine well, add in salt and pepper and the cheese.
12. Enjoy!
13. Remember, this is 4 servings, you may double.

ingredients_reels: pecans | walnuts | flour | sugar | butter | cream cheese | sugar | fresh strawberries
texte:
Strawberry Cream Torte

Ingredients:
- 1/2 pecans
- 1 1/2 walnuts
- 2 flour
- 3/4 sugar
- 8 butter
- 1/2 cream cheese
- 1 sugar
- 3 fresh strawberries

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 325° degrees F.
2. Place nuts in a food processor and pulse until chopped fine; add flour and sugar; When well blended, add the cold butter, two tablespoons at a time; Remove from processor and spread in a spring form pan, pushing the mixture one inch up the sides of the pan.
3. Bake 30 to 40 minutes until golden; Remove from oven and cool.
4. Place cream cheese and sugar in a mixing bowl and beat on high speed until fluffy and well blended.
5. While the motor is still running, add small amounts of the whipping cream in a steady small stream into the cheese mixture, NOT TOO FAST, or the mixture will be too runny.
6. When well blended, spread the cream mixture evenly into the baked, cooled crust (At this point, it can be covered and chilled up to 24 hours.).
7. When ready to serve, place halved strawberries on top of the chilled cream mixture, remove the spring form pan rim, slice and serve.

ingredients_reels: garlic cloves | salt | extra virgin olive oil | yogurt | potato
texte:
Thum -- Garlic Sauce (Lebanon -- Middle East)

Ingredients:
- 5 garlic cloves
- 1/8 salt
- 1/3 extra virgin olive oil
- 4 yogurt
- 1 potato

Instructions:
1. In a mortar & pounding with a pestle, work the garlic cloves & a little salt until reduced to a very fine paste.
2. Drizzle in the oil very slowly, stirring constantly to blend well.
3. If you don't want the sauce to be as strong as this will be, add some yogurt and/or mashed potato & blend well before serving.

ingredients_reels: boneless skinless chicken breasts | water
texte:
Cooking Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast

Ingredients:
- 6 boneless skinless chicken breasts
- 8 -10 water

Instructions:
1. Trim  excess fat from boneless skinless chicken breast and place in large sauce pan.
2. Cover with water and bring to a boil.
3. Let water boil for 2-3 minutes and turn off burner.
4. Cover with lid  for 1 minute and remove cover.
5. Let chicken sit in hot water for 20 minutes (with fire OFF).
6. After 20 minutes chicken will be done and ready use.
7. Allow to cool until chicken can be handled and cut-up as needed for recipe.
8. I use this chicken for my chicken spaghetti, chicken enchiladas, poppyseed chicken, and salads.   (or any recipe  that calls for cooked chicken).

nom: My Kids Favourite Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients_reels: butter | brown sugar | eggs | hot water | all-purpose flour | baking powder | salt | chocolate chips
texte:
My Kids Favourite Chocolate Chip Cookies

Ingredients:
- 2/3 butter
- 2 brown sugar
- 2 eggs
- 2 hot water
- 2 2/3 all-purpose flour
- 2 baking powder
- 1/4 salt
- 1 chocolate chips

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F.
2. Beat the butter, brown sugar, eggs and hot water.
3. Mix in the flour, baking powder and salt until well blended.
4. Stir in the chocolate chips.
5. Drop from a teaspoon or form into 1\" balls.
6. Place 2-inches apart on an ungreased shiny cookie sheet (the insulated kinds work the best) Bake for 8 to 9 minutes.

ingredients_reels: potatoes | water | olive oil | onions | garlic cloves | anaheim chilies | soymilk | low-fat milk | ground cumin | dried basil | garlic clove | salt | pepper | scallion | cilantro
texte:
Potato and Chile Soup

Ingredients:
- 4 potatoes
- 3 water
- 1 olive oil
- 1 1/2 onions
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1 1/2 anaheim chilies
- 1 1/2 soymilk
- 1 low-fat milk
- 1 ground cumin
- 1 dried basil
- 1 garlic clove
- salt
- pepper
- scallion
- cilantro

Instructions:
1. Cut cleaned and unpeeled potatoes into large cubes (about 1 to 1 1/2 inches). Bring water and potatoes to a low boil, cooking until the potatoes are tender.
2. While potatoes are cooking, place oil and onions in a skillet and cook until onions are cooked soft and translucent but not brown.   Add peppers, cumin, basil and garlic and continue cooking until peppers are tender, about 6-9 minutes.
3. Place potatoes and three quarters of the water into a blender or food processor, reserving the remaining water.  Blend until smooth.
4. Return processed potatoes to pot, adding peppers and milk.  Use reserved water to thin the soup further if desired.  Warm over low heat until it is ready to serve.
5. Garnish with scallions or cilantro if desired.

ingredients_reels: water | cinnamon stick | green cardamom pods | whole cloves | star anise | fresh ginger | black tea | honey | half-and-half
texte:
Aarti's Party Chai Tea

Ingredients:
- 2 water
- 1 cinnamon stick
- 4 green cardamom pods
- 4 whole cloves
- 1/2 star anise
- 2 fresh ginger
- 2 black tea
- 2 honey
- half-and-half

Instructions:
1. In a medium saucepan, bring the water, all of the spices and the ginger to a boil over medium heat. Turn off the heat and allow it to steep for 15 minutes.
2. Bring the mixture back to a boil, then add the tea. Turn the heat off, and allow it to steep for 3 to 5 minutes depending on how strong you like your tea.
3. Stir in the honey and add milk to your liking. Strain it into a bowl or pitcher and serve!
4. Enjoy!

ingredients_reels: lean ground beef | onion | diced tomatoes | kidney beans | tomato sauce | elbow macaroni | chili powder | salt | ground cayenne pepper | paprika
texte:
Speedy Chili With Macaroni

Ingredients:
- 1 lean ground beef
- 1 onion
- 1 diced tomatoes
- 1 kidney beans
- 1 tomato sauce
- 1 elbow macaroni
- 2 -4 chili powder
- 1 salt
- 1/8 ground cayenne pepper
- 1/8 paprika

Instructions:
1. Preheat skillet to 350°F.
2. Spray skillet with vegetable spray.
3. Add ground beef and onions and cook until beef is no longer pink.
4. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
5. Cover and reduce heat to simmer for 20 to 30 minutes.

ingredients_reels: seedless grapes | sugar | water | cinnamon stick | star anise | whole cloves | black peppercorns
texte:
Spiced Grapes

Ingredients:
- 1 seedless grapes
- 1 sugar
- 1 water
- 1 cinnamon stick
- 2 star anise
- 5 whole cloves
- 12 black peppercorns

Instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients except grapes in a small saucepan and boil for two to three minutes.
2. Pierce each grape two to three times with a sharp skewer or toothpick.
3. Place grapes in a small bowl and cover with the syrup mixture.
4. Refrigerate for 24 to 36 hours.
5. Serve with cheese or nuts.

ingredients_reels: potatoes | chicken broth | olive oil | garlic cloves | lemon | oregano | garlic powder | black pepper | cayenne pepper | bay leaf | salt
texte:
Greek Lemon Potatoes

Ingredients:
- 2 potatoes
- 1/2 chicken broth
- 1/4 olive oil
- 4 garlic cloves
- 1 lemon
- 1 1/2 oregano
- 1/2 garlic powder
- 1/2 black pepper
- 1/4 cayenne pepper
- 1 bay leaf
- salt

Instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large zip lock bag.  Let marinate all day in the fridge or until you're ready to start cooking!
2. Pour all of mixture, including liquids on a large rimmed baking sheet lined with foil and sprayed generously with cooking spray.
3. Roast potatoes at 400 degrees for 1 hour, or until golden brown and crunchy, stirring every 20 minutes.  (I live at high altitude, so mine take longer).

nom: Double Coated Chicken With Corn Flakes
ingredients_reels: corn | egg | nonfat milk | flour | salt | pepper | chicken pieces | margarine | butter | garlic powder
texte:
Double Coated Chicken With Corn Flakes

Ingredients:
- 1 3/4 corn
- 1 egg
- 1 nonfat milk
- 1 flour
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 pepper
- 3 chicken pieces
- 3 margarine
- 2 butter
- 1 garlic powder

Instructions:
1. Place corn flakes in a shallow bowl and set aside.
2. In a medium mixing bowl, beat egg and milk and mix slightly. Add flour, salt and pepper. Mix until smooth.
3. Dip chicken in batter and roll in crumbs. Place in a shallow pan lined with foil or sprayed with Pam. Drizzle with margarine.
4. Bake uncovered and do not turn chicken at 350 for about 45-60 minutes.

ingredients_reels: sweet potatoes | sugar | sweetened condensed milk | milk | eggs | ground cinnamon | ground allspice | ground cloves | vanilla extract | coconut
texte:
Sweet Potato Flan

Ingredients:
- 2 sweet potatoes
- 3/4 sugar
- 2 sweetened condensed milk
- 2 milk
- 10 eggs
- 1 ground cinnamon
- 1/2 ground allspice
- 1/4 ground cloves
- 1 vanilla extract
- coconut

Instructions:
1. Pierce sweet potatoes several times with a fork; place on a baking sheet.
2. Bake at 375* for 1 hour or until done; cool to touch.
3. Peel sweet potatoes, and mash.
4. Set aside 1 cup mashed sweet potatoes; reserve any remaining sweet potatoes for another use.
5. Sprinkle sugar in a 10-inch round cakepan; place over medium heat, and cook, shaking pan constantly, until sugar melts and turns a light golden brown.
6. Remove from heat, and set aside.
7. (Melted sugar may crack slightly as it cools).
8. Combine half of sweet potatoes, 1 can sweetened condensed milk, and half of next 6 ingredients in container of an electric blender; blend until smooth, stopping once to scrape down sides.
9. Pour mixture into a large bowl.
10. Repeat procedure; add to bowl, stirring well with a wire whisk.
11. Pour mixture over caramelized sugar in cakepan; cover with aluminum foil, and place in a larger shallow pan.
12. Add hot water to larger pan to depth of 1/2 inch.
13. Bake at 325* for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean.
14. Remove cakepan from water, and uncover; cool in pan on a wire rack 30 minutes.
15. Refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.
16. Loosen edges of flan from pan with a small knife; invert onto a serving plate.
17. Garnish, if desired, with toasted coconut.
18. Yield: 1 (10-inch) flan.

ingredients_reels: chicken parts | salt | fresh ground black pepper | unsalted butter | onion | garlic cloves | dried thyme | cognac | brandy | dry red wine | chicken broth | bacon | tiny new potatoes | mushroom | fresh parsley
texte:
Chicken Grand-Mere

Ingredients:
- 12 chicken parts
- salt
- 1/4 fresh ground black pepper
- 3 unsalted butter
- 1 onion
- 1 garlic cloves
- 2 dried thyme
- 1 cognac
- 1/4 brandy
- 3/4 dry red wine
- 3/4 chicken broth
- 1/2 bacon
- 1 tiny new potatoes
- 1 mushroom
- 3 fresh parsley

Instructions:
1. Pat chicken dry; sprinkle with salt and pepper.
2. Heat 1 T. butter and the oil in Dutch oven or deep 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat.  Add several pieces chicken and brown on all sides, about 10 minutes.  Transfer chicken to platter and repeat with remaining pieces.
3. Reduce heat to medium; add onion, garlic, and thyme.  Saute until onion is softened, about 5 minutes.  Pour off all but 1 T. fat.  Carefully pour Cognac into pan and scrape bottom of pan to loosen browned bits.  Return chicken to pan, placing breasts on top.  Pour in wine and broth and heat to boiling.  Reduce heat to low and simmer covered until chicken is tender, 30-40 minutes.
4. Transfer chicken to warmed serving platter; cover with foil and keep warm.  Cook sauce over medium-high heat until reduced by almost half, 12-15 minutes.
5. Meanwhile, fry bacon in separate large skillet over medium heat, until golden, about 8 minutes.
6. While bacon is cooking, cut potatoes into 3/4-inch dice and add to bacon in skillet.  Fry, stirring frequently, until golden, 5-7 minutes.  Using slotted spoon, remove bacon and potatoes to bowl.
7. Add mushrooms to skillet.  Cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 3-4 minutes.  Add mushrooms to potatoes.
8. Spoon off fat from sauce.  Add mushrooms, potatoes, and bacon and stir to coat.  Reduce heat to low and simmer until hot, 1-2 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in half the parsley and the remaining 2 T. butter.  Taste and adjust seasonings.  Pour sauce over chicken.  Sprinkle with remaining parsley and serve hot.

ingredients_reels: granulated sugar | butter | milk | flour | baking powder | salt | berries | granulated sugar | butter | boiling water
texte:
Old Fashion Berry Cobbler

4. Bake at 425°F for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

ingredients_reels: brown sugar | all-purpose flour | baking powder | salt | raisins | milk | nutmeg | butter | boiling water
texte:
Quick Raisin Pudding

Greyhound

texte:
Pecan Squares

1. Crust: Preheat oven to 350°F Grease a 9 x 12 inch baking pan.

Carrie's Beautiful Bread (ABM)

ingredients_reels: honey | eggs | flour | baking powder
texte:
Ukrainian Honey Cake

Ingredients:
- 1 honey
- 4 eggs
- 1 1/2 flour
- 1 baking powder

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375 F, and butter and flour a 7\" cake pan.
2. Beat honey until frothy.  Add eggs, flour and baking powder.
3. Pour into prepared cake pan.  Bake for 15 minutes and check the cake.  When done, it will shrink slightly from the pan. Continue baking for 5 minutes if it isn't ready yet. (continue if it needs more time).
4. Turn it out of the pan while still hot, and let cool on a rack.  Store in an airtight container for a day before serving.
